scripts.text:
[Teleport Cat]
What a nice day, isn't it!
Welcome to Cat Merchant Group. We do anything to please our customers. We would even lie on our back if you want!
scripts.translation:
[传送猫]
今天天气真好，不是吗！
欢迎来到猫咪商会。我们愿意做任何事来取悦顾客。如果您愿意，我们甚至可以躺在地上！

scripts.text:
[Teleport Cat]
We provide teleport service between various regions based on our accumulated knowledge. We accept Malangdo Canned Specialties or Zeny, so you can pay however you like it~
scripts.translation:
[传送猫]
我们根据积累的知识，提供各地区之间的传送服务。我们接受马拉甘多罐头特产或Zeny，您可以选择自己喜欢的支付方式~

scripts.text:
[Teleport Cat]
I'll see you later then.
scripts.translation:
[传送猫]
那我先走了，回头见。

scripts.text:
[Teleport Cat]
I'm afraid it's not enough. Sorry, but it can't be done for free~
scripts.translation:
[传送猫]
恐怕不够呢。抱歉，不能免费使用哦~

scripts.text:
[Teleport Cat]
I'm afraid it's not enough. Sorry, but it can't be done for free~
scripts.translation:
[传送猫]
恐怕不够呢。抱歉，不能免费使用哦~

scripts.text:
[Security Guard]
Please wait a minute.
All first-time visitors to Eclage must fill out the necessary forms before entering.
scripts.translation:
[保安]
请稍等。
所有首次前往埃克拉珠的访客，都必须填写必要的表格后才能进入。

scripts.text:
[Security Guard]
All first-time visitors to Eclage must fill out the necessary forms here before entering.
scripts.translation:
[保安]
所有首次前往埃克拉珠的访客，都必须在这里填写必要的表格后才能进入。

scripts.text:
[Security Guard]
Great, you completed the forms.
Welcome to Eclage, the capital of the Laphines.
scripts.translation:
[保安]
很好，您已填好表格。
欢迎来到拉菲尼丝的首都——埃克拉珠。

scripts.text:
[Security Guard]
Welcome to Eclage, the capital of the Laphines.
scripts.translation:
[保安]
欢迎来到拉菲尼丝的首都——埃克拉珠。

scripts.text:
[Security Guard]
Please submit your forms to the administrator over there after writing in your name, occupation, and level.
There may be some waiting time, so take your time.
scripts.translation:
[保安]
请填写您的姓名、职业和等级，然后将表格交给那边的管理员。
可能需要等待一段时间，请慢慢来。

scripts.text:
[Security Guard]
Please understand because of a recent increase in the influx of people from Midgard through Bifrost, we had to create this process.
scripts.translation:
[保安]
由于最近通过双层牛肉堡从米德加尔特涌入的人流增加，我们不得不设立这一流程，请谅解。

scripts.text:
[Security Guard]
Of course, the documents will be secured away after their use in access regulations, so you don't have to worry.
scripts.translation:
[保安]
当然，文件在用于准入管理后会被妥善保管，您不必担心。

scripts.text: Fill out the forms.
scripts.translation: 填写表格

scripts.text: Forget it.
scripts.translation: 算了。

scripts.text:
[Security Guard]
Please note that you would not be able to enter the city without filling out the forms.
scripts.translation:
[保安]
请注意，如果不填写表格，您将无法进入城市。

scripts.text:
[Security Guard]
Please fill out your name, occupation, and level here.
scripts.translation:
[保安]
请在这里填写您的姓名、职业和等级。

scripts.text: Write your name.
scripts.translation: 填写您的姓名。

scripts.text: Write your occupation.
scripts.translation: 填写您的职业。

scripts.text: Write your level.
scripts.translation: 填写您的等级。

scripts.text:
[Security Guard]
If you completed your forms, please submit them to the administrator over there.
There may be some waiting time, so take your time.
scripts.translation:
[保安]
如果您已填好表格，请将其交给那边的管理员。
可能需要等待一段时间，请慢慢来。

scripts.text:
[Security Guard]
Since Eclage is under the influence of Bifrost, there is fluent communication among the races.
scripts.translation:
[保安]
由于埃克拉珠受到双层牛肉堡的影响，各种族之间的交流非常顺畅。

scripts.text:
[Security Guard]
There would be no need for any separate translation, and there are enough bridges for on-foot races, so I hope you have a comfortable visit.
scripts.translation:
[保安]
不需要单独的翻译，而且也有足够的桥梁供步行种族使用，希望您能度过愉快的旅程。

scripts.text:
[Security Guard]
Since Eclage is under the influence of Bifrost, there is fluent communication among the races.
scripts.translation:
[保安]
由于埃克拉珠受到双层牛肉堡的影响，各种族之间的交流非常顺畅。

scripts.text:
[Security Guard]
There would be no need for any separate translation, and there are enough bridges for on-foot races, so I hope you have a comfortable visit.
scripts.translation:
[保安]
不需要单独的翻译，而且也有足够的桥梁供步行种族使用，希望您能度过愉快的旅程。

scripts.text:
[Immigration Officer]
There's still a lot of people before you. Could you please wait until your turn?
It won't be too long.
scripts.translation:
[入境官员]
您前面还有很多人，请等到轮到您时再来。
不会太久的。

scripts.text:
[Immigration Officer]
Whew! I'm sorry to have kept you waiting.
There are just too many visitors.
scripts.translation:
[入境官员]
呼！抱歉让您久等了。
游客实在太多了。

scripts.text:
[Immigration Officer]
Alright, next person in line please!
Next!
Next person!
scripts.translation:
[入境官员]
好的，下一位请上前！
下一位！
下一位！

scripts.text:
[Immigration Officer]
What do you need?
As you can see, I'm really busy here, so unless you need something, please don't bother me.
scripts.translation:
[入境官员]
您有什么事？
如您所见，我这里非常忙，如果没有急事，请不要打扰我。

scripts.text:
[Immigration Officer]
Oh wow, this is just so crazy.
{0} Here, your documents are processed.
You may enter the city when you go talk to the security guard.
scripts.translation:
[入境官员]
哇，这也太疯狂了。
{0}，您的文件已处理完毕。
请去和保安交谈后即可进入城市。

scripts.text:
[Immigration Officer]
So if you will place your forms here...
scripts.translation:
[入境官员]
那么，如果您把表格放在这里...

scripts.text:
[???]
Here!! These are my completed forms!!
This time it's all good, right?
Let me through quick!
scripts.translation:
[???]
在这里！！这是我填好的表格！！
这次应该没问题了吧？
快点让我过去！

scripts.text:
[Immigration Officer]
I'm taking care of visitors in the order they arrived, so please wait for your turn.
scripts.translation:
[入境官员]
我是按照到达顺序处理游客的，所以请等待轮到您。

scripts.text:
[???]
What are you talking about!
I was waaaay before all of these guys!
scripts.translation:
[???]
你在说什么！
我明明比这些人都早到！

scripts.text:
[Immigration Officer]
Well, your turn was delayed because you had to fill out your forms, so you have to wait until later.
scripts.translation:
[入境官员]
嗯，因为您之前需要填写表格，所以您的轮次被推迟了，您必须等到后面。

scripts.text:
[???]
What?! You just said you take care of visitors in the order they arrived!!!
scripts.translation:
[???]
什么？！你刚才不是说按照到达顺序处理游客的吗！！！

scripts.text:
[Immigration Officer]
Yes, I did say that but...
scripts.translation:
[入境官员]
是的，我确实那样说了，但是...

scripts.text: - SMACK!!! -

[???]
OW!! Why did you hit me?
scripts.translation:
[???]
痛！！你为什么要打我？

scripts.text:
[???]
I'm so sorry.
My stupid friend here is causing trouble.
scripts.translation:
[???]
非常抱歉。
是我这个笨蛋朋友在惹麻烦。

scripts.text:
[???]
Who are you calling stupid?!
scripts.translation:
[???]
你谁啊，说谁笨蛋呢？！

scripts.text:
[???]
If you hadn't filled out my name incorrectly in the first place, we wouldn't be waiting like this!
scripts.translation:
[???]
如果你一开始没有把我的名字填错，我们就不会在这里等这么久了！

scripts.text:
[???]
Mark Esha or Madrid, they're all the same!
scripts.translation:
[???]
马克·艾沙还是马德里，反正都一样！

scripts.text:
[Mark Esha]
They're not at all the same!
And what's more, how can you not know the name of your friend of 15 years?
scripts.translation:
[马克·艾沙]
完全不一样！
而且，你怎么会连认识15年的朋友的名字都不知道？

scripts.text:
[???]
It's not that I didn't know- I did it on purpose!!
Madrid is just fine! Madrid!
scripts.translation:
[???]
不是我不知道-我是故意的！！
马德里就很好！马德里！

scripts.text: - SMACK -

[Mark Esha]
Hu... I am so sorry that my friend is this stupid.
Please don't mind us and do what you need to do.
scripts.translation:
[马克·艾沙]
呜...真抱歉，我的朋友这么笨。
请别介意我们，继续做您需要做的事吧。

scripts.text:
[???]
AHHHH!!!
LET ME IN!!!!
How long do I have to wait out here!!!
scripts.translation:
[???]
啊啊啊！！！
让我进去！！！！
我还要在外面等多久啊！！！

scripts.text:
[Mark Esha]
Would you stay put just for a second?!!!
Sorry. So sorry.
scripts.translation:
[马克·艾沙]
你就不能老实待一会儿吗？！！
抱歉。真的非常抱歉。

scripts.text:
[Immigration Officer]
Oh wow, this is just so crazy.
{0} Here, your documents are processed.
You may enter the city when you go talk to the security guard.
scripts.translation:
[入境官员]
哇，这也太疯狂了。
{0}，您的文件已处理完毕。
请去和保安交谈后即可进入城市。

scripts.text:
[???]
Shuffle, shuffle
scripts.translation:
[???]
挪动，挪动

scripts.text:
[Immigration Officer]
And Mr. Deu Lean, please take your group and enter. It's just way too noisy.
scripts.translation:
[入境官员]
还有杜连先生，请带着您的队伍进去吧。这里实在太吵了。

scripts.text:
[Du Lian]
Mwahah!!
SEE THAT?!
Thanks to me, we got through faster!
scripts.translation:
[杜连]
哇哈哈！！
看到了吗？！
多亏了我，我们才过得更快！

scripts.text:
[Mark Esha]
You mean slower...
scripts.translation:
[马克·艾沙]
你是说更慢...

scripts.text:
[Du Lian]
A real man does not get bogged down by the past!!
I may have been slow with the documentation but I will be the one to enter Eclage first!
Mwahah!
scripts.translation:
[杜连]
真正的男子汉不会被过去束缚！！
虽然我在办理文件时慢了点，但我一定会第一个进入埃克拉珠！
哇哈哈！

scripts.text:
[Mark Esha]
......Whew
I'm so sorry for everything.
scripts.translation:
[马克·艾沙]
......呼
对不起，发生了这么多事。

scripts.text:
[???]
Well......
Mr. Mark, Mr. Du is already gone.
scripts.translation:
[???]
嗯......
马克先生，杜先生已经走了。

scripts.text:
[Mark Esha]
My goodness......
scripts.translation:
[马克·艾沙]
天哪......

scripts.text:
[Immigration Officer]
Ack...
I don't think it's all for the best to have so many visitors.
scripts.translation:
[入境官员]
唉...
我觉得这么多游客涌入，未必全是好事。

scripts.text:
[Tourist]
I can't believe I have to wait this long......
When is it going to be my turn?
scripts.translation:
[游客]
真不敢相信我要等这么久......
什么时候才轮到我？

scripts.text:
[Tourist]
I'm actually done with my documentation, but I'm just sticking around to appreciate all of these flowers.
scripts.translation:
[游客]
其实我的文件已经办好了，但我只是想留下来欣赏这些花。

scripts.text:
[Tourist]
I'm just getting through the night with my sleeping bag!
It's alright as long as you can withstand the security guard's annoyance with you.
scripts.translation:
[游客]
我就带着睡袋在这里过夜了！
只要你能忍受保安对你的唠叨，这就没问题。

scripts.text:
[Tourist]
I wonder how beautiful of a city Eclage would be.
It just makes my heart beat thinking about it.
scripts.translation:
[游客]
不知道埃克拉珠这座城市有多美。
光是想想就让我心跳加速。

scripts.text:
[Tourist]
No, I'm not a visitor. I'm an Eclage citizen!
scripts.translation:
[游客]
不，我不是游客。我是埃克拉珠的市民！

scripts.text:
[Tourist]
I can't believe I can't even enter because of all these tourists!
scripts.translation:
[游客]
真不敢相信，因为这么多游客，我连家都进不去！

scripts.text:
[Tourist]
I hear their acorns are delicious without a hint of bitterness.
scripts.translation:
[游客]
听说那里的橡果很好吃，而且完全没有苦味。

scripts.text:
[Tourist]
You could probably make the world's best acorn jello.
scripts.translation:
[游客]
说不定能做出世界上最好吃的橡果果冻。

scripts.text:
[Tourist]
It's important to keep your belongings light when traveling.
scripts.translation:
[游客]
旅行时保持行李轻便很重要。

scripts.text:
[Tourist]
It's going to increase as you go along anyways.
scripts.translation:
[游客]
反正随着旅程的深入，负担也会增加的。

scripts.text:
[Tourist]
Perhaps you could consider it as the weight of life?
scripts.translation:
[游客]
或许你可以把它看作生活的重量？

scripts.text:
[Tourist]
Cool cool.
scripts.translation:
[游客]
酷，真酷。

scripts.text:
[Tourist]
Snorrrreee....Erhem....
scripts.translation:
[游客]
呼噜噜噜...咳咳...

scripts.text:
[Tourist]
Err.... No.....
Curry.... Curry rice.... Snorrreeeee
scripts.translation:
[游客]
呃...不...
咖喱...咖喱饭...呼噜噜噜

scripts.text:
[Tourist]
Oh! Are you also from Midgard?
scripts.translation:
[游客]
哦！你也是来自米德加尔特吗？

scripts.text:
[Tourist]
It's encouraging to see so many Midgard people nowadays.
scripts.translation:
[游客]
现在能看到这么多米德加尔特人，真让人振奋。

scripts.text:
[Tourist]
Ow.... My legs...
You're saying I have to wait after all this traveling through Bifrost?!
scripts.translation:
[游客]
哎哟...我的腿...
经过双层牛肉堡这么长途跋涉，居然还要等待？！

scripts.text:
[Tourist]
Ahh...
Why are there so many people...?
scripts.translation:
[游客]
啊...
为什么有这么多的人...

scripts.text:
[Tourist]
I want to be alone......Sniff!
scripts.translation:
[游客]
我想一个人静静......吸溜！

scripts.text:
[Fairy Carpenter]
Hey!!!!!!!
Be careful over there!!
scripts.translation:
[妖精木匠]
嘿！！！！！！
那边小心点！！

scripts.text: - The bridge is broken. There should be some kind of a solution. -
scripts.translation: - 桥断了。应该有什么解决办法。 -

scripts.text:
[Fairy Carpenter]
Wait!!!!!
That's an unregistered visitor!!!!!!!
Security!!! Security!!!
scripts.translation:
[妖精木匠]
等等！！！！！！
那是未登记的访客！！！！！！
保安！保安！

scripts.text:
[Fairy Carpenter]
Did you talk to the security guard before coming into the city?
scripts.translation:
[妖精木匠]
进城之前你有和保安交谈过吗？

scripts.text:
[Fairy Carpenter]
The bridge is kind of broken so please be careful.
scripts.translation:
[妖精木匠]
桥有点损坏，请小心。

scripts.text:
[Fairy Carpenter]
This area is kind of broken, so be careful.
Otherwise, you'll fall aaaaaall the way down.
scripts.translation:
[妖精木匠]
这片区域有点损坏，请小心。
否则，你会一直掉下去的。

scripts.text: The work being done right now
scripts.translation: 目前正在进行的工程

scripts.text: The reason for the bridge being broken
scripts.translation: 桥梁损坏的原因

scripts.text: Forget it.
scripts.translation: 算了。

scripts.text:
[Fairy Carpenter]
As you can see, I'm doing some carpentry work.
There are more visitors to Eclage nowadays, so I'm primarily working on building bridges.
scripts.translation:
[妖精木匠]
如您所见，我正在做木工活。
最近来埃克拉珠的访客变多了，所以我主要在建桥。

scripts.text:
[Fairy Carpenter]
Oh, just a minute ago, there was a human being who took a misstep and broke a tree branch while falling.
scripts.translation:
[妖精木匠]
哦，就在刚才，有个人类失足摔下来，把树枝弄断了。

scripts.text:
[Fairy Carpenter]
You can't get past here until it's repaired, so please be careful.
scripts.translation:
[妖精木匠]
在修好之前，您无法通过这里，请小心。

scripts.text: [Fairy Carpenter]
scripts.translation: [妖精木匠]

scripts.text:
[Fairy Carpenter]
In fact, Laphines can fly around so bridges are technically not necessary, but we are building them since there are many visitors who have been getting hurt by falling while climbing trees.
scripts.translation:
[妖精木匠]
其实，拉菲涅斯会飞，所以严格来说不需要桥。
但因为有很多访客在爬树时摔伤，所以我们还是建了桥。

scripts.text:
[Fairy Carpenter]
Being close to the entrance and all, this really needs to be fixed soon.
I'm trying to decide whether I should put up a warning sign, gather the necessary materials for repair, or call a friend to help.
scripts.translation:
[妖精木匠]
这里离入口很近，真的需要尽快修好。
我正在考虑是立个警告牌，还是收集维修材料，或者叫朋友来帮忙。

scripts.text: Give help.
scripts.translation: 帮忙

scripts.text: Don't give help.
scripts.translation: 不帮忙

scripts.text:
[Fairy Carpenter]
You can't get past here until it's repaired, so please be careful.
scripts.translation:
[妖精木匠]
在修好之前，您无法通过这里，请小心。

scripts.text:
[Fairy Carpenter]
Wow!!!
You are going to help me?!
So... so kind...
scripts.translation:
[妖精木匠]
哇！！！
你要帮我吗？！
太...太善良了...

scripts.text:
[Fairy Carpenter]
I can't believe there's still this kind of kindness left in the world... Hmm, sweaty eyes...
scripts.translation:
[妖精木匠]
真不敢相信世界上还有这么善良的人... 嗯，眼睛有点湿润...

scripts.text:
[Fairy Carpenter]
Would you then bring me a new bridge to use for repair?
Since other people can get hurt, I'll use my magic to maintain this bridge in the meantime.
scripts.translation:
[妖精木匠]
那么，你能给我带一座新桥来用于维修吗？
因为其他人可能会受伤，我会先用魔法维持这座桥的状态。

scripts.text: What if you use magic to repair it?
scripts.translation: 用魔法修好它呢？

scripts.text:
[Fairy Carpenter]
Hmm, it's not impossible, but magic that deals with creation of life requires much magic power and shouldn't be used so freely.
scripts.translation:
[妖精木匠]
嗯，不是不可能，但涉及创造生命的魔法需要大量魔力，不应该随意使用。

scripts.text:
[Fairy Carpenter]
If I were to describe how stupid that would be... Well, it's like turning a deliciously baked chocolate cake back into flour.
scripts.translation:
[妖精木匠]
如果要说这有多愚蠢... 嗯，就像把烤好的美味巧克力蛋糕变回面粉一样。

scripts.text:
[Fairy Carpenter]
Since the broken part is about 19 meters from here...
scripts.translation:
[妖精木匠]
因为损坏的部分离这里大约19米...

scripts.text:
[Fairy Carpenter]
Ahh! Now that I remember, before we used to be able to order the exact necessary length, but because they are mass-producing them nowadays, they only provide preset lengths.
scripts.translation:
[妖精木匠]
啊！我想起来了，以前我们可以订购精确所需的长度，但现在因为是批量生产，只提供预设的长度。

scripts.text:
[Fairy Carpenter]
To maximize the stability, it's better to avoid connecting multiple bridge pieces together,
scripts.translation:
[妖精木匠]
为了最大化稳定性，最好避免将多块桥板连接在一起，

scripts.text:
[Fairy Carpenter]
and this broken bridge... from here to there it's about 19 meters and the prepieces come in 3 meters = 5 meters, and 10 meters......
scripts.translation:
[妖精木匠]
而且这座断桥... 从这里到那里大约19米，而预制件有3米、5米和10米...

scripts.text:
[Fairy Carpenter]
Hmm.......

[Fairy Carpenter]
Hmm......
......

[Fairy Carpenter]
......Hmm.........
- It's probably just my imagination that smoke is coming out of his head, right? -
scripts.translation: - 大概只是我的错觉，他头上冒烟了，对吧？ -

scripts.text:
[Fairy Carpenter]
Oh ho!
What do you think?
scripts.translation:
[妖精木匠]
哦！
你觉得怎么样？

scripts.text:
[Fairy Carpenter]
To make a bridge of 19 meters in length with the fewest number of pieces possible, how many of each 3, 5, or 10 meter length pieces would I need?
scripts.translation:
[妖精木匠]
要用最少的桥板拼出19米长的桥，需要多少块3米、5米或10米的桥板呢？

scripts.text:
[Fairy Carpenter]
Please write the number of pieces necessary for each length. If no pieces for that length are necessary, please write 0.
scripts.translation:
[妖精木匠]
请写出每种长度所需的数量。如果不需要某种长度，请写0。

scripts.text:
[Fairy Carpenter]
Hmm that's kind of....
Would there be a better way?
scripts.translation:
[妖精木匠]
嗯，这样有点......
有没有更好的办法？

scripts.text:
[Fairy Carpenter]
Yeah, that sounds good, right?
Especially since there wouldn't be a need to make them so straight.
scripts.translation:
[妖精木匠]
是啊，听起来不错，对吧？
而且这样就不需要把它们做得那么直了。

scripts.text:
[Fairy Carpenter]
Okay, if you talk to [Golie] who works outside the city near the tower, he will give you the new bridge pieces.
scripts.translation:
[妖精木匠]
好的，去跟[戈利]谈谈，他在中央塔附近的城外工作，他会给你新的桥板。

scripts.text:
[Fairy Carpenter]
If you talk to [Golie] who works outside the city near the tower, he will give you the new bridge pieces.
scripts.translation:
[妖精木匠]
好的，去跟[戈利]谈谈，他在中央塔附近的城外工作，他会给你新的桥板。

scripts.text:
[Fairy Carpenter]
If you talk to [Golie] who works outside the city near the tower, he will give you the new bridge pieces.
scripts.translation:
[妖精木匠]
好的，去跟[戈利]谈谈，他在中央塔附近的城外工作，他会给你新的桥板。

scripts.text:
[Carpenter Fon]
Oh man, he's still worried about that kind of thing.
He's too serious for no reason.
scripts.translation:
[木匠 丰]
天哪，他还在担心这种事。
他太认真了，毫无理由。

scripts.text:
[Carpenter Fon]
Whoa! This isn't the time to be doing this. I should repair the bridge quickly and help out all the people who fell through.
scripts.translation:
[木匠 丰]
哇！现在不是做这种事的时候。我应该尽快修好桥，帮助那些掉下去的人。

scripts.text:
[Du Lian]
Ah!
Thank goodness!
scripts.translation:
[杜连]
啊！
太好了！

scripts.text:
[Du Lian]
I would have been toast if it weren't for that tree branch.
scripts.translation:
[杜连]
要不是那根树枝，我早就完蛋了。

scripts.text:
[Mark Esha]
I told you to be careful!
Exactly how much trouble do you want to cause?
scripts.translation:
[马克·艾沙]
我告诉过你要小心！
你到底想惹出多少麻烦？

scripts.text:
[Carpenter Fon]
...

[Du Lian]
No way!
They're those guys from earlier!
Oy!
I thought I got rid of them, but it looks like they aren't going to be that easy.
scripts.translation:
[杜连]
不会吧！
是刚才那几个人！
喂！
我以为我摆脱他们了，但看来他们没那么容易打发。

scripts.text:
[Mark Esha]
I'm sorry.
We just have not been our best ever since we met.
scripts.translation:
[马克·艾沙]
对不起。
自从我们相遇以来，我们就一直状态不佳。

scripts.text:
[Carpenter Fon]
Well, I'm going to let it pass this time around, but if you break the bridge again, I'm going to put you in jail!
You should know that I am pretty busy myself.
scripts.translation:
[木匠 丰]
好吧，这次我就放过你们，但如果你们再弄断桥，我就把你们关进监狱！
你们应该知道我自己也很忙。

scripts.text:
[Mark Esha]
I'm sorry.
I'll take special caution, so please don't worry.
scripts.translation:
[马克·艾沙]
对不起。
我会特别小心的，请放心。

scripts.text:
[Du Lian]
But for a bridge to break so easily after running a bit, isn't it just too weak?
Giants couldn't even visit Eclage in this wa...
scripts.translation:
[杜连]
但是，桥才跑了一会儿就断了，这难道不是太脆弱了吗？
巨人甚至都没法这样去埃克拉珠...

scripts.text: - SNAP -
scripts.translation: - 咔嚓 -

scripts.text:
[Carpenter Fon]
......

[Mark Esha]
Oh dear....
scripts.translation:
[马克·艾沙]
哎呀....

scripts.text:
[Du Lian]
Uh oh...
scripts.translation:
[杜连]
糟糕...

scripts.text:
[Du Lian]
Wait! No, it's really a mistake this time!
Look!
Even this warning sign tells you that you have to grab onto the hand rails since the bridge is so dangerous.
scripts.translation:
[杜连]
等等！不，这次真的是个意外！
你看！
连这个警告牌都写着，因为桥太危险了，必须抓住扶手。

scripts.text:
[Du Lian]
All I did was just place my hand on it!
I really didn't do anything!
scripts.translation:
[杜连]
我只是把手放上去而已！
我真的什么都没做！

scripts.text:
[Carpenter Fon]
......

[Carpenter Fon]
Sigh...
scripts.translation:
[木匠 丰]
唉...

scripts.text:
[Carpenter Fon]
Get out of here you troublemaker!!!!
scripts.translation:
[木匠 丰]
快滚，你这个麻烦制造者!!!!

scripts.text:
[Mark Esha]
I am so sorry.
I will come by to help out later even if it's by tying this guy up to a pole.
scripts.translation:
[马克·艾沙]
非常抱歉。
稍后我会过来帮忙，哪怕是把这家伙绑在柱子上也好。

scripts.text:
[Carpenter Fon]
Don't come back!
Don't EVER come back!!!
scripts.translation:
[木匠 丰]
别回来了！
永远都别回来!!!

scripts.text:
[Carpenter Fon]
Oy........
I thought today I might be able to see my friends after finishing up my work.....
Looks like a long night again.
scripts.translation:
[木匠 丰]
喂........
我还以为今天做完工作就能见见朋友了.....
看来又得熬个长夜了。

scripts.text:
[Carpenter Fon]
Since it's not a big fix, I'm sure I can take care of this somehow.
Sigh...
scripts.translation:
[木匠 丰]
既然不是大修，我想我肯定能想办法搞定。
唉...

scripts.text:
[Carpenter Fon]
{0} Well, you should get going to Eclage.
You just need to follow this path to the northern part of the city.
scripts.translation:
[木匠 丰]
{0} 好了，你应该去埃克拉珠了。
你只需要沿着这条路走到城市的北部。

scripts.text:
[Carpenter Fon]
You'll find the main plaza as soon as you enter Eclage, and I'm sure you'll have easy time getting information from all the people there.
scripts.translation:
[木匠 丰]
一进埃克拉珠你就会看到主广场，我相信你在那里很容易就能从人们那里得到资讯。

scripts.text:
[Carpenter Fon]
And on your way, do you mind letting my friend Glasses that I won't make it today?
scripts.translation:
[木匠 丰]
另外，在去的路上，你介意帮我告诉我的朋友眼镜，我今天去不了了？

scripts.text:
[Carpenter Fon]
But where are the materials.
I need to start repairing soon...
scripts.translation:
[木匠 丰]
但是材料在哪里呢。
我得赶紧开始修理了...

scripts.text:
[Carpenter Fon]
I really ask you this favor because I'm supposed to meet with my friends to discuss a birthday coming up, but I can't just keep them waiting.
scripts.translation:
[木匠 丰]
我真的很想请你帮这个忙，因为我本来要和朋友们见面讨论即将到来的生日，但我不能一直让他们等着。

scripts.text:
[Carpenter Fon]
And on your way, do you mind letting my friend Glasses that I won't make it today?
scripts.translation:
[木匠 丰]
另外，在去的路上，你介意帮我告诉我的朋友眼镜，我今天去不了了？

scripts.text:
[Carpenter Fon]
I really ask you this favor because I'm supposed to meet with my friends to discuss a birthday coming up, but I can't just keep them waiting.
scripts.translation:
[木匠 丰]
我真的很想请你帮这个忙，因为我本来要和朋友们见面讨论即将到来的生日，但我不能一直让他们等着。

scripts.text:
[Carpenter Fon]
I wanna see my friends real soon.
scripts.translation:
[木匠 丰]
我真想快点见到我的朋友们。

scripts.text:
- Stop here !! -
- There are just too many types that -
- you cannot receive the item. -
- Please lighten your load -
- and try again. -
scripts.translation:
- 请在此停下！！ -
- 由于物品种类过多， -
- 您无法接收该物品。 -
- 请减轻负重 -
- 后重试。 -

scripts.text:
[Golie]
They say that life is nature's greatest invention and death is just a scheme to obtain more life.
scripts.translation:
[戈利]
人们常说，生命是大自然最伟大的发明，而死亡只是为了获取更多生命的手段。

scripts.text:
[Golie]
Alright, you may now deliver this to Fon. Also, while I know that it is difficult in these busy times, would you also tell him that I said, 'please take more precious care of them?'
scripts.translation:
[戈利]
好了，现在你可以把这个交给丰了。另外，虽然我知道现在大家都很忙，但能否请你转告他，我说：“请更加珍重它们？”

scripts.text:
[Golie]
To grow Elder Willow trees,
since Spring, Peco Peco
must have cried as such.
scripts.translation:
[戈利]
为了培育长老树精，
自春天起，大嘴鸟
想必就是这样啼哭过的。

scripts.text:
[Golie]
You lost the materials?
I will give you another since you are busy, but please take care.
scripts.translation:
[戈利]
你把材料弄丢了？
既然你很忙，我就再给你一份，但请务必小心保管。

scripts.text:
[Golie]
However, how about these sprouts that were born by magic- do they have life or not?
Would a bridge born by magic be considered dead or not?
scripts.translation:
[戈利]
不过，那些由魔法诞生的幼苗——它们算是有生命还是没有生命呢？
由魔法诞生的桥梁，算是死的还是活的呢？

scripts.text:
[Golie]
Because I spend so much time nurturing a bridge from a seed, it hurts me to see so many getting broken and replaced.
scripts.translation:
[戈利]
因为我花费了大量时间从种子开始培育桥梁，看到它们频繁损坏并被替换，让我很心痛。

scripts.text:
[Golie]
Would this be how the times are changing...? That must be why I am creating these objects of tragic destinies.
scripts.translation:
[戈利]
难道这就是时代变迁的方式吗...？这大概就是我创造出这些命运悲惨之物的原因吧。

scripts.text:
[Golie]
This seed is named [Goliath] after my name, and it's a plant used as a bridge for its strange ability to grow into two stems and one leaf.
scripts.translation:
[戈利]
这颗种子以我的名字命名为[戈利亚斯]，它是一种用作桥梁的植物，拥有能长出两根茎和一片叶子的奇特能力。

scripts.text:
[Golie]
Thanks to Goliath, the dire need for bridges has been resolved, but I cannot shake the concern that one day, there are going to be fearsome consequences for utilizing magic to ignore the rules of nature.
scripts.translation:
[戈利]
多亏了戈利亚斯，对桥梁的迫切需求得到了解决，但我无法摆脱一种担忧：总有一天，利用魔法无视自然法则会带来可怕的后果。

scripts.text:
[Golie]
I am recently finding encouragement bit by bit as I work with the great Fili who stands next to me here, but one day, I assure you that all of this will be fixed.
scripts.translation:
[戈利]
最近，随着我与站在我身旁伟大的菲利一起工作，我逐渐找到了一些鼓励，但我向你保证，总有一天这一切都会得到修正。

scripts.text:
[Golie]
Whenever you are disheartened and discouraged, try approaching Fili with your concerns. You will probably find new insights. 
And... Mm... the bridge was done while we were just jibber-jabbering.
scripts.translation:
[戈利]
当你感到沮丧和灰心时，试着带着你的烦恼去找菲利。你或许会发现新的见解。
而且...嗯...我们闲聊的这段时间，桥已经修好了。

scripts.text:
[Golie]
Alright, you may now deliver this to Fon. Also, while I know that it is difficult in these busy times, would you also tell him that I said, 'please take more precious care of them?'
scripts.translation:
[戈利]
好了，现在你可以把这个交给丰了。另外，虽然我知道现在大家都很忙，但能否请你转告他，我说：“请更加珍重它们？”

scripts.text:
[Golie]
Surely, I am busy nowadays helping with Fili's work but it also seems that the bridges are breaking too often.
scripts.translation:
[戈利]
当然，我现在正忙着协助菲利的工作，但看起来桥梁损坏的频率也太高了。

scripts.text:
[Golie]
Surely, I am busy nowadays helping with Fili's work but it also seems that the bridges are breaking too often.
scripts.translation:
[戈利]
当然，我现在正忙着协助菲利的工作，但看起来桥梁损坏的频率也太高了。

scripts.text:
[Golie]
To grow Elder Willow trees
the alarm in the clock tower
again must have cried as such.
scripts.translation:
[戈利]
为了培育长老树精，
钟楼的钟怪
想必又是这样啼哭过的。

scripts.text:
[Golie]
It's a song given to me by a bard from Midgard. The lyrical and nature-oriented words really resonated with me.
scripts.translation:
[戈利]
这是一首米德加尔特的一位诗人送给我的歌。那些富有韵律且贴近自然的歌词，真的让我产生了共鸣。

scripts.text:
[Golie]
I would love to hear any songs that you might know also.
scripts.translation:
[戈利]
如果你知道什么歌曲，我也很乐意听听。

scripts.text:
[Glaces]
Hm......
The guys are late.
I can only imagine that they would be busy just looking at the number of people visiting Eclage nowadays but...
scripts.translation:
[格拉西斯]
嗯......
那几个人迟到了。
我只能想象，光是看看如今埃克拉珠的访客数量，他们就会忙得不可开交，但是...

scripts.text:
[Glaces]
Hmm...
The guys are late.
scripts.translation:
[格拉西斯]
嗯...
那几个人迟到了。

scripts.text:
[Glaces]
Well, I can't leave this place since others might arrive, so if you see a fairy with a yellow, tangerine-stem-like head, please tell him Glaces is looking for him.
scripts.translation:
[格拉西斯]
好吧，我不能离开这里，因为可能还会有其他人到来。如果你看到一个头部像黄色橘子梗一样的妖精，请告诉他格拉西斯在找他。

scripts.text:
[Glaces]
Oh...
Moreng's age?
scripts.translation:
[格拉西斯]
哦...
莫伦的年龄？

scripts.text:
[Glaces]
How dare you ask a lady's age!!!
We aren't exactly the same age, but since Murah is also 30 years apart from Moreng, ask Murah.
scripts.translation:
[格拉西斯]
你怎么敢问女士的年龄！！！
我们年龄虽然不完全一样，但穆拉和莫伦也相差30岁，你去问穆拉吧。

scripts.text:
[Glaces]
Mm.. Something's missing... Mm, I couldn't tell you exactly...
You should go see Yube.
scripts.translation:
[格拉西斯]
嗯...好像少了点什么...嗯，我说不太清楚...
你应该去找尤贝。

scripts.text:
[Glaces]
Whoa!
We would need an enormous cake to fit all these candles...
scripts.translation:
[格拉西斯]
哇！
要插这么多蜡烛，我们需要一个巨大的蛋糕...

scripts.text:
[Glaces]
Who are those guys? They even took Yube with them?!
scripts.translation:
[格拉西斯]
那些人是谁？他们竟然把尤贝也带走了？！

scripts.text:
[Glaces]
I wonder what's better, cream or chocolate...
scripts.translation:
[格拉西斯]
我在想，奶油和巧克力哪个更好吃...

scripts.text:
[Glaces]
I wonder what's better, cream or chocolate?
scripts.translation:
[格拉西斯]
我在想，奶油和巧克力哪个更好吃？

scripts.text:
[Glaces]
If he really seems like he might leave soon, we should grab him before he leaves and at least throw him a farewell party.
scripts.translation:
[格拉西斯]
如果他看起来真的快要离开了，我们应该在他走之前抓住他，至少给他办个欢送会。

scripts.text:
[Glaces]
It's going to feel really empty if Moreng leaves for Midgard.
It felt like this when Yube was dispatched to the Splendide unit before...
scripts.translation:
[格拉西斯]
如果莫伦要去米德加尔特，这里会感觉很空荡的。
之前尤贝被派往辉煌领域时，也是这种感觉...

scripts.text:
[Glaces]
Shul lives in the eastern part of the city.
I'm guessing he's near his place?
scripts.translation:
[格拉西斯]
舒尔住在城市的东部。
我猜他应该就在那附近？

scripts.text:
[Glaces]
Tato is in the western part of the city.
scripts.translation:
[格拉西斯]
塔托在城市的西部。

scripts.text:
[Glaces]
A king lives in Eclage.
He is super good looking.
Hehe
scripts.translation:
[格拉西斯]
国王住在埃克拉珠。
他超级帅。
嘿嘿

scripts.text:
[Glaces]
To think of it, I should probably visit Fon and Golie as well...
I guess I'll visit later.
scripts.translation:
[格拉西斯]
想想看，我也应该去拜访一下丰和戈利...
我想我稍后再去。

scripts.text:
[Glaces]
Why... why do I have so much time at hand...?
Am I the only one with so much free time?
Am I really the only one?
scripts.translation:
[格拉西斯]
为什么...为什么我手头有这么多空闲时间...？
只有我一个人这么闲吗？
真的只有我一个人吗？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Excuse me?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
照顾什么？

scripts.text:
[Glaces]
Yes?
scripts.translation:
[格拉西斯]
是的？

scripts.text:
[Glaces]
Ah...
Oh...Well...
scripts.translation:
[格拉西斯]
啊...
哦...好吧...

scripts.text:
[Glaces]
Um... This is sort of awkward for me...
scripts.translation:
[格拉西斯]
嗯...这让我有点尴尬...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
No, that's not what I mean...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
不，我不是那个意思...

scripts.text:
[Glaces]
Hmm...
You see, I have a boyfriend already.
Man.
scripts.translation:
[格拉西斯]
嗯...
你看，我已经有男朋友了。
真是的。

scripts.text:
[Glaces]
This is why I don't like to be kept waiting for long. My popularity just doesn't let me go anywhere without being noticed.
scripts.translation:
[格拉西斯]
这就是为什么我不喜欢让人等太久。我的受欢迎程度让我走到哪里都会被注意到。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
No, I mean... Mr. Fon told me to let you know that he won't be able to make it because of his work...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
不，我的意思是... 方先生让我转告你，他因为工作原因无法到场...

scripts.text:
[Glaces]
...
scripts.translation:
[格拉西斯]
...

scripts.text:
[Glaces]
Oh, I see.
scripts.translation:
[格拉西斯]
哦，我明白了。

scripts.text:
[Glaces]
Yeah, I feel like I should hide somewhere.
scripts.translation:
[格拉西斯]
是啊，我觉得我应该找个地方躲起来。

scripts.text:
[Glaces]
Anyways, Fon can't make it?
scripts.translation:
[格拉西斯]
总之，方来不了了？

scripts.text:
[Glaces]
Moreng's birthday is not long from now, and without being able to meet all this time, it might turn out to be a terrible party.
scripts.translation:
[格拉西斯]
莫伦的生日快到了，如果我们这段时间一直见不到面，派对可能会变得很糟糕。

scripts.text:
[Glaces]
Yube even flew here from Splendide for Moreng's birthday...
Speaking of which, where did that guy go?!
scripts.translation:
[格拉西斯]
尤贝甚至从辉煌领域飞过来参加莫伦的生日派对...
话说回来，那个家伙去哪了？！

scripts.text:
[Glaces]
He was the one who suggested that we should meet at his own place.
The least he could do is opening the door before disappearing!
scripts.translation:
[格拉西斯]
是他提议我们在他的地方见面的。
他至少应该在消失之前把门打开吧！

scripts.text:
[Glaces]
Well, I can't leave this place since others might arrive, so if you see a fairy with a yellow, tangerine-stem-like head, please tell him Glaces is looking for him.
scripts.translation:
[格拉西斯]
好吧，我不能离开这里，因为可能还会有其他人到来。如果你看到一个头部像黄色橘子梗一样的妖精，请告诉他格拉西斯在找他。

scripts.text:
[Glaces]
And also please tell him that if he doesn't get back right away, I will pluck off that stem.
scripts.translation:
[格拉西斯]
还有，请告诉他，如果他再不回来，我就拔掉那根茎。

scripts.text:
[Du Lian]
Great!!!
That
favor!
I will take care of it!
scripts.translation:
[杜连]
太好了！！！
这个
忙！
包在我身上！

scripts.text:
[Mark Esha]
Hey! I told you not to interfere in other people's conversations!
scripts.translation:
[马克·艾沙]
嘿！我说过不要插嘴别人的对话！

scripts.text:
[Du Lian]
What are you talking about?
It's the job of a warrior to go wherever help is needed!
scripts.translation:
[杜连]
你在说什么？
战士的职责就是去任何需要帮助的地方！

scripts.text:
[Du Lian]
And you!
There must be some kind of destiny here running into you over and over again!
scripts.translation:
[杜连]
还有你！
我们总是反复相遇，这里一定有什么命运在牵引！

scripts.text:
[Du Lian]
Okay!
I made up my mind!
scripts.translation:
[杜连]
好了！
我决定了！

scripts.text:
[Du Lian]
I don't usually recognize others like this, but I'll let you be my rival!
And as for the competition-!!
It is to help this girl fairy Graces!
scripts.translation:
[杜连]
我通常不会这样认可别人，但我允许你成为我的对手！
至于比赛的内容——！！
就是帮助这位女孩妖精格拉西斯！

scripts.text:
[Glaces]
Who are you calling a girl? You got my name wrong too!
scripts.translation:
[格拉西斯]
谁是你叫的女孩？你连我的名字都叫错了！

scripts.text:
[Du Lian]
Heh heh, don't you worry, baby girl.
I'll take care of you!!
scripts.translation:
[杜连]
嘿嘿，别担心，小妹妹。
我会照顾你的！！

scripts.text:
[Du Lian]
Well!
I'm off to find that tangerine stem!!!
scripts.translation:
[杜连]
好了！
我去找那根橘子茎！！！

scripts.text:
[Glaces]
And also please tell him that if he doesn't get back right away, I will pluck off that stem.
scripts.translation:
[格拉西斯]
还有，请告诉他，如果他再不回来，我就拔掉那根茎。

scripts.text:
[Glaces]
Hmm... I think we are apart by about 30 years...
scripts.translation:
[格拉西斯]
嗯... 我觉得我们之间大概差了30岁...

scripts.text: Then what's Glaces' age?
scripts.translation: 那么格拉西斯几岁了？

scripts.text:
[Glaces]
How dare you ask a lady's age!!!
We aren't exactly the same age, but since Murah is also 30 years apart from Moreng, ask Murah.
scripts.translation:
[格拉西斯]
你怎么敢问女士的年龄！！！
我们年龄虽然不完全一样，但穆拉和莫伦也相差30岁，你去问穆拉吧。

scripts.text:
[Glaces]
Murah is probably at the Eclage plaza.
scripts.translation:
[格拉西斯]
穆拉大概在埃克拉珠广场。

scripts.text:
[Glaces]
Murah is probably at the Eclage plaza.
scripts.translation:
[格拉西斯]
穆拉大概在埃克拉珠广场。

scripts.text:
[Glaces]
Hmm... Since everyone seems so busy, I'm going to give up meeting them today and just go to bake a cake big enough to fit the candles.
scripts.translation:
[格拉西斯]
嗯... 既然大家都这么忙，我今天就不去见他们了，还是去烤一个能插下蜡烛的大蛋糕吧。

scripts.text:
[Glaces]
Moreng's house is down this road, so please ask him if he wants anything for his birthday.
scripts.translation:
[格拉西斯]
莫伦的家就在这条路上，请顺便问问他生日想要什么。

scripts.text:
[Du Lian]
Baby girl!
I brought the guy named Yube!
scripts.translation:
[杜连]
小丫头！
我把那个叫尤贝的家伙带来了！

scripts.text:
[Glaces]
...
scripts.translation:
[格拉西斯]
...

scripts.text:
[Yube]
What, who is this fool?
Let me go!
scripts.translation:
[尤贝]
喂，这笨蛋是谁？
放开我！

scripts.text:
[Glaces]
Do you mind not treating my friend like a piece of luggage?
And it's too late anyways!
scripts.translation:
[格拉西斯]
你能不能别把我朋友当行李一样对待？
而且现在也来不及了！

scripts.text:
[Du Lian]
What?!
But there are two of them!
I have the disadvantage!
scripts.translation:
[杜连]
什么？！
可是他们有两个！
我处于劣势啊！

scripts.text:
[Mark Esha]
There are four of us.
scripts.translation:
[马克·艾沙]
我们有四个。

scripts.text:
[Du Lian]
What do you mean?
We had that kid following us ever since we entered the city.
scripts.translation:
[杜连]
你什么意思？
我们从进城开始就有那个小孩跟着我们了。

scripts.text:
[Du Lian]
Sure, he's kind of cute too, but we have our cutest Maggi to beat them all!!!
scripts.translation:
[杜连]
没错，他确实挺可爱的，但我们有着最可爱的玛姬，足以胜过他们所有人！！！

scripts.text:
[Maggi Steen]
...
scripts.translation:
[玛姬·斯汀]
...

scripts.text:
[???]
Can you see me?
scripts.translation:
[???]
你能看见我吗？

scripts.text:
[Du Lian]
What are you saying?
Your clothes stick out like a sore thumb.
Where are you from really?
scripts.translation:
[杜连]
你在说什么？
你的衣服太显眼了，简直像个大拇指一样突出。
你到底是哪里人？

scripts.text:
[???]
Ey~~
I thought you weren't able to see me but I guess not?
scripts.translation:
[???]
哎呀~~
我还以为你们看不见我，看来不是这样？

scripts.text:
[Du Lian]
How could I not see you?
Unless you were cloaking yourself like our Alp here!
Maybe it's because he is a Guillotine Cross, but he just seems so transparent even without using any skills.
scripts.translation:
[杜连]
我怎么可能看不见你？
除非你像我们的阿尔普·奥卡特那样使用了伪装！
也许是因为他是十字斩首者，但他即使不用技能，看起来也透明得像个幽灵。

scripts.text:
[Glaces]
Maybe it's because he doesn't have much presence to begin with.
scripts.translation:
[格拉西斯]
也许是因为他本来存在感就低吧。

scripts.text:
[Alp Ocart]
...
scripts.translation:
[阿尔普·奥卡特]
...

scripts.text:
[Alp Ocart]
Now that I think about it, I think I saw you somewhere...
Where was it?
scripts.translation:
[阿尔普·奥卡特]
这么一想，我觉得我在哪里见过你...
是在哪里呢？

scripts.text:
[???]
Eh...
It's been awhile since I had such a vivid dream...
scripts.translation:
[???]
呃...
好久没有做过这么清晰的梦了...

scripts.text:
[Du Lian]
Wahahahahah!
A dream!
Hey Mark, this guy thinks it's a dream!
How adorable!
Can we take him around?
scripts.translation:
[杜连]
哇哈哈哈哈哈！
是梦啊！
嘿，马克，这家伙以为自己在做梦呢！
好可爱啊！
我们可以带他到处逛逛吗？

scripts.text:
[Mark Esha]
What are you saying?!
Don't touch whoever you want like that!
scripts.translation:
[马克·艾沙]
你在说什么啊？！
别想随便对谁动手动脚！

scripts.text:
[Oliver]
Eeek~ I don't like this.
Besides, I'm not a kid or a child!
I have a great name called Oliver!
scripts.translation:
[奥利弗]
哎呀~我不喜欢这样。
而且，我不是小孩也不是孩子！
我有一个很棒的名字，叫奥利弗！

scripts.text:
[Du Lian]
I have been rejected straight up.
To put him next to our Maggi would be just downright adorable.
scripts.translation:
[杜连]
居然被直接拒绝了。
把他放在我们的玛姬旁边，那画面简直太可爱了。

scripts.text:
[Glaces]
Hmm.
Wait, but don't you have something to give me?
You did earlier.
Where did it go?
scripts.translation:
[格拉西斯]
嗯。
等等，你们不是有什么东西要给我吗？
刚才还给我的。
去哪了？

scripts.text:
[Du Lian]
Now that I am rejected!
Off to find Moreng!
I won't lose this time for sure!
Let us begin!
scripts.translation:
[杜连]
既然被拒绝了！
那就去找莫伦吧！
这次我绝对不会输的！
让我们开始吧！

scripts.text:
[Glaces]
Who are those guys?They even took Yube with them!
scripts.translation:
[格拉西斯]
那些人是谁？他们竟然连尤贝也带走了！

scripts.text:
[Glaces]
Well, I'm sure Yube will take care of himself.
Anyways...
Moreng's house is down this road, so please ask him if he wants anything for his birthday.
scripts.translation:
[格拉西斯]
嗯...我相信尤贝能照顾好自己。
总之...
莫伦的家就在这条路上，请帮他问问生日想要什么礼物。

scripts.text:
[Glaces]
Well... I'm sure Yube will take care of himself.
Anyways...
Moreng's house is down this road, so please ask him if he wants anything for his birthday.
scripts.translation:
[格拉西斯]
嗯...我相信尤贝能照顾好自己。
总之...
莫伦的家就在这条路上，请帮他问问生日想要什么礼物。

scripts.text: - She seems really busy making the cake. Let's not bother her. -
scripts.translation: - 她似乎正忙着做蛋糕。别去打扰她。 -

scripts.text:
[Glaces]
Oh you're back.
Did you ask Moreng what he wants?
scripts.translation:
[格拉西斯]
哦，你回来了。
你问莫伦想要什么了吗？

scripts.text:
[Glaces]
...
scripts.translation:
[格拉西斯]
...

scripts.text:
[Glaces]
Huh!!!
The legend of the great bird?!
It's been close to a hundred years since I've known Moreng, and he's never talked about it before!
scripts.translation:
[格拉西斯]
什么？！
大鸟的传说？！
我和莫伦认识快一百年了，他以前从来没提过这个！

scripts.text:
[Glaces]
If he really seems like he might leave soon, we should grab him before he leaves and at least throw him a farewell party.
scripts.translation:
[格拉西斯]
如果他看起来真的快要离开了，我们应该在他走之前抓住他，至少给他办个欢送会。

scripts.text:
[Glaces]
So sudden...
I'm going to try to talk with Moreng, so would you ask Yube for me?
He went inside to look for something, so I'm sure he's still inside.
scripts.translation:
[格拉西斯]
太突然了...
我要去和莫伦谈谈，你能帮我问问尤贝吗？
他进去找东西了，应该还在里面。

scripts.text:
[Glaces]
So sudden...
I'm going to try to talk with Moreng, so would you ask Yube for me?
He went inside to look for something, so I'm sure he's still inside.
scripts.translation:
[格拉西斯]
太突然了...
我要去和莫伦谈谈，你能帮我问问尤贝吗？
他进去找东西了，应该还在里面。

scripts.text:
[Glaces]
Well, I should first decide on what present to get him!
scripts.translation:
[格拉西斯]
嗯，我得先决定送他什么礼物！

scripts.text:
- Shuffle shuffle -
He's working on something.
Let's not bother him.
scripts.translation:
- 沙沙沙沙 -
他正在忙什么。
别去打扰他。

scripts.text: - Shuffle shuffle -
scripts.translation: - 沙沙沙沙 -

scripts.text: - It looks like the fairy that Glaces was talking about. -
scripts.translation: - 看起来像是格拉西斯说的那个妖精。 -

scripts.text:
[Yube]
Whoa!
Who are you?!
scripts.translation:
[尤贝]
哇！
你是谁？！

scripts.text:
[Yube]
Whoa! Who's this? It's
{0}?
You seem more like a Warlock now!
scripts.translation:
[尤贝]
哇！这是谁？是
{0}？
你现在看起来更像个大魔导士了！

scripts.text:
[Yube]
I'm glad to see you at a place like this.
What's going on anyways?
scripts.translation:
[尤贝]
很高兴能在这里见到你。
说起来，现在是什么情况？

scripts.text: Share Glaces' story.
scripts.translation: 分享格拉西斯的故事

scripts.text:
[Yube]
I told her I'll be looking for materials to make candles with, but as expected, she wasn't listening.
She always loses her mind looking at herself through a mirror.
scripts.translation:
[尤贝]
我跟她说我要去找做蜡烛的材料，但不出所料，她根本没在听。
她总是对着镜子看自己，然后就神志不清了。

scripts.text:
[Yube]
In any case, how old is Moreng now?
I think he was younger than me, but I'm not remembering it very well...
Would you mind asking Glaces about his age for me?
scripts.translation:
[尤贝]
话说回来，莫伦现在多大了？
我记得他比我小，但具体记不太清了...
你介意帮我问问格拉西斯他的年龄吗？

scripts.text:
- Stop here !! -
- You have too many items -
- in your inventory right now. -
- Please lighten your load -
- and try again. -
scripts.translation:
- 请在这里停下 !! -
- 你现在的物品栏 -
- 已经装不下更多物品了。 -
- 请减轻负重 -
- 然后再试一次。 -

scripts.text:
[Yube]
Oh!
You gathered enough already?
I also made enough wicks just in time!
scripts.translation:
[尤贝]
哦！
你已经收集够了吗？
我也刚好做好了足够的烛芯！

scripts.text:
[Yube]
I mold the dust clumb like this and place the wick like this!
Voilà!
scripts.translation:
[尤贝]
我把灰尘团捏成这样的形状，然后像这样插上烛芯！
瞧！

scripts.text:
[Yube]
They're all made!
Please take them to Glaces.
scripts.translation:
[尤贝]
全都做好了！
请把它们带给格拉西斯。

scripts.text:
[Yube]
And also...
To return the favor, I'll let you use my house!
You can stay over whenever you want as long as you are in Eclage.
scripts.translation:
[尤贝]
还有...
为了报答你，我把我的房子借给你用！
只要你在埃克拉珠，随时都可以来住。

scripts.text:
[Yube]
I work at Splendide for the most part anyways, so I don't come to Eclage very often.
Alright, thanks a lot~
scripts.translation:
[尤贝]
反正我大部分时间都在辉煌领域工作，很少来埃克拉珠。
好了，非常感谢~

scripts.text:
[Yube]
If you aren't too busy, could you bring me a clump of dust to make some candles with?
I have to make as many candles as Moreng's age, so if you could bring me that much clump of dust, that would be good.
scripts.translation:
[尤贝]
如果你不忙的话，能帮我带一团灰尘来做蜡烛吗？
我必须做出和莫伦年龄数量相同的蜡烛，所以如果你能带够那么多灰尘团来，那就太好了。

scripts.text:
[Yube]
Huh?!
So no one knows how old Moreng is?
scripts.translation:
[尤贝]
诶？！
所以没人知道莫伦多大吗？

scripts.text:
[Yube]
I mold the dust clumb like this and place the wick like this!
Voilà!
scripts.translation:
[尤贝]
我把灰尘团捏成这样的形状，然后像这样插上烛芯！
瞧！

scripts.text:
[Yube]
Wha.. You lost the candles?
I still have some wicks left, so if you bring me the clump of dust again, I'll remake them for ya.
scripts.translation:
[尤贝]
什...你把蜡烛弄丢了？
我还剩一些烛芯，如果你再带灰尘团来，我就重新给你做。

scripts.text:
[Yube]
In any case, how old is Moreng now?
I think he was younger than me, but I'm not remembering it very well...
Would you mind asking Glaces about his age for me?
scripts.translation:
[尤贝]
话说回来，莫伦现在多大了？
我记得他比我小，但具体记不太清了...
你介意帮我问问格拉西斯他的年龄吗？

scripts.text:
[Yube]
Murah? Murah is at the Eclage plaza.
scripts.translation:
[尤贝]
穆拉？穆拉在埃克拉珠广场。

scripts.text:
[Yube]
Shul? Shul is probably at the eastern part of the city.
scripts.translation:
[尤贝]
舒尔？舒尔大概在城市东边。

scripts.text:
[Yube]
Tato? Tato is in the western part of the city.
scripts.translation:
[尤贝]
塔托？塔托在城市西边。

scripts.text:
[Yube]
Have you ever been to Jotunheim?
There are amazing giants that live there!
scripts.translation:
[尤贝]
你去过约顿海姆吗？
那里住着很棒的巨人！

scripts.text:
[Yube]
Hmm, at least to summarize what everyone has said...
He's younger than me; 30 years age gap wtih both Glaces and Murah but Glaces and Murah are not the same age,
Shul's age is to add Moreng's age to my age of 100 years before; Shul is 2 years older than Glaces; the average age of me and Shul is Tato and Tato's age is 146, right?
scripts.translation:
[尤贝]
嗯，至少总结一下大家说的话...
他比我小；他和格拉西斯、穆拉都有30岁的年龄差，但格拉西斯和穆拉年龄不同，
舒尔的年龄是我100岁之前的年龄加上莫伦的年龄；舒尔比格拉西斯大2岁；我和舒尔的平均年龄是塔托，而塔托是146岁，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Yube]
...
Then how old is he?
scripts.translation:
[尤贝]
...
那他到底多大了？

scripts.text:
[Yube]
Yes!
That's right!
Now I remember!!!
I think that's what it was!
scripts.translation:
[尤贝]
对！
没错！
我想起来了！！！
我想应该是这样！

scripts.text:
[Yube]
Hmm~ I don't think so.
Think harder.
scripts.translation:
[尤贝]
嗯~我觉得不是。
再好好想想。

scripts.text:
[Yube]
Hmm that means I still have to make more than a hundred candles...
Oy......
scripts.translation:
[尤贝]
嗯，看来我还得做一百多支蜡烛...
哎呀......

scripts.text:
[Yube]
If you aren't too busy, could you bring me a clump of dust to make some candles with?
I have to make as many candles as Moreng's age, so if you could bring me that much clump of dust, that would be good.
scripts.translation:
[尤贝]
如果你不忙的话，能帮我带一团灰尘来做蜡烛吗？
我必须做出和莫伦年龄数量相同的蜡烛，所以如果你能带够那么多灰尘团来，那就太好了。

scripts.text:
[Yube]
They're all made!
Please take them to Glaces.
scripts.translation:
[尤贝]
全都做好了！
请把它们带给格拉西斯。

scripts.text: Make the candles.
scripts.translation: 制作蜡烛

scripts.text: Don't make the candles.
scripts.translation: 不制作蜡烛

scripts.text:
[Yube]
Really?
If you need more, just let me know~
scripts.translation:
[尤贝]
真的吗？
如果你还需要更多，尽管告诉我~

scripts.text:
- The weight is just too much that -
- you cannot receive the item. -
- Please lighten your load -
- and try again. -
scripts.translation:
- 负重太重了 -
- 无法接收物品。 -
- 请减轻负重 -
- 然后重试。 -

scripts.text:
[Yube]
I can make as many as 128. How many do you need?
scripts.translation:
[尤贝]
我最多可以做128支。你需要多少？

scripts.text:
[Yube]
I mold the dust clumb like this and place the wick like this!
Voilà!
scripts.translation:
[尤贝]
我把灰尘团捏成这样的形状，然后像这样插上烛芯！
瞧！

scripts.text:
[Yube]
You aren't going to make them?
scripts.translation:
[尤贝]
你不打算做吗？

scripts.text:
[Yube]
Mmm...
To make that much, I would probably need more clumps of dust...
scripts.translation:
[尤贝]
嗯...
要做这么多，我可能需要更多的灰尘团...

scripts.text:
[Yube]
They're all made!
Please take them to Glaces.
Don't lose them again~~~
scripts.translation:
[尤贝]
都做好了！
请把它们交给格拉西斯。
别再弄丢了~~~

scripts.text:
[Murah]
Moreng's age?
I don't know it exactly...
Maybe Shul might know?
scripts.translation:
[穆拉]
莫伦的年龄？
我不太清楚...
也许舒尔知道？

scripts.text:
[Murah]
Shul's house is at the east end of the city, so he should be around there.
In any case, isn't it crazy how they were friends even before I was born?
scripts.translation:
[穆拉]
舒尔住在城东边，所以他应该在那附近。
话说回来，他们在我出生前就是朋友了，这也太不可思议了吧？

scripts.text:
[Murah]
Hmm... What amazing present should I give?
scripts.translation:
[穆拉]
嗯...我该送什么特别的礼物呢？

scripts.text:
[Murah]
Moreng, Yube, and Shul got to know each other a hundred years ago, and I remember that at that time, their age difference was pretty large that adding Moreng's and Yube's age equaled to that of Shul.
scripts.translation:
[穆拉]
嗯...莫伦、尤贝和舒尔是一百年前认识的，我记得那时候，他们的年龄差很大，莫伦和尤贝的年龄加起来等于舒尔的年龄。

scripts.text:
[Murah]
Shul's house is at the east end of the city, so he should be around there.
In any case, isn't it crazy how they were friends even before I was born?
scripts.translation:
[穆拉]
舒尔住在城东边，所以他应该在那附近。
话说回来，他们在我出生前就是朋友了，这也太不可思议了吧？

scripts.text:
[Shul]
Moreng's age?
Hmm...
It's been awhile since I kept track of everyone's age.
I just remember that Glaces was two years younger than me.
scripts.translation:
[舒尔]
莫伦的年龄？
嗯...
我已经很久没记大家的年龄了。
我只记得格拉西斯比我小两岁。

scripts.text:
[Shul]
Tato lives in the western part of the town, so try asking him there.
scripts.translation:
[舒尔]
塔托住在城镇西边，去那里问问他吧。

scripts.text:
[Shul]
Laphine's put their lives on the line to make Yai beautiful.
I'm a Laphine myself but that kind of priority is difficult to understand.
scripts.translation:
[舒尔]
拉芬族为了美化雅伊，不惜付出生命的代价。
我自己也是拉芬族，但很难理解这种优先顺序。

scripts.text:
[Shul]
Come to think of it, not too long ago, Tato said that his age was the same as the average between my age and Yube's age.
Maybe Tato would remember it?
scripts.translation:
[舒尔]
说起来，不久前塔托说他的年龄等于我和尤贝年龄的平均值。
也许塔托会记得？

scripts.text:
[Shul]
Tato lives in the western part of the town, so try asking him there.
scripts.translation:
[舒尔]
塔托住在城镇西边，去那里问问他吧。

scripts.text:
[Tato]
Moreng's age?
It hasn't been very long since I got to know him, so I don't know his age very well.
scripts.translation:
[塔托]
莫伦的年龄？
我认识他没多久，所以不太清楚他的年龄。

scripts.text:
[Tato]
But why is it that they don't know their own age either?!
scripts.translation:
[塔托]
但为什么他们连自己的年龄都不知道呢？！

scripts.text: What's Tato's age?
scripts.translation: 塔托的年龄是多少？

scripts.text:
[Tato]
I am 146 years old.
scripts.translation:
[塔托]
我今年146岁。

scripts.text: - Although the exact information regarding Moreng's age is still unknown, let's return to Yube first.
scripts.translation: - 虽然莫伦的确切年龄仍然未知，但让我们先回到尤贝那里吧。

scripts.text: - Although the exact information regarding Moreng's age is still unknown, let's return to Yube first.
scripts.translation: - 虽然莫伦的确切年龄仍然未知，但让我们先回到尤贝那里吧。

scripts.text:
[Tato]
A friend of mine recently applied to the Splendide unit.
I heard Jotunheim is really cold. I hope he's doing well.
scripts.translation:
[塔托]
我的一个朋友最近申请加入了辉煌领域部队。
听说约顿海姆非常寒冷，希望他一切都好。

scripts.text:
Eclage is a really nice place to live
The flowers are always in full bloom and the weather is always comfortable.
scripts.translation:
埃克拉珠真是个适合居住的地方。
花儿总是盛开，天气也总是舒适宜人。

scripts.text:
[Moreng]
If there were a beautiful Yai of my own, it would truly be a paradise!
scripts.translation:
[莫伦]
如果我也有一个美丽的雅伊，那这里简直就是天堂！

scripts.text:
[Moreng]
Yai actually signifies an egg.
And to Laphines, Yai could even signify what is beyond a home...
scripts.translation:
[莫伦]
雅伊实际上象征着蛋。
对于拉芬族来说，雅伊甚至象征着超越家园的存在...

scripts.text:
Eclage is a really nice place to live
The flowers are always in full bloom and the weather is always comfortable.
scripts.translation:
埃克拉珠真是个适合居住的地方。
花儿总是盛开，天气也总是舒适宜人。

scripts.text:
[Moreng]
If there were a beautiful Yai of my own, it would truly be a paradise!
scripts.translation:
[莫伦]
如果我也有一个美丽的雅伊，那这里简直就是天堂！

scripts.text:
[Oliver]
Oh, so you call those round houses a Yai.
scripts.translation:
[奥利弗]
原来你们把那些圆形的房子称为雅伊啊。

scripts.text:
[Moreng]
Yai actually signifies an egg.
And to Laphines, Yai could even signify what is beyond a home...
scripts.translation:
[莫伦]
雅伊实际上象征着蛋。
对于拉芬族来说，雅伊甚至象征着超越家园的存在...

scripts.text:
[Moreng]
While I spent time and effort as much as putting my life into it, my Yai is nothing more than a fake.
scripts.translation:
[莫伦]
我倾注了心血，甚至不惜付出生命，但我的雅伊不过是个赝品。

scripts.text:
[Moreng]
It's called an egg and looks like an egg, but it's really not an egg!
It's just something else that just looks like an egg!
scripts.translation:
[莫伦]
它叫蛋，看起来也像蛋，但它真的不是蛋！
它只是某种看起来像蛋的东西！

scripts.text:
[Moreng]
Hey, wait a minute!
Are you possibly from Midgard?!
scripts.translation:
[莫伦]
嘿，等一下！
你难道是来自米德加尔特吗？！

scripts.text: Yes, I am.
scripts.translation: 是的，我是。

scripts.text: No, I am not.
scripts.translation: 不，我不是。

scripts.text:
[Moreng]
I see...
You sure looked like it, but I guess not.
scripts.translation:
[莫伦]
原来如此...
你看起来确实很像，但看来不是。

scripts.text:
[Moreng]
Ah, great!
Then would you happen to know anything about the legend that speaks of a great bird which lives in Midgard?
scripts.translation:
[莫伦]
啊，太好了！
那你是否听说过关于米德加尔特有一只巨鸟的传说？

scripts.text:
I heard a little from various travelers.
According to rumors, there is a legend of a great bird in Midgard that lays an egg as big as a house.
scripts.translation:
我从各种旅行者那里听到了一些消息。
据传闻，米德加尔特有一只巨鸟，它下的蛋有房子那么大。

scripts.text:
[Du Lian]
Wow, if it's an egg as big as a house, how many days would it take to eat it all?
scripts.translation:
[杜连]
哇，如果蛋有房子那么大，吃完它得花多少天啊？

scripts.text:
[Moreng]
......

[Moreng]
When I first heard of that legend, I was so excited that I couldn't sleep for days.
scripts.translation:
[莫伦]
当我第一次听到那个传说时，我兴奋得几天都睡不着觉。

scripts.text:
[Moreng]
But as time went by, and as I aged more, I gradually forgot about it.
Isn't that how all childhood dreams are like?
scripts.translation:
[莫伦]
但随着时间流逝，我渐渐长大了，也慢慢忘记了它。
所有童年的梦想不都是这样吗？

scripts.text:
[Moreng]
But not too long ago when I went to the plaza, I met my old neighbor who told me about a traveler from Midgard holding an incredibly enormous feather...
scripts.translation:
[莫伦]
但不久前，当我去广场时，遇到了我的老邻居，他告诉我有一位来自米德加尔特的旅行者拿着一根巨大的羽毛...

scripts.text:
[Moreng]
Ever since I heard about it, I can't seem to put my mind on anything else.
Could that legend possibly be true?
scripts.translation:
[莫伦]
自从听到这件事后，我就无法专心做其他事情了。
那个传说难道是真的吗？

scripts.text:
[Moreng]
Truthfully, when I heard that story, I went searching all over the town but couldn't find anyone with a huge feather.
scripts.translation:
[莫伦]
说实话，听到那个故事后，我跑遍了整个城镇，却没能找到任何拿着巨大羽毛的人。

scripts.text:
[Moreng]
Do you think that old man's story is real? Or do you think it's a lie?
I used to think of it as a forgotten legend, but now I am even afraid to find out whether it is real or fake.
scripts.translation:
[莫伦]
你觉得那个老人的故事是真的吗？还是说那是谎言？
我以前一直把它当作一个被遗忘的传说，但现在我甚至害怕去证实它到底是真是假。

scripts.text:
[Du Lian]
If you are a real man, don't be so meek!
Face it head on! And if you must, you can crash and burn afterwards!
scripts.translation:
[杜连]
如果你是个真正的男人，就别这么畏畏缩缩！
正面面对它！就算最后失败也没关系！

scripts.text:
[Moreng]
Don't crash and burn anything...
scripts.translation:
[莫伦]
别失败什么的...

scripts.text:
[Du Lian]
For something like that-!
I'll be the one to ask the old man and let you know!
And if the legend sounds fake, I won't tell you so don't you worry!
scripts.translation:
[杜连]
这种事-
我会亲自去问那个老人，然后告诉你！
如果那个传说听起来像是假的，我就不会告诉你，所以你别担心！

scripts.text:
[Mark Esha]
Sometimes you should really remind yourself what it means to say 'ignorance is bliss.'
scripts.translation:
[马克·艾沙]
有时候你真的应该提醒自己，'无知是福'这句话的含义。

scripts.text:
[Mark Esha]
Regardless, I didn't hear anything about that legend either.
Although, for a typical Laphine, something that's insignificant to us could be considered really huge...
scripts.translation:
[马克·艾沙]
不管怎样，我也没听说过那个传说。
不过，对于普通的拉芬人来说，对我们来说微不足道的事情，可能对他们来说真的很大...

scripts.text:
[Alp Ocart]
But since the land of Midgard is truly far and wide, there may be legends we haven't heard of...
scripts.translation:
[阿尔普·奥卡特]
但是既然米德加尔特的土地如此广阔，也许确实有一些我们没听说过的传说...

scripts.text:
[Du Lian]
Yes, it looks like there are no other ways than to meet the old man!
scripts.translation:
[杜连]
是的，看来除了去见那个老人，没有其他办法了！

scripts.text:
Do you think that old man's story is real? Or do you think it's a lie?
I used to think of it as a forgotten legend, but now I am even afraid to find out whether it is real or fake.
scripts.translation:
你觉得那个老人的故事是真的吗？还是说那是谎言？
我以前一直把它当作一个被遗忘的传说，但现在我甚至害怕去证实它到底是真是假。

scripts.text:
[Du Lian]
Yes, it looks like there are no other ways than to meet the old man!
Let's go to the plaza!
scripts.translation:
[杜连]
是的，看来除了去见那个老人，没有其他办法了！
我们去广场吧！

scripts.text:
Do you think that old man's story is real? Or do you think it's a lie?
I used to think of it as a forgotten legend, but now I am even afraid to find out whether it is real or fake.
scripts.translation:
你觉得那个老人的故事是真的吗？还是说那是谎言？
我以前一直把它当作一个被遗忘的传说，但现在我甚至害怕去证实它到底是真是假。

scripts.text:
Is that for real?
I can't believe the legend was true...
scripts.translation:
那是真的吗？
我简直不敢相信那个传说是真的...

scripts.text:
[Moreng]
What can I say?
I feel like I can't just stay here anymore.
I have to quickly pack my bags and leave for Midgard!
scripts.translation:
[莫伦]
我能说什么呢？
我觉得我不能一直留在这里了。
我必须赶紧收拾行李，前往米德加尔特！

scripts.text: - Moreng seems like he's really about to leave soon. I should let Glaces know. -
scripts.translation: - 莫伦看起来真的快要离开了。我应该告诉格拉西斯。 -

scripts.text: I plan to leave for Midgard as soon as my birthday-farewell party with my friends is over.
scripts.translation: 我打算在和朋友们一起过完生日告别派对后，就立刻前往米德加尔特。

scripts.text:
[Moreng]
I would miss my friends for sure, but I should return that much quicker.
scripts.translation:
[莫伦]
我肯定会想念我的朋友们，但我应该能更快回来。

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
Hohoho
scripts.translation:
[老人]
呵呵呵

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
Ooo~ So you changed your mind?
Ok then, I will tell you about the story that Light Standard told only me, about which he met a gold monster in the deep Midgard mountains that eats gems!
scripts.translation:
[老人]
哦~ 你改变主意了？
好吧，那我就告诉你那个光之标准只告诉过我的故事，关于他在米德加尔特深山深处遇到一只吃宝石的金色魔物的事！

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
Hohoho~!
scripts.translation:
[老人]
呵呵呵~！

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
Looks like there are a lot of interesting visitors nowadays...
When I was young, you had to put your life on the line to go into the foreign lands.
scripts.translation:
[老人]
看来现在有很多有趣的访客...
在我年轻的时候，去外国可是要拿命去拼的。

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
Nowadays, things are way more convenient with de-regulation and all.
And with the warps and flying to all these places, where's all the romance in adventures anymore?
scripts.translation:
[老人]
如今随着管制放宽，一切都方便多了。
还有传送和飞行，想去哪就去哪，冒险还有什么浪漫可言呢？

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
Young people nowadays probably don't even know how frog eggs taste like.
scripts.translation:
[老人]
现在的年轻人，大概连蛙卵是什么味道都不知道吧。

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
It seems like yesterday when I saved enough Jellopies to buy a Tsurugi, but even that Tsurugi is deserted somewhere in the storage.
scripts.translation:
[老人]
感觉昨天才刚攒够Jellopie买了一把日本刀，可那把刀现在还被遗忘在仓库的某个角落。

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
Time really is merciless... If I had known this then, I would have...
scripts.translation:
[老人]
时间真是无情... 如果当时我知道这一点，我可能会...

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
Hey! Have you heard of a Laphine hero named Light Standard?
scripts.translation:
[老人]
嘿！你听说过一位名叫光之标准的拉芬英雄吗？

scripts.text: No, I don't think so.
scripts.translation: 不，我不觉得我懂了。

scripts.text: Yes, I have.
scripts.translation: 是的，我听过。

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
Huhuhu...
scripts.translation:
[老人]
呵呵呵...

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
Huhuhu...
He's a hero from so long ago that this generation wouldn't even know who he is.
He is probably long forgotten...
scripts.translation:
[老人]
呵呵呵...
他是一位很久以前的英雄，这一代人甚至不知道他是谁。
他大概早已被人遗忘了...

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
Huhuhu...
It's surprising how a young person like you would know of him.
I thought he would be long forgotten...
scripts.translation:
[老人]
呵呵呵...
像你这样的年轻人竟然知道他，真是令人惊讶。
我还以为他早已被人遗忘了...

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
With a small physique, he was not even a high-level Laphine, but he fought against and defeated incredible monsters.
The word legend seemed to have been made for him.
scripts.translation:
[老人]
他身材矮小，甚至算不上高等级的拉芬，却能与不可思议的魔物战斗并战胜它们。
“传说”这个词似乎就是为他而造的。

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
His heroic accounts were so famous that kids would sing of them in the streets.
But as Ragnarok passed and peace was found, he suddenly retired.
scripts.translation:
[老人]
他的英勇事迹非常有名，孩子们会在街上传唱。但仙境传说结束后，和平降临，他突然引退了。

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
And he was quickly forgotten...
He had great strength, superb intelligence, and strong, wonderful comrades, but he wasn't perfect....
scripts.translation:
[老人]
很快，他就被遗忘了...
他拥有强大的力量、卓越的智慧和强大而出色的同志，但他并不完美....

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
Do you know what he was missing?
scripts.translation:
[老人]
你知道他缺少什么吗？

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
It was a 'friend' like me.
If only if he had reliable and big-hearted friends...
scripts.translation:
[老人]
他缺少像我这样的“朋友”。
如果他有可靠且心胸宽广的朋友就好了...

scripts.text:
[Du Lian]
But old man, would you happen to know anything about a legend regarding the great bird in Midgard?
scripts.translation:
[杜连]
但是老人，您是否知道关于米德加尔特巨鸟的传说？

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
Oh!
You mean the legend of the great bird of Midgard?
scripts.translation:
[老人]
哦！
你是说米德加尔特巨鸟的传说？

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
For that, there's probably no one who knows it better than I in Eclage.
scripts.translation:
[老人]
关于这个，埃克拉珠大概没有人比我更了解了。

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
Well, it wasn't too long after Light Standard arrived in Midgard.
scripts.translation:
[老人]
嗯，那是在光之标准来到米德加尔特后不久。

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
He said he traveled in many adventures for a long time before coming to Midgard, but it was his first time seeing such a massive bird.
scripts.translation:
[老人]
他说在来到米德加尔特之前，他经历了许多冒险，但这是他第一次见到如此巨大的鸟。

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
I also honestly did not believe that there would be such a big bird.
That is, until I ran into a traveler with an immense feather at the town's entrance during my walk.
scripts.translation:
[老人]
说实话，我也不相信会有这么大的鸟。
直到我在散步时，在城镇入口遇到了一位旅行者，他带着一根巨大的羽毛。

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
As soon as I saw that feather, I began to believe all that Light Standard told me.
For example, a clump of dust that was wearing a cone hat in Jotunheim...
scripts.translation:
[老人]
一看到那根羽毛，我就开始相信光之标准告诉我的所有事情了。
比如，在约顿海姆，有一团戴着圆锥帽的灰尘...

scripts.text:
[Du Lian]
Hmm...
Earlier Moreng said he hasn't seen them in the city yet, so maybe he's still outside?
scripts.translation:
[杜连]
嗯...
刚才莫伦说他在城里还没看到它们，所以也许它们还在城外？

scripts.text:
[Du Lian]
Let's get to it then!
scripts.translation:
[杜连]
那我们赶紧去吧！

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
Huh? But I haven't even begun to talk about a monster he met in Midgard who can break any kind of metal!
scripts.translation:
[老人]
什么？我还没开始讲他在米德加尔特遇到的那个能击碎任何金属的魔物呢！

scripts.text:
[Du Lian]
We will hear about it later~
scripts.translation:
[杜连]
我们之后再听嘛~

scripts.text:
[Maggi Steen]
Um...
Du already ran off...
If we let him be, I wonder what kind of trouble he'll create next.
scripts.translation:
[玛姬·斯汀]
那个...
杜已经跑远了...
要是放任他不管，不知道他下次又会惹出什么麻烦。

scripts.text:
[Maggi Steen]
To get to the city's entrance, we have to get through the bridge that Du broke, but I wonder if it has been fixed.
scripts.translation:
[玛姬·斯汀]
要去到城镇入口，必须经过杜弄坏的那座桥，不知道修好了没有。

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
Looks like there are a lot of interesting visitors nowadays...
When I was young, you had to put your life on the line to go into the foreign lands.
scripts.translation:
[老人]
看来现在有很多有趣的访客...
在我年轻的时候，去外国可是要拿命去拼的。

scripts.text:
Old Man#ep14_2
Nowadays, things are much more convenient with de-regulation and all.
And with the warps and flying to all these places, where's all the romance in adventures anymore?
scripts.translation:
老人#ep14_2
如今，随着法规的放宽，一切都方便多了。
再加上传送和飞行，想去哪里就去哪里，冒险还有什么浪漫可言呢？

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
Young people nowadays probably don't even know how frog eggs taste like.
scripts.translation:
[老人]
现在的年轻人，大概连蛙卵是什么味道都不知道吧。

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
It seems like yesterday when I saved enough Jellopies to buy a Tsurugi, but even that Tsurugi is deserted somewhere in storage.
scripts.translation:
[老人]
感觉昨天才刚攒够Jellopie买了一把日本刀，结果那把刀现在还被遗忘在仓库的某个角落。

scripts.text:
[Traveler]
Who are you?
I've never seen you before.
scripts.translation:
[旅行者]
你们是谁？
我好像没见过你们。

scripts.text:
[Traveler]
Hey you guys, you can get into Eclage, right?
There is a cat sack merchant who's doing business in the plaza.
scripts.translation:
[旅行者]
嘿，你们能进埃克拉珠吧？
广场里有个猫麻袋商人在做生意。

scripts.text:
[Traveler]
Oh dear, my money...
I can't believe it was a fake...
Oy oy....
scripts.translation:
[旅行者]
哎呀，我的钱...
没想到竟然是假的...
真是的...

scripts.text:
[Traveler]
Oh, you came to ask me about the feather, too?
It's just a plain old decoration, but everyone really likes to bother me about it.
scripts.translation:
[旅行者]
哦，你们也是来问那根羽毛的事吗？
那只是个普通的装饰品，但大家总是喜欢拿它来烦我。

scripts.text:
[Traveler]
If you are thinking about selling it, you should just give up.
I have no wishes to sell it no matter how much you beg.
scripts.translation:
[旅行者]
如果你是想买它，那就死心吧。
不管你们怎么求我，我都不会卖的。

scripts.text:
[Traveler]
This feather.
It's not an ordinary feather.
scripts.translation:
[旅行者]
这根羽毛。
它可不是一根普通的羽毛。

scripts.text:
[Traveler]
Heh...
Well, it's actually too recent to even brag about...
scripts.translation:
[旅行者]
呵...
其实事情发生得不久，也没什么好炫耀的...

scripts.text:
[Traveler]
It's just luck that I ran into it not too long after I arrived in Alfheim.
scripts.translation:
[旅行者]
只是运气好，我刚到艾尔海姆不久就遇到了它。

scripts.text:
[Traveler]
It was so amazing. When it flapped its colossal wings, I couldn't even gather myself to attack because I was too busy just holding on.
scripts.translation:
[旅行者]
那场面太壮观了。当它扇动巨大的翅膀时，我忙着抓紧身体，根本来不及发起攻击。

scripts.text:
[Traveler]
But I am not one to give up so easily.
If I think about it, it was a very long fight.
scripts.translation:
[旅行者]
但我可不是轻易放弃的人。
回想起来，那是一场非常漫长的战斗。

scripts.text:
[Du Lian]
That's weird. The old man earlier said that he saw it in Midgard.
scripts.translation:
[杜连]
这不对劲。刚才那个老人说他在米德加尔特见过它。

scripts.text:
[Traveler]
Eck!
No... No way.
I definitely saw it at Midgard.
scripts.translation:
[旅行者]
咦？
不...不可能。
我明明是在米德加尔特看到它的。

scripts.text:
[Traveler]
I didn't want to show you this, but this scar is the proof.
It was truly a life-threatening battle.
scripts.translation:
[旅行者]
我本来不想给你们看的，但这道伤疤就是证据。
那真是一场生死之战。

scripts.text:
[Mark Esha]
Hmm...
For a fight not too long ago, the scar seems very old.
From how the scar looks, it doesn't even seem like it's been treated by magic...
scripts.translation:
[马克·艾沙]
嗯...
既然战斗结束没多久，这道伤疤看起来却非常陈旧。
从伤疤的样子来看，甚至不像受过魔法治疗...

scripts.text:
[Traveler]
Eeck!!!!
If... If I really think about, it might be awhile back actually.
I can't remember too well having so many memoirs and souvenirs.
scripts.translation:
[旅行者]
咦！！！！
如...如果仔细想想，那可能确实是很久以前的事了。
因为记忆和纪念品太多，我记不太清了。

scripts.text:
[Oliver]
But how did you travel to other places when you can't even enter Eclage?
scripts.translation:
[奥利弗]
可是你连埃克拉珠都进不去，是怎么去其他地方的？

scripts.text:
[Maggi Steen]
If it came near here somewhere, there's no way others haven't seen it...
scripts.translation:
[玛姬·斯汀]
如果它曾出现在这里附近，不可能没人见过...

scripts.text:
[Traveler]
Keeeek!!!!
Yes!
scripts.translation:
[旅行者]
呜！！！！
是的！

scripts.text:
[Traveler]
Actually, this isn't my first time here, but I had the opportunity to go to other places during when deregulation was at its peak awhile back.
scripts.translation:
[旅行者]
其实这不是我第一次来这里，只是在之前管制最严格的时候，我有机会去过其他地方。

scripts.text:
[Alp Ocart]
Hmm... But this feather...
If I look at it very closely, the shaft is too thick for its size
scripts.translation:
[阿尔普·奥卡特]
嗯...但这根羽毛...
如果仔细看，它的羽轴相对于大小来说太粗了。

scripts.text:
[Alp Ocart]
And doesn't the end of it seem really jagged?
scripts.translation:
[阿尔普·奥卡特]
而且它的末端看起来非常参差不齐？

scripts.text:
[Traveler]
Really?!
Wait! Let me see!!!!
Oh my, that's really true!
How dare that cat sell me a fake?!
scripts.translation:
[旅行者]
真的吗？！
等等！让我看看！！！！
天哪，确实是这样！
那只猫怎么敢卖假货给我？！

scripts.text:
[Du Lian]
Oh.... You bought it, didn't you?
scripts.translation:
[杜连]
哦...你是买来的，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Oliver]
You bought it, right?
scripts.translation:
[奥利弗]
你是买来的，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Alp Ocart]
Hmm... Even so, I guess this is a great piece of work. It really seems like the real thing.
scripts.translation:
[阿尔普·奥卡特]
嗯...即便如此，这也是一件杰作。它看起来真的很像真品。

scripts.text:
[Traveler]
Hu....
You have no idea how expensive this was!
scripts.translation:
[旅行者]
呼....
你不知道这东西有多贵！

scripts.text:
[Traveler]
Hey you guys, you can get into Eclage, right?
There is a cat merchant who's doing business in the plaza.
scripts.translation:
[旅行者]
你们能进埃克拉珠，对吧？
广场上有个猫商人在做生意。

scripts.text:
[Traveler]
That guy just stole my money and...
Hmm...
Please catch the cat before others also lose their money!
scripts.translation:
[旅行者]
那家伙偷了我的钱...
嗯...
请在别人也损失钱财之前抓住那只猫！

scripts.text:
[Traveler]
At least hold him until I can get into Eclage!
I ask you!
Please!
scripts.translation:
[旅行者]
至少在我能进入埃克拉珠之前先拦住它！
拜托了！
求求你们了！

scripts.text:
[Traveler]
That guy just stole my money and...
Hmm...
Please catch the cat before others also lose their money!
scripts.translation:
[旅行者]
那家伙偷了我的钱...
嗯...
请在别人也损失钱财之前抓住那只猫！

scripts.text:

I ask you!
Please!
scripts.translation:
[旅行者]
至少在我能进入埃克拉珠之前先拦住它！
拜托了！
求求你们了！

Oh, you came to ask me about the feather, too?
It's just a plain old decoration, but everyone really likes to bother me about it.
scripts.translation:
[旅行者]
哦，你们也是来问那根羽毛的事吗？
那只是个普通的装饰品，但大家总是喜欢拿它来烦我。

scripts.translation:

如果你是想买它，那就死心吧。

scripts.text:
[Traveler]
This feather..
scripts.translation:
[旅行者]
这根羽毛...

scripts.text:
[Sack Merchant]
Meow?
Helloeow~
I have a treasure from a place very, very fareow~
Take a lookeow~
I'll give you a good priceow~
scripts.translation:
[麻袋商人]
喵？
你好喵~
我这里有来自非常非常远的地方的宝物喵~
来看看喵~
我会给你一个好价格喵~

scripts.text: Talk about the feather.
scripts.translation: 谈论那根羽毛

scripts.text:
[Sack Merchant]
That's not trueow~!
I'm seriouseow~!
scripts.translation:
[麻袋商人]
才不是那样喵！
我是很认真的喵！

scripts.text:
[Sack Merchant]
That's definitely a precious item from Midgardeow.
scripts.translation:
[麻袋商人]
那绝对是来自米德加德的珍贵宝物喵。

scripts.text:
[Alp Ocart]
This end of the feather here is not very convincing...
scripts.translation:
[阿尔普·奥卡特]
这根羽毛的末端看起来不太像真的...

scripts.text:
[Sack Merchant]
Meoweoweow!!!
I...I can't believe you noticedeow...Pretty sharpeow...
scripts.translation:
[麻袋商人]
喵呜哇哇哇！！！
我...我没想到你会注意到喵...观察力真敏锐喵...

scripts.text:
[Sack Merchant]
Actually...
The feather is real for sure, but I modified just a tinyyy~tiny biteow...
scripts.translation:
[麻袋商人]
其实...
羽毛本身肯定是真的，但我只是稍微~稍微改了一点点喵...

scripts.text:
[Sack Merchant]
Because the feather was too big to carry around, I thought that I could cut it up into pieces and sell it to many moreow. But when I cut it, it was a bit weird so I just adjusted it, you seeow.
scripts.translation:
[麻袋商人]
因为羽毛太大不好携带，我想把它切成碎片卖给更多人喵。但切的时候发现有点不对劲，所以就稍微调整了一下，你懂的喵。

scripts.text:
[Maggi Steen]
This is just a cut piece?
Then how big was the real thing?
scripts.translation:
[玛姬·斯汀]
这只是切下来的一块？
那原本有多大？

scripts.text:
[Sack Merchant]
Hmm..
It was from here to thereow.
scripts.translation:
[麻袋商人]
嗯...
大概是从这里到那里那么大喵。

scripts.text:
[Sack Merchant]
I couldn't possibly carry something that bigeow...
scripts.translation:
[麻袋商人]
我怎么可能搬得动那么大的东西喵...

scripts.text:
[Du Lian]
Whoa whoa!
If it's that big, you could probably make a fried egg with the size of this plaza!
scripts.translation:
[杜连]
哇哦！
如果真有那么大，恐怕能煎出一个比这个广场还大的荷包蛋吧！

scripts.text:
[Mark Esha]
That's probably too much...
Anyways, that was important to know, so we better let Moreng know.
scripts.translation:
[马克·艾沙]
那可能有点夸张了...
总之，这很重要，我们最好告诉莫伦。

scripts.text:
[Mark Esha]
Anyways, that was important to know, so we better let Moreng know.
scripts.translation:
[马克·艾沙]
总之，这很重要，我们最好告诉莫伦。

scripts.text:
[Sack Merchant]
Meow?
Helloeow~
I have a treasure from a place very, very fareow~
Take a lookeow~
I'll give you a good priceow~
scripts.translation:
[麻袋商人]
喵？
你好喵~
我这里有来自非常非常远的地方的宝物喵~
来看看喵~
我会给你一个好价格喵~

scripts.text: - Looks like the door is locked. -
scripts.translation: - 门好像锁住了。 -

scripts.text: - Something seems a bit different. -
scripts.translation: - 这里似乎有些不同。 -

scripts.text:
[Yube]
Hmm, the legend of a great bird?
I think there was one, but since I don't believe in myths, I didn't pay much attention.
scripts.translation:
[尤贝]
嗯，关于一只大鸟的传说？
我想是有这么回事，但我不相信神话，所以没太在意。

scripts.text:
[Yube]
Whew...
Done...
The ones I took last time couldn't be used because of a mistake, and I was scolded so much for that...
scripts.translation:
[尤贝]
呼...
终于弄完了...
上次拿来的东西因为出错没法用，我被骂得很惨...

scripts.text:
[Yube]
Now that I'm done with work that Master wanted, I should get going to help out with the party.
scripts.translation:
[尤贝]
既然完成了师父交代的工作，我该去帮忙队伍了。

scripts.text:
[Yube]
How did you get in here?
Uninvited guests are not very welcome, you know?
scripts.translation:
[尤贝]
你是怎么进来的？
不请自来的客人，可不太受欢迎哦？

scripts.text:
[Yube]
Make yourself at home.
scripts.translation:
[尤贝]
请自便。

scripts.text:
[Yube]
You didn't tell Glaces?
scripts.translation:
[尤贝]
你没告诉格拉西斯吗？

scripts.text:
[Yube]
I guess if you look at Glaces' Yai...
When I first saw the crack, I was reminded of Glace's Yai.
scripts.translation:
[尤贝]
我想，如果你看看格拉西斯的Yai...
当我第一次看到那道裂缝时，我想起了格拉西斯的Yai。

scripts.text:
[Yube]
In any case, finding the great bird's egg firsthand is probably better than receiving it as a gift, right?
scripts.translation:
[尤贝]
总之，亲眼找到大鸟的蛋，总比收到它作为礼物要好，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Yube]
Ok, I should hurry with the party preparations.
I'll send whatever is urgent to Splendide first...
scripts.translation:
[尤贝]
好了，我得赶紧准备队伍的事宜了。
我会先把紧急的东西送到辉煌领域...

scripts.text:
[Yube]
It's always exciting to place seeds in a box...
One mistake can lead to immense consequences.
scripts.translation:
[尤贝]
把种子放进盒子里总是令人兴奋的...
一个错误可能导致巨大的后果。

scripts.text:
[Yube]
Please give me a minute since this is a critical process.
scripts.translation:
[尤贝]
请给我一分钟，因为这是一个关键的过程。

scripts.text:
[Yube]
Ok, if you don't mind, could you take this to a delivery man at the plaza?
Master kindly sent me a delivery man specifically for this...
scripts.translation:
[尤贝]
好的，如果不介意的话，你能把这个送到广场的送货员那里吗？
师父特意给我安排了一个送货员...

scripts.text:
[Yube]
Maybe it's an underlying statement that I would be eliminated if it's not sent right away...
scripts.translation:
[尤贝]
也许这是一种暗示，如果我不马上送出去，我就会被淘汰...

scripts.text:
[Yube]
I will be on my way so I'll catch you later~
scripts.translation:
[尤贝]
我要出发了，回头见~

scripts.text:
[Maggi Steen]
Be safe now~
scripts.translation:
[玛姬·斯汀]
注意安全哦~

scripts.text:
[Du Lian]
Hmm, now what do we do?
Hey Mark, do we have some kind of schedule or whatever?
scripts.translation:
[杜连]
嗯，现在我们要做什么？
嘿，马克，我们有什么日程安排之类的吗？

scripts.text:
[Mark Esha]
Aren't you even a bit tired after all that?
Let's rest up a bit.
scripts.translation:
[马克·艾沙]
经历了这么多，你一点都不累吗？
让我们休息一下吧。

scripts.text:
[Oliver]
Hmm...
I'm hungry.
scripts.translation:
[奥利弗]
嗯...
我饿了。

scripts.text:
[Oliver]
Acorns!
I saw many acorns just outside the city!
I want them!
scripts.translation:
[奥利弗]
橡子！
我刚在城外看到很多橡子！
我想要！

scripts.text:
[Du Lian]
Acorns?!
Are they any good?
scripts.translation:
[杜连]
橡子？！
它们好吃吗？

scripts.text:
[Du Lian]
Alright then, shall we get some acorns?
I'll bring a bunch back!
scripts.translation:
[杜连]
好吧，那我们去拿些橡子吧？
我会带一堆回来！

scripts.text:
[Oliver]
Hey hey hey!
I told you not to pull on my cheeks!!
scripts.translation:
[奥利弗]
嘿，嘿，嘿！
我告诉过你不要拉我的脸颊！！

scripts.text:
[Mark Esha]
Seriously, you just don't get tired huh...
Ok, I'm going to rest here with the others, so do what you need to do.
scripts.translation:
[马克·艾沙]
真是的，你就是不累啊...
好吧，我要在这里和其他人一起休息，你去忙你的吧。

scripts.text:
[Du Lian]
Greeeeat!
Let's go!{0}!
scripts.translation:
[杜连]
太棒了！
我们走！{0}！

I will be on my way so I'll catch you later~

[Oliver]
Acorns~~!!!
I thought you said you'll bring a whole bunch of acorns~~
scripts.translation:
[奥利弗]
橡子~~！！！
你不是说会带一堆橡子回来吗~~

scripts.text:
[Oliver]
Whoa, what a delicious looking acorn!
Thanks!
scripts.translation:
[奥利弗]
哇，这看起来真好吃！
谢谢！

scripts.text:
[Oliver]
Yawnnn... so sleepy...
I'm going to take a nap, so wake me up when we're leaving... Don't leave without me now~
scripts.translation:
[奥利弗]
哈欠...好困...
我要去睡一会儿，出发的时候叫醒我...现在别丢下我走哦~

scripts.text:
[Du Lian]
Let's go!{0}!
scripts.translation:
[杜连]
我们走！{0}！

scripts.text:
[Oliver]
It's so good!!!
What about you Maggi?
scripts.translation:
[奥利弗]
太好吃了！！！
玛姬，你觉得怎么样？

scripts.text:
[Maggi Steen]
It's very good.
scripts.translation:
[玛姬·斯汀]
非常好吃。

scripts.text:
[Oliver]
Yay!! What a feast!!
I'm full now.
Ugh...
scripts.translation:
[奥利弗]
耶！！真是一顿盛宴！！
我吃饱了。
唉...

scripts.text:
[Du Lian]
Oliver, eat more.
You have to eat a lot when you're young. That's how you'll grow!
scripts.translation:
[杜连]
奥利弗，再吃点。
小孩子要多吃才能长身体！

scripts.text:
[Oliver]
Yawn...
I'm full...
I'm sleepy...
scripts.translation:
[奥利弗]
哈欠...
我吃饱了...
好困...

scripts.text:
[Du Lian]
Hey Oliver, don't suddenly be so lazy now...
scripts.translation:
[杜连]
嘿，奥利弗，别突然这么懒散...

scripts.text:
[Oliver]
But I'm so sleepy.
scripts.translation:
[奥利弗]
可是我好困。

scripts.text:
[Oliver]
I thought this was all a dream, but I guess it's not seeing how sleepy I am.
scripts.translation:
[奥利弗]
我以为这全是梦，但看我现在这么困，应该不是梦吧。

scripts.text:
[Oliver]
Acorns were so good...
Zzzz....
scripts.translation:
[奥利弗]
橡子真好吃...
呼噜噜....

scripts.text:
[Oliver]
...

[Oliver]
...

[Alp Ocart]
...
scripts.translation:
[阿尔普·奥卡特]
...

scripts.text:
[Du Lian]
AHHHHHHHH!!!!!!!!!!
scripts.translation:
[杜连]
啊啊啊啊啊！！！！！！

scripts.text:
[Delivery Man]
Is this that item?
I'll mail it safely, so you won't have to worry about it.
scripts.translation:
[送货员]
是这个物品吗？
我会安全寄送的，您不用担心。

scripts.text:
[Delivery Man]
Sigh...
I need to get going in order to make it on time.
scripts.translation:
[送货员]
唉...
我得赶紧走了，不然赶不上时间了。

scripts.text:
[Delivery Man]
The road from Splendide to Eclage used to be dangerous, but nowadays, it's actually better to come all the way to Eclage.
scripts.translation:
[送货员]
从辉煌领域到埃克拉珠的路以前很危险，但现在直接送到埃克拉珠反而更安全。

scripts.text:
[Delivery Man]
I don't know why people can't just make small amounts of pickled Poring for themselves instead of mailing them...
scripts.translation:
[送货员]
我不明白为什么人们不自己腌一点波利，非要邮寄过来...

scripts.text:
[Delivery Man]
Wait a minute...
Is it actually better to deliver it later...
I remember seeing so many boxes of pickled Poring in the storage waiting to be delivered...
scripts.translation:
[送货员]
等一下...
其实晚点送可能更好...
我记得仓库里堆了很多箱等着寄送的腌波利...

scripts.text:
- Stop here !! -
- The weight is just too much that -
- you cannot receive the item. -
- Please lighten your load -
- and try again. -
scripts.translation:
- 停在这里！！ -
- 负重太重了 -
- 无法接收物品。 -
- 请减轻负重 -
- 然后重试。 -

scripts.text:
[Du Lian]
Hmm... Where did he go...?
Could he be... a ghost?!
scripts.translation:
[杜连]
嗯...他去哪了...？
该不会...是幽灵吧？！

scripts.text:
[Maggi Steen]
I didn't sense any use of magic or other things of the sort...
scripts.translation:
[玛姬·斯汀]
我没有感觉到魔法或其他类似的东西...

scripts.text:
[Maggi Steen]
Wait! Here's the hood that Oliver was wearing...
scripts.translation:
[玛姬·斯汀]
等等！这是奥利弗戴的兜帽...

scripts.text:
[Maggi Steen]
And... doesn't it feel like this room is different from before?
scripts.translation:
[玛姬·斯汀]
而且...这个房间感觉和之前不一样？

scripts.text:
[Du Lian]
Hey stop that!!
It's scaring me!!!
scripts.translation:
[杜连]
嘿，住手！！
吓死我了！！！

scripts.text:
[Maggi Steen]
Arrrrr~~
scripts.translation:
[玛姬·斯汀]
啊啊啊~~

scripts.text:
[Alp Ocart]
Oh!!! I just remembered...
Oliver...
scripts.translation:
[阿尔普·奥卡特]
哦！！！我想起来了...
奥利弗...

scripts.text:
[Alp Ocart]
...
Oliver Hilpert...
.........is also known as the dreaming novelist...
scripts.translation:
[阿尔普·奥卡特]
...
奥利弗·希尔佩特...
.........也被称为梦幻小说家...

scripts.text:
[Alp Ocart]
And this book...
Why didn't I remember this book when Oliver was around?
scripts.translation:
[阿尔普·奥卡特]
还有这本书...
为什么奥利弗在的时候，我不记得这本书？

scripts.text:
[Du Lian]
Hey...
Did you just take that book out from your bag?
scripts.translation:
[杜连]
嘿...
你刚才把书从包里拿出来的？

scripts.text:
[Alp Ocart]
Yeah, that's because I'm a fan...
scripts.translation:
[阿尔普·奥卡特]
是的，因为我是他的粉丝...

scripts.text:
[Du Lian]
Why didn't you remember the book when you are such a fan..?
Not only that, do people usually carry books with them when they're fans?? Especially hardcover books?
scripts.translation:
[杜连]
既然你是粉丝，为什么之前不记得这本书？
而且，粉丝通常会随身带着书吗？尤其是精装书？

scripts.text:
[Alp Ocart]
......
scripts.translation:
[阿尔普·奥卡特]
......

scripts.text:
[Du Lian]
You are a little bit weir...
scripts.translation:
[杜连]
你有点怪...

scripts.text:
[Mark Esha]
More importantly... The title of this book...
is [The City of Fairies]?
scripts.translation:
[马克·艾沙]
更重要的是...这本书的书名...
是《精灵之城》？

scripts.text:
[Mark Esha]
And...
It's been many years since this book was published...
scripts.translation:
[马克·艾沙]
而且...
这本书出版已经很多年了...

scripts.text:
[Du Lian]
...This is getting kind of scary...?
scripts.translation:
[杜连]
...这有点吓人...

scripts.text:
[Mark Esha]
......

[Maggi Steen]
......

[Alp Ocart]
......
scripts.translation:
[阿尔普·奥卡特]
......

scripts.text:
[Du Lian]
But this is Volume 1. Does that mean there's more?
scripts.translation:
[杜连]
但这是第一卷。这意味着还有更多？

scripts.text:
[Alp Ocart]
It has a total of 3 volumes.
scripts.translation:
[阿尔普·奥卡特]
总共有3卷。

scripts.text:
[Du Lian]
Wow, how many are you carrying with you...
Why are you bringing all of them around...
scripts.translation:
[杜连]
哇，你身上背了这么多...
为什么要全都带着到处跑啊...

scripts.text:
[Mark Esha]
Everybody calm down!!!
This has to be some kind of a dream!
scripts.translation:
[马克·艾沙]
大家冷静一点！！！
这一定是某种梦吧！

scripts.text:
[Du Lian]
Why are you hitting me, calling it a dream and all!
It hurts!
scripts.translation:
[杜连]
你干嘛打我，还说什么这是梦！
好痛啊！

scripts.text:
[Mark Esha]
Ahhhh maybe it really isn't a dream after all!!!
scripts.translation:
[马克·艾沙]
啊啊啊，看来真的不是梦啊！！！

scripts.text:
[Maggi Steen]
...A...A...Aaaaahhhhhhhhh!!!!!
scripts.translation:
[玛姬·斯汀]
...啊...啊...啊啊啊啊啊啊啊！！！

scripts.text:
[Du Lian]
Don't cry, Maggi~
scripts.translation:
[杜连]
别哭啦，玛姬~

scripts.text:
[Alp Ocart]
I wonder...
Why didn't I remember this...?
scripts.translation:
[阿尔普·奥卡特]
我在想...
为什么我没有想起这件事...

scripts.text:
[Alp Ocart]
I... I should have.. I should have gotten his autograph!!!
scripts.translation:
[阿尔普·奥卡特]
我...我应该...我应该要让他签名的！！！

scripts.text:
- Stop Here!! -
- You have too many items. -
- You cannot carry any more items. -
- Lighten your load and -
- try again. -
scripts.translation:
- 停在这里！！ -
- 您的物品太多了。 -
- 您无法再携带任何物品。 -
- 请减轻负重， -
- 然后再试一次。 -

scripts.text:
[Wuhari]
I haven't seen your face before... You aren't from around here?
scripts.translation:
[乌哈里]
我好像没见过你的脸...你不是这附近的人吧？

scripts.text:
[Wuhari]
{0} - Hello, what brings you here?
I thought you were busy...
scripts.translation:
[乌哈里]
{0} - 你好，什么事把你带到这里来了？
我还以为你很忙呢...

scripts.text:
[Wuhari]
Have you met my brother yet?
scripts.translation:
[乌哈里]
你见过我哥哥了吗？

scripts.text:
[Wuhari]
