Oh, {0} Have you met my brother yet? How is he doing?
scripts.translation:
[乌哈里]
哦，{0} 你见过我哥哥了吗？他最近怎么样？

scripts.text:
[Wuhari]
Oh man, even the people we found are so apathetic... What could I possibly do now...?
scripts.translation:
[乌哈里]
天哪，连我们找到的人都这么冷漠...我现在还能做什么呢...

scripts.text:
[Wuhari]
What happened?
scripts.translation:
[乌哈里]
发生什么事了？

scripts.text:
[Wuhari]
What happened? Did you find out anything?
scripts.translation:
[乌哈里]
发生什么事了？你查到什么了吗？

scripts.text:
[Wuhari]
I'm still in the process of looking through the report. It's very complex, so I'll need more time.
scripts.translation:
[乌哈里]
我还在查阅报告。内容非常复杂，我需要更多时间。

scripts.text:
[Wuhari]
Great, you got here at the right time.
scripts.translation:
[乌哈里]
太好了，你来得正是时候。

scripts.text:
[Wuhari]
{0} Are you going to help me?
scripts.translation:
[乌哈里]
{0} 你愿意帮我吗？

scripts.text:
[Wuhari]
Did you find that high-level Laphine?
scripts.translation:
[乌哈里]
你找到那只高等级的拉芬了吗？

scripts.text:
[Wuhari]
Did you bring all the ingredients?
scripts.translation:
[乌哈里]
你把所有材料都带齐了吗？

scripts.text:
[Wuhari]
Ah... Is there anyone with more experience with this...
scripts.translation:
[乌哈里]
啊...有没有谁在这方面更有经验呢...

scripts.text:
[Wuhari]
The research is still ongoing. If I had a thread of hope, I would hang on it, but I can't seem to find it just yet.
scripts.translation:
[乌哈里]
研究还在进行中。如果有一丝希望，我都会紧紧抓住，但我目前似乎还找不到方向。

scripts.text: [Wuhari]
scripts.translation: [乌哈里]

scripts.text:
[Wuhari]
If you are a person who has enough courage and wisdom to go to a foreign land all alone, I'm sure you have a lot of experience as well.
scripts.translation:
[乌哈里]
如果你是一个有足够勇气和智慧，能独自前往异国他乡的人，我相信你一定拥有很多经验。

scripts.text:
[Wuhari]
I would like to learn the name of a great adventurer like you, so that I can talk about you elsewhere.
scripts.translation:
[乌哈里]
我想请教一下像您这样伟大的冒险者的名字，这样我可以在别处谈论您。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
My name is {1}.

[Wuhari]
Wow! The name sure sounds like it has defeated many in the mountains, seas, and skies! It's amazing!
scripts.translation:
[乌哈里]
哇！这名字听起来就像是在山川湖海中击败过无数敌人一样！太了不起了！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
It's not much.
I am not really all that great.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
没什么了不起的。
我也没那么厉害。

scripts.text:
[Wuhari]
Um... {0} I ask because you look so dependable.
Could I please ask you a favor?
scripts.translation:
[乌哈里]
嗯... {0} 我之所以这么问，是因为您看起来非常可靠。
可以请您帮个忙吗？

scripts.text: I'm kind of busy right now...
scripts.translation: 我现在有点忙...

scripts.text: Of course!
scripts.translation: 当然！

scripts.text:
[Wuhari]
Really? Oh well...
scripts.translation:
[乌哈里]
是吗？好吧...

scripts.text:
[Wuhari]
Sorry to bother you.
scripts.translation:
[乌哈里]
抱歉打扰您了。

scripts.text:
[Wuhari]
Really?
Thank you so much!
scripts.translation:
[乌哈里]
真的吗？
太感谢您了！

scripts.text:
[Wuhari]
For me, I have a ^0000cd big brother^000000.
scripts.translation:
[乌哈里]
对我来说，我有一个^0000cd哥哥^000000。

scripts.text:
[Wuhari]
My brother is... not an extremely well-known scholar.
Although his fame lost a bit of flare these recent years because he was stuck at home getting too fond of housework.
scripts.translation:
[乌哈里]
我的哥哥...并不是什么特别著名的学者。
虽然近年来因为他宅在家里沉迷于家务，名声稍微有些黯淡了。

scripts.text:
[Wuhari]
It's been long since the last time I saw his face because I was all over the place for a while.
scripts.translation:
[乌哈里]
因为我之前四处奔波，已经很久没见到他的面了。

scripts.text:
[Wuhari]
I don't mean to brag, but I am also a distinguished intellectual myself, so I'm sought after by many, haha.
scripts.translation:
[乌哈里]
我也不想自夸，但我自己也是一位杰出的知识分子，所以很多人都会来找我，哈哈。

scripts.text:
[Wuhari]
Anyways, we wrote letters to each other regularly, but with a sudden drop in contact, I hurriedly came to see him to find out that ^0000cdhe was taken to jail^000000.
scripts.translation:
[乌哈里]
总之，我们之前一直有书信往来，但突然就断了联系。我急忙赶去看他，结果发现^0000cd他被关进了监狱^000000。

scripts.text:
[Wuhari]
They said something about his research but I don't know the details myself. I would like to find out more, but I am not in a situation to make my way there.
scripts.translation:
[乌哈里]
他们说是关于他的研究，但我自己也不清楚具体细节。我想了解更多，但我现在的处境无法亲自前往那里。

scripts.text:
[Wuhari]
{0} would you mind ^0000cdvisiting my big brother in my place^000000 to find out what's going on and let me know?
scripts.translation:
[乌哈里]
{0} 您介意^0000cd替我去探望一下我哥哥^000000，弄清楚发生了什么，然后告诉我吗？

scripts.text: I would like to help you but...
scripts.translation: 我想帮您，但是...

scripts.text: Sure.
scripts.translation: 当然。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I would really lke to help you, but...
Yeah, I would like to help, but...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我很想帮您，但是...
嗯，我很想帮忙，可是...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I can't really express my desire to help any other way...
But, I'm really sorry. I can't.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我实在不知该如何表达我想帮忙的心情...
但，真的很抱歉。我做不到。

scripts.text:
[Wuhari]
Oh, no, no. I am sure you are really busy. I'm sorry to have asked such a favor.
scripts.translation:
[乌哈里]
啊，不，不。我相信您一定很忙。抱歉让您为难了。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Sure. It's not a big deal.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
当然。没什么大不了的。

scripts.text:
[Wuhari]
Really? Thank you so much.
It seems that a person with so much experience like you has a wonderful heart as well.
scripts.translation:
[乌哈里]
真的吗？太感谢您了。
看来像您这样经验丰富的人，心地也非常善良。

scripts.text: I wanted to help you.
scripts.translation: 我想帮您。

scripts.text: Just because.
scripts.translation: 只是顺手而已。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I was just wondering how things are coming along.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我只是想知道事情进展得怎么样了。

scripts.text:
[Wuhari]
Nothing... Nothing really happened yet...
I can't do anything in my own strength... Nothing at all...
scripts.translation:
[乌哈里]
没什么...还没发生什么...
凭我自己的力量什么都做不了...完全无能为力...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I just couldn't pass by without doing something about it.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我只是觉得不能就这样置之不理。

scripts.text:
[Wuhari]
Does that mean you would meet up with my brother?
Thank you so much!!!
scripts.translation:
[乌哈里]
那意思是您会去见我哥哥吗？
太感谢您了！！！

scripts.text:
[Wuhari]
The prison is inside the palace, but to find it, it might be a bit difficult.
scripts.translation:
[乌哈里]
监狱在宫殿里面，但找到它可能有点困难。

scripts.text:
[Wuhari]
By the way, my brother ^0000cddoesn't talk very well to strangers.^000000
He's typically very shy and introverted.
scripts.translation:
[乌哈里]
顺便说一句，我哥哥^0000cd不太擅长和陌生人说话^000000。
他通常非常害羞且内向。

scripts.text:
[Wuhari]
So you might have to be a bit patient with him. Please give this ^0000cdletter^000000 to him.
scripts.translation:
[乌哈里]
所以您可能需要对他多一点耐心。请把这封^0000cd信件^000000交给他。

scripts.text:
[Wuhari]
Well, you must have a long way to go, so please be on your way.
scripts.translation:
[乌哈里]
好了，您路途遥远，请快出发吧。

scripts.text: I lost the letter.
scripts.translation: 我把信弄丢了。

scripts.text: Not yet.
scripts.translation: 还没有准备好。

scripts.text:
[Wuhari]
Um... {0} It looks like what you have in your coat is my letter...?
scripts.translation:
[乌哈里]
嗯... {0} 看起来您外套里装的是我的信...？

scripts.text:
[Wuhari]
Sure, I'll write you another one {0}. Compared to the trouble you have to go through, this is not a problem at all.
scripts.translation:
[乌哈里]
当然，我再给您写一封 {0}。比起您要经历的麻烦，这根本不算什么。

scripts.text:
[Wuhari]
I know I'm the one asking a favor, but could you please hurry?
scripts.translation:
[乌哈里]
我知道是我在求人帮忙，但能请您快点吗？

scripts.text: [Wuhari]
scripts.translation: [乌哈里]

scripts.text:
[Wuhari]
I am really concerned about him.
scripts.translation:
[乌哈里]
我真的非常担心他。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Your brother seems to be doing well.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
您的弟弟看起来过得很好。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Compared to how he was when I first met him, he surprisingly had... lots to say...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
比起我第一次见到他时的样子，他居然...话很多...

scripts.text:
[Wuhari]
Yeah... He's pretty talkative, isn't he?
scripts.translation:
[乌哈里]
是啊...他确实挺健谈的，不是吗？

scripts.text:
[Wuhari]
What did he say?
scripts.translation:
[乌哈里]
他说了什么？

scripts.text: - Wuhari is told about Wuhuru -
scripts.translation: - 乌哈里得知了关于乌胡鲁的事 -

scripts.text:
[Wuhari]
Why did he do such a thing...
scripts.translation:
[乌哈里]
他为什么要做这种事...

scripts.text:
[Wuhari]
Well, I guess he always had a negative self-image of his physical self.
He thought that he would be able to do anything if he was big and beautiful.
scripts.translation:
[乌哈里]
嗯，我想他一直对自己的身体形象很负面。
他觉得如果自己能变得高大漂亮，就能做任何事了。

scripts.text: Do you have any complaints?
scripts.translation: 您有什么不满吗？

scripts.text:
[Wuhari]
No, I don't have any complaints at all.
scripts.translation:
[乌哈里]
不，我完全没有不满。

scripts.text:
[Wuhari]
He always told me that since we are disadvantaged physically, we need to at least be smart and taught me very diligently.
scripts.translation:
[乌哈里]
他总是告诉我，既然我们在身体上处于劣势，至少要在智力上占优势，并且非常认真地教导我。

scripts.text:
[Wuhari]
For that, I am now able to support myself well, and my relationship with him is really strong.
scripts.translation:
[乌哈里]
多亏了他，我现在能很好地养活自己，而且我和他的关系非常亲密。

scripts.text:
[Wuhari]
And since my physique is so small, many people adore me even when I age.
scripts.translation:
[乌哈里]
而且因为我的身材娇小，即使年纪大了，很多人也都很喜欢我。

scripts.text:
[Wuhari]
Thanks to that, many gave us lots of good things to eat, heh heh.
scripts.translation:
[乌哈里]
多亏了这个，很多人给了我们很多好吃的东西，呵呵。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Your brother asked me to figure out a way for him to recover his body.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
您的弟弟让我想办法帮他恢复身体。

scripts.text:
[Wuhari]
Yes, that's not even a question. We need to not only recover his body but also rescue him from imprisonment.
scripts.translation:
[乌哈里]
是的，这甚至不用问。我们不仅要恢复他的身体，还要把他从囚禁中解救出来。

scripts.text:
[Wuhari]
With regards to that, I actually have another ^0000cdfavor^000000 to ask.
scripts.translation:
[乌哈里]
关于这件事，我其实还有另一个^0000cd请求^000000想提。

scripts.text: I would like to, but...
scripts.translation: 我想帮忙，但是...

scripts.text: Sure thing.
scripts.translation: 没问题。

scripts.text:
[Wuhari]
Yes, of course, you would be very busy. I am grateful for even letting me know about my brother.
scripts.translation:
[乌哈里]
是的，当然，您会很忙。能告诉我弟弟的消息，我已经很感激了。

scripts.text:
[Wuhari]
Thank you so much!
scripts.translation:
[乌哈里]
非常感谢！

scripts.text: Well, I can help you.
scripts.translation: 嗯，我可以帮您。

scripts.text: Ignore him.
scripts.translation: 无视他

scripts.text:
[Wuhari]
Oh dear~ Is there anyone who can help~~ This world is so ruthless~
scripts.translation:
[乌哈里]
哎呀~有没有人能帮帮我~~
这个世界真是太残酷了~

scripts.text:
[Wuhari]
Will you really?
Are you doing this because I look so sad?
scripts.translation:
[乌哈里]
您真的愿意帮忙吗？
是因为看我这么难过才这样做的吗？

scripts.text:
[Wuhari]
Whatever it is, I thank you so much!
scripts.translation:
[乌哈里]
无论是什么，我都非常感谢！

scripts.text:
[Wuhari]
First, if we were to figure out how to recover his body, we have to know exactly what happened at that moment.
scripts.translation:
[乌哈里]
首先，如果要弄清楚如何找回他的遗体，
我们必须确切知道当时发生了什么。

scripts.text:
[Wuhari]
It would be helpful to know on what basis he carried out his research. But, I don't really know despite listening to his story.
scripts.translation:
[乌哈里]
如果能知道他进行研究的依据就好了。
但我听了他的故事后，还是不太明白。

scripts.text:
[Wuhari]
It looks like we don't have ways to figure that out right now. To explore it on my own, it just seems too difficult...
scripts.translation:
[乌哈里]
看来我们现在没有途径去查明这件事。
靠我自己去调查，似乎太难了...

scripts.text:
[Wuhari]
It is probably best to ask the ^0000cdpeople who may be familiar with what happened then^000000.
scripts.translation:
[乌哈里]
最好的办法，大概是去问问^0000cd当时可能了解情况的人^000000。

scripts.text:
[Wuhari]
Please, I ask you. In the meantime, I'll carefully think about what my brother has said.
scripts.translation:
[乌哈里]
拜托您了。在此期间，我会仔细回想我弟弟说过的话。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I'm still looking into things.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我还在继续调查。

scripts.text:
[Wuhari]
I see... I ask you, please take care of it.
scripts.translation:
[乌哈里]
我明白了...拜托您了，请多费心。

scripts.text: They told me to give this to you.
scripts.translation: 他们让我把这个交给您。

scripts.text:
[Wuhari]
Hmm...
scripts.translation:
[乌哈里]
嗯...

scripts.text:
[Wuhari]
This is... ^0000cda research report^000000. My brother, he must have seen this and...
scripts.translation:
[乌哈里]
这是...^0000cd一份研究报告^000000。
我弟弟，他一定是看到了这个，然后...

scripts.text:
[Wuhari]
Umm... What is it that you brought?
scripts.translation:
[乌哈里]
那个...您带来的是什么？

scripts.text:
[Wuhari]
But hmm... this is... Were there any other reports?
scripts.translation:
[乌哈里]
不过嗯...这个...还有其他报告吗？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
No, that was the only one I was given.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
没有，我只拿到了这一份。

scripts.text:
[Wuhari]
Oh... That's too bad...
Well, I'll have to analyze this in more depth. I would need some ^0000cdtime^000000.
scripts.translation:
[乌哈里]
哦...真可惜...
看来我得更深入地解析一下。这需要一些^0000cd时间^000000。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Huh! What the...!?
Where did it go?

[{0}]
I must have dropped it on the way here.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我一定是来这里的路上把它掉了。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I'll bring it to you.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我会把它带给您的。

scripts.text:
[Wuhari]
I looked into this report, but I still don't really understand what it is telling.
The ingredients are written here but they were difficult to gather and the application methods are a bit hard to understand...
scripts.translation:
[乌哈里]
我仔细研究了这份报告，但还是不太明白它到底在说什么。
虽然上面列出了材料，但那些材料很难收集，而且使用方法也有些晦涩难懂...

scripts.text:
[Wuhari]
Why would they use a piece of a high-level Laphine's wings and hair from a Sapha?
scripts.translation:
[乌哈里]
为什么要使用高阶拉菲尼的翅膀碎片，还有萨法的毛发呢？

scripts.text:
[Wuhari]
It's not only difficult to obtain them, but the ways you would have to obtain them are brutal...
scripts.translation:
[乌哈里]
不仅获取它们非常困难，而且获取的方式也极其残忍...

scripts.text: Your brother's physique was...
scripts.translation: 你哥哥的身体状况是...

scripts.text:
[Wuhari]
What do you mean exactly by that?
scripts.translation:
[乌哈里]
你具体是指哪方面？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
His body was bigger and glowing blue like a Sapha, and his wings were much bigger than that of a normal Laphine.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
他的体型比萨法还要大，而且散发着蓝色的光芒，翅膀也比普通的拉菲尼大得多。

scripts.text:
[Wuhari]
I wonder if it's ^0000cda method to merge the unique characteristics of both races^000000...
scripts.translation:
[乌哈里]
我想知道这是否是一种^0000cd融合两个种族独特特征的方法^000000...

scripts.text:
[Wuhari]
But even for his own experiments, my brother would have needed someone's wing and someone's hair... Would he really...
scripts.translation:
[乌哈里]
但即使是进行他自己的实验，也需要用到别人的翅膀和毛发...他难道真的...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
According to your brother, he received the ingredients from a high-level Laphine.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
据你哥哥所说，他是从高阶拉菲尼那里获得了这些材料。

scripts.text:
[Wuhari]
The more I look at it, the stranger it gets... To think of this in the first place...
scripts.translation:
[乌哈里]
越看越觉得奇怪...光是想到这些就已经...

scripts.text:
[Wuhari]
Regardless, to figure out a way to recover my brother's body, I would have to study this.
I wish the instructions were more detailed.
scripts.translation:
[乌哈里]
不管怎样，为了找到恢复我哥哥身体的方法，我必须研究这个。
真希望说明能更详细一些。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Then should I go and ask your brother again?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
那我去再问问你哥哥？

scripts.text:
[Wuhari]
That's probably no use. My brother also must have used these instructions to experiment, but he must have become that way because he failed.
scripts.translation:
[乌哈里]
那可能没用。我哥哥肯定也是用这些说明进行实验的，但他之所以变成那样，一定是因为实验失败了。

scripts.text:
[Wuhari]
To understand these instructions accurately, we have to ^0000cdfind the Laphine who provided this report^000000.
scripts.translation:
[乌哈里]
要准确理解这些说明，我们必须^0000cd找到提供这份报告的拉菲尼^000000。

scripts.text: That's seems too uncertain.
scripts.translation: 这似乎太不确定了。

scripts.text: Shall I look for that Laphine?
scripts.translation: 我去找那只拉菲尼？

scripts.text:
[Wuhari]
Yes. I know. That's why {0} I asked you to help.
{1} You have much experience and have the necessary skills.
scripts.translation:
[乌哈里]
是的，我知道。所以我才请{0}帮忙。
{1}你经验丰富，具备必要的技能。

scripts.text:
[Wuhari]
That's exactly my request!
Wow, your veteran sensibilities are truly amazing.
scripts.translation:
[乌哈里]
这正是我的请求！
哇，你的老练直觉真是惊人。

scripts.text: [Wuhari]
scripts.translation: [乌哈里]

scripts.text:
[Wuhari]
But I guess it's still too much.
It must be too much...
scripts.translation:
[乌哈里]
不过我想这要求还是太高了。
这肯定太为难你了...

scripts.text:
[Wuhari]
In any case, thanks so much!
It looks like I'll have to depend on you again! Thank you!
scripts.translation:
[乌哈里]
总之，非常感谢！
看来我又得依赖你了！谢谢你！

scripts.text:
[Wuhari]
First, please go find that Laphine and ask how to return his body back. And also please ask why the report was given to my brother in the first place.
scripts.translation:
[乌哈里]
首先，请去找那个拉芬，问问如何把他的身体还回来。另外，也请问问为什么那份报告会交到我哥哥手里。

scripts.text:
[Wuhari]
It's probably best to ask the ^0000cdpeople in the village first^000000.
scripts.translation:
[乌哈里]
最好先去问问^0000cd村里的人^000000。

scripts.text: It's important to help others.
scripts.translation: 帮助他人很重要。

scripts.text: No, I'm just passing by.
scripts.translation: 不，我只是路过。

scripts.text:
[Wuhari]
Thank you so much!!!
Awesome! The world hasn't let me down just yet! I know it was too big of a favor..
scripts.translation:
[乌哈里]
非常感谢！！！
太棒了！这个世界还没有让我失望！我知道这要求太大了...

scripts.text:
[Wuhari]
Really?
But I'm a little busy right now.
scripts.translation:
[乌哈里]
真的吗？
不过我现在有点忙。

scripts.text: [Wuhari]
scripts.translation: [乌哈里]

scripts.text:
[Wuhari]
Please go find that Laphine and ask how to return his body back. And also please ask why the report was given to my brother in the first place.
scripts.translation:
[乌哈里]
请去找那个拉芬，问问如何把他的身体还回来。另外，也请问问为什么那份报告会交到我哥哥手里。

scripts.text:
[Wuhari]
It's probably best to ask the ^0000cdpeople in the village first^000000.
scripts.translation:
[乌哈里]
最好先去问问^0000cd村里的人^000000。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Well... That Laphine ^0000cdwas already dead.^000000

[Wuhari]
What? He was dead?
scripts.translation:
[乌哈里]
什么？他死了？

scripts.text: - It's probably better not to tell him Wuhuru's story -
scripts.translation: - 最好不要告诉他乌胡鲁的故事 -

scripts.text:
[{0}]
You see, when I went to the field where he was last seen, he was already dead.
Could it be that the palace noticed how a risky research was being done and sent a person to take care of things?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你看，当我去他最后出现的那个地方时，他已经死了。
会不会是宫殿注意到了这项危险的研究，派人来处理了？

scripts.text:
[Wuhari]
Possibly...
scripts.translation:
[乌哈里]
有可能...

scripts.text:
[Wuhari]
But why of all people did they entrust my brother with that research?
scripts.translation:
[乌哈里]
但为什么偏偏是我哥哥被委托做这项研究？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
It might be that they took advantage of his inferiority complex toward his physique and his superb intellect.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
也许他们利用了他对自己体型的自卑感，以及他卓越的智力。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
If he succeeded, they might have involved lower-level Laphines into the matter for less than desirable purposes.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
如果他成功了，他们可能会让低阶的拉芬参与进来，用于不可告人的目的。

scripts.text:
[Wuhari]
Ahh, how terrible..
scripts.translation:
[乌哈里]
啊，太可怕了...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
It could have been better off for your brother to have failed.
Even though it's unfortunate for him.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
对你哥哥来说，失败可能反而是好事。
虽然这对他来说很遗憾。

scripts.text:
[Wuhari]
Could it mean that my brother is...
scripts.translation:
[乌哈里]
难道说，我哥哥是...

scripts.text:
[Wuhari]
No, I'm sure there is some way.
I'll recover his body no matter what even if I were to do it by myself.
scripts.translation:
[乌哈里]
不，我相信一定有办法的。
无论如何，我都会把他的身体找回来，哪怕是我一个人去。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Is there anything I can do to help?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
有什么我可以帮忙的吗？

scripts.text:
[Wuhari]
You already helped me so much... If so, I'll ask you for even another favor. It's probably going to be the last one.
scripts.translation:
[乌哈里]
你已经帮了我很多了...既然如此，我想再拜托你一件事。这大概会是最后一次了。

scripts.text:
[Wuhari]
All of the ^0000CDingredients^000000 in this research report are very difficult for me to gather myself. {0} I would like to ask for your help.
scripts.translation:
[乌哈里]
这份^0000CD研究报告^000000里列出的材料，我自己很难收集到。{0}我想请你帮忙。

scripts.text:
[Wuhari]
Ingredients I need are ^0000CDone of each of the following: Laphine's Wing Fragment, Hair of Sapha, Karvodailnirol, Purified Bradium, Rune of Darkness, Rune of Blood^000000.
scripts.translation:
[乌哈里]
我需要的材料是^0000CD以下物品各一个：拉芬的翅膀碎片、萨法的头发、卡勒波迪药水、精炼魔力之石、黑暗的轮、鲜血的轮^000000。

scripts.text:
[Wuhari]
All I can trust is you {0}. Thank you.
scripts.translation:
[乌哈里]
我只信任你，{0}。谢谢你。

scripts.text: I brought them all.
scripts.translation: 我都带来了

scripts.text: What were they again?
scripts.translation: 需要哪些材料来着？

scripts.text:
[Wuhari]
Ingredients I need are ^0000cdone of each of the following: Laphine's Wing Fragment, Hair of Sapha, Karvodailnirol, Purified Bradium, Rune of Darkness, Rune of Blood ^000000.
scripts.translation:
[乌哈里]
我需要的材料是^0000cd以下物品各一个：拉芬的翅膀碎片、萨法的头发、卡勒波迪药水、精炼魔力之石、黑暗的轮、鲜血的轮 ^000000。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Of course!

[Wuhari]
Um... Where did you say the items were {0}?
I couldn't work without them.
scripts.translation:
[乌哈里]
那个...刚才说材料在哪里来着，{0}？
没有它们我没法进行研究。

scripts.text:
[Wuhari]
It must have been really difficult! Thank you so much!
scripts.translation:
[乌哈里]
一定很不容易吧！非常感谢你！

scripts.text:
[Wuhari]
I'll try to continue the research with these.
scripts.translation:
[乌哈里]
我会试着用这些继续研究的。

scripts.text:
[Wuhari]
Thank you for helping me through all of this.
scripts.translation:
[乌哈里]
谢谢你在我最困难的时候帮助我。

scripts.text:
[Wuhari]
This is nothing, but it's just a token of my appreciation.
scripts.translation:
[乌哈里]
这不算什么，只是我的一点心意。

scripts.text:
[Wuhari]
I wish you best of luck in the coming future {0}.
scripts.translation:
[乌哈里]
祝你未来一切顺利，{0}。

scripts.text:
[Suspicious man]
......

[{0}]
Um... Excuse me.
I'm looking for someone.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
那个...打扰一下。
我在找人。

scripts.text:
[Suspicious man]
......

[{0}]
Hello?

[Suspicious man]
......

[{0}]
Can you hear me?
EXCUSE ME!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你能听到我吗？
喂！

scripts.text:
[Suspicious man]
......

[{0}]
Who is this guy?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
这家伙是谁？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Excuse me. You can hear me, right?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
打扰一下。你能听到我说话吧？

scripts.text:
[Suspicious man]
......

[{0}]
I'm not a bad person. I'm just looking for someone in this prison.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我不是坏人。我只是想在这座监狱里找个人。

scripts.text:
[Suspicious man]
......

[{0}]
Ahhh! How irritating!!!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
啊！真是烦死了！！

scripts.text:
[Suspicious man]
......
- The suspicious man doesn't seem to want to talk at all -
scripts.translation: - 那个可疑的男子似乎完全不想说话 -

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Hey, if you are asked something, would you at least respond?!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
喂，我问你话，你至少能回应一下吗？！

scripts.text:
[Suspicious man]
......

[Suspicious man]
......

[Suspicious man]
......

[{0}]
All I am trying to do is just deliver this to him!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我只是想把这个交给他而已！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
This right here! This thing!
Right? Can you see this? This thing!!!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
就是这个！这个东西！
对吧？你能看到这个吗？这个东西！！

scripts.text:
[Suspicious man]
What did you say you have?
scripts.translation:
[可疑的男子]
你说你带了什么？

scripts.text: - The letter was nowhere to be found -
scripts.translation: - 那封信不知去向 -

scripts.text:
[Suspicious man]
A... letter...?
scripts.translation:
[可疑的男子]
一...封信...？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Yes! A letter! I'm trying to deliver this to him!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
没错！是一封信！我想把它交给他！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Would you know who Wuhuru is?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你知道乌胡鲁是谁吗？

scripts.text:
[Suspicious man]
Wu...huru...? That's...
scripts.translation:
[可疑的男子]
乌...胡鲁...？那是...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
It looks like ^0000cdyou are Wuhuru^000000. Your little brother wanted me to deliver this ^0000cdletter^000000 to you.
Although I didn't expect the delivery to be this way.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
看来^0000cd你就是乌胡鲁^000000。你的弟弟让我把这封^0000cd信^000000交给你。
虽然我没料到送信会是这种方式。

scripts.text:
[Wuhuru]
Thank...you.
scripts.translation:
[乌胡鲁]
谢...谢你。

scripts.text: - You leave Wuhuru alone to read through the letter -
scripts.translation: - 你让乌胡鲁独自阅读那封信 -

scripts.text:
[Wuhuru]
I, I can't believe I did this to my little bro... Is Wuhari alright?
Ah.. What have I done...?
scripts.translation:
[乌胡鲁]
我...我竟然对弟弟做了这种事...乌哈里没事吧？
啊...我都干了些什么...

scripts.text:
[Wuhuru]
Have you met Wuhari? What a relief.
I can finally relax a little bit even in this prison.
scripts.translation:
[乌胡鲁]
你见过乌哈里？真是让人放心。
即使在这座监狱里，我也能稍微放松一下了。

scripts.text:
[Wuhuru]
Any good news?
scripts.translation:
[乌胡鲁]
有什么好消息吗？

scripts.text:
[Wuhuru]
Please, I ask you.
scripts.translation:
[乌胡鲁]
拜托了，求求你。

scripts.text:
[Wuhuru]
......

[Wuhuru]
If you have met Wuhari, as you can see, I didn't look like this originally. My brother and I had ^0000cdparticular small physiques.^000000 even among the lower-level Laphines.
scripts.translation:
[乌胡鲁]
既然你见过乌哈里，你也看到了，我原本不是这副模样。我和弟弟在低阶拉菲涅斯中，^0000cd身材都特别娇小。^000000

scripts.text:
[Wuhuru]
So among Laphines, who value aesthetics so much, we couldn't help but always feel inferior.
scripts.translation:
[乌胡鲁]
所以在极度重视美感的拉菲涅斯中，我们总是忍不住感到自卑。

scripts.text:
[Wuhuru]
Being physically disadvantaged relative to others, we always studied at home. Thanks to that, we were able to become much smarter than others.
scripts.translation:
[乌胡鲁]
因为身体条件不如别人，我们一直在家自学。也多亏了这一点，我们的智力远超常人。

scripts.text:
[Wuhuru]
One day, a high-level Laphine named ^0000cdMwaridica^000000 came to visit me.
He said that he is a member of a research facility, and that he wanted my help in a secret research project they were working on.
scripts.translation:
[乌胡鲁]
有一天，一位名叫^0000cd姆瓦利迪卡^000000的高阶拉菲涅斯来拜访我。
他说他是研究机构的成员，希望我协助他们进行一项秘密研究项目。

scripts.text:
[Wuhuru]
And that's when he gave me a research report that had some instructions and necessary ingredients.
It was a research project to ^0000cdstrengthen one's physique to make the Laphines stronger and more beautiful^000000.
scripts.translation:
[乌胡鲁]
就在那时，他给了我一份研究报告，上面写着说明和所需材料。
那是一项旨在^0000cd强化体格，让拉菲涅斯变得更强壮、更美丽^000000的研究。

scripts.text:
[Wuhuru]
I immediately said yes. For me, it was clearly a way of being recognized. There was no reason for hesitation.
And also, if I were to find the means to make myself bigger...
scripts.translation:
[乌胡鲁]
我立刻答应了。对我来说，这显然是获得认可的机会，没有任何犹豫的理由。
而且，如果能找到让自己变大的方法...

scripts.text:
[Wuhuru]
He requested that I wouldn't share any of this information. So I complied with all of his requests.
I didn't even share it with my brother who I trust so much.
scripts.translation:
[乌胡鲁]
他要求我保密这些信息。所以我完全照做了。
我甚至没有告诉我最信任的弟弟。

scripts.text:
[Wuhuru]
I don't know if that was good or bad...
scripts.translation:
[乌胡鲁]
我不知道这样做是对是错...

scripts.text:
[Wuhuru]
In any case, through much research, I finally had the results right before me.
But we had no experimental subjects at hand.
scripts.translation:
[乌胡鲁]
总之，经过大量研究，我最终得出了成果。
但我们手头没有实验对象。

scripts.text:
[Wuhuru]
So I let myself become one.
And as you can see, the consequence was...
scripts.translation:
[乌胡鲁]
于是，我让自己成为了实验对象。
正如你所见，结果...

scripts.text:
[Wuhuru]
As soon as the experiment failed, that Laphine just withdrew himself right away.
I tried to take care of things on my own, but I ultimately ended up here.
scripts.translation:
[乌胡鲁]
实验失败后，那位拉菲涅斯立刻撤走了。
我试图独自处理，但最终落得如此下场。

scripts.text:
[Wuhuru]
After obtaining this body, I realize that I'd rather have my small body back.
As it is now, I am a monster.
scripts.translation:
[乌胡鲁]
拥有了这副身体后，我意识到我宁愿变回原来的小个子。
现在的我，不过是个魔物罢了。

scripts.text:
[Wuhuru]
I didn't want this for myself... My greed was excessive.
scripts.translation:
[乌胡鲁]
我并不想这样...是我的贪婪过头了。

scripts.text:
[Wuhuru]
Only if I had known earlier...
scripts.translation:
[乌胡鲁]
要是早点知道就好了...

scripts.text:
[Wuhuru]
I'm sorry, I talked too much.
Regardless, I think it's over for me to get out of here.
scripts.translation:
[乌胡鲁]
抱歉，我说了太多。
无论如何，我觉得我出不去了。

scripts.text:
[Wuhuru]
If you can make it out of here, could you please let my brother know to figure out a way for me to return to my original self.
scripts.translation:
[乌胡鲁]
如果你能逃出去，请告诉我的弟弟，让他想办法让我恢复原状。

scripts.text:
[Wuhuru]
My brother, he is smaller than I, but has always been the smarter one.
scripts.translation:
[乌胡鲁]
我的弟弟比我更矮小，但一直比我更聪明。

scripts.text:
[Wuhuru]
Please, I ask you.
scripts.translation:
[乌胡鲁]
拜托了，求求你。

scripts.text:
[Wuhuru]
This jail cell feels particularly warm today.
scripts.translation:
[乌胡鲁]
今天的牢房感觉格外温暖。

scripts.text: I saw a dead corpse of a Laphine in the field.
scripts.translation: 我在野外看到了一具拉菲涅斯的尸体。

scripts.text:
[Wuhuru]
...A dead Laphine corpse?
scripts.translation:
[乌胡鲁]
...一具拉菲涅斯的尸体？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
^0000cdIt was a dead corpse of a high-level Laphine.^000000 The way he seemed was suggestive of the Laphine who requested the research from you.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
^0000cd那是一具高阶拉菲涅斯的尸体。^000000 他的样子暗示着，正是那位向你提出研究请求的拉菲涅斯。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
And I also met someone who witnessed another bigger Laphine chasing after that Laphine before you were imprisoned here.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我还遇到了一个人，他目睹了在你被关押到这里之前，另一只体型更大的拉菲涅斯追赶那只拉菲涅斯的情景。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
And then he was murdered.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
随后，他就遇害了。

scripts.text:
[Wuhuru]
What are you trying to say?
Are you telling me that I am a murderer?
scripts.translation:
[乌胡鲁]
你想说什么？
你是想告诉我，我是个杀人犯吗？

scripts.text: Did you murder him out of anger?
scripts.translation: 你是出于愤怒杀了他吗？

scripts.text:
[Wuhuru]
What does it matter even if I were to... Reveal that I am a murderer...?
scripts.translation:
[乌胡鲁]
就算我承认...承认我是个杀人犯...那又怎样？

scripts.text:
[Wuhuru]
I am trapped in this body no matter what...
scripts.translation:
[乌胡鲁]
无论发生什么，我都被困在这具身体里...

scripts.text:
[Wuhuru]
He tricked me, you see!
scripts.translation:
[乌胡鲁]
他骗了我，你知道吗！

scripts.text:
[Wuhuru]
He convinced me that the goal of the research was to beautify and strengthen the Laphines and even set me up as the experimental subject!
scripts.translation:
[乌胡鲁]
他说服我，说研究的目标是美化并强化拉菲涅斯，甚至把我安排成了实验对象！

scripts.text:
[Wuhuru]
And as soon as the experiment failed, he ran away!
scripts.translation:
[乌胡鲁]
而一旦实验失败，他就逃跑了！

scripts.text:
[Wuhuru]
He told me the truth only right before his death.
scripts.translation:
[乌胡鲁]
他直到临死前才告诉我真相。

scripts.text:
[Wuhuru]
His true goal was to prove to his authorities that ^0000cdhis skills as a researcher was for real^000000.
scripts.translation:
[乌胡鲁]
他的真正目标，是向他的上级证明^0000cd他作为研究员的实力是真实的^000000。

scripts.text:
[Wuhuru]
He said that he didn't even examine the content of the experment or the ingredients themselves.
scripts.translation:
[乌胡鲁]
他说他根本没有检查实验的内容，甚至没有查看过那些材料本身。

scripts.text:
[Wuhuru]
And he also used dirty means to obtain the hair of a Sapha!
scripts.translation:
[乌胡鲁]
他还用卑鄙的手段获取了萨法的毛发！

scripts.text:
[Wuhuru]
The palace then discovered the means of this research, chased us down, and captured me for participating in the project.
scripts.translation:
[乌胡鲁]
后来宫殿发现了这项研究的手段，追捕我们，并因为我参与了该项目而将我逮捕。

scripts.text:
[Wuhuru]
What exactly did I do wrong?
scripts.translation:
[乌胡鲁]
我到底做错了什么？

scripts.text:
[Wuhuru]
I was only a pawn in his ambitious schemes.
scripts.translation:
[乌胡鲁]
我只是他野心勃勃计划中的一枚棋子。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
It looks like his goals to engage in the study were similar to your own goals to participate.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
看来他参与研究的目标，和你参与的目标很相似。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
While you are a victim of his schemes, it is hard to justify what you have done... But
the way you are imprisoned here seems like you are paying for your actions.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
虽然你是他阴谋的受害者，但很难为你所做的事辩护...不过，你被关押在这里的样子，似乎是在为你的行为付出代价。

scripts.text:
[Wuhuru]
......

[Wuhuru]
Please... don't share this story with Wuhari.
I implore you.
scripts.translation:
[乌胡鲁]
请...不要把这件事告诉乌哈里。
我恳求你。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Alright, I will act as though I have never made it here.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
好吧，我会假装我从未到过这里。

scripts.text:
[Wuhuru]
Thank you... I am indebted to you...
scripts.translation:
[乌胡鲁]
谢谢你...我欠你一个人情...

scripts.text:
[Masione]
Whoa! Hey!
Would you please stop appearing out of nowhere?
scripts.translation:
[马西奥内]
哇！嘿！
你能不能别总是突然从不知道哪里冒出来？

scripts.text:
[Masione]
Whoa! Hey!
What's going on! You shocked me!
What are you trying to do to me?
scripts.translation:
[马西奥内]
哇！嘿！
怎么回事！吓我一跳！
你想对我做什么？

scripts.text:
[Masione]
I'm a fragile, sensitive being!
scripts.translation:
[马西奥内]
我可是个脆弱又敏感的人！

scripts.text: Um, about Wuhuru...
scripts.translation: 嗯，关于乌胡鲁的事...

scripts.text:
[Masione]
Oh, I was shocked for no reason.
About Wuhuru... Well, I don't really know the messy details...
scripts.translation:
[马西奥内]
哦，我白担心了。
关于乌胡鲁...嗯，那些乱七八糟的细节我也不太清楚...

scripts.text:
[Masione]
I don't know how a guy who lived so peacefully all his life became like that.
scripts.translation:
[马西奥内]
我不知道一个一直过着平静生活的人，怎么会变成那样。

scripts.text:
[Masione]
Come to think of it, on the day that it happened, I heard a ^0000cdreally loud scream^000000...
Many in the village were too scared to go out for awhile after hearing that.
scripts.translation:
[马西奥内]
说起来，事发那天，我听到了一声^0000cd非常响亮的尖叫^000000...
村里很多人听到后吓得好一阵子都不敢出门。

scripts.text:
[Masione]
And not too long after, many people from the palace came over and took Wuhuru away.
scripts.translation:
[马西奥内]
没过多久，宫里来了很多人，把乌胡鲁带走了。

scripts.text:
[Masione]
For me, it was the first time I got out of the house in a while so all I saw was Wuhuru being captured.
scripts.translation:
[马西奥内]
对我来说，那是我很久以来第一次出门，所以我只看到乌胡鲁被抓走的样子。

scripts.text:
[Masione]
But Wuhuru's appearance at the time... his appearance...
scripts.translation:
[马西奥内]
但当时乌胡鲁的样子...他的样子...

scripts.text:
[Masione]
Anyways, ^0000cdGoatie^000000 was also there with me, so ask him too.
He's really sharp with these kind of things so he might remember more.
scripts.translation:
[马西奥内]
总之，^0000cd山羊仔^000000当时也和我在一起，你也可以问问他。
他对这类事情很敏锐，可能记得更多。

scripts.text:
[Goatie]
What do you need?
scripts.translation:
[山羊仔]
你需要什么？

scripts.text:
[Goatie]
Did you want to know about something else?
scripts.translation:
[山羊仔]
你还想知道别的什么吗？

scripts.text:
[Goatie]
Have you ever been to the palace?
They say that it is so much more beautiful than our Yai's could ever be.
scripts.translation:
[山羊仔]
你去过皇宫吗？
听说那里比我们雅伊的宫殿还要美丽得多。

scripts.text: I came after talking with Masione...
scripts.translation: 我是和马西奥内谈完话后过来的...

scripts.text:
[Goatie]
Masione sent you? What's the problem?
scripts.translation:
[山羊仔]
马西奥内让你来的？出什么事了？

scripts.text: I wanted to ask you about Wuhuru.
scripts.translation: 我想问问你关于乌胡鲁的事。

scripts.text:
[Goatie]
Oh, you came for Wuhuru. But I don't know much either...
scripts.translation:
[山羊仔]
哦，你是为了乌胡鲁来的。但我也不怎么知道...

scripts.text:
[Goatie]
Ah! I just remembered seeing Wuhuru right before that happened!
He came by with some ^0000cdstranger^000000...
scripts.translation:
[山羊仔]
啊！我刚想起来，事发前我见过乌胡鲁！
他和一个^0000cd陌生人^000000一起来的...

scripts.text:
[Goatie]
At any rate, in all my days knowing Wuhuru, it's the first time I've seen him so happy.
scripts.translation:
[山羊仔]
总之，在我认识乌胡鲁的这么多年里，还是第一次见他这么开心。

scripts.text:
[Goatie]
When I asked him why he was so happy, he showed me some ^0000cdpieces of paper^000000 and told me that he was going to look great soon...
scripts.translation:
[山羊仔]
我问他为什么这么高兴，他给我看了一些^0000cd纸片^000000，说很快他就会变得很帅气...

scripts.text:
[Goatie]
And the guy next to him would hint at him to keep quiet...
scripts.translation:
[山羊仔]
而他旁边的那个人则暗示他保持安静...

scripts.text:
[Goatie]
Well, I was a bit concerned, but seeing him so happy, I couldn't say anything.
scripts.translation:
[山羊仔]
嗯，我有点担心，但看他那么开心，我也就没说什么。

scripts.text:
[Goatie]
And it was after that when the big accident occurred.
scripts.translation:
[山羊仔]
就在那之后，大事故发生了。

scripts.text: What was the piece of paper?
scripts.translation: 那是什么纸片？

scripts.text:
[Goatie]
That thing? Hmm, I don't know. I was too far to tell...
scripts.translation:
[山羊仔]
那个东西？嗯，我不知道。我离得太远，看不清楚...

scripts.text:
[Goatie]
That's right, why don't you go see my ^0000cdhusband^000000. He was pretty close to Wuhuru so he might know more.
scripts.translation:
[山羊仔]
对了，你不妨去见见我的^0000cd丈夫^000000。他和乌胡鲁关系不错，也许他知道得更多。

scripts.text: I want to hear about the high-level Laphine who Wuhuru was working with.
scripts.translation: 我想听听关于乌胡鲁合作的那只高等级拉芬的事。

scripts.text:
[Goatie]
Oh the high-level Laphine...? Yes~ I remember!
scripts.translation:
[山羊仔]
哦，高等级拉芬...？是的~ 我想起来了！

scripts.text:
[Goatie]
The stranger who came by with Wuhuru was a high-level Laphine. Are you talking about him?
scripts.translation:
[山羊仔]
和乌胡鲁一起来的那个陌生人是一只高等级拉芬。你说的是他吗？

scripts.text:
[Goatie]
If you are talking about him, he quietly left the place after staying with Wuhuru for a bit.
scripts.translation:
[山羊仔]
如果你说的是他，他在和乌胡鲁待了一会儿后，就悄悄离开了那里。

scripts.text:
[Goatie]
After that, Wuhuru would just spend his days in his Yai.
scripts.translation:
[山羊仔]
之后，乌胡鲁就整天待在他的巢穴里。

scripts.text:
[Goatie]
But that Laphine, ^0000cdhe did have impressive, beautiful wings that made him seem very elegant, but his gaze and something about him made him very suspicious^000000.
scripts.translation:
[山羊仔]
不过那只拉芬，^0000cd他确实有一双令人印象深刻的美丽翅膀，看起来非常优雅，但他的眼神和某种气质让他显得非常可疑^000000。

scripts.text: Do you remember anything else?
scripts.translation: 你还记得其他什么吗？

scripts.text:
[Goatie]
Hmm, come to think of it, ^0000cdPompe told me one day that he saw a terrible thing happening to a high-level Laphine in the land of blooming flowers^000000.
scripts.translation:
[山羊仔]
嗯，仔细想想，^0000cd蓬佩有一天告诉我，他在花之国度看到一只高等级拉芬遭遇了可怕的事情^000000。

scripts.text:
[Goatie]
He did say that the Laphine that he saw at the time also had ^0000cdparticularly large and beautiful wings...^000000.
scripts.translation:
[山羊仔]
他说当时看到的那只拉芬也有^0000cd特别巨大且美丽的翅膀...^000000。

scripts.text:
[Goatie]
Go see Pompe and check with him.
scripts.translation:
[山羊仔]
去见见蓬佩，问问他吧。

scripts.text:
[Goatie]
I guess people who have nothing can only dream.
scripts.translation:
[山羊仔]
我想，一无所有的人只能做做梦罢了。

scripts.text:
[Svery]
Do you need something from me?
scripts.translation:
[斯维里]
你需要我做什么吗？

scripts.text:
[Svery]
It's my wife's big wish to visit the palace.
scripts.translation:
[斯维里]
去皇宫参观是我妻子最大的心愿。

scripts.text:
[Svery]
I know why you are here!
scripts.translation:
[斯维里]
我知道你为什么来这里了！

scripts.text:
[Svery]
Do you need something else from me?
scripts.translation:
[斯维里]
你还需要我做什么吗？

scripts.text: I was wondering about the paper that Wuhuru was holding.
scripts.translation: 我在想乌胡鲁手里拿的那张纸。

scripts.text:
[Svery]
Yeah, that's right. My wife told me that he was holding something like that, but I have no idea what that was.
scripts.translation:
[斯维里]
没错，就是这样。我妻子告诉我他拿着那样的东西，但我完全不知道那是什么。

scripts.text:
[Svery]
But who would you be to look for such a thing?
scripts.translation:
[斯维里]
不过，你是谁，为什么要找那样的东西？

scripts.text: Wuhari asked me a favor.
scripts.translation: 乌哈里拜托我帮忙。

scripts.text:
[Svery]
Oh really? Come to think of it, I forgot to tell this to Wuhari.
Before Wuhuru was caputured away, Wuhuru's ^0000cdletter^000000 was placed on our window.
scripts.translation:
[斯维里]
哦，是吗？仔细想想，我忘了告诉乌哈里这件事。
在乌胡鲁被抓走之前，他的^0000cd信件^000000被放在我们的窗台上。

scripts.text:
[Svery]
He must have written it in preparation for his fate.
scripts.translation:
[斯维里]
他一定是在预见到自己的命运后写下的。

scripts.text:
[Svery]
He asked me to deliver a sealed ^0000cddocument^000000 to his brother.
scripts.translation:
[斯维里]
他让我把一封密封的^0000cd文件^000000交给他的兄弟。

scripts.text:
[Svery]
However!
We were so busy that we couldn't meet up with Wuhari even when we heard that he came back around here.
scripts.translation:
[斯维里]
但是！
我们太忙了，即使听说乌哈里回到这一带，也没能和他碰上面。

scripts.text:
[Svery]
Hmm, I wonder if that sealed document is the paper that my wife was talking about?
Whatever is it, give this to Wuhari.
scripts.translation:
[斯维里]
嗯，我想知道那封密封的文件是不是我妻子说的那张纸？
不管是什么，请把这个交给乌哈里。

scripts.text:
[Svery]
Let me see... Where did I put it...
scripts.translation:
[斯维里]
让我看看...我把它放在哪里了...

scripts.text: - Shuffle -
scripts.translation: - 翻找声 -

scripts.text:
- Shuffle -
- Shuffle -
scripts.translation:
- 翻找声 -
- 翻找声 -

scripts.text:
- Shuffle -
- Shuffle -
- Shuffle -
scripts.translation:
- 翻找声 -
- 翻找声 -
- 翻找声 -

scripts.text:
[Svery]
Yes, here it is.
scripts.translation:
[斯维里]
是的，在这里。

scripts.text:
[Svery]
I told myself that I'll keep it really safe, and that's why it's like this.
It's a bit wrinkled and stained, but it should be just fine to read.
scripts.translation:
[斯维里]
我告诉自己一定要把它保管好，所以它才变成这样。
虽然有点皱和污渍，但应该还是能读的。

scripts.text:
[Svery]
Please help those poor kids.
scripts.translation:
[斯维里]
请帮帮那些可怜的孩子。

scripts.text:
[Svery]
I don't know how nice kids like them became like that...
scripts.translation:
[斯维里]
我不知道像他们那样好的孩子怎么会变成那样...

scripts.text:
[Svery]
I want to grant that wish for her, but how could that ever be possible.
Especially given our situation...
scripts.translation:
[斯维里]
我想帮她实现那个愿望，但怎么可能呢。
尤其是考虑到我们现在的处境...

scripts.text:
[Svery]
You dropped this, didn't you?
scripts.translation:
[斯维里]
你掉东西了吧？

scripts.text:
[Svery]
Tsk tsk. How could a young one like you be so forgetful.
scripts.translation:
[斯维里]
啧啧。像你这样年轻的人，怎么这么健忘。

scripts.text: Who's the high-level Laphine?
scripts.translation: 那个高等级的拉芬是谁？

scripts.text:
[Svery]
A high-level laphine? Hmm? I'm not sure who that was.
scripts.translation:
[斯维里]
高等级的拉芬？嗯？我不记得那是谁。

scripts.text:
[Svery]
I never saw him before. And that was also the last time I saw him.
scripts.translation:
[斯维里]
我以前没见过他。而且那也是我最后一次见到他。

scripts.text:
[Svery]
Why don't you go see my wife? She was with me.
scripts.translation:
[斯维里]
你为什么不问问我的妻子？她当时和我在一起。

scripts.text:
[Svery]
My wife is much sharper than me with these kind of things, so she'll probably be more helpful.
scripts.translation:
[斯维里]
我妻子在这方面比我敏锐得多，她可能更有帮助。

scripts.text:
[Svery]
I want to grant that wish for her, but how could that ever be possible.
Especially given our situation...
scripts.translation:
[斯维里]
我想帮她实现那个愿望，但怎么可能呢。
尤其是考虑到我们现在的处境...

scripts.text:
[Pompe]
I saw it!
scripts.translation:
[蓬佩]
我看见了！

scripts.text:
[Pompe]
Ouch! Whoa! Who is this? Is it a ghost?
scripts.translation:
[蓬佩]
哎哟！哇！这是谁？是幽灵吗？

scripts.text:
[Pompe]
I really saw it!!
scripts.translation:
[蓬佩]
我真的看见了！！

scripts.text: I was sent by Goatie...
scripts.translation: 我是山羊仔派来的...

scripts.text:
[Pompe]
Goatie sent you? What's the problem?
Is it because of what they gave me last time? Tell them they have to wait a bit longer.
scripts.translation:
[蓬佩]
山羊仔派你来的？出什么事了？
是因为上次给我的东西吗？告诉他们还得再等等。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
That's not it. I was just curious about the Laphine you saw in the field.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
不是。我只是好奇你在田里看到的那个拉芬。

scripts.text:
[Pompe]
Oy! That Laphine?
scripts.translation:
[蓬佩]
哦！那个拉芬？

scripts.text:
[Pompe]
Whoa! Don't even start with me!
scripts.translation:
[蓬佩]
哇！别跟我提这个！

scripts.text:
[Pompe]
I was doing my business in the field in the middle of a night, but there suddenly appeared two dark shadows!
scripts.translation:
[蓬佩]
我半夜在田里干活，突然出现了两个幽冥火球！

scripts.text:
[Pompe]
At first, a ^0000cdhigh-level Laphine^000000 disappeared into distance so fast, and it was such a beautiful sight that I looked on for a while.
^0000cdThe wings were really big and pretty.^000000
scripts.translation:
[蓬佩]
起初，一个^0000cd高等级的拉芬^000000迅速消失在远处，那景象太美了，我看了好一会儿。
^0000cd翅膀真的很大很漂亮。^000000

scripts.text:
[Pompe]
And then! Not too long after, suddenly!
scripts.translation:
[蓬佩]
然后！没过多久，突然！

scripts.text:
[Pompe]
So suddenly!!!
^0000cdA huge Laphine^000000 was chasing after that high-level Laphine!
scripts.translation:
[蓬佩]
太突然了！！！
^0000cd一只巨大的拉芬^000000在追那个高等级的拉芬！

scripts.text:
[Pompe]
I'm not sure if it was because it was so dark at the time, but ^0000cdhis body was so dark^000000 that I couldn't tell who it was.
scripts.translation:
[蓬佩]
我不确定是不是因为当时太黑了，但^0000cd它的身体非常黑暗^000000，我根本看不清它是什么。

scripts.text:
[Pompe]
I didn't think much into it and returned home. But some time later a scream, so loud that could shake the entire field, ripped through the air.
It was such a scary scream.
scripts.translation:
[蓬佩]
我没多想就回家了。但过了一会儿，一声巨大的尖叫声划破长空，震得整片田地都在颤抖。
那声音太可怕了。

scripts.text:
[Pompe]
And I was too afraid to go out for a while after that.
scripts.translation:
[蓬佩]
从那以后，我吓得好一阵子都不敢出门。

scripts.text:
[Pompe]
And a few days ago, when I went out to the field, I saw in the corner ^0000cda big corpse^000000!
I also saw many ^0000cdsuspicious tree branches^000000 scattered in the area.
scripts.translation:
[蓬佩]
几天前，当我再次去田里时，我在角落看到了^0000cd一具巨大的尸体^000000！
我还看到周围散落着许多^0000cd可疑的树枝^000000。

scripts.text:
[Pompe]
It was so disquieting that I didn't get near it...
scripts.translation:
[蓬佩]
那景象太令人不安了，我根本不敢靠近...

scripts.text: A corpse?
scripts.translation: 尸体？

scripts.text:
[Pompe]
Yeah! I don't know what kind of terrible thing happened, but ^0000cda big wing was ripped, and the more I think about it, it looks like the corpse of the Laphine that I saw^000000.
scripts.translation:
[蓬佩]
是的！我不知道发生了什么可怕的事，但^0000cd一只巨大的翅膀被撕裂了，我越想越觉得，那具尸体就是我之前看到的那只拉芬^000000。

scripts.text:
[Pompe]
Oh dear~~ I don't know why this kind of thing happened so suddenly.
A high-level Laphine should have great magic powers, but to see him dead so easily, the other huge Laphine must be something else.
scripts.translation:
[蓬佩]
天哪~~ 我不知道为什么这种事会突然发生。
高等级的拉芬应该拥有强大的魔力，但它却这么轻易地死了，那只巨大的拉芬一定不是普通生物。

scripts.text:
[Pompe]
That's why I'm afraid to go out to the field.
scripts.translation:
[蓬佩]
所以我才不敢去田里。

scripts.text:
[Pompe]
What if that huge Laphine attacks me when I'm out and about in the field?
scripts.translation:
[蓬佩]
万一我在田里活动时，那只巨大的拉芬突然袭击我怎么办？

scripts.text:
[Pompe]
My kids are too young, and I need to take care of them! I need to stay safe, you see!
scripts.translation:
[蓬佩]
我的孩子还太小，我必须照顾他们！我必须保证自己的安全，你明白吗！

scripts.text:
[Pompe]
You should stay away, too, if you can.
scripts.translation:
[蓬佩]
如果你能避开的话，最好也离那里远一点。

scripts.text:
[Giranni]
Excuse me, if it's not too much trouble, could I talk to you for a second?
scripts.translation:
[吉兰尼]
打扰一下，如果不麻烦的话，能占用您一点时间吗？

scripts.text:
[Giranni]
Did you find something?
scripts.translation:
[吉兰尼]
您发现什么了吗？

scripts.text:
[Giranni]
Did you need something from me?
scripts.translation:
[吉兰尼]
您有什么需要我帮忙的吗？

scripts.text:
[Giranni]
I went to go see my father.
scripts.translation:
[吉兰尼]
我去找神父了。

scripts.text:
[Giranni]
I wonder where he went. It should be around here...
scripts.translation:
[吉兰尼]
不知道他去了哪里。应该就在这附近...

scripts.text:
[Giranni]
Did you find something?
Oh... I see you haven't yet...
scripts.translation:
[吉兰尼]
您发现什么了吗？
哦...看来您还没有...

scripts.text:
[Giranni]
Father... Sob sob...
scripts.translation:
[吉兰尼]
神父...呜呜...

scripts.text:
[Giranni]
Where did he go...?
scripts.translation:
[吉兰尼]
他到底去哪里了...？

scripts.text:
[Giranni]
You really seem like you have an impressive aura.
scripts.translation:
[吉兰尼]
您身上似乎散发着令人印象深刻的气息。

scripts.text: Do you know the way?
scripts.translation: 您知道路吗？

scripts.text:
[Giranni]
I'm sorry? Do I know the way...?
No, no, I'm not someone like that.
scripts.translation:
[吉兰尼]
抱歉？我知道路...？
不不，我不是那种人。

scripts.text:
[Giranni]
I noticed from earlier that you are looking for something. Am I right?
scripts.translation:
[吉兰尼]
我刚才就注意到您在寻找什么东西，对吗？

scripts.text:
[Giranni]
I'd like to make a ^0000cdsuggestion^000000.
Would you like to hear it?
scripts.translation:
[吉兰尼]
我想提一个^0000cd建议^000000。
您愿意听听吗？

scripts.text: Sure, I'll hear you out.
scripts.translation: 好的，我听听看。

scripts.text:
[Giranni]
It won't be a waste of your time. To be honest, I'm actually ^0000cdlooking for someone^000000 here too.
scripts.translation:
[吉兰尼]
不会浪费您的时间的。说实话，其实我也^0000cd正在寻找某人^000000。

scripts.text:
[Giranni]
My father hasn't returned home for some time now, and when I visited his work, they said that he hasn't shown up there for a while either.
scripts.translation:
[吉兰尼]
我父亲已经很久没回家了，我去他的工作地点找他，他们说他也有一段时间没出现了。

scripts.text:
[Giranni]
He's not one to vanish like that, so I asked around.
scripts.translation:
[吉兰尼]
他不是一个会突然消失的人，所以我四处打听了一下。

scripts.text:
[Giranni]
I heard that people saw him around here, but I can't find a trace of him anywhere.
scripts.translation:
[吉兰尼]
我听说有人在这附近见过他，但我到处都找不到他的踪迹。

scripts.text: Did you try asking the authorities?
scripts.translation: 您问过当局吗？

scripts.text:
[Giranni]
I already did. In fact, they were already searching for him.
I'm guessing they didn't make much progress.
scripts.translation:
[吉兰尼]
我已经问过了。事实上，他们已经在寻找他了。
我想他们应该没有取得什么进展。

scripts.text:
[Giranni]
I'm worried something might have happened to him, so I came out searching for him myself.
scripts.translation:
[吉兰尼]
我担心他可能出了什么事，所以出来亲自寻找他。

scripts.text:
[Giranni]
So, my suggestion is why don't we help each other find what each other needs throughout this search?
scripts.translation:
[吉兰尼]
所以，我的建议是，我们在这次搜索中互相帮助，各自寻找自己需要的东西，怎么样？

scripts.text:
[Giranni]
What do you think? I'm sure doing this together would be better than doing it alone.
scripts.translation:
[吉兰尼]
您觉得如何？我相信一起行动会比独自行动更好。

scripts.text: What's he look like?
scripts.translation: 他长什么样？

scripts.text:
[Giranni]
Oh great, that means you'll take my suggestion, right?
scripts.translation:
[吉兰尼]
太好了，这意味着您接受我的建议了，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Giranni]
My father is similar to me. ^0000cdHe has particularly large wings and has a generally red aura around him.^000000
scripts.translation:
[吉兰尼]
我父亲和我很像。^0000cd他的翅膀特别大，而且周身通常环绕着红色的气息。^000000

scripts.text:
[Giranni]
His name is ^0000cdMwadirica^000000.
scripts.translation:
[吉兰尼]
他的名字是^0000cdMwadirica^000000。

scripts.text: I'm looking for him too!
scripts.translation: 我也在找他！

scripts.text:
[Giranni]
Oh, really? Why are you looking for my father?
scripts.translation:
[吉兰尼]
真的吗？您为什么在找我父亲？

scripts.text:
[Giranni]
Actually, let's talk about this later and search for my father now.
scripts.translation:
[吉兰尼]
其实，这件事我们稍后再谈，现在先去找我父亲吧。

scripts.text:
[Giranni]
If we find something, let's meet back here.
scripts.translation:
[吉兰尼]
如果我们找到了什么，就回到这里碰头。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I brought this.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我带来了这个。

scripts.text:
[Giranni]
What... Did you say you found something?
scripts.translation:
[吉兰尼]
什...您说您找到了什么？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Hmm? Where did it go? Did I drop it on the way?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嗯？它去哪了？我是不是在路上弄丢了？

scripts.text: - You describe the corpse that you found in the field and show the piece of wing -
scripts.translation: - 您描述了在田野中发现的尸体，并展示了那片翅膀 -

scripts.text:
[Giranni]
Oh, oh....! This is.... Definitely my father's...
Sob... NOoo!
How could this be...?
scripts.translation:
[吉兰尼]
哦，天哪....！这是....绝对是我父亲的...
呜...不！
怎么会这样...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
He's in the eastern part of the field among the tall grasses. Should I accompany you?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
他在田野东边的高草丛里。需要我陪您去吗？

scripts.text:
[Giranni]
No, no. I'll go alone.
scripts.translation:
[吉兰尼]
不，不用。我要独自去。

scripts.text:
[Giranni]
Before that, I would like to hear about why you were looking for my father.
scripts.translation:
[吉兰尼]
在那之前，我想听听您为什么在找我父亲。

scripts.text: - You share Wuhuru's research story -
scripts.translation: - 您分享了乌胡鲁的研究故事 -

scripts.text:
[Giranni]
My father? He was certainly working on something very hard recently...
scripts.translation:
[吉兰尼]
我父亲？他最近确实在非常努力地研究某件事...

scripts.text:
[Giranni]
Ah, who in the world... did such a thing...
A kind person like him...
scripts.translation:
[吉兰尼]
啊，究竟是谁...做了这种事...
像他那样善良的人...

scripts.text:
[Giranni]
In any case, thanks a lot. You found my father...
This couldn't possibly be enough compensation, but please take it.
scripts.translation:
[吉兰尼]
总之，非常感谢。您找到了我父亲...
这点补偿可能远远不够，但请收下。

scripts.text:
[Giranni]
And please tell Wuhuru about my father.
They worked together, so he should hear about my father.
scripts.translation:
[吉兰尼]
还有，请告诉乌胡鲁关于我父亲的事。
他们曾一起工作，他应该知道关于我父亲的事。

scripts.text: I need a piece of your father's wing.
scripts.translation: 我需要您父亲的一片翅膀。

scripts.text:
[Giranni]
Isn't that what you already have in your hand right now?
scripts.translation:
[吉兰尼]
那不是您现在手里正拿着的东西吗？

scripts.text:
[Giranni]
Why would you need a piece of my father's wing...?
scripts.translation:
[吉兰尼]
您为什么需要我父亲的一片翅膀...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
What! When did it get here?!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
什么！它什么时候跑到这里来的？！

scripts.text: - You briefly share Wuhuru's story -
scripts.translation: - 你简要讲述了乌胡鲁的故事 -

scripts.text:
[Giranni]
I see... It resulted from their research together...
scripts.translation:
[吉兰尼]
原来如此...这是他们共同研究的结果...

scripts.text:
[Giranni]
Ok, sure. I will give it to you. I'm sure that's what my father would have liked you to have it.
scripts.translation:
[吉兰尼]
好吧，没问题。我就把它给你。我相信我父亲也会希望你拥有它的。

scripts.text:
[Giranni]
Please tell him I wish him the best.
scripts.translation:
[吉兰尼]
请告诉他，我祝他一切顺利。

scripts.text:
[Giranni]
I would like to reminisce a bit more about my father here.
scripts.translation:
[吉兰尼]
我想在这里再多回忆一下关于我父亲的事。

scripts.text: - An unidentifiable figure that looks like a huge flower bud -
scripts.translation: - 一个看起来像巨大花蕾的无法辨认的身影 -

scripts.text: This looks like the Laphine corpse that Pompe talked about.
scripts.translation: 这看起来像是蓬佩提到的拉芬尸体。

scripts.text: Looking at the shape of the wing, ^0000cdit is Mwaridica's high-level Laphine wing as described by Wuhuru and Giranni^000000.
scripts.translation: 观察翅膀的形状，^0000cd正如乌胡鲁和吉兰尼所描述的那样，这是姆瓦里迪卡的高级拉芬翅膀^000000。

scripts.text: Seeing various scars on the body, he seems to have been ^0000cdmurdered^000000 after a fight.
scripts.translation: 看到身体上的各种伤痕，他似乎是在战斗后^0000cd被谋杀^000000的。

scripts.text: If he were to be overpowered, it must have been ^0000cda creature of large physique^000000 that surpasses a high-level Laphine.
scripts.translation: 如果他被击败，那一定是^0000cd体型巨大的生物^000000，超越了高级拉芬。

scripts.text: Let's pick up these scattered wing pieces and go tell Giranni about this.
scripts.translation: 让我们捡起这些散落的翅膀碎片，去告诉吉兰尼这件事。

scripts.text: The scattered wing pieces are collected.
scripts.translation: 散落的翅膀碎片已收集完毕。

scripts.text: - Around the corpse are some hair strands of a Sapha that look like tree branches -
scripts.translation: - 尸体周围有一些看起来像树枝的萨法毛发 -

scripts.text: - Since this is a research ingredient, let's take some -
scripts.translation: - 既然这是研究材料，那就拿一些吧 -

scripts.text: - A high-level Laphine corpse -
scripts.translation: - 高级拉芬的尸体 -

scripts.text:
[Dandy]
Take a look at me! How's this? Am I not so fabulous?
scripts.translation:
[丹迪]
看看我！怎么样？我是不是非常迷人？

scripts.text:
[Dandy]
A Laphine can freely change in between different clothes, but not any Laphine looks this great!
scripts.translation:
[丹迪]
拉芬可以自由更换不同的衣服，但不是每个拉芬都能穿得这么好看！

scripts.text:
[Lafiki]
What nonsensical nonsense are you saying? No matter who looks at it, this region's best looker is me!
scripts.translation:
[拉菲基]
你在说什么胡话？不管谁看，这个地区最好看的都是我！

scripts.text:
[Lafiki]
My fashion sense today is excellent as usual. Heh-
scripts.translation:
[拉菲基]
我今天的时尚感一如既往地出色。嘿嘿-

scripts.text:
[Lafiki]
Hello~ My beautiful body~
Every strand of hair is so beautiful!
scripts.translation:
[拉菲基]
你好~我美丽的身躯~
每一根头发都如此美丽！

scripts.text:
[Dandy]
Yes, it's definitely your garbage fashion sense that wreaks of trash as usual.
scripts.translation:
[丹迪]
没错，你那一如既往散发着垃圾味道的糟糕时尚感。

scripts.text:
[Wutapoa]
I recently moved out of my parent's place!
I am so glad I finally have my own Yai!
scripts.translation:
[武塔波阿]
我最近搬出了父母家！
终于有了自己的小屋，真是太开心了！

scripts.text:
[Wutapoa]
I'm going to make it the most decorative, beautiful Yai in Eclage!
scripts.translation:
[武塔波阿]
我要把它装饰成埃克拉珠最漂亮的小屋！

scripts.text:
[Wutapoa]
Yay, woohoo!!!
scripts.translation:
[武塔波阿]
耶，万岁！！！

scripts.text:
[Mijani]
You are not from around here?
Welcome.
scripts.translation:
[米贾尼]
你不是这里的人吧？
欢迎。

scripts.text:
[Mijani]
Of course, as long as you don't disrupt Eclage.
scripts.translation:
[米贾尼]
当然，前提是你不要扰乱埃克拉珠的安宁。

scripts.text:
[Markoza]
I also want to visit foreign lands.
scripts.translation:
[马尔科扎]
我也想去看看外面的世界。

scripts.text:
[Markoza]
But would foreigners leave me be when I am this adorable?
scripts.translation:
[马尔科扎]
但是，像我这么可爱的人，外国人会放过我吗？

scripts.text:
[Markoza]
Man, wherever I go, my cuteness just complicates everything...
scripts.translation:
[马尔科扎]
唉，不管去哪里，我的可爱总是让事情变得复杂...

scripts.text:
[Pambo]
Do you like things that twinkle?
scripts.translation:
[潘博]
你喜欢闪闪发光的东西吗？

scripts.text:
[Pambo]
I love them so much!
scripts.translation:
[潘博]
我超喜欢它们的！

scripts.text:
[Pambo]
Twinkle twinkle~ Twinkle twinkle~
scripts.translation:
[潘博]
一闪一闪~ 一闪一闪~

scripts.text:
[Pambo]
Twinkle twinkle~ Twinkle twinkle~
Sparkle sparkle~ Sparkle sparkle~
scripts.translation:
[潘博]
一闪一闪~ 一闪一闪~
亮晶晶~ 亮晶晶~

scripts.text:
[Pambo]
Twinkle twinkle~ Twinkle twinkle~
Sparkle sparkle~ Sparkle sparkle~
Mmhahah~ Hahaha~ Hehehe~
Heh heh heh~ Huhuhe~ Hoho~
Kehehe~ Halala~ Fufu~
scripts.translation:
[潘博]
一闪一闪~ 一闪一闪~
亮晶晶~ 亮晶晶~
嘿嘿嘿~ 哈哈哈~ 呵呵呵~
嘿嘿嘿~ 呼呼呼~ 呵呵~
嘻嘻嘻~ 啦啦啦~ 噗噗~

scripts.text:
[Pambo]
But there's nothing twinkling here...
scripts.translation:
[潘博]
但是这里没有什么闪闪发光的东西...

scripts.text:
[Warao]
Ah~ I'm so hungry. What should I eat today?
scripts.translation:
[瓦拉奥]
啊~好饿。今天该吃什么好呢？

scripts.text:
[Warao]
Come to think of it, I wonder how this foreigner will taste?
scripts.translation:
[瓦拉奥]
说起来，不知道这个外地人吃起来是什么味道？

scripts.text:
[Warao]
Hey hey, you know I'm kidding, right?
scripts.translation:
[瓦拉奥]
嘿，你知道我在开玩笑吧？

scripts.text:
[A kneeling boy]
Why am I kneeling like this?
scripts.translation:
[跪着的男孩]
我为什么跪在这里？

scripts.text:
[A kneeling boy]
At first, it was because it was comfortable. Now it's because I can't stretch my legs out anymore.
scripts.translation:
[跪着的男孩]
一开始是因为这样很舒服。现在是因为我的腿伸不直了。

scripts.text:
[A kneeling boy]
I try to stretch them out, and my legs are all asleep!!
Does that mean I have to fly around with my legs flexed like this?
scripts.translation:
[跪着的男孩]
我试着把腿伸直，结果腿都麻了！！
难道我要一直这样蜷着腿飞来飞去吗？

scripts.text:
[Catering]
Wahahaha! How do you do!
It's perfect weather for a picnic, no?
scripts.translation:
[宴席承办]
哇哈哈！你好啊！
今天天气真好，正适合野餐呢，不是吗？

scripts.text:
[Catering]
You say it's hard to pack for a picnic?
scripts.translation:
[宴席承办]
你说野餐很难准备吗？

scripts.text:
[Catering]
Don't you worry!
scripts.translation:
[宴席承办]
别担心！

scripts.text:
[Catering]
This is a specialty combining acorns with 7 different kinds and 7 different levels of flavor collected by squirrels of Eclage!
scripts.translation:
[宴席承办]
这是我们的特色菜，由埃克拉珠的松鼠们采集了7种不同种类、7种不同风味的橡果精心制作而成！

scripts.text:
[Catering]
This specialty to-go box is only 2,999 coins!!!
scripts.translation:
[宴席承办]
这款特色外带盒只要2,999金币！！！

scripts.text:
[Catering]
Such a remarkable price!
scripts.translation:
[宴席承办]
价格非常划算哦！

scripts.text:
[Catering]
If you order now, we also give you a disposable fork that feels like new even with a hundred uses!
scripts.translation:
[宴席承办]
现在订购，我们还赠送一次性叉子，用一百次都像新的一样！

scripts.text:
[A blushing girl]
Do you see this balcony up top?
Mayor Jun appears there everytime there is an important occasion!
scripts.translation:
[脸红的女孩]
你看到上面那个阳台了吗？
每逢重要场合，朱恩市长都会出现在那里！

scripts.text:
[A blushing girl]
He's so handome!! Ahhh~
scripts.translation:
[脸红的女孩]
他好帅啊！！啊呜~

scripts.text:
[Choir conductor]
We are Eclage's Tree Wing Choir~
We bring you heavenly harmonies~
scripts.translation:
[唱诗班指挥]
我们是埃克拉珠的树翼唱诗班~
为您带来天籁般的和声~

scripts.text:
[Choir conductor]
Hello foreigner, we'll give you a taste of our harmony~
scripts.translation:
[唱诗班指挥]
你好，外地人，让我们为你展示一下我们的和声~

scripts.text:
[Choir]
Aaa~
scripts.translation:
[唱诗班]
啊~

scripts.text:
[Choir]
Aaa~~
Aaa~
scripts.translation:
[唱诗班]
啊~~
啊~

scripts.text:
[Choir]
Aaa~~~
Aaa~~
Aaa~
scripts.translation:
[唱诗班]
啊~~~
啊~~
啊~

scripts.text:
[Choir]
Aaa~~~~
Aaa~~~
Aaa~~
Aaa~

[Choir]
Aaa~~~~~
Aaa~~~~
Aaa~~~
Aaa~~
Aaa~

[Choir]
Aaa~~~~~~
Aaa~~~~~
Aaa~~~~
Aaa~~~
Aaa~~
Aaa~

[Choir]
Uhhurukukuruhuuhhurukukuruhuuh
Try to feel this~ The melody that flows~
scripts.translation:
[唱诗班]
乌呼噜库库鲁呼呼呼噜库库鲁呼呼
试着感受一下吧~ 这流淌的旋律~

scripts.text:
[Choir conductor]
How is it!! Our harmony!!
scripts.translation:
[唱诗班指挥]
怎么样！！我们的和声！！

scripts.text:
[Choir member]
Aaa~
scripts.translation:
[唱诗班成员]
啊~

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Shuffle... Shuffle...
Tap... Tap... Creak... Creak...
Thud thud thud...
Thud Thud!!! Creak~ Thud!
What are these sounds?
scripts.translation: 这些声音是什么？

scripts.text: Ignore them and move on.
scripts.translation: 无视它们，继续赶路。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
There are weird sounds of some kind...
I should go in and check it out.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
里面传来奇怪的声音...
我应该进去看看。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
It's probably nothing.
I should just go on my way~
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
大概没什么事吧。
我还是继续赶路~

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Hello~
Is there something wrong?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你好~
出什么事了吗？

scripts.text:
- Something hits you
over the head really hard.
Your body loses its strength and your vision goes blurry -
scripts.translation:
- 有什么东西重重地砸在你的头上。
你的身体失去了力气，视线变得模糊 -

scripts.text: - Oh, I can't lose my consciousness like this -
scripts.translation: - 啊，我不能就这样失去意识 -

scripts.text:
[Daughter Luen]
What just happened?
scripts.translation:
[女儿 露恩]
刚才发生了什么？

scripts.text:
[Father Dames]
There's no way the house is
in this much disarray without
a thief breaking and entering...
scripts.translation:
[达姆斯神父]
家里这么凌乱，
肯定是盗贼闯进来了...

scripts.text:
[Mother Rosa]
Just earlier, my necklace
was stolen!
scripts.translation:
[罗莎修女]
刚才，我的项链
被偷走了！

scripts.text:
[Poppy]
Bow wow! Bow wow!
Grrrrr Bow Wow!
scripts.translation:
[波比]
汪汪！汪汪！
呜呜 汪汪！

scripts.text:
[Mother Rosa]
This darn dog always
bites random strangers
that other Laphines hate it!
How many times did I say
that we should kick
this dog out for good?
scripts.translation:
[罗莎修女]
这只讨厌的狗总是
咬那些陌生的路人，
其他拉菲尼人都讨厌它！
我说过多少次了，
我们应该把这狗赶出去！

scripts.text:
[Daughter Luen]
Poppy~ Be nice~
This person is not
someone to be afraid of,
Shh~ Shh~~
scripts.translation:
[女儿 露恩]
波比~ 乖一点~
这个人不是
需要害怕的对象，
嘘~ 嘘~~

scripts.text:
[Mother Rosa]
And how many times 
did I tell you to lock the doors
properly, my dear!!
This is all because of you
not caring for our house enough!
scripts.translation:
[罗莎修女]
还有多少次了，
我告诉过你要把门锁好，亲爱的！！
这都是因为你
不够关心我们的家！

scripts.text:
[Father Dames]
Hey, hey, you keep
blaming me too much!
Aren't we lucky enough 
that we are not
hurt anywhere?
scripts.translation:
[达姆斯神父]
嘿，嘿，你总是
责怪我太多！
我们没受伤，
难道不是运气很好吗？

scripts.text:
[Mother Rosa]
What did you say?
My goodness!
scripts.translation:
[罗莎修女]
你说什么？
天哪！

scripts.text:
[Daughter Luen]
Hmm?
I think that person's awake!
Hey, are you okay?
scripts.translation:
[女儿 露恩]
嗯？
我觉得那个人醒了！
嘿，你没事吧？

scripts.text: My head hurts so much...
scripts.translation: 我的头好痛...

scripts.text:
[Mother Rosa]
If the human's awake, get rid of it!
Our house just got robbed
and we don't have the 
luxury of taking care of someone!
scripts.translation:
[罗莎修女]
既然那个人类醒了，就赶紧把他赶走！
我们家刚被抢了，
哪有余力照顾别人！

scripts.text:
[Daughter Luen]
Still, you shouldn't say that to someone who's been knocked out...
scripts.translation:
[女儿 露恩]
可是，你不该对刚昏迷醒来的人说这种话...

scripts.text:
[Daughter Luen]
How do you feel?
You were in front of our house, unconscious so we brought you inside.
What happened to you?
scripts.translation:
[女儿 露恩]
你感觉怎么样？
你当时昏倒在我们家门口，所以我们把你带了进来。
你身上发生了什么？

scripts.text: Someone came out... and...
scripts.translation: 有人冲出来...然后...

scripts.text:
[Daughter Luen]
Wow... I can't believe something like that happened.
I think the person who knocked
you unconscious is the one 
who robbed our house.
scripts.translation:
[女儿 露恩]
哇...真不敢相信发生了这种事。
我觉得那个把你打晕的人，
就是抢了我们家的人。

scripts.text:
[Mother Rosa]
How can you believe what {0} saying?
How do you know {1} not lying
after robbing our stuff {2}?
Search {3} possessions immediately!!
scripts.translation:
[罗莎修女]
你怎么能相信{0}说的话？
抢了我们东西之后，
你怎么知道{1}没有说谎{2}？
立刻搜查{3}的随身物品！！

scripts.text:
[Father Dames]
No, how could you say such things?
In common sense, why would the robber be lying down in front of the house?
I think what this person is
saying is probably true...
scripts.translation:
[达姆斯神父]
不，你怎么能这么说？
按常理来说，小偷怎么会躺在房子前面呢？
我觉得这个人说的
应该是真的...

scripts.text:
[Daughter Luen]
In any case. What do you plan to do?
Because our house just got robbed,
we don't have the means to take care of you.
scripts.translation:
[女儿 露恩]
不管怎样。你打算怎么办？
因为我们家刚被抢了，
没有能力照顾你。

scripts.text: I'm not the type to be bullied around.
scripts.translation: 我不会任人欺负。

scripts.text: I'll help you catch the thief.
scripts.translation: 我会帮你们抓住小偷。

scripts.text:
[Daughter Luen]
Hmm... The way you look
seems like you would have 
been bullied around in the past..
scripts.translation:
[女儿 露恩]
嗯...看你的样子，
过去似乎经常被人欺负...

scripts.text:
[Daughter Luen]
Hmm, I guess
we'll need
your help
with this.
scripts.translation:
[女儿 露恩]
嗯，看来
我们需要
你的帮助
来处理这件事。

scripts.text:
[Daughter Luen]
Hmm, since you say that,
I can't trust you 100%, but
I'll trust you as best as I can.
scripts.translation:
[女儿 露恩]
嗯，既然你这么说，
我没法百分之百信任你，
但我会尽力信任你。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Yes. I'll definitely
find the jerk who hit
me over my head.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
是的。我一定会
找到那个从背后偷袭我的混蛋。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Before anything, I'll first listen to your
observations on what may have happened.
Please give me your best cooperation.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
首先，我要先听听你们
对可能发生的事情的观察。
请全力配合我。

scripts.text:
[Daughter Luen]
Sure, you got it.
scripts.translation:
[女儿 露恩]
好的，没问题。

scripts.text:
[Mother Rosa]
I don't know about this...
scripts.translation:
[罗莎修女]
我对这件事没什么把握...

scripts.text:
[Father Dames]
Alright, let's go for it.
scripts.translation:
[达姆斯神父]
好吧，那就试试看吧。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Hmm... The stories you told me...
Now I've processed through them..
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嗯...你们告诉我的故事...
我现在已经整理清楚了...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
There are some points of interest
that I am considering right now...
First of all..
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
有几个关键点
我正在考虑...
首先...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
The likely suspect is...
A person with short, red hair.
We aren't sure whether the
person is male or female, but
has a familiar face...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嫌疑人很可能是...
一个留着红色短发的人。
我们还不确定
此人是男是女，但
看起来很面熟...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Dames came back from meeting with a friend..
The friend is nice.
He's a bit immature, but doesn't
seem to be of a particular problem.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
达姆斯神父是和朋友见面后回来的。
那位朋友人不错。
他有点不成熟，但似乎
并没有特别的嫌疑。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Rosa was coming back from shopping.
Since I was lying unconscious
and the house was a mess,
she was afraid of me and left me 
there and stayed inside the house.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
罗莎修女是购物回来时发现的。
因为我当时昏迷不醒，
家里又一片狼藉，
她吓坏了，把我留在那里，
自己躲进了屋里。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I thought the daughter discovered
me first but Rosa was already
in the house by then.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我原以为是女儿
先发现我的，但那时
罗莎修女已经在屋里了。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
The daughter told me that 
she saw Balumin passing
by the house...
He seemed to be preoccupied
with something...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
女儿告诉我，
她看到巴卢明
从房子旁边经过...
他似乎心事重重...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
In other words... the person who
discovered me first was Rosa
and I was lying in front of
the house.
The house was in much disarray
And...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
也就是说...第一个
发现我的人是罗莎修女，
而我当时正躺在
房子门口。
家里一片混乱，
而且...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
But why was I just passed
by when I was unconcious?
Something's not right.
And...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
但我昏迷时，
为什么只是被人
路过而已？
这不对劲。
而且...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
However, Dames actually
suspects Rosa the most.
Their marriage has been becoming
more difficult. She's been asking him for
more things. Their relationship doesn't seem healthy.
And..
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
然而，达姆斯神父
其实最怀疑罗莎修女。
他们的婚姻
越来越艰难。她总是
向他索要更多东西。他们的关系
似乎很不健康。
而且...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
The stolen necklace was
what the husband bought for his wife..
Recently, the wife asked him to 
buy her a necklace, but he refused.
That's why he suspects her.
And..
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
被偷的项链
是丈夫买给妻子的...
最近，妻子让他
买一条项链，但他拒绝了。
所以他怀疑她。
而且...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
She said she doesn't suspect anyone.
She trusts her family entirely.
The stolen necklace was
something that she
really cared for.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
她说她不怀疑任何人。
她完全信任家人。
被偷的项链
是她
非常珍视的东西。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
There are no particularly expensive
items in the house and neither was the necklace.
It was just a meaningful item.
It is weird that it was stolen
when it didn't seem very expensive.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
家里没有特别昂贵的
物品，项链也不贵。
它只是一个有意义的物品。
它看起来并不值钱，
却被偷了，这很奇怪。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
The analysis is enough for now and
the second thing I have to do is...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
目前的分析已经足够了，
接下来我要做的是...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Field examination!
The robber must have left
some evidence!
Shall I start?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
现场勘查！
窃贼一定
留下了证据！
要开始吗？

scripts.text: - Let's examine Poppy first -
scripts.translation: - 先检查波比 -

scripts.text:
- Let's examine the messy
bookshelves first -
scripts.translation: - 先检查凌乱的书架 -

scripts.text:
- Let's examine the damaged
book first -
scripts.translation: - 先检查破损的书 -

scripts.text:
- Let's examine the
container first -
scripts.translation: - 先检查容器 -

scripts.text:
- Let's examine the
messed up table first -
scripts.translation: - 先检查凌乱的桌子 -

scripts.text:
[Daughter Luen]
Oh......
What should I do...
scripts.translation:
[女儿 露恩]
啊......
我该怎么办...

scripts.text:
[Daughter Luen]
Oh... What happened here?
I can't believe that the house was robbed...
scripts.translation:
[女儿 露恩]
啊...这里发生了什么？
我不敢相信家里被偷了...

scripts.text:
[Daughter Luen]
I hope the robber
is caught soon..
scripts.translation:
[女儿 露恩]
希望小偷能尽快被抓到...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Ok then,
I will begin interviewing
the victims.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
好的，
我开始对受害者进行询问。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I won't ask twice
so please respond carefully.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我只问一次，
请仔细回答。

scripts.text: Where were you coming from?
scripts.translation: 你是从哪里来的？

scripts.text:
[Daughter Luen]
I was taking a walk
in the land of blooming flowers.
I was reading a book and enjoying the breeze.
scripts.translation:
[女儿 露恩]
我本来在花海中散步。
一边看书，一边享受着微风。

scripts.text:
[Daughter Luen]
If I go to a place where there are soft breezes,
I feel much better and
forget everything about the house.
scripts.translation:
[女儿 露恩]
如果去有柔和微风的地方，
我就会感觉好很多，
也能忘掉家里的事。

scripts.text: Was there anyone suspicious?
scripts.translation: 有看到可疑的人吗？

scripts.text:
[Daughter Luen]
Hmm... I'm not sure.
scripts.translation:
[女儿 露恩]
嗯...我不太确定。

scripts.text:
[Daughter Luen]
Oh! Come to think of it, there was!
There was a person with short, red hair hurriedly going somewhere.
I wondered to myself
what's the big hurry?
scripts.translation:
[女儿 露恩]
啊！想起来，有一个人！
有个红短发的人匆匆忙忙地赶着去某处。
我当时还纳闷，
这么着急干什么？

scripts.text:
[Daughter Luen]
It was an uncommon hair color
so it made me stare at the person 
for a bit, wondering who it was.
scripts.translation:
[女儿 露恩]
那个发色很少见，
所以我盯着那个人看了一会儿，
想知道那是谁。

scripts.text: Was the person male or female?
scripts.translation: 那个人是男性还是女性？

scripts.text: Do you know anyone with short, red hair?
scripts.translation: 你认识红短发的人吗？

scripts.text:
[Daughter Luen]
That I'm not sure...
Hmm, now that you ask.
I wonder what the gender is.
scripts.translation:
[女儿 露恩]
这个我不太清楚...
嗯，被你这么一问。
我也想知道那是男是女。

scripts.text:
[Daughter Luen]
Hmm...
No matter how much I think about it...
scripts.translation:
[女儿 露恩]
嗯...
我怎么想都想不起来...

scripts.text: [Daughter Luen]
scripts.translation: [女儿 露恩]

scripts.text:
[Daughter Luen]
The physique seems
more masculine, but
the hair seemed more
feminine...
scripts.translation:
[女儿 露恩]
身材看起来比较像男性，
但发型又比较像女性...

scripts.text:
[Daughter Luen]
And... Something about
the person was familiar
to me..
I'm not exactly sure though.
scripts.translation:
[女儿 露恩]
而且...那个人
让我觉得有点熟悉...
不过我也说不太准。

scripts.text: Who's the first person to find me?
scripts.translation: 谁第一个发现我的？

scripts.text: Have you seen short, red hair elsewhere?
scripts.translation: 你在别的地方见过红短发的人吗？

scripts.text:
[Daughter Luen]
I think... I was the 
first one to discover you...
scripts.translation:
[女儿 露恩]
我想...应该是
我第一个发现你的...

scripts.text:
[Daughter Luen]
No, I didn't see the person again
but on my way back home,
I saw my dad's friend
Balumin passing by
the house.
scripts.translation:
[女儿 露恩]
不，我没有再见到那个人。
不过在我回家的路上，
我看到爸爸的朋友巴卢明
从我家门前经过。

scripts.text: [Daughter Luen]
scripts.translation: [女儿 露恩]

scripts.text:
[Daughter Luen]
When I first found you,
you were lying in
front of the house unconscious.
scripts.translation:
[女儿 露恩]
我第一次发现你的时候，
你正躺在屋前，
而且已经失去了意识。

scripts.text:
[Daughter Luen]
I was shocked thinking
that it was a dead corpse,
but thankfully you were breathing.
scripts.translation:
[女儿 露恩]
我当时吓了一跳，
还以为是一具尸体，
但幸好你还有呼吸。

scripts.text:
[Daughter Luen]
So I was hastily trying
to bring you inside the house,
but I was shocked again seeing
the house in so much disarray.
scripts.translation:
[女儿 露恩]
所以我急忙想把你抱进屋里，
但看到屋里一片狼藉，
我又吓了一跳。

scripts.text:
[Daughter Luen]
But inside the house, my mom
was already there.
I mean, if a person is lying in front of the house
unconscious, how could she just
go inside the house without doing anything?
scripts.translation:
[女儿 露恩]
不过屋里的时候，
妈妈已经在那里了。
我是说，如果有人在屋前
失去意识地躺着，
她怎么可能什么都不做就进屋呢？

scripts.text:
[Daughter Luen]
So I guess if I were to answer
that again, the first person to see you
was probably my mom.
scripts.translation:
[女儿 露恩]
所以如果让我再回答一次的话，
第一个看到你的人
应该是妈妈。

scripts.text:
[Daughter Luen]
I saw him far away
so I didn't see in much detail
but he was sweating
a whole lot at the time.
scripts.translation:
[女儿 露恩]
我离他比较远，
所以没看清细节，
但他当时满头大汗。

scripts.text:
[Daughter Luen]
I couldn't talk to him,
but he seemed very
preoccupied with something.
scripts.translation:
[女儿 露恩]
我没有和他说话，
但他看起来
心事重重。

scripts.text:
[Daughter Luen]
Come to think of it,
if he passed by our house,
he must have seen you unconscious body but I wonder why he didn't do anything?
scripts.translation:
[女儿 露恩]
仔细想想，
如果他经过我家，
肯定看到了你失去意识的样子，
但我不明白他为什么什么都没做？

scripts.text:
[Daughter Luen]
Anyways, I think that's pretty much all I know.
scripts.translation:
[女儿 露恩]
总之，我想我知道的大概就是这些了。

scripts.text: Thank you for your honest answers.
scripts.translation: 谢谢你的坦诚回答。

scripts.text:
[Daughter Luen]
No problem.
I hope that was helpful 
at least somewhat.
scripts.translation:
[女儿 露恩]
不客气。
希望能帮上你一点忙。

scripts.text:
[Daughter Luen]
I hope we can catch the robber.
scripts.translation:
[女儿 露恩]
希望能抓住那个强盗。

scripts.text:
[Daughter Luen]
No, I have never seen anyone else with that hairstyle.
scripts.translation:
[女儿 露恩]
不，我从未见过其他人
留那样的发型。

scripts.text:
[Daughter Luen]
At least from the people that I know,
I don't think there was ever a person like that.
Yeah... Not at all!
This I know for sure!
scripts.translation:
[女儿 露恩]
至少在我认识的人里，
我觉得从来没有过这样的人。
是的...绝对没有！
这一点我确信无疑！

scripts.text:
[Daughter Luen]
If it was a color as 
obvious as that,
there is no way I wouldn't remember!
scripts.translation:
[女儿 露恩]
如果是那么明显的颜色，
我不可能不记得！

scripts.text: Who's the first person to find me?
scripts.translation: 谁第一个发现我的？

scripts.text: Have you seen short, red hair before?
scripts.translation: 你以前见过红短发的人吗？

scripts.text:
[Daughter Luen]
I think... I was the 
first one to discover you...
scripts.translation:
[女儿 露恩]
我想...应该是
我第一个发现你的...

scripts.text:
[Daughter Luen]
No, I didn't see the person again
but on my way back home,
I saw my dad's friend
Balumin passing by
the house.
scripts.translation:
[女儿 露恩]
不，我没有再见到那个人。
不过在我回家的路上，
我看到爸爸的朋友巴卢明
从我家门前经过。

scripts.text: [Daughter Luen]
scripts.translation: [女儿 露恩]

scripts.translation:

scripts.text:

scripts.translation:

所以如果让我再回答一次的话，
第一个看到你的人应该是妈妈。

scripts.text:

I saw him far away
so I didn't see in much detail
but he was sweating
a whole lot at the time.
scripts.translation:

我离他比较远，
所以没看清细节，
但他当时满头大汗。

scripts.text:
[Daughter Luen]
I couldn't talk to him,
but he seemed very
preoccupied with something.
scripts.translation:
[女儿 露恩]
我没有和他说话，
但他看起来
心事重重。

scripts.text:
[Daughter Luen]
Come to think of it,
if Balumin passed by our house, too,
he must have seen you unconscious
but I wonder why he didn't do anything?
scripts.translation:
[女儿 露恩]
仔细想想，
如果巴卢明也经过我家，
他肯定看到了你失去意识的样子，
但我不明白他为什么什么都没做？

scripts.text:
[Daughter Luen]
Anyways, I think that's 
pretty much all I know.
scripts.translation:
[女儿 露恩]
总之，我想我知道的大概就是这些了。
