scripts.translation: 谢谢你的坦诚回答。

scripts.text:
[Daughter Luen]
No problem.
I hope that was helpful 
at least somewhat.
scripts.translation:
[女儿 露恩]
不客气。
希望能帮上你一点忙。

scripts.text:
[Daughter Luen]
I hope we can catch the robber.
scripts.translation:
[女儿 露恩]
希望能抓住那个强盗。

scripts.text:
[Daughter Luen]
Did you say you are going to do a field examination?
Is there anything
I can help with?
scripts.translation:
[女儿 露恩]
你说过要进行现场勘查吗？
有什么我可以帮忙的吗？

scripts.text:
[Daughter Luen]
You were working on the field examination, right?
But I guess you aren't done.
Please let me know what you find
when you are done.
scripts.translation:
[女儿 露恩]
你正在做现场勘查，对吧？
看来还没做完。
结束后请告诉我你的发现。

scripts.text:
[Daughter Luen]
You finished with all of the
field examination!
Did you find anything?
scripts.translation:
[女儿 露恩]
你已经完成了所有的现场勘查！
有什么发现吗？

scripts.text:
[Daughter Luen]
Maybe...
The necklace wasn't stolen, but
was just lost somewhere in the house...
scripts.translation:
[女儿 露恩]
也许...
项链并没有被偷，
只是掉在屋子里的某个地方了...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Unfortunately, that wasn't the case,
and I should do a 
survey investigation of
various people.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
不幸的是，情况并非如此，
我应该对相关人员
进行调查询问。

scripts.text:
[Daughter Luen]
Oh, I see...
But aren't you doing
too much for us?
Honestly, we are very
thankful for what
you've already done...
scripts.translation:
[女儿 露恩]
噢，我明白了...
但是，你为我们做的
是不是太多了？
说实话，对于你已经做的，
我们非常感激...

scripts.text:
[Mother Rosa]
What are you saying?
No matter what! My necklace!
And the thief who took it!
We have to find them!
No matter what!
scripts.translation:
[罗莎修女]
你在说什么？
无论如何！我的项链！
还有偷走它的小偷！
我们必须找到它们！
无论如何！

scripts.text:
- Footstep sounds -
- It sounds like someone is walking toward the house -
scripts.translation:
- 脚步声 -
- 听起来有人正朝房子走来 -

scripts.text:
[Cruyan]
Mother~ Father~
I'm back~!
What the...?!
What happened to the house?
Was it robbed?!
scripts.translation:
[克鲁扬]
妈妈~ 爸爸~
我回来啦~！
天哪...？！
房子怎么了？
被抢劫了吗？！

scripts.text:
[Mother Rosa]
How am I possibly
your mother??
You take that back right away!!
How many times did I tell you to
stay away from my daughter, huh?!
Get out of the house right now!!
scripts.translation:
[罗莎修女]
我怎么可能
是你妈妈？？
你马上给我收回这句话！！
我告诉过你多少次
离我女儿远点，嗯？！
现在立刻给我滚出去！！

scripts.text:
[Cruyan]
Mother!! If something
has been robbed, I will
definitely find it for you!
You can trust me, mother!!
scripts.translation:
[克鲁扬]
妈妈！！如果有什么
东西被偷了，我绝对
会帮你找到的！
你可以相信我，妈妈！！

scripts.text:
[Mother Rosa]
You are just a nuisance.
Get out of the house right now!!
scripts.translation:
[罗莎修女]
你只是个讨厌鬼。
现在立刻给我滚出去！！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
That guy must be Luen's
boyfriend... Before it
gets messier here, I should
get on with my
survey investigation.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
这家伙肯定是露恩的
男朋友... 在事情变得更糟之前，
我应该继续进行
我的调查询问。

scripts.text:
[Daughter Luen]
Did you say you are going to do a field examination?
Is there anything
I can help with?
scripts.translation:
[女儿 露恩]
你说过要进行现场勘查吗？
有什么我可以帮忙的吗？

scripts.text: I found out who the robber was.
scripts.translation: 我已经查出了小偷是谁。

scripts.text: I haven't figured things out yet.
scripts.translation: 我还没有查明真相。

scripts.text:
[Daughter Luen]
I... I see...
Finding the robber is important, but...
The necklace is even more important...
scripts.translation:
[女儿 露恩]
我... 我明白了...
找到小偷很重要，但是...
项链更重要...

scripts.text:
[Daughter Luen]
Oh my.. Really?
scripts.translation:
[女儿 露恩]
天哪.. 真的吗？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Yes.
Of course, I also found out
where the robbed necklace was..
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
是的。
当然，我也查出了
被偷的项链在哪里..

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Now..
I'll let you know the 
results of my investigation.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
现在..
我会告诉你
我的调查结果。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Then why don't I gather all of the victims and suspects and go through the thought process with you.
This place is not appropriate so let us go to another location.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
那么，为什么不把所有受害者和嫌疑人召集起来，和我一起梳理一下思路呢。
这里不太合适，我们去别的地方吧。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Let's get going.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我们出发吧。

scripts.text:
- I must lighten the
weight before talking again -
scripts.translation: - 在继续对话前，我需要减轻负重 -

scripts.text:
[Daughter Luen]
I told my parents and
all the others.
scripts.translation:
[女儿 露恩]
我已经告诉了我的父母
和其他所有人。

scripts.text:
[Daughter Luen]
That my boyfriend was the one.
I knew about it already.
But, I couldn't tell my parents because if they were to find out the truth,
they would oppose him even more...
scripts.translation:
[女儿 露恩]
那个小偷就是我的男朋友。
我早就知道了。
但我不能告诉父母，因为如果他们发现真相，
就会更加反对他...

scripts.text:
[Daughter Luen]
But thank you so much for helping us both physically and emotionally.
This is just a small token of my appreciation.
Thanks again.
scripts.translation:
[女儿 露恩]
非常感谢你在身体和精神上都帮助了我们。
这只是我的一点心意，聊表谢意。
再次感谢。

scripts.text:
[Daughter Luen]
Thank you so much for helping us
both physically and emotionally.
Thanks again.
scripts.translation:
[女儿 露恩]
非常感谢你在身体和精神上都帮助了我们。
再次感谢。

scripts.text:
[Father Dames]
Heh, this kind of thing.
scripts.translation:
[达姆斯神父]
呵，真是这种事。

scripts.text:
[Father Dames]
It's the first time this kind of
thing ever happened to us.
scripts.translation:
[达姆斯神父]
这是第一次发生这种事。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
As you may have heard, to figure out the thief responsible for this, I will begin my interview with you.
Please give me your best cooperation.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
想必你也听说了，为了查明这起盗窃案的凶手，我将开始对你进行询问。
请全力配合。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I won't ask twice so
please respond carefully.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我只问一次，
请仔细回答。

scripts.text: Where were you coming from?
scripts.translation: 你是从哪里来的？

scripts.text:
[Father Dames]
I was coming back from
meeting with a friend.
scripts.translation:
[达姆斯神父]
我刚从和朋友见面的地方回来。

scripts.text:
[Father Dames]
I talked to him about my daughter.
I talked to him about my wife.
I talked to him about life.
scripts.translation:
[达姆斯神父]
我和他聊了聊我女儿的事。
也聊了聊我妻子的事。
还聊了聊生活。

scripts.text:
[Father Dames]
Then I came back home
and it was a mess.
My wife and daughter were devastated.
And you were lying unconscious.
scripts.translation:
[达姆斯神父]
然后我回到家，发现一片狼藉。
我的妻子和女儿都崩溃了。
而你当时正昏迷不醒。

scripts.text: What kind of friend is he?
scripts.translation: 他是怎样的朋友？

scripts.text: Did you talk about anything else?
scripts.translation: 你们还聊了什么吗？

scripts.text:
[Father Dames]
He's not anyone particularly mean or bad.
scripts.translation:
[达姆斯神父]
他并不是什么特别坏或刻薄的人。

scripts.text:
[Father Dames]
Although he's a bit immature
no matter how much he ages...
To put it positively, he lives young, but to put it negatively, he's just an immature kind of a guy.
scripts.translation:
[达姆斯神父]
虽然无论长多大，他都挺不成熟的...
往好了说，他活得年轻；往坏了说，他就是个不成熟的人。

scripts.text:
[Father Dames]
Aside from that,
he is no trouble at all.
He's that kind of a friend.
scripts.translation:
[达姆斯神父]
除此之外，
他完全没什么麻烦。
他就是那种朋友。

scripts.text:
[Father Dames]
Actually..
Not too long ago,
the guy asked
me a favor..
scripts.translation:
[达姆斯神父]
其实..
不久前，
那家伙
求了我一个忙..

scripts.text:
[Father Dames]
He said he has an urgent need
for some money..
And asked me to help him out..
scripts.translation:
[达姆斯神父]
他说他急需一笔钱..
然后让我帮帮他..

scripts.text:
[Father Dames]
So since I didn't have money myself
and it's not the best to exchange money
between friends,
I told him that I was sorry
and sent him off after
treating him to a meal.
scripts.translation:
[达姆斯神父]
我自己手头也不宽裕，
而且朋友之间互相借钱也不太合适，
所以我向他道了歉，
请他吃了顿饭就把他送走了。

scripts.text:
[Father Dames]
Aside from that,
I don't see anything
suspicious about him..
scripts.translation:
[达姆斯神父]
除此之外，
我觉得他没有什么可疑的地方..

scripts.text: Has he been suspicious before?
scripts.translation: 他以前有可疑的行为吗？

scripts.text: Do you suspect him after the incident?
scripts.translation: 事发后您怀疑他吗？

scripts.text:
[Father Dames]
To be honest,
I suspect my wife.
She has been complaining about
every little thing recently.
scripts.translation:
[达姆斯神父]
说实话，
我怀疑的是我妻子。
她最近总是为了一点小事就抱怨。

scripts.text:
[Father Dames]
No matter what I say, she either says 'no' or 'I don't like it.'
It's not for any specific reason but she just opposes me for
the sake of opposing me.
scripts.translation:
[达姆斯神父]
不管我说什么，她要么说“不”，要么说“我不喜欢”。
并没有具体的理由，她就是单纯地为了反对而反对。

scripts.text:
[Father Dames]
Recently, she's been asking for this and that, and getting mad about this and that.
It's really been tough.
scripts.translation:
[达姆斯神父]
最近，她总是这也要那也要，又因为这那而生气。
真的很难应付。

scripts.text:
[Father Dames]
The item that was stolen is my wife's necklace...
It's a necklace that I got for her.
scripts.translation:
[达姆斯神父]
被偷的东西是我妻子的项链...
那是我送给她的。

scripts.text:
[Father Dames]
When the house was robbed I was really worried.
But when I found out that it was the necklace...
I recalled what my wife had told me not too long ago.
scripts.translation:
[达姆斯神父]
家里被偷的时候，我非常担心。
但当我发现被偷的是那条项链时...
我想起了妻子不久前对我说的话。

scripts.text:
[Father Dames]
She said that she wants a new necklace.
I told her that I will buy her one for her next birthday...
She was mad still.
I wonder if this kind of thing happened because of that in the end.
scripts.translation:
[达姆斯神父]
她说想要一条新项链。
我告诉她下个生日我会买给她...
但她还是很生气。
我想，这件事最后是不是就是因为这个才发生的。

scripts.text: Thank you for your honest answers.
scripts.translation: 谢谢你的坦诚回答。

scripts.text:
[Father Dames]
Not a problem.
I hope my responses 
will help you.
scripts.translation:
[达姆斯神父]
没问题。
希望我的回答能帮到你。

scripts.text:
[Father Dames]
Only if we can
catch that robber soon,
how wonderful that would be.
scripts.translation:
[达姆斯神父]
只要我们能尽快抓到那个小偷，
那就太好了。

scripts.text:
[Father Dames]
I see you are getting through your field examination.
I ask that you would
give your all.
scripts.translation:
[达姆斯神父]
看来你正在接受实地考核。
希望你能全力以赴。

scripts.text:
[Father Dames]
I see you are continuing your investigation.
Are you thinking of 
talking to my friend as well?
scripts.translation:
[达姆斯神父]
看来你还在继续调查。
你打算也去问问我的朋友吗？

scripts.text:
[Father Dames]
How is the
investigation going?
scripts.translation:
[达姆斯神父]
调查进展如何？

scripts.text:
- I must lighten the
weight before talking again -
scripts.translation: - 在继续对话前，我需要减轻负重 -

scripts.text:
[Father Dames]
I heard most of the story
from Cruyan.
scripts.translation:
[达姆斯神父]
我从克鲁扬那里
听说了大部分的事情。

scripts.text:
[Father Dames]
It was pretty shocking...
but in some ways, I could
see why he did it.
scripts.translation:
[达姆斯神父]
这让人挺震惊的...
但在某种程度上，
我也能理解他为什么会这么做。

scripts.text:
[Father Dames]
Thank you for helping us
throughout this time.
You went through a lot for us.
scripts.translation:
[达姆斯神父]
谢谢你这段时间的帮助。
你为我们付出了很多。

scripts.text:
[Father Dames]
I know that it's up to us
from now to figure
things out...
scripts.translation:
[达姆斯神父]
我知道接下来
要靠我们自己
去弄清楚事情了...

scripts.text:
[Father Dames]
Here's something for you.
Thanks again and
I hope that all your work
in the future will go well.
scripts.translation:
[达姆斯神父]
这是给你的。
再次感谢，
希望以后你的工作一切顺利。

scripts.text:
[Father Dames]
Thanks again and
I hope that all your work
in the future will go well.
scripts.translation:
[达姆斯神父]
再次感谢，
希望以后你的工作一切顺利。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
As you may have heard, to figure out the thief responsible for this,
I will begin my interview with you.
Please give me your best cooperation.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
想必你也听说了，为了查明这起盗窃案的幕后黑手，
我将开始对你进行询问。
请全力配合。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I won't ask twice so please respond carefully.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我只问一次，请仔细回答。

scripts.text: Where were you coming from?
scripts.translation: 你是从哪里来的？

scripts.text:
[Mother Rosa]
I don't really trust you
but I'll talk to you for
the sake of my necklace.
scripts.translation:
[罗莎修女]
我其实不太信任你，
但为了我的项链，
我还是愿意和你谈谈。

scripts.text:
[Mother Rosa]
I was shopping around
in the store nearby
to see if there's anything
I should get.
scripts.translation:
[罗莎修女]
我本来是在附近的商店里逛逛，
看看有没有什么需要买的东西。

scripts.text:
[Mother Rosa]
I didn't really have anything 
I liked, so I just came back home.
That's all.
scripts.translation:
[罗莎修女]
没什么我喜欢的，
所以我就回家了。
就是这样。

scripts.text: Why did you just go into the house?
scripts.translation: 你为什么直接进屋了？

scripts.text: Was there anything suspicious?
scripts.translation: 有没有什么可疑的地方？

scripts.text:
[Mother Rosa]
When I first saw you
lying down, I was shocked
out of my mind, and actually
thought that if you were alive,
I need to do something about it!
I'm not that bad, you know!
scripts.translation:
[罗莎修女]
当我第一眼看到你倒在那里时，
我吓坏了，
心想如果你还活着，
我得做点什么才行！
我可不是那种见死不救的人！

scripts.text:
[Mother Rosa]
But the world today, is it all that simple?
There are so many kinds of accidents these days!
A feeble housewife like me really can't do much!
scripts.translation:
[罗莎修女]
但如今的世界，哪有那么简单？
现在的意外事故太多了！
像我这样手无缚鸡之力的家庭主妇，
真的帮不上什么忙！

scripts.text:
[Mother Rosa]
So I first went into the house,
and planned to pick you up
with the rest of my family!
But when I went into the house,
the house was in chaos
as if it was robbed!
scripts.translation:
[罗莎修女]
所以我先进了屋，
打算叫上家人一起把你抬起来！
但当我进屋时，
家里一片狼藉，
像是被抢劫过一样！

scripts.text:
[Mother Rosa]
A person lying at the door!
A robbed house!
I was so scared that
I couldn't go out to get you!
Do you understand me?
scripts.translation:
[罗莎修女]
门口躺着一个人！
家里被洗劫一空！
我吓得不敢出去救你！
你明白吗？

scripts.text:
[Mother Rosa]
When I came into the house,
aside from it being so messy,
there wasn't anything else!
scripts.translation:
[罗莎修女]
我进屋后，
除了乱糟糟的，
没发现其他异常！

scripts.text:
[Mother Rosa]
Of all things, why was my
necklace stolen...?
Why couldn't the robber
just take that useless
dog instead!
scripts.translation:
[罗莎修女]
偏偏我的项链被偷了...
那个强盗为什么不去偷那只没用的狗呢！

scripts.text:
[Mother Rosa]
The more I think about, the more annoying it gets!
......
............
I'm sorry... I was venting
on you for no reason...
scripts.translation:
[罗莎修女]
越想越气！
......
............
对不起...我不该无缘无故
对你发火...

scripts.text:
[Mother Rosa]
Anyways, I don't think there was
anything peculiar about it.
scripts.translation:
[罗莎修女]
总之，我觉得没什么特别的地方。

scripts.text: Do you suspect anyone?
scripts.translation: 你怀疑谁吗？

scripts.text: Is there anything else missing?
scripts.translation: 还有别的东西丢失吗？

scripts.text:
[Mother Rosa]
Not sure.
Even though my husband is apathetic to me, he's not a bad person.
My no-good daugther doesn't listen to me when I tell her to break up with her boyfriend.
But she's still a nice girl...
scripts.translation:
[罗莎修女]
不确定。
虽然我的丈夫对我很冷淡，但他不是坏人。
我那不争气的女儿不听劝，不肯和男朋友分手。
但她还是个不错的女孩...

scripts.text:
[Mother Rosa]
And it's not that our house is 
filled with expensive items,
and the necklace is one
precious item that I
truly treasure...
scripts.translation:
[罗莎修女]
而且我们家也没什么贵重的东西，
那条项链是我
真正珍视的
宝物之一...

scripts.text:
[Mother Rosa]
That's what got robbed!
It's not my family for sure!
There's no way I'd suspect them!
Not at all!
scripts.translation:
[罗莎修女]
被偷的就是那个！
肯定不是我们家人干的！
我绝对不会怀疑他们的！
完全不会！

scripts.text:
[Mother Rosa]
We don't have anything in our house that's particularly expensive.
scripts.translation:
[罗莎修女]
我们家没有什么特别贵重的东西。

scripts.text:
[Mother Rosa]
In fact, the necklace is also not
all that expensive. But it's just 
that it's an object of multiple
significance...
scripts.translation:
[罗莎修女]
其实，那条项链也不算太贵。
只是它有着
多重意义...

scripts.text:
[Mother Rosa]
It's obvious that the necklace 
is not that pricey.
Even if you sell it..
I don't think it would be all that much.
I have no idea why it was stolen.
scripts.translation:
[罗莎修女]
很明显，那条项链并不值钱。
就算把它卖了...
我想也卖不了多少钱。
我不知道为什么会被偷。

scripts.text: Thank you for your honest answers.
scripts.translation: 谢谢你的坦诚回答。

scripts.text:
[Mother Rosa]
I really wish...
that you would find my necklace.
scripts.translation:
[罗莎修女]
我真的希望...
你能找到我的项链。

scripts.text:
[Mother Rosa]
That necklace. It's what
my husband got me.. So it's
very important to me.
scripts.translation:
[罗莎修女]
那条项链。是我丈夫
送给我的...所以对我来说
非常重要。

scripts.text:
- I must lighten the
weight before talking again -
scripts.translation: - 在继续对话前，我需要减轻负重 -

scripts.text:
[Mother Rosa]
......
I heard the whole story.
scripts.translation:
[罗莎修女]
......
我听到了整个故事。

scripts.text:
[Mother Rosa]
I never really liked Cruyan in the first place but I feel more disappointed in my daughter.
scripts.translation:
[罗莎修女]
我本来就不太喜欢克鲁扬，但对我女儿感到更加失望。

scripts.text:
[Mother Rosa]
I was actually pretty doubtful...
With all that, I sincerely appreciate you for being so helpful.
scripts.translation:
[罗莎修女]
我其实挺怀疑的...
尽管如此，还是真心感谢你的帮助。

scripts.text:
[Mother Rosa]
But...
It turns out that 
Cruyan or my daughter
don't have the necklace.
For that I'm still pretty upset.
scripts.translation:
[罗莎修女]
但是...
结果发现
克鲁扬和我女儿
都没有那条项链。
这让我还是很生气。

scripts.text:
- While carefully handing -
- Rosa her necklace -
- I tell her where it was found -
scripts.translation:
- 小心地将 -
- 项链递给罗莎 -
- 告诉她项链是在哪里找到的 -

scripts.text:
[Mother Rosa]
I see... I didn't know it
was in such a place.
You had already found it but to figure out the truth behind everything.
You kept it all to yourself until now.
I didn't know you put such deep consideration for this...
scripts.translation:
[罗莎修女]
原来如此...我不知道它
会在那么远的地方。
你早就找到了，但为了查明真相。
你一直把它藏在身边直到现在。
我不知道你竟然考虑得这么周到...

scripts.text:
[Mother Rosa]
I am just
speechless.
Thank you very very much.
scripts.translation:
[罗莎修女]
我真是
无话可说。
非常感谢，非常感谢。

scripts.text:
[Mother Rosa]
I don't have much...
If this is alright with you,
this is just my gratitude.
Thank you very very much.
scripts.translation:
[罗莎修女]
我没有多少钱...
如果你不介意的话，
这只是我的一点心意。
非常感谢，非常感谢。

scripts.text:
[Mother Rosa]
Oh my. How could this be...?
scripts.translation:
[罗莎修女]
天哪。怎么会这样...

scripts.text:
[Mother Rosa]
I would have never imagined
that our house would be robbed!
scripts.translation:
[罗莎修女]
我从来没想过
我们家会被入室盗窃！

scripts.text:
[Mother Rosa]
You are going to do a field examination?
Great, do what you need to do!
scripts.translation:
[罗莎修女]
你要进行现场勘查吗？
太好了，请随意调查！

scripts.text:
[Mother Rosa]
You'll be carrying out your
investigation carefully, right?
scripts.translation:
[罗莎修女]
你会仔细
进行调查的，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Mother Rosa]
Is the investigation going
alright...?
Somehow I can't really... trust...
scripts.translation:
[罗莎修女]
调查进展顺利吗...？
我总觉得...不太...放心...

scripts.text:
[Mother Rosa]
I am just
speechless.
Thank you very very much.
scripts.translation:
[罗莎修女]
我真是
无话可说。
非常感谢，非常感谢。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Hello.
You must be Luen's boyfriend
who just visited the house, right?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你好。
你就是刚刚来家里拜访的鲁恩的男朋友吧？

scripts.text:
[Cruyan]
Oop.
...
Yes. That's right.
And you are...
scripts.translation:
[克鲁扬]
哎呀。
...
是的，没错。
而你是...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I'm the detective who 
is responsible for this case.
I have a few questions to ask and I would appreciate your cooperation.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我是负责这个案件的侦探。
我有几个问题要问，希望你能配合。

scripts.text: Where were you 10 minutes ago?
scripts.translation: 十分钟前你在哪里？

scripts.text:
[Cruyan]
Your possessions are too 
heavy that I can't confirm
my alibi. Please lighten
your load and come back.
scripts.translation:
[克鲁扬]
你携带的物品太重了，我无法核实你的不在场证明。
请减轻负重后再来。

scripts.text:
[Cruyan]
At the time, I was in the land of blooming flowers.
I heard that monster infestations are increasing,
so I was just taking care of some as exercise.
scripts.translation:
[克鲁扬]
当时，我在花之国度。
听说那里魔物泛滥，所以我只是去那里打怪锻炼一下。

scripts.text:
[Cruyan]
I did not steal
the necklace!
scripts.translation:
[克鲁扬]
我没有偷那条项链！

scripts.text:
[Cruyan]
And I will find that necklace no matter what and bring it to mother!
scripts.translation:
[克鲁扬]
无论如何，我都会找到那条项链并交给母亲！

scripts.text: Did anything particular happen?
scripts.translation: 发生了什么特别的事吗？

scripts.text:
[Cruyan]
When I was on my way out of
the land of blooming flowers,
I saw the friend of 
my girlfriend's father
hurrying somewhere.
scripts.translation:
[克鲁扬]
当我离开花之国度时，
我看到我女朋友的父亲的朋友正匆忙地赶往某处。

scripts.text:
[Cruyan]
And, I just came back to the town to see my girlfriend.
scripts.translation:
[克鲁扬]
然后，我刚回到城镇来看望我的女朋友。

scripts.text: Could you confirm your alibi?
scripts.translation: 你能核实你的不在场证明吗？

scripts.text:
[Cruyan]
Of course.
The loot that I got from hunting monsters there is this Concentration Potion.
See, have I confirmed it now?
scripts.translation:
[克鲁扬]
当然可以。
我在那里打怪获得的战利品就是这瓶集中药水。
看，我现在核实过了吗？

scripts.text:
[Cruyan]
Since you seem to be working hard, I'll give you this Concentration Potion that I got from hunting~
scripts.translation:
[克鲁扬]
既然你看起来工作很努力，我就把这瓶打怪获得的集中药水送给你吧~

scripts.text:
[Cruyan]
So we are done with these questions, right?
And since I will find that necklace for sure, you probably won't have to worry about it anymore.
scripts.translation:
[克鲁扬]
那么，这些问题问完了，对吧？
而且既然我肯定会找到那条项链，你大概也不用再为此担心了。

scripts.text: - If I go to the land of the blooming flowers and hunt these monsters, I can confirm whether or not this item can really be obtained -
scripts.translation: - 如果我去花之国度打这些魔物，就能确认这个物品是否真的能获取 -

scripts.text:
- I must lighten the
weight before talking again -
scripts.translation: - 在继续对话前，我需要减轻负重 -

scripts.text:
[Cruyan]
To be honest, I blamed you a lot for this.
If it worked out, it could have been a chance to win mother's trust...
scripts.translation:
[克鲁扬]
说实话，我因为这件事责怪了你很久。
如果事情顺利，这本来可能是赢得母亲信任的机会...

scripts.text:
[Cruyan]
But...
Once I confessed everything,
I was so ashamed of
myself for thinking of such
things in the first place...
scripts.translation:
[克鲁扬]
但是...
当我坦白了一切后，
我为自己竟然会有这种想法而感到非常羞愧...

scripts.text:
[Cruyan]
Thank you...
I also heard that
you found the
necklace...
I really owe you
in many ways...
scripts.translation:
[克鲁扬]
谢谢你...
我也听说
你找到了
那条项链...
我在很多方面
都欠你人情...

scripts.text:
[Cruyan]
From now on, I won't depend on these dumb ploys.
I will face Luen's mom straight on and do my best.
scripts.translation:
[克鲁扬]
从现在开始，我不会再依赖这些愚蠢的伎俩了。
我会正面面对鲁恩的母亲，并尽我所能。

scripts.text:
[Cruyan]
Please take this as an expression of my gratitude.
Thank you!
scripts.translation:
[克鲁扬]
请收下这个，以表达我的感激之情。
谢谢！

scripts.text:
[Cruyan]
I will find that necklace
no matter what and
bring it to mother.
scripts.translation:
[克鲁扬]
无论如何，我都会找到那条项链，
并把它交给母亲。

scripts.text:
[Cruyan]
So we are done with these questions, right?
And since I will find that necklace you probably won't have to worry about it anymore.
scripts.translation:
[克鲁扬]
那么，这些询问就到此为止，对吧？
既然我会找到那条项链，你大概也不用再为此担心了。

scripts.text:
[Cruyan]
Since I will find that necklace you probably won't have to worry about it anymore.
scripts.translation:
[克鲁扬]
既然我会找到那条项链，你大概也不用再为此担心了。

scripts.text:
[Cruyan]
From now on, I won't depend on these dumb ploys.
I will face Luen's mom straight on and do my best.
scripts.translation:
[克鲁扬]
从现在开始，我不会再依赖这些愚蠢的伎俩了。
我会正面面对鲁恩的母亲，并尽我所能。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
- I must lighten the
weight before talking again -
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
- 在再次交谈前，我必须减轻负重 -

scripts.text:
[Balumin]
I got to hear the whole story, but I never thought something like that would happen.
scripts.translation:
[巴卢明]
我听到了整个故事，但我从未想过会发生这样的事。

scripts.text:
[Balumin]
As a friend, I felt
pretty bad about myself
for being more of a
burden than help.
scripts.translation:
[巴卢明]
作为朋友，
我觉得自己很糟糕，
因为我更像是个负担，
而不是帮手。

scripts.text:
[Balumin]
I know that you were 
a big part in resolving
this incident.
scripts.translation:
[巴卢明]
我知道你在解决
这起事件中
起了很大的作用。

scripts.text:
[Balumin]
This is not much but it's loot I got while hunting monsters.
Please at least take this.
scripts.translation:
[巴卢明]
这不算什么，
但这是我打怪时获得的战利品。
请至少收下这个。

scripts.text:
[Balumin]
I hope that your
future will be full
of blessings.
scripts.translation:
[巴卢明]
希望你的未来
充满祝福。

scripts.text:
I'm sorry, but
I'm kind of busy right now.
I'm in the middle of hunting monsters...
It seems like you're also in the middle of hunting..
Come back to me
after you're done.
scripts.translation:
抱歉，
我现在有点忙。
我正在打怪...
看起来你也在打怪...
等你忙完再回来找我吧。

scripts.text: Who are you?
scripts.translation: 你是谁？

scripts.text: I'm here regarding the robbery incident.
scripts.translation: 我是关于抢劫事件的。

scripts.text:
[Balumin]
Oh no! Was there such an incident?
It must be very troublesome for my friend...
scripts.translation:
[巴卢明]
天哪！发生了这样的事？
这对我的朋友来说一定很麻烦...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I am actually responsible for helping out with catching the robber.
I have a few questions to ask and I would appreciate your cooperation.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我实际上负责协助抓捕小偷。
我有几个问题要问，希望你能配合。

scripts.text: What did you do today?
scripts.translation: 你今天做了什么？

scripts.text:
[Balumin]
I was here
all day long.
I was making money
by hunting some monsters.
scripts.translation:
[巴卢明]
我整天都在这里。
我在打怪赚钱。

scripts.text:
[Balumin]
And earlier today, I met
with my buddy and talked
about many things.
scripts.translation:
[巴卢明]
今天早些时候，
我和巴迪见了面，
聊了很多事情。

scripts.text: Have you seen a guy named Cruyan?
scripts.translation: 你见过一个叫克鲁扬的人吗？

scripts.text:
[Balumin]
Hmm, I was
here all day, but
aside from my friend Dames
I didn't see anybody.
scripts.translation:
[巴卢明]
嗯，我整天都在这里，
除了我的朋友达梅斯，
我没见到任何人。

scripts.text:
[Balumin]
All I saw were the land of blooming flowers and monsters.
scripts.translation:
[巴卢明]
我只看到了盛开的花朵和魔物。

scripts.text: Do monsters drop Concentration...
scripts.translation: 魔物会掉落集中力...

scripts.text:
[Balumin]
I don't think it's something
you can obtain from the
monsters around here.
That I know for sure.
scripts.translation:
[巴卢明]
我不认为这是
附近魔物掉落的。
这一点我很确定。

scripts.text:
[Balumin]
That seems like something you can purchase from a merchant...
I don't think it's from an ordinary merchant...
scripts.translation:
[巴卢明]
那看起来像是商人那里能买到的东西...
不过我觉得不是普通商人那里能买到的...

scripts.text:
[Balumin]
In any case, with such a terrible incident at my friend's place, I ask that you would catch that robber.
scripts.translation:
[巴卢明]
总之，我的朋友那里发生了这么糟糕的事情，我拜托你抓住那个小偷。

scripts.text:
[Balumin]
I'm sorry, but
I'm kind of busy right now.
I'm in the middle of hunting monsters...
Come back to me later.
scripts.translation:
[巴卢明]
抱歉，
我现在有点忙。
我正在打魔物...
请稍后再来找我。

scripts.text:
[Balumin]
With such a terrible incident at my friend's place, I ask that you would catch that robber.
scripts.translation:
[巴卢明]
我的朋友那里发生了这么糟糕的事情，我拜托你抓住那个小偷。

scripts.text:
[Balumin]
I hope that your
future will be full
of blessings.
scripts.translation:
[巴卢明]
希望你的未来
充满祝福。

scripts.text:
- Upon getting closer,
I smell a terrible
stench of alcohol -
[Wandering Merchant]
At least thanks for
freeing me from any
suspicion, okay~~?
scripts.translation:
- 走近时，
闻到了一股
难闻的酒味 -

scripts.text:
{0}

{0}

好吧，随便你们怎么搜。
我真的没有那条项链！！

scripts.text: - You search through Cruyan's possessions -
scripts.translation: - 你搜查了克鲁扬的随身物品 -

scripts.text: - You find nothing -
scripts.translation: - 你什么也没找到 -

scripts.text:
{0}
That's because when you
were about to steal the
necklace, you were caught
by Luen.

{0}
Although Luen 
was shocked to see her
boyfriend trying to rob and 
going through the house,
she got to hear his side of
the story.
scripts.translation:
{0}
虽然露恩看到男友试图入室行窃
感到震惊，
但她还是听了他这边的说法。

scripts.text:
{0}
She must have sympathized
with how you felt, but probably
disagreed with you. She must 
have physically resisted you 
trying to steal the necklace, and
in the process, the necklace was lost...
scripts.translation:
{0}
她一定对你当时的感受产生了同情，
但可能并不认同你的做法。她一定
在身体上阻止了你偷项链，
在这个过程中，项链丢失了...

scripts.text:
{0}
And that's when I was coming in
from outside. And since you
didn't want to be caught,
you knocked me out...
scripts.translation:
{0}
就在那时，我从外面走了进来。
由于你不想被抓，
你就把我打晕了...

scripts.text:
{0}
You were both afraid of
what might have happened to me..
The necklace was lost in the process..
And since your parents were about
to return home, you hurriedly
left the house.
scripts.translation:
{0}
你们两人都害怕
我可能会遭遇不测...
项链在这个过程中丢失了...
而且因为你的父母
快要回家了，你匆忙离开了房子。

scripts.text:
{0}
You tried to do something
with me, but Rosa was
already on her way back at
the time, so you couldn't do anything.
scripts.translation:
{0}
你试图对我做什么，
但当时罗莎已经在回来的路上了，
所以你什么也没做成。

scripts.text:
{0}
And Cruyan, as soon as you
got to the house, you said
that the necklace was stolen.
How did you know that when
nobody had told you
about it?
scripts.translation:
{0}
而克鲁扬，你一回到家，
就说项链被偷了。
既然没人告诉过你这件事，
你怎么会知道？

{0}
混乱的家具，
没有对窃贼吠叫的波比，
以及露恩和克鲁扬在震惊中编造的拙劣借口，
如果你顺着这些线索追查...

scripts.text:
[Cruyan]
Stop... Please stop...
I don't want to be even more miserable
than I already am...
scripts.translation:
[克鲁扬]
停...请停下来...
我不想让自己变得更惨了...

scripts.text:
[Cruyan]
Yes... I am the thief...
I won't try to 
justify that.
scripts.translation:
[克鲁扬]
是的...我就是那个小偷...
我不会试图为自己辩解。

scripts.text:
[Cruyan]
As for Luen... my girlfriend
did nothing wrong..
It's all my fault..
scripts.translation:
[克鲁扬]
至于露恩...我的女朋友
没有任何错..
一切都是我的错..

scripts.text:
[Cruyan]
The rest of this,
I'll confess and explain everything..
And I'll make my apologies...
scripts.translation:
[克鲁扬]
剩下的部分，
我会坦白并解释一切...
我会道歉...

scripts.text:
[Cruyan]
I ask you...
Please don't involve yourself any further...
scripts.translation:
[克鲁扬]
拜托你...
请不要再卷入其中了...

scripts.text:
{0}
I... I guess
I must have gotten something wrong.
I'll think about it more and figure out who the robber is...
scripts.translation:
{0}
我...我想我一定是
弄错了什么。
我会再仔细想想，
查出那个小偷是谁...

scripts.text:
[Daughter Luen]
Thank you for lightening 
our burdens...
Cruyan and I will resolve
the rest of this issue.
Would you please go outside now?
scripts.translation:
[女儿 露恩]
谢谢你帮我们减轻了负担...
我和克鲁扬会解决剩下的问题。
请你现在出去好吗？

scripts.text: Leave the house.
scripts.translation: 离开房子

scripts.text: Leave after a bit.
scripts.translation: 稍后再离开

scripts.text:
[Daughter Luen]
Thank you for everything...
scripts.translation:
[女儿 露恩]
谢谢你做的一切...

scripts.text:
[Daughter Luen]
Please let us know
when you're leaving.
scripts.translation:
[女儿 露恩]
请在你离开时
告诉我们一声。

scripts.text: [Daughter Luen]
scripts.translation: [女儿 露恩]

scripts.text:
- It's floating in mid-air
but it feels like I could
enter it -
scripts.translation:
- 它悬浮在半空中，
但感觉我可以走进去 -

scripts.text: Don't enter the residence.
scripts.translation: 不进入住宅

scripts.text: Enter the residence.
scripts.translation: 进入住宅

scripts.text: - Let's check it out later -
scripts.translation: - 我们稍后再来看看 -

scripts.text: Don't exit the residence.
scripts.translation: 不离开住宅

scripts.text: Exit the residence.
scripts.translation: 离开住宅

scripts.text: - Let's leave a bit later -
scripts.translation: - 我们稍后再离开 -

scripts.text:
[Eirinn]
Oww, my stomach hurts!!
What are you looking at?
scripts.translation:
[艾琳]
哎哟，我肚子好痛！！
你在看什么？

scripts.text:
[Eirinn]
Oww, my stomach hurts!!
Aren't Green Herbs so common?
I can't believe they're not in stock!
scripts.translation:
[艾琳]
哎哟，我肚子好痛！！
绿色药草不是很常见吗？
居然没货，真不敢相信！

scripts.text:
[Eirinn]
Hmm...I'm sure I took the right medicine...
but why isn't it getting better?
Maybe it's not just a stomachache?
Could it be that I have...
scripts.translation:
[艾琳]
嗯...我确定我吃了正确的药...
但为什么不见好？
也许不仅仅是胃痛？
难道我得了...

scripts.text:
[Eirinn]
Cecilia is so random
She already knows that I like books...
scripts.translation:
[艾琳]
塞西莉亚真随性，
她居然已经知道我喜欢看书了...

scripts.text:
[Eirinn]
Did I read any books recently?
Umm...yea, I read a lot usually.
I don't have anything else to do at the clinic.
scripts.translation:
[艾琳]
我最近有看书吗？
嗯...是的，我平时看得很多。
在诊所里我也没什么别的事可做。

scripts.text:
[Eirinn]
Is Cecilia investing something?
Right? Isn't she? Am I right? Right?
scripts.translation:
[艾琳]
塞西莉亚是不是在搞什么鬼？
对吧？不是吗？我说得对吧？对吧？

scripts.text:
[Eirinn]
Well, then...
Should I start punishing Dominic for giving a stomachache to this beautiful lady!!
scripts.translation:
[艾琳]
那么...
我要开始惩罚多米尼克了，居然让这位美丽的女士胃痛！！

scripts.text:
[Eirinn]
Are you done yet?
I'm tired of waiting~
Let's hurry it up a little more.
Pranks are not fun if you think about it too much.
scripts.translation:
[艾琳]
好了吗？
我都等烦了~
动作快一点啦。
恶作剧想太多就不好玩了。

scripts.text:
[Eirinn]
I'm all ready here.
Now, I mix what you brought like this, and...
scripts.translation:
[艾琳]
我这边都准备好了。
现在，把你带来的东西像这样混合一下，然后...

scripts.text:
[Eirinn]
Hmm? It's weird.
There's something weird about you.
scripts.translation:
[艾琳]
嗯？有点奇怪。
你身上有股奇怪的味道。

scripts.text:
[Eirinn]
Have we...have we succeeded at last?!
Now, go plant this secretly around Dominic's bookshelves.
If he finds random weeds growing near the bookshelves he'll be so mad, right?
scripts.translation:
[艾琳]
我们...我们终于成功了吗？！
现在，悄悄地把这个种在多米尼克书架周围。
如果他发现书架旁边莫名其妙长出了杂草，肯定会气疯的，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Eirinn]
Kekeke, I could hear Dominic screaming from here.
Is he really upset now?
scripts.translation:
[艾琳]
嘿嘿嘿，我都能听到多米尼克在尖叫了。
他真的很生气吗？

scripts.text:
[Eirinn]
Poor little Dominic he won't dare mess with me again.
scripts.translation:
[艾琳]
可怜的小多米尼克，他再也不敢惹我了。

scripts.text: [Eirinn]
scripts.translation: [艾琳]

scripts.text:
[Eirinn]
I haven't really eaten anything unusual these days but why am I getting stomach aches so often!
scripts.translation:
[艾琳]
我最近没吃什么奇怪的东西，为什么总是胃痛啊！

scripts.text:
[Eirinn]
I haven't really eaten anything unusual these days but why am I getting stomach aches so often!
scripts.translation:
[艾琳]
我最近没吃什么奇怪的东西，为什么总是胃痛啊！

scripts.text:
[Eirinn]
Are you still there?
Good, you came at just the right moment.
scripts.translation:
[艾琳]
你还在吗？
很好，你来得正是时候。

scripts.text:
[Eirinn]
I was going to get a perscription for my stomachache but, they don't have herbs for it in the warehouse anymore.
scripts.translation:
[艾琳]
我本来想去开个胃痛的药方，但仓库里已经没有那种药草了。

scripts.text:
[Eirinn]
Just like an old saying,
'Even green herbs are difficult to find when you need them.'
Could you go out and find herbs and things like that?
scripts.translation:
[艾琳]
就像那句老话说的，
“急需时，连绿色药草都难找。”
你能出去找找药草之类的东西吗？

scripts.text: Why should I?
scripts.translation: 为什么我要这么做？

scripts.text: Sure!
scripts.translation: 当然！

scripts.text:
[Eirinn]
Fine, then don't bother me
and go away.
scripts.translation:
[艾琳]
好吧，那就别烦我了，
快走吧。

scripts.text:
[Eirinn]
I need
^ff000010 Green Herbs^000000
I hope you hurry before Eclage is filled with the sounds of my groaning.
scripts.translation:
[艾琳]
我需要
^ff000010 绿色药草^000000
希望你在埃克拉珠充满我呻吟声之前快点回来。

scripts.text: Give Herbs
scripts.translation: 给予药草

scripts.text: Go somewhere else.
scripts.translation: 去别的地方

scripts.text:
[Eirinn]
Didn't your kindergarten teacher tell you?
'Lying is bad!'
I wonder if she said something about helping those in need, too.
scripts.translation:
[艾琳]
你的幼儿园老师没教过你吗？
“说谎是不对的！”
不知道她有没有说过要帮助有需要的人。

scripts.text:
[Eirinn]
Ah, thank you so much!
I'll prepare my medicine then.
I hope it helps...
scripts.translation:
[艾琳]
啊，太感谢你了！
那我去准备药了。
希望能有用...

scripts.text:
[Eirinn]
By the way, I was looking through the warehouse and I found some herbs. They're not for stomachaches so, I'll give you some to repay your kindness.
scripts.translation:
[艾琳]
对了，我翻仓库的时候发现了一些药草。虽然治不了胃痛，但为了报答你的好意，我送你一些吧。

scripts.text:
[Eirinn]
You can usually find them around here but it's really effective, so a lot of the adventurers like them.
scripts.translation:
[艾琳]
通常在这里都能找到，不过效果真的很好，所以很多冒险者都喜欢。

scripts.text:
[Eirinn]
Something serious? Like, something untreatable??
Am I going to be like the leading actress who plays a tragic role in a soap opera?
scripts.translation:
[艾琳]
很严重？比如，治不好的那种？？
难道我要像肥皂剧里演悲剧角色的女主角一样吗？

scripts.text:
[Eirinn]
If you remember any other stories, tell me again.
and if you remember, ask Cecilia why she asked such a question.
scripts.translation:
[艾琳]
如果你还记得其他的故事，再告诉我一遍。
如果记得的话，问问塞西莉亚为什么问这种问题。

scripts.text:
[Eirinn]
Ah, before I had this stomach ache,
I borrowed a book.
It was about where you came from and it was really interesting. But why?
scripts.translation:
[艾琳]
啊，在我胃痛之前，
我借了一本书。
那是关于你从哪来的，真的很有趣。但是为什么呢？

scripts.text:
[Eirinn]
Cecilia is so random
She already knows that I like books...
Anyway, tell her I said so.
scripts.translation:
[艾琳]
塞西莉亚真随性
她明明知道我喜欢书...
总之，替我告诉她我这么说了。

scripts.text:
[Eirinn]
Wing for wing, feeler for feeler, and trick for trick!
This is our law.
scripts.translation:
[艾琳]
翅膀对翅膀，触角对触角，诡计对诡计！
这就是我们的法则。

scripts.text:
[Eirinn]
Since Dominic takes good care of the bookshelves, should I make a mess around that area to annoy him?
scripts.translation:
[艾琳]
既然多米尼克很爱护书架，我要不要在那附近弄得一团糟来惹他生气？

scripts.text:
[Eirinn]
Okay, I've decided.
Let me ask you another favor, please?
Could you bring me a plant stem and Green Herb, one each?
I'm going to do some magic here.
scripts.translation:
[艾琳]
好的，我决定了。
请再帮我一个忙好吗？
能帮我带一根植物茎和绿色药草，各一个吗？
我要在这里施法。

scripts.text: Why should I?
scripts.translation: 为什么我要这么做？

scripts.text: Sure!
scripts.translation: 当然！

scripts.text:
[Eirinn]
Umm...I guess I can't help it if you don't want to.
I should look for someone else...
scripts.translation:
[艾琳]
嗯...如果你不愿意的话，我也没办法。
我应该去找别人...

scripts.text:
[Eirinn]
It's very simple, so it shouldn't take that long, right?
I'll be preparing here, so hurry and make a quick trip!
scripts.translation:
[艾琳]
很简单，应该不会花太长时间，对吧？
我会在准备，快去快回吧！

scripts.text:
[Eirinn]
What I need is a stem of the plant and Green Herb, one each.
scripts.translation:
[艾琳]
我需要一根植物茎和绿色药草，各一个。

scripts.text:
[Eirinn]
Ta-da~
A simple summoning tool: sprout is finished!
It's available for everyone~
scripts.translation:
[艾琳]
当当~
简单的召唤工具：嫩芽完成了！
大家都能用~

scripts.text:
[Eirinn]
Scripts written by Eirinn!
Featuring{0}!
The villain's role played by Dominic
We're all here and the props are ready!
scripts.translation:
[艾琳]
艾琳编剧！
主演{0}！
多米尼克饰演反派
大家都到齐了，道具也准备好了！

scripts.text:
[Eirinn]
Now if we plant this secretly around the bookshelves that Dominic is taking care of, our mission is completed!
If he finds random weeds growing near the bookshelves he'll be so mad, right?
scripts.translation:
[艾琳]
现在如果我们悄悄地把这个种在多米尼克照顾的书架周围，任务就完成了！
如果他在书架附近发现长出的杂草，肯定会很生气，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Eirinn]
Come on, it's no fun if you take too much time.
Let's go and do this thing!
scripts.translation:
[艾琳]
快点，花太多时间就没意思了。
我们去办这件事吧！

scripts.text:
[Eirinn]
Now, take this again and don't forget to plant it secretly around Dominic's bookshelves.
scripts.translation:
[艾琳]
现在，再把这个拿好，别忘了悄悄种在多米尼克的书架周围。

scripts.text:
[Eirinn]
Come on, it's no fun if you take too much time.
Let's go and do this thing!
scripts.translation:
[艾琳]
快点，花太多时间就没意思了。
我们去办这件事吧！

scripts.text:
[Eirinn]
Too bad I couldn't see for myself how he was creating a scene there.
I should try it again later.
scripts.translation:
[艾琳]
真可惜，我没亲眼看到他在那里大闹一场。
以后应该再试一次。

scripts.text:
[Bourbon]
How strange. I've been losing my stuff recently like things I put in my pocket or even the things I put away properly.
scripts.translation:
[波本]
真奇怪。最近我老是丢东西，比如放进口袋里的，或者明明收好的东西。

scripts.text:
[Bourbon]
Uh oh, you... didn't you promise
to give a good spanking to the little guys outside?
scripts.translation:
[波本]
哎呀，你...你不是答应过要狠狠教训外面那些小家伙吗？

scripts.text:
[Bourbon]
You'll see them right outside the door so I don't have to tell you the exact location right?
Give the 20 fairies outside what they deserve and come back, please~
scripts.translation:
[波本]
它们就在门外，不用我告诉你具体位置吧？
去把外面那20只妖精好好教训一顿，然后回来，拜托了~

scripts.text:
[Bourbon]
Hmm? You're done already?
Puhahahah!
scripts.translation:
[波本]
嗯？你已经搞定了？
噗哈哈哈哈哈！

scripts.text:
[Bourbon]
How strange...
I can't find my pen anywhere.
I've been using it pretty often...
Who would have done this to me...
scripts.translation:
[波本]
真奇怪...
我到处都找不到我的笔。
我明明经常用它...
是谁对我做了这种事...

scripts.text:
[Bourbon]
All of a sudden, people from Midgard started to visit Eclage more and more.
So, we're getting information about Midgard as well and I'm interested, too.
scripts.translation:
[波本]
突然之间，来自米德加尔特的人开始频繁造访埃克拉珠。
所以我们也在收集关于米德加尔特的情报，我也很感兴趣。

scripts.text:
[Bourbon]
Books? Well, I like books a lot.
There are many books on Midgard that just came out recently so I read them myself.
scripts.translation:
[波本]
书？嗯，我很喜欢书。
最近米德加尔特出版了很多新书，所以我自己也读了一些。

scripts.text:
[Bourbon]
Hmm...I smell it...
I smell something fun going on here...
scripts.translation:
[波本]
嗯...我闻到了...
我闻到这里有什么有趣的事情正在发生...

scripts.text:
[Bourbon]
A real gentleman should give what he has received!
I will not tolerate this.
scripts.translation:
[波本]
真正的绅士应该回报他所收到的！
我绝不容忍这种事。

scripts.text:
[Bourbon]
Wooo, I'm on fire!!
My whole body is filled with the spirit of pranks!
scripts.translation:
[波本]
哇哦，我热血沸腾了！！
我的全身都充满了恶作剧的精神！

scripts.text:
[Bourbon]
Good!
I'm ready as well.
Let's see...it's been a while since the last time I used a material conversion spell.
scripts.translation:
[波本]
很好！
我也准备好了。
让我看看...距离我上次使用物质转换魔法已经有一段时间了。

scripts.text:
[Bourbon]
No, something's weird here.
I feel like there's something wrong.
Ah, whatever! Take this anyway.
I don't want to think about it.
scripts.translation:
[波本]
不，这里有些不对劲。
我感觉有什么地方有问题。
啊，算了！反正拿着吧。
我不想再想这些了。

scripts.text:
[Bourbon]
Throw what you received in front of Dominic.
It'll become a rat and start moving around him.
scripts.translation:
[波本]
把你收到的东西扔在多米尼克面前。
它会变成一只老鼠，然后在他身边乱跑。

scripts.text:
[Bourbon]
Ahah~by the way,
What could Dominic have done about the rat?
It wouldn't come back at me like a boomerang, would it?
scripts.translation:
[波本]
啊哈~顺便问一下，
多米尼克能拿那只老鼠怎么办？
它不会像回旋镖一样飞回我身上吧？

scripts.text:
[Bourbon]
I hope he learned that I'm a step above him when it's comes to pranking, so that he won't try to mess with me again.
scripts.translation:
[波本]
我希望他明白，在恶作剧方面我比他高出一筹，这样他就不会再试图捉弄我了。

scripts.text: [Bourbon]
scripts.translation: [波本]

scripts.text:
[Bourbon]
Right, I'm sure the little pranksters outside are doing this to me.
They must have taken my stuff while I wasn't here.
scripts.translation:
[波本]
没错，肯定是外面那些小捣蛋鬼在搞鬼。
他们一定趁我不在的时候拿走了我的东西。

scripts.text:
[Bourbon]
I would like to teach them a lesson but I have a work to do and I can't go anywhere.
And if I leave for personal reasons like this I'll get in trouble.
scripts.translation:
[波本]
我想教训他们一顿，但我有工作要做，不能离开。
如果我因为这种私人原因离开，我会惹上麻烦的。

scripts.text:
[Bourbon]
So, you're here just in time!
Could you teach the little gangsters outside, a lesson on my behalf?
How does that sound, will you?
scripts.translation:
[波本]
所以，你来得正好！
你能替我教训一下外面那些小流氓吗？
怎么样，愿意吗？

scripts.text: Why should I?
scripts.translation: 为什么我要这么做？

scripts.text: Sure!
scripts.translation: 当然！

scripts.text:
[Bourbon]
Hmm, I guess I can't force you.
I should look for someone else...
scripts.translation:
[波本]
嗯，我想我也不能强迫你。
我应该找别人...

scripts.text:
[Bourbon]
Good, you promised.
Go outside and give 20 fairies what they deserve.
Then I'll feel much better.
scripts.translation:
[波本]
很好，你答应了。
去外面把那20只妖精好好教训一顿。
那样我会感觉好多了。

scripts.text:
[Bourbon]
You'll see them right outside the door so I don't have to tell you the exact location right?
Good luck~
scripts.translation:
[波本]
它们就在门外，不用我告诉你具体位置吧？
祝你好运~

scripts.text:
[Bourbon]
I think something went wrong here.
Could you talk to me again?
scripts.translation:
[波本]
我觉得这里出了点问题。
你能再和我谈谈吗？

scripts.text:
[Bourbon]
Good luck, then.
scripts.translation:
[波本]
那么，祝你好运。

scripts.text:
[Bourbon]
You need to brush off your clothes.
You have feathers all over.
Would it have been that hard...?
Hmm, it seems like you've suffered badly. Let me give you a reward.
scripts.translation:
[波本]
你得把衣服上的羽毛拍掉。
你身上全是羽毛。
这很难吗...？
嗯，看来你受了不少苦。让我给你一点奖励。

scripts.text:
[Bourbon]
Anyway, thanks.
But I feel like somebody took my pen while you were gone...who could it be...?
scripts.translation:
[波本]
总之，谢谢。
但我感觉你不在的时候有人拿走了我的笔...会是谁呢...？

scripts.text:
[Bourbon]
It doesn't seem like a perfect place to live but it definitely sounds like a fun place.
I wonder if there's any new book that came out...
I should go check.
scripts.translation:
[波本]
这里似乎不是完美的居住地，但听起来确实是个有趣的地方。
不知道有没有什么新书出版...
我应该去看看。

scripts.text:
[Bourbon]
I was interested seeing how there's a sudden influx of visitors from your village into Eclage.
It doesn't seem like a perfect place to live but it definitely sounds like a fun place.
scripts.translation:
[波本]
我很好奇，为什么突然有很多来自你村庄的人涌入埃克拉珠。
这里似乎不是完美的居住地，但听起来确实是个有趣的地方。

scripts.text:
[Bourbon]
Let's see what Dominic hates the most...
Ahah~I'm all fired up.
My name is Bourbon a real prankster from birth.
scripts.translation:
[波本]
让我看看多米尼克最讨厌什么...
啊哈~我兴奋起来了。
我叫波本，是个天生的恶作剧者。

scripts.text:
[Bourbon]
I'm sure he said he hates something small, swift, and with a long tail.
The more I think about doesn't it sound like a...rat?
scripts.translation:
[波本]
我记得他说他讨厌某种小而快、长着长尾巴的东西。
我越想越觉得，这听起来像...老鼠？

scripts.text:
[Bourbon]
Right, it's a rat. Nothing's going to stop me now.
I shall release some rats then!
scripts.translation:
[波本]
没错，是老鼠。现在没有什么能阻止我了。
我要释放一些老鼠！

scripts.text:
[Bourbon]
...but come to think of it there are no rats here, right?
Let me ask you another favor.
This is a matter of my pride. Will you help me?
scripts.translation:
[波本]
...不过仔细想想，这里没有老鼠，对吧？
让我再求你个忙。
这关乎我的尊严。你会帮我的，对吧？

scripts.text: I'd rather not...
scripts.translation: 我不想...

scripts.text: Sure!
scripts.translation: 当然！

scripts.text:
[Bourbon]
What? How could you!
Can't you hear my heart beating like a drum?
It's not reasonable if you pretend not to see and turn your back on me.
scripts.translation:
[波本]
什么？你怎么能这样！
你听不到我的心跳像鼓一样吗？
如果你假装没看见并背过身去，那是不合理的。

scripts.text:
[Bourbon]
Now that's the spirit!
You're just like me a cheeky little monkey!
scripts.translation:
[波本]
这才对嘛！
你就像我一样，是个调皮的小猴子！

scripts.text:
[Bourbon]
I'll fill you in on the details once we're done preparing and what we need right now is 2 rat tails
Obviously we don't have rats here so it might take you sometime to find one.
scripts.translation:
[波本]
等我们准备完毕，我会告诉你细节。现在我们需要2根鼠尾。
显然这里没有老鼠，所以你可能需要花点时间去找。

scripts.text:
[Bourbon]
Thanks, my friend.
Hahahahaha!
We're already in the same camp.
scripts.translation:
[波本]
谢谢，我的朋友。
哈哈哈哈！
我们已经站在同一边了。

scripts.text:
[Bourbon]
...umm?
You couldn't find any rat tails yet?
I know it's pretty hard but I'm counting on you, my friend!
scripts.translation:
[波本]
...嗯？
你还没找到鼠尾吗？
我知道这很难，但我指望你了，我的朋友！

scripts.text:
[Bourbon]
You see, this is just a small tail right now but it'll be a great...
well, it's just a rat and not a 'great' rat after all but still, with a mysterious power
scripts.translation:
[波本]
你看，现在这只是个小尾巴，但它会成为很棒的...
嗯，毕竟它只是一只老鼠，不是一只“伟大”的老鼠，但依然拥有神秘的力量。

scripts.text:
[Bourbon]
Shazam! The spell is now done.
Throw what you received next to Dominic!
It'll become a rat and start moving around him.
This completes our 'mission'!
scripts.translation:
[波本]
沙扎姆！咒语完成了。
把你收到的东西扔在多米尼克旁边！
它会变成一只老鼠，并开始在他周围走动。
这就完成了我们的“任务”！

scripts.text:
[Bourbon]
hehehe...
I'm soooo excited.
What are you doing? Go!
scripts.translation:
[波本]
嘿嘿嘿...
我太兴奋了。
你在干什么？快去吧！

scripts.text:
[Bourbon]
Throw this in front of Dominic.
It'll become a rat and start moving around him.
scripts.translation:
[波本]
把这个扔在多米尼克面前。
它会变成一只老鼠，并开始在他周围走动。

scripts.text:
[Bourbon]
hehehe....
I'm soooo excited.
What are you doing? Go!
scripts.translation:
[波本]
嘿嘿嘿...
我太兴奋了。
你在干什么？快去吧！

scripts.text:
[Bourbon]
I'm sure Dominic couldn't have movednot even a finger.
scripts.translation:
[波本]
我敢打赌，多米尼克连一根手指头都动不了。

scripts.text:
[Bourbon]
I hope he learned that I'm a step above him when it's comes to pranking, so that he won't try to mess with me again.
scripts.translation:
[波本]
我希望他明白，在恶作剧方面我比他高出一筹，这样他就不会再试图捉弄我了。

scripts.text:
[Cecilia]
Mm...mm... what should I do...
scripts.translation:
[塞西莉亚]
嗯...嗯...我该怎么办...

scripts.text: - She seems too busy to talk to you. -
scripts.translation: - 她似乎太忙了，没空和你说话。 -

scripts.text:
[Cecilia]
Mm...mm...
scripts.translation:
[塞西莉亚]
嗯...嗯...

scripts.text:
[Cecilia]
What should I do?
No matter how many times I check some items are missing...
Is it because of the wanderers randomly showing up in town nowadays?
scripts.translation:
[塞西莉亚]
我该怎么办？
不管检查多少次，总有些物品不见了...
是因为最近经常有浪姬舞者随机出现在镇上吗？

scripts.text:
[Cecilia]
Hey~ hey~ listen!
Hey you, what are you doing over there?
You heard everything I said just now didn't you?
scripts.translation:
[塞西莉亚]
嘿~ 嘿~ 听着！
喂，你在那边干什么呢？
刚才我说的话你都听到了吧？

scripts.text:
[Cecilia]
It can't be that we have thieves in Eclage.
The more I think about it seems like an outsider is responsible for this.
Don't you think?
scripts.translation:
[塞西莉亚]
不可能是在埃克拉珠出现了盗贼。
越想越觉得是外人在搞鬼。
你不觉得吗？

scripts.text:
[Cecilia]
For that reason you, who knows that our supplies are missing and who happens to be an outsider as well.
Must be a thief!
scripts.translation:
[塞西莉亚]
因此，你，一个知道我们物资丢失且恰好是外人的家伙。
一定是盗贼！

scripts.text:
[Cecilia]
You have the right to have an attorney present and... no, never mind.
Let's hear what you have to say after putting you in prison first.
Here, you're accused of stealing how do you feel now?
scripts.translation:
[塞西莉亚]
你有权要求律师在场... 不，算了。
先把你关进监狱，再听听你有什么要说的。
喂，你被指控偷窃，现在感觉如何？

scripts.text:
[Cecilia]
You see, we suffer an unforeseen misfortune in life sometimes.
We're all like that.
scripts.translation:
[塞西莉亚]
你看，生活中难免会遇到意想不到的不幸。
大家都一样。

scripts.text: [Cecilia]
scripts.translation: [塞西莉亚]

scripts.text:
[Cecilia]
Oh, you want to exercise your right and just remain silent?
Let's see how long you can hold your tongue!
I have an idea. Do you want to hear about it?
scripts.translation:
[塞西莉亚]
哦，你想行使权利保持沉默？
让我看看你能憋多久！
我有个主意。想听听吗？

scripts.text: What are you doing?
scripts.translation: 你在做什么？

scripts.text:
[Cecilia]
Here's your last chance!
It's something that could save both of us.
You want to hear about it?
scripts.translation:
[塞西莉亚]
这是你最后的机会！
这是能救我们俩的事。
你想听听吗？

scripts.text: I don't want to!
scripts.translation: 我不想听！

scripts.text: Fine.
scripts.translation: 好的。

scripts.text:
[Cecilia]
Oh, well!
Then I'll have to hand you over to prove my innocence.
scripts.translation:
[塞西莉亚]
哦，好吧！
那我只能把你交出去，以证明我的清白。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
(What kind of a fairy is this, so immoral?!)
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
（这是什么妖精，这么不道德?!）

scripts.text:
[Cecilia]
Now, should I start to plant evidence on you?
You just need three fairies to make up anything even if it's the Yggdrasil Tree.
scripts.translation:
[塞西莉亚]
现在，我该开始在你身上栽赃了吗？
只要三个妖精，哪怕是世界树也能编出来。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
(Maybe I should just run away.)
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
（也许我该直接逃跑。）

scripts.text:
[Cecilia]
There's a simple and ordinary solution for this.
scripts.translation:
[塞西莉亚]
解决这个问题有一个简单又普通的方法。

scripts.text:
[Cecilia]
That is you finding what's missing and refilling the shelves.
I can't go anywhere because I have to look after the warehouse.
It's better to take some trouble than being accused of stealing, isn't it?
scripts.translation:
[塞西莉亚]
你要做的就是找出缺失的物品，并把货架补满。
我得看着仓库，不能离开。
与其被指控偷窃，不如多费点手脚，不是吗？

scripts.text:
[Cecilia]
Let me tell you what you need to find.
First of all, ^66000010 Piles of Acorns^000000, ^66000010 Worn Out Pages^000000, and lastly, ^66000010 Mould Powders^000000.
It's strange how 10 of each item are missing exactly...
scripts.translation:
[塞西莉亚]
让我告诉你需要找什么。
首先，^66000010堆橡果^000000、^66000010页破旧的书页^000000，最后是^66000010霉菌粉末^000000。
奇怪的是，每种物品恰好都少了10个...

scripts.text:
[Cecilia]
We're in the same boatnow.
Technically, we call it 'accomplices'.
Now, good luck!
You'll be able to find them easily around here.
scripts.translation:
[塞西莉亚]
我们现在是一条船上的蚂蚱了。
严格来说，这叫“共犯”。
那么，祝你好运！
你应该能在附近很容易找到它们。

scripts.text:
[Cecilia]
You didn't get caught, right?
Let's see what you have then...
scripts.translation:
[塞西莉亚]
你没被抓到吧？
让我看看你带了什么...

scripts.text:
[Cecilia]
It's still not enough...
You didn't forget what I asked for, did you?
scripts.translation:
[塞西莉亚]
还是不够...
你没忘记我让你找什么吧？

scripts.text:
[Cecilia]
You're more skilled than I thought.
Everything is as written in the books now.
So, we're both safe.
scripts.translation:
[塞西莉亚]
你比我想象的更熟练。
现在一切都和账本上写的一样了。
所以，我们都安全了。

scripts.text:
[Cecilia]
You need to find Piles of Acorns, Worn Out Pages, and Mould Powders, 10 of each.
Don't forget this time.
scripts.translation:
[塞西莉亚]
你需要找10堆橡果、10页破旧的书页和10份霉菌粉末。
这次别再忘了。

scripts.text:
[Cecilia]
When you come back again you'd better be bringing everything we need.
If they find out that some items are missing, then...
No, I don't want to think about it.
scripts.translation:
[塞西莉亚]
下次回来时，最好把所有需要的东西都带齐。
如果他们发现有些物品不见了，那么...
不，我不想往那方面想。

scripts.text:
[Cecilia]
We're in this together so I don't have to thank you, right?
scripts.translation:
[塞西莉亚]
既然我们是一条船上的，我就不必谢你了，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Cecilia]
I'll go check if there's anything else missing as well.
It's so strange how these missing items were all very trivial.
Besides, exactly 10 of each item were stolen.
I feel like this is more than just a theft.
scripts.translation:
[塞西莉亚]
我去检查一下是否还有其他东西缺失。
奇怪的是，这些丢失的物品都很琐碎。
而且，每种物品恰好都少了10个。
我觉得这不仅仅是偷窃那么简单。

scripts.text:
[Cecilia]
How strange...
I'm sure I organized everything but why is it so messy here.
Could it be that someone really hates me...?
scripts.translation:
[塞西莉亚]
真奇怪...
我明明整理过一切，为什么这里这么乱。
难道真的有人很讨厌我吗...？

scripts.text:
[Cecilia]
Oh, by the way,
I heard you met Eirinn and Bourbon.
scripts.translation:
[塞西莉亚]
哦，对了，
我听说你遇到了艾琳和波本。

scripts.text:
[Cecilia]
I heard Eirinn has a stomachache and I also heard that you helped Bourbon find lost items.
scripts.translation:
[塞西莉亚]
我听说艾琳胃痛，还听说你帮波本找到了丢失的物品。

scripts.text: - Cecilia seems to be lost in deep thought -
scripts.translation: - 塞西莉亚似乎陷入了沉思 -

scripts.text:
[Cecilia]
If things that have never happened before happened, then there's something new going on.
scripts.translation:
[塞西莉亚]
如果以前从未发生过的事情发生了，那就说明有新情况。

scripts.text:
[Cecilia]
Now, shall we go find out what it is?
This time, it's not a theft, of course.
scripts.translation:
[塞西莉亚]
那么，我们要去弄清楚那是什么吗？
当然，这次不是偷窃。

scripts.text:
[Cecilia]
Could you go ask Eirinn and Bourbon about reading books?
Ask them if they have borrowed or read any books recently.
scripts.translation:
[塞西莉亚]
你能去问问艾琳和波本关于读书的事吗？
问问他们最近是否借过或读过什么书。

scripts.text:
[Cecilia]
Could you go ask Eirinn and Bourbon about reading books?
Ask them if they have borrowed or read any books recently.
scripts.translation:
[塞西莉亚]
你能去问问艾琳和波本关于读书的事吗？
问问他们最近是否借过或读过什么书。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I met both of them.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我两个都遇到了。

scripts.text: ^000088You tellCecilia what Eirinn and Bourbon said.^000000
scripts.translation: ^000088你告诉塞西莉亚艾琳和波本说了什么。^000000

scripts.text:
[Cecilia]
Mmm, I see.
scripts.translation:
[塞西莉亚]
嗯，我明白了。

scripts.text:
[Cecilia]
So, they have recently borrowed and read books, too?
Good, this solves the mystery!
scripts.translation:
[塞西莉亚]
所以，他们最近也借书并阅读了吗？
很好，这就解开了谜团！

scripts.text:
[Cecilia]
I borrowed some books as well to learn about people from Midgard since there are so many visitors coming from that area lately.
scripts.translation:
[塞西莉亚]
我也借了一些书，因为最近有很多来自米德加尔特的访客，我想了解一下那里的人。

scripts.text:
[Cecilia]
Eirinn, Bourbon, and I have one thing in common.
That is, we all read books recently.
But I don't understand why that brought bad luck to all three of us.
scripts.translation:
[塞西莉亚]
艾琳、波本和我有一个共同点。
那就是我们最近都读了书。
但我不明白为什么这给三个人都带来了厄运。

scripts.text:
[Cecilia]
I have a feeling that Dominic might know something.
He might know...or...
scripts.translation:
[塞西莉亚]
我有一种感觉，多米尼克可能知道些什么。
他可能知道...或者...

scripts.text:
[Cecilia]
Eirinn, Bourbon, and I have one thing in common.
That is, we all read books recently.
But I don't understand why that brought bad luck to all three of us.
scripts.translation:
[塞西莉亚]
艾琳、波本和我有一个共同点。
那就是我们最近都读了书。
但我不明白为什么这给三个人都带来了厄运。

scripts.text:
[Cecilia]
Oh, did you visit Dominic by any chance?
Dominic takes care of the bookshelves and I feel like he might know something.
scripts.translation:
[塞西莉亚]
哦，你碰巧去见过多米尼克了吗？
多米尼克负责管理书架，我觉得他可能知道些什么。

scripts.text:
[Cecilia]
Oh, and as the manager of the warehouse let me give you something in return.
You found lost items and helped here and there...so, think of it as a reward.
scripts.translation:
[塞西莉亚]
哦，作为仓库管理员，让我给你一些回报吧。
你找回了失物，又在这里帮忙...就当作是奖励吧。

scripts.text:
[Cecilia]
You'll be able to read as many books as you want from the bookshelves in the plaza.
scripts.translation:
[塞西莉亚]
你可以随意阅读广场上书架里的任何书籍。

scripts.text: [Cecilia]
scripts.translation: [塞西莉亚]

scripts.text:
[Cecilia]
I have a feeling that Dominic might know something.
He might know...or...
scripts.translation:
[塞西莉亚]
我有一种感觉，多米尼克可能知道些什么。
他可能知道...或者...

scripts.text: Tell Cecilia about Dominic.
scripts.translation: 告诉塞西莉亚关于多米尼克的事

scripts.text:
[Cecilia]
So I was right.
It was somebody's prank.
Dominic has always been like that so petty and strange.
scripts.translation:
[塞西莉亚]
所以我猜对了。
这是某人的恶作剧。
多米尼克一直都很小气且古怪。

scripts.text:
[Cecilia]
I hope you don't misunderstand us.
Most of the residents in Eclage;
No, an absolute majority of the residents here are never against outsiders.
scripts.translation:
[塞西莉亚]
希望你们不要误会我们。
埃克拉珠的大多数居民；
不，这里的绝大多数居民都从不排斥外来者。

scripts.text:
[Cecilia]
It's just Dominic who's acting very weirdly so I hope you don't have a prejudice against us.
scripts.translation:
[塞西莉亚]
只是多米尼克表现得非常奇怪，希望你们不要因此对我们产生偏见。

scripts.text:
[Cecilia]
Anyway, now that I found out about it,
I shouldn't just sit silently!
scripts.translation:
[塞西莉亚]
总之，既然我已经查明了真相，
我就不应该只是沉默地坐在这里！

scripts.text:
[Cecilia]
Let's start planning for revenge, shall we?
I'll give Eirinn and Bourbon notice in advance.
You should go talk to them.
scripts.translation:
[塞西莉亚]
让我们开始计划复仇吧？
我会提前通知艾琳和波本。
你应该去和他们谈谈。

scripts.text:
[Cecilia]
I'll get permission from above so that you can read any books from the bookshelves that Dominic is in charge of.
scripts.translation:
[塞西莉亚]
我会向上面申请许可，让你可以阅读多米尼克负责的那些书架上的任何书籍。

scripts.text:
[Cecilia]
It's about where you came from and I'm sure you'll like it.
If your perspective on something changes, the way you evaluate that object changes as well.
Explore Midgard from our perspective~!
scripts.translation:
[塞西莉亚]
这是关于你来自哪里的内容，我相信你会喜欢的。
如果你对某事物的看法改变了，你评价该事物的方式也会随之改变。
从我们的视角来探索米德加尔特吧~！

scripts.text:
[Cecilia]
Hope you have a good time in Eclage.
I have to take inventory now,
so I can't talk to you anymore, sorry~
scripts.translation:
[塞西莉亚]
祝你在埃克拉珠玩得开心。
我现在必须去盘点库存了，
所以不能再和你多聊了，抱歉~

scripts.text:
[Dominic]
Mmm...what do you want?
I won't stop you from walking around in Eclage but I hope you don't bother me.
scripts.translation:
[多米尼克]
嗯...你想要什么？
我不会阻止你在埃克拉珠四处走动，但希望你不要打扰我。

scripts.text:
[Dominic]
I won't stop you from walking around in Eclage but, don't bother me you outsider!
scripts.translation:
[多米尼克]
我不会阻止你在埃克拉珠四处走动，但别打扰我，你这个外来者！

scripts.text:
[Dominic]
Bah, tell them if you want to!
I'm not scared at all.
They should know how scary I can be.
scripts.translation:
[多米尼克]
哼，你想告诉他们就告诉他们吧！
我一点都不害怕。
他们应该知道我可以有多可怕。

scripts.text:
[Dominic]
I feel...something's not right.
I feel like something bad is going to happen any minute...
scripts.translation:
[多米尼克]
我总觉得...有什么不对劲。
感觉随时都会有坏事发生...

scripts.text: Cecilia says...
scripts.translation: 塞西莉亚说...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Cecilia told me that someone's fooling around with people who borrowed books recently.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
塞西莉亚告诉我，最近有人在恶作剧，针对那些借阅书籍的人。

scripts.text:
[Dominic]
Huh? Kekeke.
In principle, people living here in the capital of Eclage are not supposed to discriminate against outsiders, but not everyone is like that.
scripts.translation:
[多米尼克]
哈？呵呵呵。
原则上，住在埃克拉珠首都的人不应该歧视外来者，但也不是每个人都这样。

scripts.text:
[Dominic]
I hate it so much when people in Eclage are talking about Midgard.
Why are they so fascinated about foreign areas when this place is perfect and peaceful.
scripts.translation:
[多米尼克]
我真的很讨厌埃克拉珠的人谈论米德加尔特。
既然这里如此完美和平，他们为什么对外地那么着迷呢。

scripts.text:
[Dominic]
I don't like fairies here writing about Midgard nowadays and I hate how those books are distributed far and wide.
So, I decided to play a little trick on them.
scripts.translation:
[多米尼克]
我不喜欢这里的精灵最近写关于米德加尔特的内容，更讨厌那些书被广泛传播。
所以，我决定给他们一点小小的恶作剧。

scripts.text:
[Dominic]
Bah, tell them if you want to!
I'm not scared at all.
They should know how scary I can be.
scripts.translation:
[多米尼克]
哼，你想告诉他们就告诉他们吧！
我一点都不害怕。
他们应该知道我可以有多可怕。

scripts.text: - Do you want to throw the rat tail? -
scripts.translation: - 你要扔出鼠尾吗？ -

scripts.text: No.
scripts.translation: 不。

scripts.text: Yes.
scripts.translation: 是的

scripts.text: - The rat tail became a rat even before hitting the ground. -
scripts.translation: - 鼠尾在落地前变成了一只老鼠。 -

scripts.text:
[Dominic]
What, where did it come from out of the blue!
I'm sure people from Midgard brought it here!
You little filthy thing, ah!
scripts.translation:
[多米尼克]
什么，这东西哪来的！
肯定是米德加尔特的人带来的！
你这肮脏的小东西，啊！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
(His reaction is not that fun.)
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
（他的反应并不怎么有趣。）

scripts.text: - You were told to plant weeds. -
scripts.translation: - 你被要求种植杂草。 -

scripts.text: Don't do it.
scripts.translation: 我不做

scripts.text: Do it.
scripts.translation: 开始吧。

scripts.text: - Plant weeds secretly . -
scripts.translation: - 偷偷种植杂草。 -

scripts.text:
[Dominic]
Hey, what are you doing over there?
You'd better not be doing anything weird.
scripts.translation:
[多米尼克]
嘿，你在那边干什么？
最好别做什么奇怪的事。

scripts.text:
[Dominic]
Mmm...what the...
Why are weeds growing here?
scripts.translation:
[多米尼克]
嗯...这什么...
为什么这里会长出杂草？

scripts.text:
[Dominic]
Well, I don't care.
I guess there's no such thing as 'weeds.' Every plant is special in its own way.
scripts.translation:
[多米尼克]
好吧，我不在乎。
我想不存在所谓的“杂草”。每株植物都有其独特之处。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
(What's up with his reaction?)
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
（他的反应是怎么回事？）

scripts.text: - I saw a book and stretched my hand out to reach for it. I think it's about Midgard. -
scripts.translation: - 我看到一本书，伸手去拿。我想那是关于米德加尔特的内容。 -

scripts.text:
[Dominic]
Hey, outsider who said you can touch my books?
Stay away from my bookshelves!
scripts.translation:
[多米尼克]
嘿，外来者，谁让你碰我的书了？
离我的书架远点！

scripts.text: - I saw a book and stretched my hand out to reach for it. I think it's about cities in Rune-Midgarts. -
scripts.translation: - 我看到一本书，伸手去拿。我想那是关于卢恩·米德加兹城市的内容。 -

scripts.text: Stay away from the bookshelves.
scripts.translation: 离书架远点

scripts.text: Check out the bookshelves.
scripts.translation: 看看书架上的书

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I shouldn't read it.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我不该读它的。

scripts.text: Prontera, the capital of Rune-Midgarts, is filled with beautiful buildings that were thoroughly designed.
scripts.translation: 普隆德拉是卢恩·米德加兹的首都，这里充满了设计精美的宏伟建筑。

scripts.text: Here, they have a leader called 'king,' who used to arrange marriages.
scripts.translation: 这里有一位被称为“国王”的首领，过去曾负责安排婚姻。

scripts.text: There are many arenas, in which warriors race and wrestle to compete with each other.
scripts.translation: 这里有许多竞技场，战士们在那里赛跑和摔跤，互相竞争。

scripts.text: The group of winners are supposedly to get some kind of rewards, but seems like it lost its popularity nowadays.
scripts.translation: 据说获胜者会获得某种奖励，但如今似乎已经不再流行了。

scripts.text: You need to be careful because there are some people in Prontera with superhuman powers.
scripts.translation: 你需要小心，因为普隆德拉有一些拥有超能力的人。

scripts.text: They're able to destroy any type of weapons or armors with a few punches, and what they use for that is just a small hammer.
scripts.translation: 他们能用几拳摧毁任何类型的武器或盔甲，而他们使用的工具只是一把小锤子。

scripts.text: I don't understand why adventurers keep laying tools at their feet. Could it be that they're priests and people are offering a tribute to them?
scripts.translation: 我不明白为什么冒险者总是把工具放在脚边。难道他们是牧师，人们是在向他们供奉吗？

scripts.text: There's a village called Payon in the forest. It has a place called 'Palace' as well, although its purpose is unclear.
scripts.translation: 在普勒斯特森林里有一个叫斐扬的村庄。那里也有一个被称为“宫殿”的地方，虽然其用途不明。

scripts.text: Maybe it's a place used before Prontera became the capital of Rune-Midgarts...
scripts.translation: 也许那是普隆德拉成为卢恩·米德加兹首都之前使用的地方...

scripts.text: Humans, too, establish border towns close to the boundary of their residential area, and the city of Aldebaran is one of them.
scripts.translation: 人类也会在居住区边界附近建立边境城镇，阿尔贝塔就是其中之一。

scripts.text: In the middle of the village, there are clock-shaped monsters living in a clock tower. Further investigation is needed to find out why monsters appear in the middle of the village.
scripts.translation: 在村庄中央，有一座钟楼，里面住着钟形的魔物。需要进一步调查为什么魔物会出现在村庄中央。

scripts.text: Although it's called a clock tower, there are more monsters inside than clocks. I personally count them my self, I really did!
scripts.translation: 虽然叫钟楼，但里面的魔物比钟还多。我亲自数过，真的！

scripts.text: Geffen, a city built by great wizards, is characterized by Tower of Wizards in the middle of the city.
scripts.translation: 吉芬是由伟大的巫师建造的城市，其特点是城市中央有一座巫师塔。

scripts.text: Come to think of it, there's a fountain in the center of Prontera, a clock tower in Aldebaran, and a tower in Geffen as well.
scripts.translation: 仔细想想，普隆德拉中央有一个喷泉，阿尔贝塔有一座钟楼，吉芬也有一座塔。

scripts.text: Maybe human's urban planning is based on symmetry or circular placement. I think it's less sophisticated.
scripts.translation: 也许人类的城市规划基于对称或圆形布局。我觉得这不够精致。

scripts.text: Izlude is a port city and is the gateway to Prontera. Since humans can't fly, they travel in big boxes.
scripts.translation: 依斯鲁得岛是一个港口城市，是通往普隆德拉的门户。既然人类不会飞，他们就在大箱子里旅行。

scripts.text: I'm sure they think that big boxes made a great contribution to their civilization...but is it true?
scripts.translation: 我确信他们认为这些大箱子对他们的文明做出了巨大贡献...但这是真的吗？

scripts.text: Alberta is a place that people of Rune-Midgarts visit when they need to travel to other countries.
scripts.translation: 艾尔贝塔是卢恩·米德加兹的人们需要前往其他国家时访问的地方。

scripts.text: There are many ships--a moving box that floats on water--ready and people travel on them.
scripts.translation: 有许多船只——一种漂浮在水面上的移动箱子——随时待命，人们乘坐它们旅行。

scripts.text: Seriously, human capability is...so disappointing. If they're wise enough, they'll use Warp-portal.
scripts.translation: 说真的，人类的能力真是...令人失望。如果他们足够聪明，就会使用传送门。

scripts.text: Morocc Village is known to be a place where Morocc, the king of demons, rests.
scripts.translation: 莫洛村以是恶魔之王莫洛歇息之地而闻名。

scripts.text: Making waterways and lakes in the barren inhospitable desert...what an exceptional piece of work for humans.
scripts.translation: 在贫瘠荒凉的沙漠中开凿水道和湖泊...这对人类来说真是非凡的杰作。

scripts.text: I think it's a very peaceful place...at least until monsters appear in the buildings where their leader is burried.
scripts.translation: 我觉得那里非常宁静...至少直到魔物出现在埋葬他们首领的建筑里之前。

scripts.text: There is the sea in the east of Rune-Midgarts, a desert in the south, forest and vegetation in the middle, and mountains in the north.
scripts.translation: 卢恩·米德加兹的东部是海洋，南部是沙漠，中部是森林和植被，北部是山脉。

scripts.text: If you ask children to draw a world, wouldn't they draw it like this?
scripts.translation: 如果你让小孩子画一个世界，他们不会画成这样吗？

scripts.text: However, it's not an ideal place nor is it a great place to live.
scripts.translation: 然而，它既不是理想之地，也不是伟大的居住地。

scripts.text: - I saw a book and stretched my hand out to reach for it. I think it's about cities in Rune-Midgarts. -
scripts.translation: - 我看到一本书，伸手去拿。我想那是关于卢恩·米德加兹城市的内容。 -

scripts.text: Stay away from the bookshelves.
scripts.translation: 离书架远点

scripts.text: Check out the bookshelves.
scripts.translation: 看看书架上的书

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I shouldn't read it.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我不该读它的。

scripts.text: Humans often find great joy in venturing their lives in uncertain future.
scripts.translation: 人类常常在冒着生命危险探索不确定的未来时，找到巨大的快乐。

scripts.text: Comodo is a place for people who gamble with their future for something called 'fortune.' It seems irrelevant to ruling the kingdom though.
scripts.translation: 克魔岛是那些为了所谓的“运气”而赌上未来之人的地方。这似乎与统治王国无关。

scripts.text: Unidentifiable groups such as 'Female and Foot Volleyball' and 'Play Ranking Committee' got rid of games in that city.
scripts.translation: 像“女性与脚排球”和“游戏排名委员会”这样的不明组织，取消了该城市的比赛。

scripts.text: Comodo was known to be a beach city filled with pleasure, and it used to be a place where you could find all sorts of entertainment. But I can't really say if it's still like that.
scripts.translation: 克魔岛曾以充满欢乐的海滨城市而闻名，过去是寻找各种娱乐的地方。但我无法确定现在是否依然如此。

scripts.text: There's a female priest, who is admired by the people of the village, and there seems to be good reasons for her existence.
scripts.translation: 那里有一位女性牧师，受到村民的敬仰，她似乎有存在的正当理由。

scripts.text: People bring her diamonds as a tribute, and she gives them gods' gifts in return. Although it seems like you have to be pretty lucky to receive it...
scripts.translation: 人们向她献上钻石作为贡品，她则回赠神明的礼物。不过，似乎需要相当幸运才能收到...

scripts.text: First of all, I would like to start this book by expressing my respect to the challenging spirit of humans.
scripts.translation: 首先，我想在这本书的开头表达对人类挑战精神的敬意。

scripts.text: In Umbala, where a gigantic tree forms a village, there are people who challenge themselves to jump off from tall trees for various reasons.
scripts.translation: 在汶巴拉，一棵巨大的树形成了一个村庄，那里有人出于各种原因挑战自己从高大的树上跳下来。

scripts.text: It's kind of strange if you think about it. I thought jumping off from a tree was a type of coming-of-age ceremony for human males. I can't believe there's another reason for it.
scripts.translation: 仔细想想，这有点奇怪。我以为从树上跳下来是人类男性的成年礼。我无法相信还有其他原因。

scripts.text: Comodo is the only village in the southern part of this continent.
scripts.translation: 克魔岛是这个大陆南部唯一的村庄。

scripts.text: Then, what is Paros Lighthouse for?
scripts.translation: 那么，帕罗斯灯塔是做什么用的？

scripts.text: Further investigation is delayed because only a sailor is stationed in that area currently and I couldn't find any evidence to suggest that a political or social organization is involved in that area.
scripts.translation: 由于目前该区域只有一名水手驻守，且未找到任何证据表明有政治或社会组织参与其中，进一步的调查被推迟了。

scripts.text: You can get to an island called Bahia by boat, and you can find an underground cave there.
scripts.translation: 乘船可以到达一座名为巴伊亚的岛屿，那里有一座地下洞穴。

scripts.text: The existence of such a deep and long cave in an island is a geographical mystery!
scripts.translation: 在岛屿上存在如此深邃且漫长的洞穴，是一个地理学上的谜团！

scripts.text: Moreover, would any scholar be able to explain how humans here can breathe without gills in a place filled with water?
scripts.translation: 而且，有哪位学者能解释这里的人类为何在没有鳃的情况下，还能在充满水的地方呼吸呢？

scripts.text: Prontera is a big city, so ensuring the stable supply of resources is very important.
scripts.translation: 普隆德拉是一座大城市，因此确保资源的稳定供应至关重要。

scripts.text: Especially, the supply of water resources is important for humans are vulnerable and they can't survive even for 30 days without water.
scripts.translation: 尤其是水资源的供应，因为人类很脆弱，没有水连30天都活不下去。

scripts.text: Therefore, they built a huge building that looks like a water and sewer facility...
scripts.translation: 因此，他们建造了一座看起来像水利和排污设施的巨大建筑...

scripts.text: But why can't I find the entrance inside the city? Is it a structural problem? Or is it for security?
scripts.translation: 但我为什么找不到城市内部的入口呢？是结构问题？还是出于安全考虑？

scripts.text: Glast Heim, the ruins of what was once a great castle.
scripts.translation: 格拉斯特海姆，曾经是一座宏伟城堡的废墟。

scripts.text: Soon, they're going to reveal what have happened here and the story behind it. So, let's focus on the development of the situation.
scripts.translation: 很快，这里发生的一切及其背后的故事就会揭晓。所以，让我们关注事态的发展吧。

scripts.text: Anyway, there are a number of monsters living together in more than 10 regions; all in the upper and lower parts of Glast Heim.
scripts.translation: 总之，有超过10个区域，许多魔物共同生活在格拉斯特海姆的上下两部分。

scripts.text: More detailed geographic information on this region is...so limited that I want to just grab any urban engineer by the collar and start asking.
scripts.translation: 关于这个地区的详细地理信息...太有限了，我真想抓住任何一位城市工程师的衣领开始质问。

scripts.text: Although human civilization is advanced enough to establish a country, humans are not accumulating knowledge but merely shifting their focus from one to another,
scripts.translation: 虽然人类文明已经先进到足以建立国家，但他们并没有积累知识，只是将注意力从一个领域转移到另一个领域，

scripts.text: and it seems like they're no longer able to differentiate a certain tree or grass from another.
scripts.translation: 而且他们似乎已经无法分辨某棵树或某株草与其他有什么不同。

scripts.text: Otherwise, they wouldn't have named this well-organized forest as 'the mysterious forest.' I can't believe they gave such a strange name to this forest just because they can't find their way out.
scripts.translation: 否则，他们不会把这片井然有序的森林命名为“神秘森林”。我无法相信他们仅仅因为找不到出口，就给这片森林起了这么奇怪的名字。

scripts.text: They might have believed that language is an exclusive possession of human. But I'm sure they changed their mind after meeting us, the fairies.
scripts.translation: 他们可能曾认为语言是人类独有的。但我很确定，在遇见我们精灵之后，他们改变了想法。

scripts.text: However, they're not surprised to see that some cats, much bigger in size than normal ones, are living in a socialized society and are able to communicate with humans.
scripts.translation: 然而，看到一些体型比普通猫大得多的猫，生活在社会化的群体中并能与人类交流，他们并不感到惊讶。

scripts.text: There's something I don't know. Should I reveal the truth?
scripts.translation: 有些我不知道的事情。我应该揭露真相吗？

scripts.text: Breaking News: Thoughts on a secret place.
scripts.translation: 突发新闻：关于一个秘密地点的思考。

scripts.text: There is constant exploitation and harassment going on in a monastery, not far from Prontera.
scripts.translation: 在距离普隆德拉不远的修道院，存在着持续的剥削和骚扰行为。

scripts.text: They lure people who attempt to walk in god's way and make them gather mushrooms or run long distances...why is this acceptable!
scripts.translation: 他们诱骗那些试图行善的人，让他们去采蘑菇或跑长距离...这怎么能被接受！

scripts.text: - I saw a book and stretched my hand out to reach for it. I think it's about the northern parts of Midgard. -
scripts.translation: - 我看到一本书，便伸手去拿。我想，那大概是关于米德加尔特北部地区的。-

scripts.text: Stay away from the bookshelves.
scripts.translation: 离书架远点

scripts.text: Check out the bookshelves.
scripts.translation: 看看书架上的书

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I shouldn't read it.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我不该读它的。

scripts.text: Humans continued to float big boxes on water and the sea, and finally, they began to use the sky.
scripts.translation: 人类继续让巨大的箱子漂浮在水面和海洋上，最终，他们开始利用天空。

scripts.text: Where are they going next? Underground? Or are they going to transcend time and space?
scripts.translation: 他们下一步要去哪里？地下？还是说他们要超越时间和空间？

scripts.text: At this rate, people will be willing to travel to the past. Human's technological advancements require attention.
scripts.translation: 照这个速度发展下去，人们甚至愿意穿越回过去。人类的科技进步值得警惕。

scripts.text: Einbroch is filled with machines. They don't seem to manufacture a lot of industrial goods, but machines are their weapons definitely.
scripts.translation: 艾音布罗克充满了机器。他们似乎并没有生产大量的工业品，但机器绝对是他们的武器。

scripts.text: What are those numerous factories producing, and for what are people working?
scripts.translation: 那些众多的工厂在生产什么？人们又是在为什么而工作？

scripts.text: Don't they know that civilization development doesn't necessarily improve the value of life?
scripts.translation: 他们难道不知道，文明的发展并不一定能提升生命的价值吗？

scripts.text: If you take a train in Einbroch, you can get to a village called Einbech.
scripts.translation: 如果在艾音布罗克乘坐火车，就能到达一个叫艾音贝赫的村庄。

scripts.text: Of course I hate this form of transportation (smells like iron too much), but it's a useful for humans because of its cheap price and transport capacity.
scripts.translation: 当然，我讨厌这种交通工具（铁锈味太重了），但因为它价格便宜且载货量大，对人类来说非常实用。

scripts.text: By the way, don't they have enough materials to make railroad tracks? When will they make extensions to the train routes?
scripts.translation: 顺便问一下，他们难道没有足够的材料来铺设铁轨吗？什么时候才能延长火车线路呢？

scripts.text: Hugel, a small rural village, is like Comodo of southern region.
scripts.translation: 毁葛，一个小小的乡村，就像南方的克魔岛一样。

scripts.text: There are a variety of mini games and the landscape is very idyllic as well.
scripts.translation: 那里有各种各样的小游戏，风景也非常田园诗意。

scripts.text: But aren't those entertainment facilities supposed to be in the center of a country?
scripts.translation: 但是，这些娱乐设施不应该建在国家的中心吗？

scripts.text: A city called Juno is even floating in the sky! How incredible is this.
scripts.translation: 甚至有一个叫朱诺的城市漂浮在天空中！这简直太不可思议了。

scripts.text: And there is a special reward for those who escape the maze: there is a place where rebirth is given.
scripts.translation: 而且，对于逃出迷宫的人还有特别的奖励：那里有一个可以重生的地方。

scripts.text: Humans are truly scary. But I feel like I've seen this maze somewhere...
scripts.translation: 人类真是可怕。但我感觉我好像在某个地方见过这个迷宫...

scripts.text: In Rahel, the capital of Arunafeltz, there lives a small, cute, and white creature that seems really soft.
scripts.translation: 在阿鲁纳菲兹的首都拉赫尔，生活着一种小巧、可爱且白色的生物，看起来非常柔软。

scripts.text: If you thought of Siroma, you are wrong. It's not marine either.
scripts.translation: 如果你想到的是小雪怪，那就错了。它也不是海洋生物。

scripts.text: The answer is a girl who is both a priest and a leader. This is because Arunafeltz is a theocratic entity.
scripts.translation: 答案是，她既是一位牧师，也是一位首领。这是因为阿鲁纳菲兹是一个神权实体。

scripts.text: In the plains of Audhumbla, there lives many monster flowers and herbivore animals.
scripts.translation: 在奥杜姆布拉的平原上，生活着许多魔物花朵和食草动物。

scripts.text: Although one would think that they are not herbivores seeing how they attack humans, but
scripts.translation: 虽然看到它们攻击人类，人们可能会认为它们不是食草动物，但

scripts.text: if they were really carnivores, what food would they live on? Moreover, there is no record of them eating the adventurers who travel by after attacking them.
scripts.translation: 如果它们真的是食肉动物，那它们靠什么为食呢？而且，也没有记录显示它们会吃掉被它们攻击的冒险者。

scripts.text: Veins, a village built on a hill, seems like a well-planned city.
scripts.translation: 伯仁斯，一座建在山丘上的村庄，看起来像是一座规划良好的城市。

scripts.text: While it's confusing to know where you would exit and enter from, but
scripts.translation: 虽然让人困惑的是不知道从哪里进出，但

scripts.text: if you want to see interesting sights such as a stone eating up a coin you dropped, it's a good place to visit.
scripts.translation: 如果你想看一些有趣的景象，比如石头吃掉你掉落的硬币，那里是一个不错的去处。

scripts.text: There was also a place that was extremely hot somewhere in Arunafeltz..
scripts.translation: 在阿鲁纳菲兹的某个地方，还有一个极其炎热的地方...

scripts.text: The heat there felt like it would burn through my wings in their entirety. The residents of that place also did not seem very friendly.
scripts.translation: 那里的热浪仿佛要将我的翅膀完全烧毁。那里的居民看起来也不太友好。

scripts.text: So I had to stop the expedition. I hope that you, the readers, would also distance yourselves from that place.
scripts.translation: 所以我不得不中止探险。希望读者们也能远离那个地方。

scripts.text: Well...It's not that I was afraid of the guardian there, you see!
scripts.translation: 嗯...并不是因为我害怕那里的守卫，你知道吗！

scripts.text: In Lighthalzen, there is a colossal building constructed by technicians. Although what they exactly do in there is a little suspicious...
scripts.translation: 在里希塔乐镇，有一座由技术人员建造的巨大建筑。虽然他们在里面具体做什么有点可疑...

scripts.text: I'm not sure if a profit-seeking corporation should be doing something like that.
scripts.translation: 我不确定一家追求利润的公司是否应该做这样的事情。

scripts.text: It's also very strange that clean and dirty areas in the city are divided...
scripts.translation: 城市里清洁区和脏乱区被分开，这也非常奇怪...

scripts.text: - I saw a book and stretched my hand out to reach for it. I think it's about various regions in Midgard. -
scripts.translation: - 我看到一本书，伸手去拿。我想它是关于米德加尔特各个地区的。 -

scripts.text: Stay away from the bookshelves.
scripts.translation: 离书架远点

scripts.text: Check out the bookshelves.
scripts.translation: 看看书架上的书

scripts.text:

scripts.translation:
