如果你想要猫商人的服务，应该去找特工，而不是我。

scripts.text:
[Shelby]
Here's some advice. Don't waste your time with me. Look for other people to help you out.
scripts.translation:
[谢尔比]
给你个建议。别在我身上浪费时间。去找其他人帮你吧。

scripts.text:
[Shelby]
Let me remind you before you forget, the materials you need to activate the rift fragment are ^000099 1 Dark Debris, 2 of each red/yellow/blue Gemstone^000000.
scripts.translation:
[谢尔比]
在你忘记之前提醒你一下，激活裂缝碎片需要的材料是 ^0000991个黑暗残骸，以及红/黄/蓝宝石原石各2个^000000。

scripts.text:
[Shelby]
Hey~ Did you do the past experiment well?
scripts.translation:
[谢尔比]
嘿~ 之前的实验做得顺利吗？

scripts.text:
[Shelby]
Hmm? What's wrong?
scripts.translation:
[谢尔比]
嗯？怎么了？

scripts.text: What an interesting cat.
scripts.translation: 真是一只有趣的猫。

scripts.text:
[Shelby]
Why? Is it weird to see me after seeing all the cats that are so polite and overly excited?
scripts.translation:
[谢尔比]
为什么？在见过那么多礼貌又过度兴奋的猫之后，看到我难道很奇怪吗？

scripts.text:
[Shelby]
Meow~ How are youeow~ I really liked canned fisheow~!!...Is this what you wanted?
scripts.translation:
[谢尔比]
喵~ 你好喵~ 我真的很喜欢罐头鱼喵~!!...这就是你想要的吗？

scripts.text:
[Shelby]
Just because we are cats, it doesn't mean we are all the same. I'm also really depressed right now, so it's probably best for you to look for other cats to help you.
scripts.translation:
[谢尔比]
虽然我们都是猫，但不代表我们都是一样的。我现在也很沮丧，所以你最好去找其他猫帮你。

scripts.text: Ask about dimensional rift fragments
scripts.translation: 询问关于次元裂缝碎片的事

scripts.text:
[Shelby]
Haha, I can't believe you are asking a cat about that. Our science is not something a lot of people pay attention to. We have our biggest interest in commerce and fishery.
scripts.translation:
[谢尔比]
哈哈，真不敢相信你会问一只猫这种事。我们的科学并不是很多人关注的领域。我们最大的兴趣在于商业和渔业。

scripts.text:
[Shelby]
Here's an advice. Don't waste your time with me. Look for other people to help you out.
scripts.translation:
[谢尔比]
给你个建议。别在我身上浪费时间。去找其他人帮你吧。

scripts.text: It seems like there are too many types of items. Let's try again after reducing the number of types.
scripts.translation: 看起来物品种类太多了。让我们减少种类后再试一次。

scripts.text: It seems like my possessions are too heavy. Let's try again after lightening the load.
scripts.translation: 我的物品似乎太重了。让我们减轻负重后再试一次。

scripts.text: ^000099He is busy fighting against Shelby. If no one stops this fight, it might be impossible to ever talk to him again.^000000
scripts.translation: ^000099他正忙着和谢尔比打架。如果没人阻止这场打斗，可能就没法再和他说话了。^000000

scripts.text:
[Ford]
^000099Tendery Brand Canned Foods^000000, which are used as salaries, are not being released. Ford is sad. ^000099Shelby^000000 over there also seem depressed~.
scripts.translation:
[福特]
^000099特嫩里牌罐头食品^000000，也就是用来发工资的东西，没有发放。福特很难过。那边的 ^000099谢尔比^000000 看起来也很沮丧~。

scripts.text:
[Ford]
You gave us salary! You are kind! Shelby likes you too! We don't have to starve anymore!
scripts.translation:
[福特]
你给我们发了工资！你真好！谢尔比也很喜欢你！我们不用挨饿了！

scripts.text: [Ford]
scripts.translation: [福特]

scripts.text:
[Shelby]
Shut up Ford!!
scripts.translation:
[谢尔比]
闭嘴，福特！！

scripts.text: Ask about the dimensional rift.
scripts.translation: 询问关于次元裂缝的事

scripts.text:
[Ford]
Meow?
Ford doesn't know a difficult thing like that. Ford knows sardines well! Also mackerels! ^000099Dimension... Stuff Shelby knows better!^000000 But Shelby isn't working because he's a down. I don't either!!
scripts.translation:
[福特]
喵？
福特不懂那种复杂的事情。福特很懂沙丁鱼！还有鲭鱼！ ^000099次元... 那些谢尔比更懂！^000000 但谢尔比现在没在工作，因为他心情不好。我也一样！！

scripts.text:
[Shelby]
Shut up Ford!!
scripts.translation:
[谢尔比]
闭嘴，福特！！

scripts.text: ^000099You hear the sound of two cats fighting.^000000
scripts.translation: ^000099你听到两只猫打架的声音。^000000

scripts.text:
[Shelby]
...
scripts.translation:
[谢尔比]
……

scripts.text: ^000099Seeing how Shelby isn't screaming at Ford, he really must be in a good mood now.^000000
scripts.translation: ^000099看谢尔比没有对福特大喊大叫，看来他现在心情不错。^000000

scripts.text: It seems like there are too many types of items. Let's try again after reducing the number of types.
scripts.translation: 看起来物品种类太多了。让我们减少种类后再试一次。

scripts.text: It seems like my possessions are too heavy. Let's try again after lightening the load.
scripts.translation: 我的物品似乎太重了。让我们减轻负重后再试一次。

scripts.text:
[Prison Guard]
I see, I don't think I ever saw you on our visitor's list. Who are you visiting?
scripts.translation:
[狱卒]
原来如此，我想我从未在访客名单上见过你。你是来探谁的？

scripts.text:
[Prison Guard]
This is all thanks to you! The fact that Mr. Clever is sleeping, it means that he won't be awake for a few days.
scripts.translation:
[狱卒]
这都要多亏了你！既然聪明鬼正在睡觉，意味着他接下来几天都不会醒。

scripts.text:
[Prison Guard]
I've never seen you before... Are you a visitor?
scripts.translation:
[狱卒]
我好像没见过你……你是来探监的吗？

scripts.text:
[Prison Guard]
Please, I ask you. Please shut Mr. Clever's mouth. I've been listening to him for a year now and it's driving me insane. I can't beat a prisoner either...
scripts.translation:
[狱卒]
求求你了，帮帮忙。请让聪明鬼闭嘴吧。我已经听他唱了一年了，简直要疯了。我也不能打囚犯...

scripts.text:
[Prison Guard]
Do you need something else?
scripts.translation:
[狱卒]
你还需要什么吗？

scripts.text:
[Prison Guard]
^000099{0}^000000? ... That means...

[Prison Guard]
Hmm? You want to visit ^000099{0}^000000? I don't see that visitation on the list. Are you sure you made a formal request?
scripts.translation:
[狱卒]
嗯？你想探^000099{0}^000000？我在名单上没看到这条记录。你确定你提交了正式的探监申请吗？

scripts.text:
[Clever]
Huh? I've got a visitor? Yahoo! It's a visit! Yay~
scripts.translation:
[聪明鬼]
咦？我有访客？耶！有人来探监啦！好耶~

scripts.text:
[Prison Guard]
Ahh...
scripts.translation:
[狱卒]
啊……

scripts.text: ^000099The guard's expression grows dim. He looks so terrible upon just mentioning the name Clever...^000000
scripts.translation: ^000099狱卒的脸色变得阴沉。仅仅是提到聪明鬼这个名字，他就显得如此痛苦……^000000

scripts.text:
[Prison Guard]
Well, on the list at least... It doesn't seem like there is a visit scheduled with Clever...
scripts.translation:
[狱卒]
嗯，至少在名单上……看起来并没有安排与聪明鬼的探监……

scripts.text:
[Clever]
Hey~ Guard~ What are you doing? Open this cell quickly, would you! This is a visit, hahaha! If you interfere with my visits, I'm going to sing everytime you work! Aren't you excited?
scripts.translation:
[聪明鬼]
嘿~狱卒~你在干什么？快点打开这个牢房！这是探监时间，哈哈！如果你敢阻碍我的探监，我每次你上班都要唱歌！你不兴奋吗？

scripts.text:
[Clever]
Actually, why don't I start singing now?
scripts.translation:
[聪明鬼]
其实，我为什么现在就开始唱呢？

scripts.text: ^000099The guard's face grows even dimmer. His expression betrays his great irritation with the curent situation.^000000
scripts.translation: ^000099狱卒的脸色更加阴沉了。他的表情暴露了他对当前状况的极度恼火。^000000

scripts.text:
[Prison Guard]
You aren't on the list, but, haha, I guess this is an administrative error. Please go ahead. As far as the time for visitation, hm...
scripts.translation:
[狱卒]
你不在名单上，但是，哈哈，我想这可能是行政失误。请进吧。至于探监时间，嗯……

scripts.text:
[Prison Guard]
You can take as much time as you want. Don't worry about it, and take your time.
scripts.translation:
[狱卒]
你可以想待多久就待多久。别担心，慢慢来。

scripts.text:
[Prison Guard]
I don't know when's the last time I've had this much peace. I pray for the blessing of your home tree.
scripts.translation:
[狱卒]
我不知道多久没这么清静过了。我祈祷你的家园之树蒙受祝福。

scripts.text: ^000099You gained experience points and job experience points, thanks to Clever's sleep and the guard's happiness.^000000
scripts.translation: ^000099由于聪明鬼的沉睡和狱卒的喜悦，你获得了经验值和职业经验值。^000000

scripts.text: Look inside.
scripts.translation: 向内看

scripts.text: Get me out of here.
scripts.translation: 把我弄出去

scripts.text: It seems like there are too many types of items. Let's try again after reducing the number of types.
scripts.translation: 看起来物品种类太多了。让我们减少种类后再试一次。

scripts.text: It seems like my possessions are too heavy. Let's try again after lightening the load.
scripts.translation: 我的物品似乎太重了。让我们减轻负重后再试一次。

scripts.text: ^000099I see a plain-looking journal. It seems to deal with third-rate gossip stories.^000000
scripts.translation: ^000099我看到一本其貌不扬的杂志。看起来里面全是些三流八卦故事。^000000

scripts.text:
^990000---Eclage Monthly---^000000
^999900(Shocking! Birth of Eclage Special)^000000
^000099This must be the one that Clever talked about. Extreme articles are faded out. ^000000
scripts.translation:
^990000---埃克拉珠月刊---^000000
^999900（震惊！埃克拉珠特刊诞生）^000000
^000099这应该就是聪明鬼提到的那本。极端的文章已经褪色了。^000000

scripts.text: ^000099This isn't a history document. It's just a third-rate magazine. Let's look through the table of contents.^000000
scripts.translation: ^000099这不是历史文献。只是一本三流杂志。让我们看看目录。^000000

scripts.text: Close the book
scripts.translation: 合上书

scripts.text: Settlement of despair-------7p
scripts.translation: 绝望的清算-------7页

scripts.text: Brutality of the Elder Assembly-------48p
scripts.translation: 长老会议的暴行-------48页

scripts.text: Eternal farewell--------132p
(Faded out areas)
scripts.translation: （褪色区域）

scripts.text: ^000099Doesn't seem very interesting.^000000

^000099Chapter 1. Land of Despair^000000
Is there a problem in Yggdrasil? A smell of death began to fill the peaceful land.
scripts.translation:
^000099第一章 绝望之地^000000
世界树出了什么问题？死亡的气息开始弥漫在这片宁静的土地上。

scripts.text: Polluted gardens, dried lands, attack of various mutant life forms. A huge change is found in Laphine's place of life.
scripts.translation: 花园被污染，土地干涸，各种变异生物发起攻击。拉斐涅的生活之地发生了巨大的变化。

scripts.text: ^000099(I flip through various faded out pages.)^000000
scripts.translation: ^000099（我翻过几页已经褪色的页面。）^000000

scripts.text: Laphine's leaders did not doubt that this is the best place for Yggdrasil's guardian. Because of the Elder Assemblly's pressure to establish at such a barren land, it is now difficult to control Laphine citizens.
scripts.translation: 拉斐涅的首领们并不怀疑这是世界树的守护者最好的栖息地。但由于长老会议施压，要求建立在这种贫瘠的土地上，现在很难控制拉斐涅的市民。

scripts.text: Cursed times passed with many families and friends suffering through multiple diseases and attacks by indigenous life forms.
scripts.translation: 在诅咒的时代里，许多家庭和朋友遭受了多种疾病和土著生物的袭击。

scripts.text: ^000099(The rest of it is faded out significantly, so it is hard to tell.)^000000
scripts.translation: ^000099（剩下的部分褪色严重，很难辨认。）^000000

scripts.text:
^000099Chapter 2. Elder Assembly's Scheme^000000
Elder Assembly continued to blame the Laphine leaders for ongoing failures.
scripts.translation:
^000099第二章 长老会议的阴谋^000000
长老会议继续指责拉斐涅的首领们持续失败。

scripts.text: Upon hearing that the land has been selected incorrectly, they internally decided to move the capital to the southern areas where the area is flourishing with forests.
scripts.translation: 在得知土地选择错误后，他们内部决定将首都迁往南部森林茂盛的地区。

scripts.text: ^000099(I flip a ripped page.)^000000
The scouts sent south found the shocking truth. The forests in the south could not be close to being safe. 90% of the scouts sent were eliminated by an unknown monstrous figure.
scripts.translation: 派往南部的侦察兵发现了令人震惊的真相。南部的森林根本不安全。90%的侦察兵被一个未知的怪物消灭了。

scripts.text: However, the Elder Assembly insisted that the area was our destiny and continued to delegate scouting teams. It was a ridiculous decision.
scripts.translation: 然而，长老会议坚持认为这片土地是我们的命运，并继续派遣侦察队。这是一个荒谬的决定。

scripts.text: As for the leaders, they needed something drastic to oppose Elder Assembly's ridiculous demands. The elders were just too old and ambitious to think practically.
scripts.translation: 至于首领们，他们需要采取一些果断的措施来反对长老会议荒谬的要求。长老们太老迈且野心勃勃，无法务实地思考。

scripts.text: At this point, two Donas, ^000099Etran and Robert,^000000 suggested large-scale restorative efforts to the leaders. These were individuals of greatest restorative abilities and authority among the Laphines.
scripts.translation: 此时，两位多娜，^000099埃特兰和罗伯特，^000000向首领们建议进行大规模的恢复工作。她们是拉斐涅中恢复能力和权威最高的个体。

scripts.text: The leaders began to listen to the strategies suggested by the experts of nature restoration who lived out the principles of restoration all their lives.
scripts.translation: 首领们开始听取那些一生践行恢复原则的自然恢复专家的建议。

scripts.text: The suggestions made by the two Dona were crystal clear. ^000099It was to create an enormous home tree to directly fellowship with Yggdrasil and to restore the land all at once^000000.
scripts.translation: 两位多娜的建议非常明确。^000099那就是创造一棵巨大的家园之树，直接与世界树尤克特拉希尔共鸣，并一次性恢复土地。^000000

scripts.text: As expected, Elder Assembly completely undermines their suggestion. ^000099In order to create home tree, it was necessary to drain the life force from the land. ^000000
scripts.translation: 不出所料，长老会议完全驳回了她们的建议。^000099为了创造家园之树，必须从土地中汲取生命力。^000000

scripts.text: As such, ^000099creating a home tree to restore the land could be an obstacle instead.^000000 The Elder Assembly argued that the process would be impossible.
scripts.translation: 因此，^000099创造家园之树来恢复土地反而可能成为障碍。^000000长老会议辩称这个过程是不可能的。

scripts.text: And they continued to say that for everyone to live, it would be better to move to the south than to restore the barren land. That was their ploy to begin with.
scripts.translation: 他们继续说，为了让大家生存，迁往南部比恢复这片贫瘠的土地更好。这就是他们最初的计谋。

scripts.text: ^000099(Pages were ripped after this.)^000000
^000099(There are many ink stains that seem to purposely block out the writing here.)^000000
scripts.translation: ^000099（这里有很多墨迹，似乎是故意遮挡文字的。）^000000

scripts.text: ^000099(There are many ink stains that seem to purposely block out the writing here.)^000000
scripts.translation: ^000099（这里有很多墨迹，似乎是故意遮挡文字的。）^000000

scripts.text: There is a folded page.
scripts.translation: 有一页折叠的纸。

scripts.text: ^000099If it is unfolded carefully, it may reveal the page.^000000
scripts.translation: ^000099如果小心地展开，可能会露出这一页。^000000

scripts.text: The page is unfolded carefully.
scripts.translation: 小心地展开这一页。

scripts.text: ^000099There is a page of reflections by Laphine readers. It might be that they were anonymous, but the comments were written aggressively.^000000
scripts.translation: ^000099这是拉斐涅读者的评论页。虽然可能是匿名的，但评论写得非常激烈。^000000

scripts.text:
^990000RE:^000000Who ruined this part here? This is the only copy left!! I love this story.
----------
^990000RE-RE:^000000: I have another copy that I made. If you want it, let me know.
scripts.translation:
^990000回复：^000000是谁弄坏了这部分？这是唯一剩下的副本了！！我喜欢这个故事。
----------
^990000回复-回复：^000000：我有另一份我制作的副本。如果你想要，告诉我。

scripts.text: ^990000RE:^000000Hey guys, do you know this? The Elder Assembly at first completely opposed the building of home tree. But it says in the history books that they're the ones that came up with the idea. Isn't that weird? Who's right?
scripts.translation: ^990000回复：^000000嘿，大家知道吗？长老会议最初完全反对建造家园之树。但历史书上说是他们提出了这个想法。这不是很奇怪吗？谁是对的？

scripts.text:
^990000RE:^000000If you are a Laphine with a wing span greater than 180cm, I'll consider dating you.
----------
<- Anais likes this.
----------
^990000RE-RE:^000000: How did you come up with that?
scripts.translation:
^990000回复：^000000如果你是一只翼展超过180厘米的拉斐涅，我会考虑和你约会。
----------
<- 阿奈斯喜欢这条。
----------
^990000回复-回复：^000000：你是怎么想出这个的？

scripts.text: ^990000RE:^000000I heard this from my father, but to fight against Elder Assembly's decisions, ^000099Etran and Robert argued one another in front of the elders on purpose.^000000 Is that true?
scripts.translation: ^990000回复：^000000我从父亲那里听说，为了对抗长老会议的决定，^000099埃特兰和罗伯特故意在长老面前互相争吵。^000000这是真的吗？

scripts.text: ^990000RE-RE:^000000: I heard that too. ^000099To make sure they seem authentic, they started arguing each other a bit by bit from a few days before the meeting^000000. That's the most controversial topic among historians.
scripts.translation: ^990000回复-回复：^000000：我也听说了。^000099为了确保看起来真实，他们在会议前几天就开始互相争吵。^000000这是历史学家中最有争议的话题。

scripts.text:
^990000RE:^000000There are more idiots that believe this stuff. Hey kids, Eclage Monthly is a third-rate gossip magazine. Don't confuse it with history.
----------
^990000RE-RE:^000000: Oh I see. Thank you so much for your wisdom. I guess if you leave comments like that on a third-rate magazine, you just look incredibly smart.
scripts.translation:
^990000回复：^000000还有更多相信这些鬼话的傻瓜。嘿，孩子们，《埃克拉珠月刊》是一本三流八卦杂志。别把它和历史搞混了。
----------
^990000回复-回复：^000000：哦，我明白了。非常感谢你的智慧。我想如果你在三流杂志上留这样的评论，你只会显得特别聪明。

scripts.text:
^990000RE:^000000I'll be running with the high profile photo of Mayor Jun in undies. I'll give it to the first one to claim it!
----------
^990000RE-RE:^000000: I'll take the photo. I'll put you on our editorial staff.
scripts.translation:
^990000回复：^000000我要刊登一张市长Jun只穿内衣的高清照片。谁先抢我就给谁！
----------
^990000回复-回复：^000000：我要这张照片。我要把你招进我们的编辑团队。

scripts.text: ^000099(You've gathered information about the two Donas, Etran and Robert. Take a note of this and ask Clever about it)^000000
scripts.translation: ^000099（你收集到了关于两位多娜、埃特兰和罗伯特的信息。记下这一点，并向聪明鬼询问详情）^000000

scripts.text: ^000099The book must be damaged. I can't really open it.^000000
scripts.translation: ^000099这本书一定损坏了。我实在打不开它。^000000

scripts.text: It seems like there are too many types of items. Let's try again after reducing the number of types.
scripts.translation: 看起来物品种类太多了。让我们减少种类后再试一次。

scripts.text: It seems like my possessions are too heavy. Let's try again after lightening the load.
scripts.translation: 我的物品似乎太重了。让我们减轻负重后再试一次。

scripts.text:
[????]
Hmm? What is this? Am I dreaming? Something feels different.
scripts.translation:
[????]
嗯？这是什么？
我在做梦吗？
感觉有些不同。

scripts.text: Can you hear me? Would you be Sir Etran?
scripts.translation: 你能听到我说话吗？你是埃特兰大人吗？

scripts.text:
[Etran]
You know my name? Who are you?
scripts.translation:
[埃特兰]
你知道我的名字？
你是谁？

scripts.text: Explain the situation.
scripts.translation: 解释情况

scripts.text:
[Etran]
Huhhh?
Are you telling me to believe that story? You are from the future of thousands of years away? That kind of science is available in the future?
scripts.translation:
[埃特兰]
哈？
你让我相信那个故事？
你来自几千年后的未来？
未来竟然有那种科技？

scripts.text: Explain to him about the rift reactor.
scripts.translation: 向他解释关于裂隙反应堆的事。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Sir Etran, it's not that we are from the future, but rather, we opened the walls between the past and the future just temporarily. I have so many questions to ask.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
埃特兰大人，并不是我们来自未来，
而是我们暂时打开了过去与未来之间的墙壁。
我有许多问题想问。

scripts.text: ^000099Etran suprisingly looks similar to Clever. Could it be that Clever and Hiel are reincarnations of Etran and Robert? No, that couldn't be...^000000
scripts.translation:
^000099埃特兰看起来竟然和聪明鬼很像。
难道聪明鬼和希尔是埃特兰和罗伯特的转世？
不，那不可能...^000000

scripts.text:
^000099Etran suprisingly looks similar to Clever. Could it be that Clever and Hiel are reincarnations of Etran and Robert? No, that couldn't be...^000000
I honestly don't have much confidence. The Bifrost now is too deteriorated that no matter how much life force is used, there would be no end in sight.
scripts.translation:
^000099埃特兰看起来竟然和聪明鬼很像。
难道聪明鬼和希尔是埃特兰和罗伯特的转世？
不，那不可能...^000000
说实话，我没什么信心。
现在的Bifrost已经太过腐朽，
无论投入多少生命力，都看不到尽头。

scripts.text: Ask about the Elder Assembly.
scripts.translation: 询问关于长老会议的事。

scripts.text: Ask about the fight with Robert.
scripts.translation: 询问关于与罗伯特争吵的事。

scripts.text: Ask about land restoration project.
scripts.translation: 询问关于土地恢复计划的事。

scripts.text:
[Etran]
Hmm, the Elder Assembly is really a rotten organization. They're like fossils, still living in the times when Laphines began to exist.
scripts.translation:
[埃特兰]
嗯，长老会议真的是个腐朽的组织。
他们就像化石一样，
还活在拉斐涅刚刚出现的那个时代。

scripts.text:
[Etran]
Oh yeah, you talking about the time we argued in front of the Elder Assembly.
scripts.translation:
[埃特兰]
哦，你是说我们在长老会议面前争吵的那次。

scripts.text:
[Etran]
I honestly don't have much confidence. The Bifrost now is too deteriorated that no matter how much life force is used, there would be no end in sight.
scripts.translation:
[埃特兰]
说实话，我没什么信心。
现在的Bifrost已经太过腐朽，
无论投入多少生命力，都看不到尽头。

scripts.text:
[Etran]
They try to interfere with presidency, politics, culture, and everything else. They are even minding the matters that deal with our survival.
scripts.translation:
[埃特兰]
他们试图干涉总统、政治、文化以及一切。
他们甚至插手关乎我们生存的事务。

scripts.text:
[Etran]
The elders are trying to ignore the practical young leaders of this area who want to establish a capital nearby here. They are only trying to carve out their place in the center of this issue regarding the capital.
scripts.translation:
[埃特兰]
长老们试图无视那些想要在此附近建立首都的务实的年轻领袖。
他们只想在这个关于首都的问题中占据中心位置。

scripts.text:
[Etran]
That's why they are pushing for the ridiculous idea of settling in the south.
scripts.translation:
[埃特兰]
这就是为什么他们极力推行那个荒谬的南迁定居计划。

scripts.text:
[Etran]
The young Laphines could never accept that. That's why Robert and I made the outrageous claim that we could restore the area here and blocked off the movement toward the south.
scripts.translation:
[埃特兰]
年轻的拉菲涅人绝不会接受这一点。这就是为什么我和罗伯特提出了那个荒谬的主张，声称我们可以恢复这片区域，并阻止了向南迁移的计划。

scripts.text:
[Etran]
Of course... It would only be significant if we succeed. If we fail, many more young Laphines would be sent off to the south.
scripts.translation:
[埃特兰]
当然...只有我们成功了，这一切才有意义。如果我们失败了，会有更多年轻的拉菲涅人被送往南方。

scripts.text:
[Etran]
I can no longer let the elders shed the blood of the young Laphines.
I honestly don't have much confidence. The Bifrost now is too deteriorated that no matter how much life force is used, there would be no end in sight.
scripts.translation:
[埃特兰]
我不能再让长老们牺牲年轻拉菲涅人的鲜血了。
说实话，我没什么信心。现在的Bifrost已经太过腐朽，无论投入多少生命力，都看不到尽头。

scripts.text:
[Etran]
That happened about a year ago from the dimension that I'm currently in. Because we wanted to draw the elders' attention to our idea, we made them focus on only two issues, home tree's restoration or the land's restoration.
scripts.translation:
[埃特兰]
那发生在我目前所处的维度大约一年前。为了吸引长老们的注意，我们让他们只关注两个问题：是恢复家园之树，还是恢复这片土地。

scripts.text:
[Etran]
We succeeded ultimately. They didn't even get to discuss the option of settling in the forests of the south. It just had too many Laphine lives at stake.
scripts.translation:
[埃特兰]
我们最终成功了。他们甚至没能讨论在南方森林定居的选项。因为这关乎太多拉菲涅人的性命。

scripts.text:
[Etran]
If I could meet Robert later, I wish to continue that conversation.
I honestly don't have much confidence. The Bifrost now is too deteriorated that no matter how much life force is used, there would be no end in sight.
scripts.translation:
[埃特兰]
如果之后能再见到罗伯特，我希望继续那次谈话。
说实话，我没什么信心。现在的Bifrost已经太过腐朽，无论投入多少生命力，都看不到尽头。

scripts.text:
[Etran]
Furthermore, the energy that the home tree consumes is just too colossal and too rapid.
scripts.translation:
[埃特兰]
而且，家园之树消耗的能量实在太庞大，速度也太快了。

scripts.text:
[Etran]
Robert is probably doing everything he can. Once the home tree connected to a piece of land, the entire area will be consumed. To prevent that, he put his life on the line.
scripts.translation:
[埃特兰]
罗伯特大概正在竭尽全力。一旦家园之树连接到一片土地，整个区域都会被吞噬。为了防止这种情况，他赌上了自己的性命。

scripts.text:
[Etran]
You get the idea right? Our roles are in two parts right now. Me, who focuses on pouring out the energy into the land. Robert, who blocks off the home tree's wild consumption.
scripts.translation:
[埃特兰]
你明白我的意思吧？我们的角色现在分为两部分。我专注于将能量注入土地，而罗伯特则负责阻止家园之树的疯狂吞噬。

scripts.text:
[Etran]
If the balance between us two is not maintained, the entire land will be destroyed along with home tree. The problem is, I just don't know if we are doing it all correctly.
scripts.translation:
[埃特兰]
如果我们两人之间的平衡无法维持，整片土地连同家园之树都会被毁灭。问题是，我不知道我们是否做对了。

scripts.text: Actually, your project succeeded.
scripts.translation: 实际上，你的计划成功了。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
You succeeded. Bifrost, full of flowers and grass, is a land of plenty.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你成功了。Bifrost开满了鲜花和绿草，是一片富饶之地。

scripts.text:
[Etran]
I succeeded...?
scripts.translation:
[埃特兰]
我成功了...？

scripts.text: Would you like to see for yourself?
scripts.translation: 你想亲眼看看吗？

scripts.text:
[Etran]
Sure. Lead the way. I'll follow...
scripts.translation:
[埃特兰]
当然。请带路。我会跟着你...

scripts.text: ^000099The additional reaction does not get reduced.^000000

[Etran]
Oh? Something's familiar. Would you be that traveler from the future?
scripts.translation:
[埃特兰]
哦？感觉很熟悉。你是来自未来的那位旅行者吗？

scripts.text:
[Etran]
You are here! I was worried that you wouldn't come back!
scripts.translation:
[埃特兰]
你来了！我还担心你不会回来呢！

scripts.text:
[Etran]
After your visit, I felt so much lighter. I was also excited to control the life force.
scripts.translation:
[埃特兰]
在你来访之后，我感觉轻松了许多。我也很兴奋地想要控制生命力。

scripts.text:
[Etran]
More importantly, did you give the necklace to Robert? And what about the leaf of the home tree?
scripts.translation:
[埃特兰]
更重要的是，你把项链交给罗伯特了吗？还有家园之树的叶子呢？

scripts.text: Give the necklace and the home tree leaf.
scripts.translation: 交出项链和家园之树的叶子

scripts.text:
[Etran]
Wow, it was true that home tree has grown! What a relief!!
scripts.translation:
[埃特兰]
哇，家园之树真的长高了！真是让人放心啊！！

scripts.text:
[Etran]
But even so, it's a bit sad that he didn't keep the necklace...
scripts.translation:
[埃特兰]
不过话说回来，他居然没有收下项链，这有点让人难过...

scripts.text: Tell him what Robert said.
scripts.translation: 告诉他罗伯特说了什么

scripts.text:
[Etran]
I see. Robert, as usual, is strong unlike me. That's Robert's strong point.
scripts.translation:
[埃特兰]
原来如此。罗伯特还是老样子，不像我这么软弱。这就是罗伯特的强项。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
And, Sir Robert also asked me to tell you this.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
还有，罗伯特先生也让我转告您这句话。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
That as much as you trust in me, ^000099I trust in you^000000...

[Etran]
Robert really said that? Really?
scripts.translation:
[埃特兰]
罗伯特真的这么说了吗？真的吗？

scripts.text:
[Etran]
I think this is the first time he's ever said he trusts me ever since we started working together. Now I can just focus and give all my heart to putting energy into this land.
scripts.translation:
[埃特兰]
我想这是我们开始合作以来，他第一次说信任我。现在我可以专心致志，全心全意地将能量注入这片土地了。

scripts.text: ^000099Etran's shoulders seem to be trembling.^000000
scripts.translation: ^000099埃特兰的肩膀似乎在颤抖。^000000

scripts.text:
[Etran]
I didn't get to know you very long, but thank you, traveler from the future.
scripts.translation:
[埃特兰]
虽然与您相识的时间不长，但谢谢您，来自未来的旅行者。

scripts.text:
[Etran]
By the way, the necklace that Robert refused to keep. I'll give it to you as a token of gratitude. Just keep it for yourself.
scripts.translation:
[埃特兰]
对了，罗伯特拒绝收下的那条项链，我就把它送给您作为谢礼吧。请留作纪念。

scripts.text:
[Etran]
Well then, I should get going. Also, please send my word of appreciation to the person who built this incredible machine.
scripts.translation:
[埃特兰]
那么，我该走了。另外，请代我向建造这台不可思议机器的工匠转达我的谢意。

scripts.text: ^000099Etran's keepsake was received. It is possible to equip it, but ^ff0000to utilize its full strength,^000099 I would need Hiel's help later.^000000
scripts.translation: ^000099收到了埃特兰的纪念品。虽然可以装备，但^ff0000要发挥其全部力量，^000099之后需要希尔的帮助。^000000

scripts.text: ^000099This is a grave where communication with Etran was established. He must have spent his last days around here.^000000
scripts.translation: ^000099这是一座建立了与埃特兰联系的坟墓。他最后的时光应该是在这里度过的。^000000

scripts.text: ^000099There is a cemetery unfitting with the tower. It's so worn down that it's difficult to tell whose graves these are.^000000
scripts.translation: ^000099这里有一座与塔格格不入的墓地。墓碑风化严重，难以辨认是谁的坟墓。^000000

[{0}]

[{0}]

[埃特兰]

scripts.translation: ^000099埃特兰开始啜泣，似乎卸下了生命中的重担。他似乎想起了什么，问了一个问题。^000000

scripts.translation: 他的家园树也长得很好。

[Etran]

scripts.translation:
[埃特兰]

scripts.text: Unfortunately, that can't happen...
scripts.translation: 很遗憾，那不可能...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Unfortunately, this reactor's range is too small that while I try to take you there, the connection will drop. I'm afraid it's impossible.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]

[Etran]

scripts.translation:
[埃特兰]

A proof?

证明？

scripts.translation:
[埃特兰]

[{0}]

[{0}]

scripts.translation:
[埃特兰]

[Etran]

[埃特兰]

[Etran]

scripts.translation:
[埃特兰]
如果你能带给我一片完全成熟的家园树叶子，我绝不会放弃。毕竟，罗伯特的成功是无法伪造的，你明白吗。

[Etran]
Also, I have another favor.
scripts.translation:
[埃特兰]

scripts.text:
[Etran]

scripts.translation:
[埃特兰]
