scripts.translation: ^000099反应堆启动了，但是...不知为何，我感到很烦躁。^000000

scripts.text:
[Notice]
Pan-galactic ultra genius engineer Hiel's strange and creepy workshop.
Normal Laphines, animals, and Saphas are prohibited.
scripts.translation:
[告示]
泛银河系超天才工程师希尔的怪异且令人毛骨悚然的工作室。
禁止普通拉芬、动物和萨法进入。

scripts.text: Continue my way.
scripts.translation: 继续我的路

scripts.text: Enter this place.
scripts.translation: 进入这个地方

scripts.text: If you would like to go down, please press the bell~
scripts.translation: 如果您想下去，请按下铃铛~

scripts.text: Forget it.
scripts.translation: 算了。

scripts.text: Go down.
scripts.translation: 下去

scripts.text:
[????]
Baby, you don't know why I'm upset, do you?
Present{0}Dog
scripts.translation:
[????]
宝宝，你不知道我为什么生气，对吧？
礼物{0}狗

scripts.text: It seems like there are too many types of items. Let's try again after reducing the number of types.
scripts.translation: 看起来物品种类太多了。让我们减少种类后再试一次。

scripts.text: It seems like my possessions are too heavy. Let's try again after lightening the load.
scripts.translation: 我的物品似乎太重了。让我们减轻负重后再试一次。

scripts.text: ^000099It's a workshop with lots of oddities.^000000
scripts.translation: ^000099这是一个充满奇奇怪怪东西的工作室。^000000

scripts.text: ^000099It looks like Hiel's preliminary rift reactor. It seems like it could be operated upon touching it.^000000
scripts.translation: ^000099看起来像是希尔的初步裂隙反应堆。似乎触摸它就可以操作。^000000

scripts.text: ^000099As soon as the Dark Debris was placed in the middle of Hiel's arrangement, everything went dark and a strange voice appeared out of nowhere.^000000
scripts.translation: ^000099当暗黑碎片被放置在希尔排列的中心时，一切变得黑暗，一个奇怪的声音不知从哪里出现了。^000000

scripts.text:
[????]
According to the estimation, the time it takes for home tree's restoration is at least 200 years. During that period, 80% of life forms on this land will be destroyed.
scripts.translation:
[????]
根据估算，家园之树的恢复至少需要200年。在此期间，这片土地上80%的生命形式将被摧毁。

scripts.text:
[????]
However, if we were to take care of the life forms in the land without restoring home tree, without the basic resources to support the life forms, it will inevitably reach destruction. That period would not even last more than 400 years.
scripts.translation:
[????]
然而，如果我们不恢复家园之树，就无法维持这片土地上的生命形式。没有维持生命所需的基本资源，毁灭是不可避免的。那段时期甚至不会超过400年。

scripts.text:
[????]
Will we enjoy long lasting peace taking into account the 200 years of sacrifice? Or, do we just die out after working to sustain life for 400 years.
scripts.translation:
[????]
考虑到200年的牺牲，我们能否享受长久的和平？还是说，我们在维持生命400年后就会灭绝。

scripts.text:
[????]
We ask for the wisdom of Elder Assembly.
scripts.translation:
[????]
我们请求长老议会的智慧。

scripts.text:
[A low voice]
We will first consider your report. The assembly's decision is.... (Static... Static)
scripts.translation:
[低沉的声音]
我们将首先考虑你们的报告。议会的决定是.... (静电... 静电)

scripts.text: ^000099Noises interfered the voice and the present time returned.^000000
scripts.translation: ^000099噪音干扰了声音，时间回到了现在。^000000

scripts.text: ^000099It looks like Hiel's preliminary rift reactor. It seems like it could be operated upon touching it.^000000
scripts.translation: ^000099看起来像是希尔的初步裂隙反应堆。似乎触摸它就可以操作。^000000

scripts.text: ^000099Hiel seems to continue with the improvement. It does not seem right to touch it.^000000
scripts.translation: ^000099希尔似乎还在继续改进。现在去碰它似乎不太合适。^000000

scripts.text:
[Robert]
Hmm?
Could this be... the guys from last time?
scripts.translation:
[罗伯特]
嗯？
难道这是...上次那几个人？

scripts.text:
[Robert]
Come to think of it,{0}, you disappeared after leaving me in front of home tree!
scripts.translation:
[罗伯特]
说起来，{0}，你把我丢在家园之树前就消失了！

scripts.text: ^000099It was good that Robert appeared in such clarity. But he seems really mad about the time when the communication got cut off last time. Let's first calm his hand holding my collar up.^000000
scripts.translation: ^000099罗伯特出现得如此清晰，这很好。但他似乎对上次通讯中断的事非常生气。先让他松开抓着我衣领的手吧。^000000

scripts.text: You see...
scripts.translation: 你看...

scripts.text: It's a misunderstanding!
scripts.translation: 这是个误会！

scripts.text: This is difficult.
scripts.translation: 这很难解释。

scripts.text: Please give me some time to explain!
scripts.translation: 请给我点时间解释！

scripts.text:
[Robert]
Hmm? The necklace in your right hand...
scripts.translation:
[罗伯特]
嗯？你右手上的项链...

scripts.text: I bought it at the market.
scripts.translation: 我在市场买的。

scripts.text: I stole it.
scripts.translation: 我偷的。

scripts.text: I met with Sir Etran.
scripts.translation: 我见到了埃特兰爵士。

scripts.text:
[Robert]
You may fool others, but you can't fool me. Tell me straight. Where is that necklace from?
scripts.translation:
[罗伯特]
你可以骗别人，但骗不了我。老实说。那条项链是从哪来的？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
As you know, this is Sir Etran's necklace.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
如您所知，这是埃特兰爵士的项链。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Sir Etran seemed exhausted. So I showed him how the future of his work looks like.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
埃特兰爵士看起来很疲惫。所以我向他展示了他的工作未来的样子。

scripts.text:
[Robert]
......

[{0}]
He didn't know whether his work was a success or a failure, but after seeing Bifrost full of life, he found the strength to continue.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
他不知道自己的工作算成功还是失败，但看到充满生机的双层牛肉堡后，他找到了继续下去的力量。

scripts.text:
[Robert]
I see. That's what happened.
scripts.translation:
[罗伯特]
我明白了。原来是这么回事。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
And Sir Etran asked me to deliver this necklace to you. It was to let you know that he won't ever give up the future of Bifrost he's seen.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
埃特兰爵士让我把这条项链转交给您。他想让您知道，他绝不会放弃他所看到的双层牛肉堡的未来。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
The only thing is.. He was worried about how you were doing. Especially since he couldn't see whether your home tree grew successfully.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
只是...他担心您的状况。特别是因为他无法看到您的家园树是否生长成功。

scripts.text:
[Robert]
That can't be helped. The one who is putting in the life force cannot leave the place.
scripts.translation:
[罗伯特]
这没办法。注入生命力的人不能离开那个地方。

scripts.text: Is it possible to obtain a home tree leaf?
scripts.translation: 能否获得一片家园树叶？

scripts.text:
[Robert]
Ah, you are trying to show Etran my home tree's leaf. You ask such an obvious question...
scripts.translation:
[罗伯特]
啊，你是想给埃特兰看我的家园树叶。你问这种显而易见的问题...

scripts.text:
[Robert]
In fact, my home tree just bloomed up its first leaf. It's very big and full of splendor. Give me a minute.
scripts.translation:
[罗伯特]
事实上，我的家园树刚刚长出了第一片叶子。它非常大，而且充满生机。请稍等片刻。

scripts.text: ^000099Robert's reaction has not emerged yet. He must be still in the process of obtainig a home tree leaf.^000000
scripts.translation: ^000099罗伯特的反应尚未出现。他可能还在获取家园树叶的过程中。^000000

scripts.text:
[Robert]
I kept you waiting.
scripts.translation:
[罗伯特]
让您久等了。

scripts.text:
[Robert]
Take this home tree leaf. This is a leaf that I obtained myself, so it won't affect home tree much at all.
scripts.translation:
[罗伯特]
拿着这片家园树叶。这是我亲自获取的，所以不会对家园树造成太大影响。

scripts.text:
[Robert]
And the necklace you gave me earlier, I understand very well the will of Etran, so you can just return it back to him.
scripts.translation:
[罗伯特]
还有你之前给我的那条项链，我非常理解埃特兰的心意，所以你可以直接把它还给他。

scripts.text:
[Robert]
There's no way I would feel good after receiving a necklace from that kid. I know it might be troublesome, but please give it back to him.
scripts.translation:
[罗伯特]
收到那个小孩送的项链，我怎么可能心情好。我知道这可能会麻烦，但请把它还给他。

scripts.text:
[Robert]
Oh, and please tell him I said this. As much as you trust in me, ^000099I trust in you^000000.^000000
scripts.translation:
[罗伯特]
哦，请告诉他我说了这句话。正如你信任我一样，^000099我也信任你^000000。^000000

scripts.text:
[Robert]
And to not cry anywhere he goes... Wait, no I take that one back.
scripts.translation:
[罗伯特]
还有不要在任何地方哭泣...等等，我收回这句话。

scripts.text: ^000099After making that statement, Robert disappeared back into the reactor. In my hand were Robert's home tree leaf and Etran's necklace.^000000
scripts.translation: ^000099说完这句话，罗伯特消失回了反应堆。我手中拿着罗伯特的家园树叶和埃特兰的项链。^000000

scripts.text: ^000099With the energy from the golden leaf, my body and mind feel like they are rejuvenated. Gained experience points and job experience points.^000000
scripts.translation: ^000099借助黄金树叶的能量，我的身心仿佛焕然一新。获得了经验值和职业经验值。^000000

scripts.text: ^000099The rift reactor is lying here. I guess I don't have use for it right now.^000000
scripts.translation: ^000099裂隙反应堆躺在这里。我想我现在还用不上它。^000000

scripts.text: ^000099Now, the rift reactor could be used to look at the past, present, or other dimensions. Let's take a look at it whenever necessary. ^000000
scripts.translation: ^000099现在，裂隙反应堆可以用来查看过去、现在或其他维度。等需要的时候再看看吧。^000000

scripts.text:
[???]
A person like you who doesn't know the power of love is destitute!!
scripts.translation:
[???]
像你这样不知道爱的力量的人，真是可怜！！

scripts.text: ^000099It's been a while since I felt that about myself. Yes, indeed... This machine is getting on my nerves.^000000
scripts.translation: ^000099我已经很久没有对自己产生这种感觉了。没错...这台机器真是让我心烦意乱。^000000

scripts.text:
[???]
CHTTTTSTATIC~~~~ ANG!?~~ CHTTTTT ~ oh my shoulder!!
scripts.translation:
[???]
CHTTTTSTATIC~~~~ ANG!?~~ CHTTTTT ~ 我的肩膀！！

scripts.text: ^000099Oh, I'm sorry. I'm going to leave this channel.^000000
scripts.translation: ^000099哦，抱歉。我要离开这个频道了。^000000

scripts.text: ^000099Etran's sad legend^000000

[Etran]
Hey Robert, do you know? My sad expression... There is a sad legend here.
scripts.translation:
[埃特兰]
嘿，罗伯特，你知道吗？我这张悲伤的表情...这里有一个悲伤的传说。

scripts.text:
[Robert]
I don't believe in myths.
scripts.translation:
[罗伯特]
我不相信神话。

scripts.text:
[Etran]
The person who drew me. He couldn't get into it when he was drawing the sad expression.
scripts.translation:
[埃特兰]
画我的人。他在画这张悲伤的表情时，怎么也画不出来。

scripts.text:
[Robert]
Wait a minute! What are you trying to say. If you are trying to say something dangerous for the present time, you should let it be!!
scripts.translation:
[罗伯特]
等一下！你想说什么？如果你是想说一些对现在来说很危险的话，那就别说了！！

scripts.text:
[Etran]
Nah~ why not? This trascends time and space. Where else would I talk about it?
scripts.translation:
[埃特兰]
不~为什么不行？这超越了时间和空间。我还能在哪里谈论它呢？

scripts.text:
[Robert]
Hm, ok fine. If that's the case, let's just hear the rest of that story. So what happened to that Mr. L?
scripts.translation:
[罗伯特]
嗯，好吧。既然这样，那就听听剩下的故事吧。那么，那位L先生后来怎么样了？

scripts.text:
[Etran]
(This guy mentioned his initial! Ok, this guy is making it more dangerous than I am!!) He took out equipments from the storage to see if he wants to refine them.
scripts.translation:
[埃特兰]
(这家伙提到了他的首字母！好吧，这家伙比我更危险！！)他从仓库里取出装备，看看是否想要精炼它们。

scripts.text:
[Robert]
So he broke them.
scripts.translation:
[罗伯特]
所以他把它们弄坏了。

scripts.text:
[Etran]
He did...
scripts.translation:
[埃特兰]
他确实...弄坏了。

scripts.text:
[Robert]
Kekekeke...
scripts.translation:
[罗伯特]
呵呵呵呵...

scripts.text:
[Etran]
His expression then is this one here. Isn't it sad?
scripts.translation:
[埃特兰]
他当时的表情就是这张。是不是很悲伤？

scripts.text:
[Robert]
Sorry I laughed.
scripts.translation:
[罗伯特]
抱歉，我笑了。

scripts.text: ^000099What if Etran and Robert were the prisoner and the guard?^000000
scripts.translation: ^000099如果埃特兰和罗伯特是囚犯和卫兵呢？^000000

scripts.text:
[Etran]
Hey Guard~ I think the humidity here is too high. My skin is gonna be ruined. Is that ok? Huh?
scripts.translation:
[埃特兰]
嘿，卫兵~我觉得这里的湿度太高了。我的皮肤要毁了。这可以吗？嗯？

scripts.text:
[Robert]
Wash your face.
scripts.translation:
[罗伯特]
洗洗脸。

scripts.text:
[Etran]
Oh...
scripts.translation:
[埃特兰]
哦...

scripts.text: ^000099Etran and Robert were put to work as cat merchants.^000000
scripts.translation: ^000099埃特兰和罗伯特被安排去当猫商人。^000000

scripts.text:
[Etran]
Welcome welcomeow~! We are cat merchants, always serving guests as our kingeow~! Special sale! One piece of meat for 200 Zeny!!
scripts.translation:
[埃特兰]
欢迎欢迎喵~！我们是猫商人，永远像国王一样招待客人喵~！特价促销！一块肉只要200 Zeny！！

scripts.text:
[Robert]
......

[Etran]
If you buy it now, we will also give you 3 canned foodseow!! Buy lotseow!!!
scripts.translation:
[埃特兰]
现在买的话，我们还送3罐猫粮喵！！多买点多买喵！！！

scripts.text:
[Robert]
......

[Etran]
(Hey, Robert! Don't just stand there and imitate a cat or something! If you just stand still, we are gonna be kicked out!)
scripts.translation:
[埃特兰]
（喂，罗伯特！别光站在那里装猫啊！你一直不动的话，我们会被赶出去的！）

scripts.text:
[Robert]
GRRRRRR....
scripts.translation:
[罗伯特]
呜呜呜....

scripts.text:
[Robert]
......

[Etran]
A dog?...
scripts.translation:
[埃特兰]
一只狗？...

scripts.text: ^000099Etran and Robert were placed in a Flight machine.^000000
scripts.translation: ^000099埃特兰和罗伯特被安置在一架飞行机器里。^000000

scripts.text:
[Robert]
......

[Etran]
Hey Robert, don't you love this machine that flies in the air?
scripts.translation:
[埃特兰]
嘿，罗伯特，你不喜欢这台在空中飞的机器吗？

scripts.text:
[Robert]
......

[Etran]
Huh? Why are you looking so green? What's wrong?
scripts.translation:
[埃特兰]
咦？你怎么脸色这么绿？怎么了？

scripts.text:
[Robert]
Etran, I was looking for a restroom here.
scripts.translation:
[罗伯特]
埃特兰，我在找这里的洗手间。

scripts.text:
[Etran]
Ok, so what about the restroom.
scripts.translation:
[埃特兰]
好的，那洗手间在哪里。

scripts.text:
[Robert]
They don't have one here. No restrooms here.
scripts.translation:
[罗伯特]
这里没有。这里没有洗手间。

scripts.text: ^000099We will be arriving at Izlude Airport in 6 hours. ^000000
scripts.translation: ^000099我们将在6小时后抵达依斯鲁得岛机场。^000000

scripts.text:
[Etran]
Hahahha, I can't keep myself from laughing after listening to you.
scripts.translation:
[埃特兰]
哈哈哈哈哈，听你说话我忍不住想笑。

scripts.text:
[Robert]
Ughh....
scripts.translation:
[罗伯特]
呜....

scripts.text:
[Etran]
Let us go as we are to Izlude!!!
scripts.translation:
[埃特兰]
让我们就这样去依斯鲁得岛吧！！！

scripts.text:
[Robert]
......
^000099Iron Chef Robert^000000

[Robert]
I'm going to bake a pie now.
scripts.translation:
[罗伯特]
我现在要去烤一个派。

scripts.text:
[Etran]
Really really?
Are you going to add some blueberries too? I love blueberry pies!
scripts.translation:
[埃特兰]
真的吗真的吗？
你会加蓝莓吗？我超爱蓝莓派的！

scripts.text:
[Robert]
Of course. I'm also going to add some raspberries from morning and add some syrup too.
scripts.translation:
[罗伯特]
当然。我还打算加一些早上摘的覆盆子，再加点糖浆。

scripts.text:
[Etran]
Really really?
Raspberries will add that berry citrus flavor!! I love raspberry pies! How many are you baking? Isn't two just too little?
scripts.translation:
[埃特兰]
真的吗真的吗？
覆盆子能增添那种浆果的酸甜风味！！我超爱覆盆子派的！你要烤几个？只烤两个是不是太少了？

scripts.text:
[Robert]
I'm going to bake 1. You aren't getting one.
scripts.translation:
[罗伯特]
我只烤一个。你吃不到。

scripts.text:
[Etran]
Huh??....
^000099Robert actually likes beer.^000000

[Robert]
Oh man~ I'm craving for some chilled beer and yakitori back in the human world~
scripts.translation:
[罗伯特]
哎呀~好想喝点冰啤酒，再吃点人间的烤串~

scripts.text:
[Etran]
Robert! Robert! Did you see the new yakitori place here? They are doing a grand opening sale today! Let's go eat some!
scripts.translation:
[埃特兰]
罗伯特！罗伯特！你看到这里新开的那家烤串店了吗？今天开业大酬宾哦！我们去吃吧！

scripts.text:
[Robert]
(Really, they actually sell that here?)
How could you be talking about beer? You should be ashamed of yourself, Etran~
scripts.translation:
[罗伯特]
（真的，这里居然有卖那个？）
你怎么能提啤酒呢？真是不害臊，埃特兰~

scripts.text:
[Etran]
Huh?... You don't like beer, Robert?
scripts.translation:
[埃特兰]
诶？...你不喜欢啤酒吗，罗伯特？

scripts.text:
[Robert]
That's just something that humans drink. You go ahead. I don't really care for it.
scripts.translation:
[罗伯特]
那只是人类喝的。你去喝吧。我不太在意这个。

scripts.text:
[Etran]
Ok. Oh well then.
scripts.translation:
[埃特兰]
好吧。那算了。

scripts.text:
[Robert]
But do they have good yakitori there?
scripts.translation:
[罗伯特]
不过那里的烤串好吃吗？

scripts.text:
[Etran]
Yeah!! Totally good! Do you want to go? Huh?
scripts.translation:
[埃特兰]
好吃！！超级好吃！你想去吗？诶？

scripts.text:
[Robert]
Well, it's not that I really want yakitori or anything, but....
scripts.translation:
[罗伯特]
嗯，也不是说我真的特别想吃烤串，但是....

scripts.text:
[Etran]
Yayyy!!!!
^000099Robert the cook^000000

[Robert]
MmmMmm~ Smells so good.
scripts.translation:
[罗伯特]
嗯嗯~闻起来好香。

scripts.text:
[Robert]
Etran is going to be back soon. By then, it should be ready.
scripts.translation:
[罗伯特]
埃特兰很快就回来了。到时候应该刚好能做好。

scripts.text:
[Robert]
Ah~ very good. Look at this perfect pie. The fragrance is amazing, too. Should I taste it a bit?
scripts.translation:
[罗伯特]
啊~真不错。看这个完美的派。香气也绝了。要不要尝一口？

scripts.text:
[Robert]
Hmm.. No.
I'll eat it with him when Etran comes home.
scripts.translation:
[罗伯特]
嗯..算了。
等埃特兰回家了一起吃吧。

scripts.text: ^000099Robert who went over to Etran's house with the pie.^000000
scripts.translation: ^000099带着派去埃特兰家的罗伯特。^000000

scripts.text:
[Etran's Notice]
Welcome to Etran's home! I went to Bifrost to water some plants! It's going to take at least two days because the land is so large. Any gifts can be left at the door.
scripts.translation:
[埃特兰的告示]
欢迎来到埃特兰的家！我去双层牛肉堡浇花了！因为地皮太大，至少需要两天时间。如果有礼物，可以放在门口。

scripts.text:
[Etran's Notice]
Oh, I'm sure there won't be anyone with gifts. Especially nothing like Robert bringing a nicely baked pie, hahaha.
scripts.translation:
[埃特兰的告示]
哦，肯定没人会带礼物来的。尤其是像罗伯特那样带着烤得完美的派，哈哈哈。

scripts.text:
[Robert]
Ok, I didn't! My gosh, I didn't bake the pie!!!
scripts.translation:
[罗伯特]
喂，我没有！天哪，我才没有烤那个派！！！

scripts.text: ^000099Childhood friends, Etran and Robert^000000
scripts.translation: ^000099青梅竹马，埃特兰和罗伯特^000000

scripts.text:
[Robert]
Hey, why are you crying like that?
scripts.translation:
[罗伯特]
嘿，你为什么在那哭？

scripts.text:
[Etran]
Sob sob...Dona of the same class are making fun of my size and calling me a Papang...
scripts.translation:
[埃特兰]
呜呜...同班的唐娜在嘲笑我的身高，还叫我帕潘...

scripts.text:
[Robert]
That's all it was? Just because they call you a Papang, it doesn't mean you, a Dona, will turn into a Papang! Those guys just wanted to see you cry. Why don't you stop crying?
scripts.translation:
[罗伯特]
就这点事？就算他们叫你帕潘，你身为唐娜也不会变成帕潘的！那些家伙只是想看你哭而已。别哭了行不行？

scripts.text:
[Etran]
Sob...
scripts.translation:
[埃特兰]
呜呜...

scripts.text:
[Robert]
Really now... You cry too often.
scripts.translation:
[罗伯特]
真是的...你哭得太频繁了。

scripts.text:
[Etran]
I wish I was as calm and cool as you were, Robert.
scripts.translation:
[埃特兰]
我真想变得像你一样冷静又酷，罗伯特。

scripts.text:
[Robert]
Psh, you are 100 years too early to be as cool as I am...
scripts.translation:
[罗伯特]
呸，想变得像我这么酷，你还早了一百年...

scripts.text:
[Robert]
^FF0000This is the place where those kids who make fun of Etran hang out often. Shall I see who they are?^000000
scripts.translation:
[罗伯特]
^FF0000这里是那些嘲笑埃特兰的小孩经常出没的地方。要不要我去看看他们是谁？^000000

scripts.text: ^000099Nobody knows why, but it was told that the Laphines who made fun of Etran were hospitalized for 4 weeks.^000000
scripts.translation: ^000099没人知道为什么，但据说嘲笑埃特兰的拉菲娜们住院了4周。^000000

scripts.text:
[Etran]
You shouldn't be a kid like this~ School violence is an unforgivable crime. Friends should stay away from violence and spend good times together.
scripts.translation:
[埃特兰]
你不应该像个孩子这样~校园暴力是不可饶恕的罪行。朋友应该远离暴力，一起度过美好的时光。

scripts.text: ^000099In boiling water~ 3 minutes~ ... Static static^000000
^0000993 minutes in boiling water... What after that. Does it mean it will die 3 minutes in boiling water? Do I pour the boiling water over a monster or something?^000000
scripts.translation: ^000099沸水中3分钟...然后呢。意思是它在沸水中3分钟就会死吗？我要把沸水倒在魔物身上吗？^000000

scripts.text: ^000099Houston~ Houston~ This is CHTTTCHTTT~ We see a large tower and a tree. It seems like there are life forms here on this planet as well~ STATIC~ ^000000
scripts.translation: ^000099休斯顿~休斯顿~这里是CHTTTCHTTT~我们看到了一座大塔和一棵树。这个星球上似乎也有生命体~滋滋~ ^000000

scripts.text: ^000099Some desperate voices are heard. Not sure what the words, planets and life forms, are referring to.^000000
scripts.translation: ^000099听到了一些绝望的声音。不确定那些关于词语、星球和生命体的话是什么意思。^000000

scripts.text: ^000099There's too much static. Try adjusting the frequency. ^000000
scripts.translation: ^000099杂音太多了。试着调整一下频率。^000000

scripts.text: ^000099The work desk is a huge mess.^000000

[Fili]
It's always so beautiful with flowers blooming everywhere.
scripts.translation:
[菲利]
到处都是盛开的花朵，总是这么美。

scripts.text:
[Fili]
Are the adventurers doing okay? Don't forget to check all three of them~
scripts.translation:
[菲利]
冒险者们还好吗？别忘了确认那三个人的情况哦~

scripts.text:
[Fili]
Thank goodness they're all okay. What a relief. But did they tell you when they'll be out?
scripts.translation:
[菲利]
谢天谢地，大家都没事。真是让人放心。不过，他们有没有告诉你什么时候出来？

scripts.text:
[Fili]
Do you see the tower here? I don't know when it was built or who built it, but I heard it's been here since forever.
scripts.translation:
[菲利]
你看到这里的塔了吗？我不知道它是什么时候建的，也不知道是谁建的，但我听说它已经存在很久了。

scripts.text:
[Fili]
Four Laphines are preparing to work today. Make sure you tell every one of them.
scripts.translation:
[菲利]
今天有四只拉菲涅准备开始工作。请务必告诉它们每一个人。

scripts.text:
[Fili]
Ahng!? I think they already started the work. The field is breathing again. There are many stories to this field, you know.
scripts.translation:
[菲利]
啊？！我想它们已经开始工作了。这片大地又恢复了呼吸。这片大地有很多故事，你知道吗。

scripts.text:
[Fili]
Now that I see...you're a traveler, right? Sorry, I can't really notice anything unless I'm interested.
scripts.translation:
[菲利]
现在我看出来了...你是旅行者，对吧？抱歉，除非我感兴趣，否则我很难注意到什么。

scripts.text:
[Fili]
Look at this beautiful field filled with little blades of grass and twigs breathing!
scripts.translation:
[菲利]
看看这片美丽的田野，长满了小草和树枝，正在呼吸呢！

scripts.text:
[Fili]
Looking at this beautiful field, the song sings itself~
scripts.translation:
[菲利]
看着这片美丽的田野，歌声仿佛在脑海中响起~

scripts.text: [Fili]
scripts.translation: [菲利]

scripts.text:
[Fili]
Take a look at this beautiful field. It feels like you can hear each twig and blade of grass singing, right?
scripts.translation:
[菲利]
看看这片美丽的田野。感觉能听到每一根树枝和每一根小草在歌唱，对吧？

scripts.text: Start a conversation
scripts.translation: 开始对话

scripts.text: Laphine that loves the earth
scripts.translation: 热爱大地的拉菲涅

scripts.text: Asking after adventurers
scripts.translation: 询问冒险者的情况

scripts.text:
[Fili]
What is Eclage like? It's such a nice place.
scripts.translation:
[菲利]
埃克拉珠是什么样的地方？那里是个好地方。

scripts.text:
[Fili]
People wouldn't hate or hold each other at knife point if their hearts are filled with love for flowers and the earth.
scripts.translation:
[菲利]
如果心中充满了对花朵和大地的爱，人们就不会互相憎恨，也不会把刀架在彼此脖子上。

scripts.text:
[Fili]
You should avoid going into the tower. It's dangerous. We can't do much for the ones who have already entered, though.
scripts.translation:
[菲利]
你应该避免进入塔里。那里很危险。不过，对于已经进去的人，我们也无能为力。

scripts.text:
[Fili]
Glad you're here. We're about to start working again. Would you help us?
scripts.translation:
[菲利]
很高兴你在这里。我们要开始工作了。你愿意帮忙吗？

scripts.text:
[Fili]
I appreciate what you did last time. The earth seemed to be in a good mood, too. I could just feel it. Would you mind helping us again?
scripts.translation:
[菲利]
我很感激你上次的帮助。大地似乎心情也不错，我能感觉到。你介意再帮我们要忙吗？

scripts.text:
[Fili]
It seems like the earth is feeling well right now. A little break would be nice.
scripts.translation:
[菲利]
看起来大地现在感觉很好。稍微休息一下也不错。

scripts.text:
[Fili]
There are four in the work group. Don't forget to tell everyone.
scripts.translation:
[菲利]
工作组里有四个人。别忘了告诉大家。

scripts.text:
[Fili]
Thanks. Can you hear the earth singing? The sound of flowers and trees dancing in the wind. You'll hear it someday.
scripts.translation:
[菲利]
谢谢。你能听到大地在歌唱吗？那是花朵和树木在风中起舞的声音。总有一天你会听到的。

scripts.text:
[Fili]
There are three adventurers in the tower still. I understand they have their own reasons, but I can't help worrying about them.
scripts.translation:
[菲利]
塔里还有三个冒险者。我知道他们有自己的理由，但我忍不住担心他们。

scripts.text:
[Fili]
I don't have any responsibility. But the earth will be sad if any of the adventurers gets hurt here.
scripts.translation:
[菲利]
我并没有责任。但如果这里的任何冒险者受伤，大地会难过的。

scripts.text:
[Fili]
We should go check if the adventurers are okay.
scripts.translation:
[菲利]
我们应该去看看冒险者是否安好。

scripts.text:
[Fili]
Should I say it's a relief that they're all alive...? Well...at least it's good that they're still alive.
scripts.translation:
[菲利]
应该说他们还活着是个解脱...？嗯...至少他们还活着就好。

scripts.text:
[Fili]
I'm glad they're all safe and sound. I'll be relieved if they finish their business quickly and go back...Thanks anyway!
scripts.translation:
[菲利]
很高兴他们都安然无恙。如果他们能尽快办完事回去，我就放心了...谢谢！

scripts.text: [Fili]
scripts.translation: [菲利]

scripts.text: Sure!
scripts.translation: 当然！

scripts.text: I'm sorry, I can't
scripts.translation: 抱歉，我做不到

scripts.text:
[Fili]
Thanks so much! Tell Laphines to start working!
scripts.translation:
[菲利]
非常感谢！告诉拉菲妮丝开始工作吧！

scripts.text:
[Fili]
Do you hear the voice of the earth fading to a whisper? Looks like it's not feeling well today.
scripts.translation:
[菲利]
你听到大地微弱如耳语的声音吗？看起来它今天感觉不太好。

scripts.text: [Fili]
scripts.translation: [菲利]

scripts.text:
[Fili]
We should do something to bring cheer to the earth at a time like this!
scripts.translation:
[菲利]
在这种时候，我们应该做点什么让大地开心起来！

scripts.text:
[Fili]
Please, make sure you check how the adventurers are doing. Who knows, you'll get some help from them in the future.
scripts.translation:
[菲利]
请一定要确认冒险者的状况。说不定将来你会从他们那里得到帮助。

scripts.text:
[Fili]
Will you help checking the safety of the adventurers today?
scripts.translation:
[菲利]
你今天愿意帮忙确认冒险者的安全吗？

scripts.text: Sure, I'm an adventurer, too!
scripts.translation: 当然，我也是冒险者！

scripts.text: Sorry, I'm kind of tired today.
scripts.translation: 抱歉，我今天有点累。

scripts.text:
[Fili]
Thanks! Make sure all three of the adventurers are doing well!
scripts.translation:
[菲利]
谢谢！确保那三个冒险者都安好！

scripts.text:
[Fili]
Hmm, it's unfortunate, but I guess it can't be helped. I'm worried though, especially for the one who was singing.
scripts.translation:
[菲利]
嗯，这很遗憾，但我也没办法。我很担心，尤其是那个在唱歌的人。

scripts.text: [Fili]
scripts.translation: [菲利]

scripts.text:
[Fili]
Hmm...I can't just ignore them though...
scripts.translation:
[菲利]
嗯...但我不能就这样无视他们...

scripts.text: The adventurer on the third floor is starving!
scripts.translation: 三楼的冒险者饿坏了！

scripts.text:
[Fili]
Seriously...I can't believe it's an adventurer. Would you mind giving it some food if you have any?
scripts.translation:
[菲利]
真是的...难以置信，竟然是一个冒险者。如果你手头有食物，能分给他一些吗？

scripts.text:
[Fili]
Let's see...this is all I've got. It's not much, but hopefully it'll help him.
scripts.translation:
[菲利]
让我看看...这就是全部了。虽然不多，但希望能帮到他。

scripts.text:
[Fili]
I should start checking their safety regularly. Stop by again later, please.
scripts.translation:
[菲利]
我应该定期去检查他们的安全。请稍后再来。

scripts.text:
[Fili]
And we're trying to stop travelers going into the tower since there are monsters inside.
scripts.translation:
[菲利]
而且我们正在阻止旅行者进入中央塔，因为里面有魔物。

scripts.text:
[Fili]
But you know, travelers...they want to go even more if it's dangerous.
scripts.translation:
[菲利]
但你知道的，旅行者...越是危险的地方，他们越想进去。

scripts.text:
[Fili]
^FF0000three adventurers^000000went into the tower recently. I'm not sure if they're still alive...
scripts.translation:
[菲利]
^FF0000三名冒险者^000000最近进入了中央塔。我不确定他们是否还活着...

scripts.text:
[Fili]
I should have tried harder to stop them...Could you go check if they're safe and sound?
scripts.translation:
[菲利]
我应该更努力阻止他们的...你能去检查一下他们是否平安吗？

scripts.text: I'll do it! I'm an adventurer, too!
scripts.translation: 我会去的！我也是冒险者！

scripts.text: Sorry, I can't do it right now.
scripts.translation: 抱歉，我现在做不到。

scripts.text:
[Fili]
Good. There are three adventurers in the tower right now.
scripts.translation:
[菲利]
很好。现在中央塔里有三名冒险者。

scripts.text:
[Fili]
It's nothing urgent, but I'm worried about the adventurers.
scripts.translation:
[菲利]
虽然不紧急，但我担心那些冒险者。

scripts.text: [Fili]
scripts.translation: [菲利]

scripts.text:
[Fili]
The first adventurer went inside just now. He's pretty young and I gave him a good scolding. You'll find him in just a few minutes.
scripts.translation:
[菲利]
第一名冒险者刚刚进去。他很年轻，我好好教训了他一顿。你几分钟内就能找到他。

scripts.text:
[Fili]
The second adventurer seemed like an uptight lady. I wonder how she's doing.
scripts.translation:
[菲利]
第二名冒险者看起来像是一位严肃的女士。不知道她怎么样了。

scripts.text:
[Fili]
The third adventurer is the problem here...I don't know what he's doing but he's been inside for about a month now.
scripts.translation:
[菲利]
第三名冒险者是个麻烦...我不知道他在做什么，但他已经在里面待了大约一个月了。

scripts.text:
[Fili]
He said proudly that he'll be out in a second and took his instrument to make a song inside the tower. But I haven't heard from him since then. Please look for him.
scripts.translation:
[菲利]
他自豪地说他马上就会出来，然后带着乐器进中央塔唱歌去了。但我从那以后就没听到他的消息了。请去找找他。

scripts.text:
[Fili]
They're all preparing somewhere in the field.
scripts.translation:
[菲利]
他们都在田野里的某个地方准备着。

scripts.text:
[Fili]
You'll be able to hear its story from somewhere if you love flower, trees, and Laphines.
scripts.translation:
[菲利]
如果你喜爱花儿、树木和拉芬，你会在某个地方听到他们的故事。

scripts.text:
[Fili]
I think their work for the field is finished for the day. By the way, ^FF0000there's another work. Ask about it if you're interested.^000000
scripts.translation:
[菲利]
我想他们今天的田野工作已经结束了。顺便说一下，^FF0000还有另一项工作。如果你感兴趣，可以问问看。^000000

scripts.text:
[Fili]
I'll introduce myself first. My name is Fili and I'm a Laphine. I do a variety of work in Eclage. You can tell from these muscles, ahng?
scripts.translation:
[菲利]
我先自我介绍一下。我叫菲利，是一只拉芬。我在埃克拉珠做各种工作。从这些肌肉可以看出，对吧？

scripts.text: What's up with that 'ahng' sound you make?
scripts.translation: 你发出的那个'昂'音是怎么回事？

scripts.text:
[Fili]
It's just a habit, don't mind. Anyway, it's time to start the work for the day...you're a traveler, right? Can you help me?
scripts.translation:
[菲利]
这只是个习惯，别介意。总之，该开始今天的工作了...你是旅行者吧？能帮帮我吗？

scripts.text: See what kind of work it is.
scripts.translation: 看看是什么工作。

scripts.text: Tell him you're busy.
scripts.translation: 告诉他你很忙。

scripts.text:
[Fili]
Ahng? It's simple. Tell Laphines that are scattered all over the field to start today's work.
scripts.translation:
[菲利]
昂？很简单。告诉散布在田野各处的拉芬，开始今天的工作。

scripts.text:
[Fili]
Ahng? Well, too bad. But if you have time later, please drop by. I could use a little help here.
scripts.translation:
[菲利]
昂？哎呀，真遗憾。不过如果你之后有空，请过来看看。我这里需要一点帮助。

scripts.text: [Fili]
scripts.translation: [菲利]

scripts.text:
[Fili]
Laphines love this field, and in their own ways, they're sharing their energy with trees, grasses, winds, and the earth.
scripts.translation:
[菲利]
拉芬们热爱这片田野，它们以自己的方式，将能量分享给树木、草地、风和大地。

scripts.text:
[Fili]
We're not sure how much it actually helps. They're mysterious creatures, you know.
scripts.translation:
[菲利]
我们不确定这到底有多大帮助。它们是神秘的生物，你知道的。

scripts.text:
[Fili]
But we want to try anything that might help.
scripts.translation:
[菲利]
但我们想尝试任何可能有帮助的事情。

scripts.text:
[Fili]
It's something that I've been doing by myself usually. But now that my shoulder is injured, I can't really leave this place anymore. Help me, please.
scripts.translation:
[菲利]
这通常是我一个人做的。但现在我的肩膀受伤了，真的不能再离开这里了。请帮帮我。

scripts.text:
[Fili]
But for some reason, I feel like I can't hear them breathing anymore. So, little Laphines water and sing to cheer them up.
scripts.translation:
[菲利]
但不知为何，我感觉听不到它们的呼吸声了。所以，小拉芬们会浇水并唱歌来让它们振作起来。

scripts.text:
[Fili]
I think it's time for Laphines to start today's work.
scripts.translation:
[菲利]
我想是时候让拉芬们开始今天的工作了。

scripts.text:
[Singing Laphine]
Whew, did I sing too much? I'm so thirsty. A glass of rice wine sounds great, hah~
scripts.translation:
[唱歌的拉菲尼]
呼，我是不是唱太多了？好渴啊。来杯米酒就好了，哈~

scripts.text:
[Singing Laphine]
Did the great Fili send you? Man, he's got skills for sure! I shall start singing then!?
scripts.translation:
[唱歌的拉菲尼]
是伟大的菲利派你来的吗？哇，他真有本事！那我开始唱歌了！

scripts.text:
[Singing Laphine]
I suppose you came to tell me to start working? Don't worry, my voice will touch the earth~
scripts.translation:
[唱歌的拉菲尼]
我想你是来叫我开始工作的吧？别担心，我的歌声会触动大地~

scripts.text:
[Singing Laphine]
Can you...hear the voice of the earth? It sounds very sad right now.
scripts.translation:
[唱歌的拉菲尼]
你能...听到大地的心声吗？它现在听起来很悲伤。

scripts.text:
[Singing Laphine]
I'm singing for flowers and the earth.
scripts.translation:
[唱歌的拉菲尼]
我在为花儿和大地唱歌。

scripts.text:
[Singing Laphine]
I think it's time to start singing...
scripts.translation:
[唱歌的拉菲尼]
我想是时候开始唱歌了...

scripts.text:
[Singing Laphine]
It feels great to sing for the earth.
scripts.translation:
[唱歌的拉菲尼]
为大地唱歌感觉真棒。

scripts.text: As soon as the Laphine started singing, it began to warm my heart.
scripts.translation: 拉菲尼一开始唱歌，我的心就感到温暖起来。

scripts.text:
[Watering Laphine]
I think the earth is running dry.
scripts.translation:
[浇水的拉菲尼]
我觉得大地快干涸了。

scripts.text:
[Watering Laphine]
I think this is enough for the day. I have to take a break and draw water, too. Hehe~!
scripts.translation:
[浇水的拉菲尼]
我觉得今天浇到这里就够了。我也得休息一下，去提点水。嘿嘿~！

scripts.text:
[Watering Laphine]
I'll water these dying flowers and grasses again. This brings them back to life! Hehe~!
scripts.translation:
[浇水的拉菲尼]
我要再给这些枯萎的花草浇水。这样它们就能恢复生机了！嘿嘿~！

scripts.text:
[Watering Laphine]
I'm watering here and there. You look so tired! Should I water you, too?
scripts.translation:
[浇水的拉菲尼]
我正在到处浇水呢。你看起来好累啊！要不要我也给你浇点水？

scripts.text:
[Watering Laphine]
I'm sure Eclage needs a Laphine like me! Hehe~!
scripts.translation:
[浇水的拉菲尼]
埃克拉珠肯定需要像我这样的拉菲尼！嘿嘿~！

scripts.text:
[Watering Laphine]
Oh, they started working? I'll start watering the earth then. I mean, sometimes we Laphines can be practical, too!
scripts.translation:
[浇水的拉菲尼]
哦，它们开始工作了？那我也开始给大地浇水吧。毕竟，我们拉菲尼有时候也是很务实的！

scripts.text:
[Watering Laphine]
Do you hear the sound of grasses and flowers coming alive again? It's all because I watered them diligently! Hehe~!
scripts.translation:
[浇水的拉菲尼]
你听到花草重新焕发生机的声音了吗？这都是因为我辛勤地给它们浇水！嘿嘿~！

scripts.text:
[Watering Laphine]
Hehe~! Now that I'm done watering, I should wait for the great Fili.
scripts.translation:
[浇水的拉菲尼]
嘿嘿~！浇完水了，我该等伟大的菲利了。

scripts.text:
[Watering Laphine]
It's my job to water the earth.
scripts.translation:
[浇水的拉菲尼]
给大地浇水是我的工作。

scripts.text:
[Dancing Laphine]
You mean the great Fili said to start the work? But why would he ask you to tell us?
scripts.translation:
[跳舞的拉菲尼]
你是说伟大的菲利让我们开始工作？但他为什么要让你来告诉我们呢？

scripts.text:
[Dancing Laphine]
It's important to warm up like this before you start dancing. One, two, three, four....
scripts.translation:
[跳舞的拉菲尼]
开始跳舞前像这样热身很重要。一、二、三、四....

scripts.text:
[Dancing Laphine]
I would love to see the great Fili next time...
scripts.translation:
[跳舞的拉菲尼]
我真希望能再次见到伟大的菲利...

scripts.text:
[Dancing Laphine]
Ah, it's you again! You're so insensitive. Anyway, you're here to tell me to start working, right? I see, I see. You can go now.
scripts.translation:
[跳舞的拉菲尼]
啊，又是你！你真是不解风情。总之，你是来让我开始工作的，对吧？我知道了，我知道了。你可以走了。

scripts.text:
[Dancing Laphine]
I can't dance well when adventurers like you are watching! Don't worry and just go~ I won't slack off on the job, okay?
scripts.translation:
[跳舞的拉菲尼]
有像你这样的冒险者看着，我跳不好舞的！别担心，快走吧~ 我工作时会全力以赴的，好吗？

scripts.text:
[Dancing Laphine]
I do Hip Hop dancing moves whenever I feel sad. Huh? Oh, it's a dance style. It's very elegant and it makes your heart ache.
scripts.translation:
[跳舞的拉菲尼]
每当感到悲伤时，我都会跳嘻哈舞。嗯？哦，那是一种舞蹈风格。它非常优雅，让人心痛。

scripts.text:
[Dancing Laphine]
I would really love to see the great Fili next time.
scripts.translation:
[跳舞的拉菲尼]
我真希望能再次见到伟大的菲利。

scripts.text:
[Dancing Laphine]
When the grasses sway in the wind, doesn't it look like they're actually dancing?
scripts.translation:
[跳舞的拉菲尼]
当草儿在风中摇曳时，看起来是不是就像在跳舞一样？

scripts.text:
[Dancing Laphine]
I could've showed Fili my new moves!
scripts.translation:
[跳舞的拉菲尼]
我本可以向菲利展示我的新舞步的！

scripts.text:
[Dancing Laphine]
Oh well, I'll just do the moves I was doing earlier today. You know, Fili should be the first one to see my new moves, so...
scripts.translation:
[跳舞的拉菲尼]
算了，我就跳今天早些时候跳的那些舞步吧。毕竟，菲利应该是第一个看到我的新舞步的人，所以...

scripts.text: So, how does dancing help the earth exactly...?
scripts.translation: 那么，跳舞具体是怎么帮助大地的呢...？

scripts.text:
[Dancing Laphine]
Look at you, a cold-hearted adventurer! All the Laphines living in this area can feel it. We hear the sounds of the earth and creatures.
scripts.translation:
[跳舞的拉菲尼]
瞧瞧你，真是冷酷无情的冒险者！
住在这片区域的所有拉菲尼都能感受到。
我们听得见大地和生灵的声音。

scripts.text:
[Dancing Laphine]
You'll see as you continue your adventure. Anyway, I'll start working now.
scripts.translation:
[跳舞的拉菲尼]
随着冒险的继续，你会明白的。
总之，我要开始工作了。

scripts.text:
[Cute Laphine]
What brings you here?
scripts.translation:
[可爱的拉菲尼]
你找我有事吗？

scripts.text:
[Cute Laphine]
Is this the first time that you're seeing a blooming field? It's so beautiful, just like me.
scripts.translation:
[可爱的拉菲尼]
这是你第一次看到花开满地的景象吗？
真美啊，就像我一样。

scripts.text:
[Cute Laphine]
It takes a cute person like me to bring joy to the earth...Too bad that you'll never be able to do so!
scripts.translation:
[可爱的拉菲尼]
像我这样可爱的人，才能给大地带来欢乐...
真可惜，你永远做不到！

scripts.text:
[Cute Laphine]
You're new, right? Tell him I'll start the work.
scripts.translation:
[可爱的拉菲尼]
你是新来的吧？
告诉他，我要开始工作了。

scripts.text:
[Cute Laphine]
You might think smiling to the earth always is nothing, but it's not that easy actually. I mean, it's hard to be cute like me in the first place~
scripts.translation:
[可爱的拉菲尼]
你可能觉得对大地微笑很简单，其实并不容易。
毕竟，像我这样可爱本身就很难~

scripts.text:
[Cute Laphine]
I hope someday the flowers, trees, grasses, and little creatures on this earth will smile with joy.
scripts.translation:
[可爱的拉菲尼]
我希望有一天，大地上的花朵、树木、小草和小动物们都能露出开心的笑容。

scripts.text:
[Cute Laphine]
Don't you always smile when you remember good memories of the past?
scripts.translation:
[可爱的拉菲尼]
想起过去的美好回忆时，你难道不会微笑吗？

scripts.text: I'm here at Fili's request.
scripts.translation: 我是受菲利之托来的。

scripts.text:
[Cute Laphine]
You mean you were asked a favor from the great Fili? Are you a new worker then?
scripts.translation:
[可爱的拉菲尼]
你是说，你接受了伟大菲利的委托？
那你就是新来的工人了？

scripts.text: No, I'm an adventurer
scripts.translation: 不，我是冒险者

scripts.text:
[Cute Laphine]
Don't be shy. I started working just recently, too. But since I was here first, I'm your boss, okay?!
scripts.translation:
[可爱的拉菲尼]
别害羞嘛。我也是最近才开始工作的。
不过既然我先来的，我就是你的老板，好吗？！

scripts.text:
[Cute Laphine]
So, what's your specialty?
scripts.translation:
[可爱的拉菲尼]
那么，你的特长是什么？

scripts.text:
[Cute Laphine]
We all love the earth, but we express it in different ways. Like, thorugh dancing or singing.
scripts.translation:
[可爱的拉菲尼]
我们都热爱大地，但表达方式各不相同。
比如，通过跳舞或唱歌。

scripts.text:
[Cute Laphine]
Looks like...you're not really good at anything!
scripts.translation:
[可爱的拉菲尼]
看起来...你好像没什么特长！

scripts.text: Well, what do you do then?
scripts.translation: 那你做什么呢？

scripts.text:
[Cute Laphine]
Oh come on~You're insensitive, too? Look at me, so cute and nice!
scripts.translation:
[可爱的拉菲尼]
哎呀~你也太迟钝了吧？
看看我，多可爱多好啊！

scripts.text:
[Cute Laphine]
My job is to share my smile with the earth. If I smile like this, I'm sure the earth will feel so much better!
scripts.translation:
[可爱的拉菲尼]
我的工作是把我的微笑分享给大地。
如果我这样微笑，大地一定会感觉好多了！

scripts.text:
[Cute Laphine]
Anyway, you should find some work for the earth as well. Tell Fili that I'll start working.
scripts.translation:
[可爱的拉菲尼]
总之，你也应该为大地找点事做。
告诉菲利，我要开始工作了。

scripts.text: As soon as he finished talking, he put on a bright smile.
scripts.translation: 他刚说完，脸上便露出了灿烂的笑容。

scripts.text:
[Rosi]
Anyway, this isn't an ordinary place. This place, it's filled with newsworthy stories!
scripts.translation:
[罗西]
总之，这里可不是什么普通的地方。
这里充满了值得报道的新闻！

scripts.text:
[Rosi]
Oh my gosh! You scared me! What are you doing here?
scripts.translation:
[罗西]
天哪！你吓到我了！
你在这里做什么？

scripts.text:
[Rosi]
It's you again! Oh, is it because I'm a woman? Let me make it clear here. I'm going nowhere until I get a news item.
scripts.translation:
[罗西]
又是你啊！
哦，是因为我是女子吗？
我在这里声明一下，在拿到新闻之前，我哪儿也不去。

scripts.text:
[Rosi]
I need to get a scoop. Something that will catch the eyes of adventurers!
scripts.translation:
[罗西]
我需要挖到一个独家新闻。
那种能吸引冒险者眼球的大新闻！

scripts.text:
[Rosi]
This tower is very quiet yet mysterious. It's definitely something that adventurers would love, right?
scripts.translation:
[罗西]
这座塔非常安静，却又充满神秘感。
这绝对是冒险者会喜欢的地方，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Rosi]
Gosh, you're just bugging me. Don't worry, I can take care of myself just fine!
scripts.translation:
[罗西]
真是的，你就别烦我了。
别担心，我完全能照顾好自己！

scripts.text:
[Rosi]
Don't worry, I'll get the biggest scoop of the year!
scripts.translation:
[罗西]
别担心，我会挖到今年最大的独家新闻的！

scripts.text: Explain the situation
scripts.translation: 解释情况

scripts.text:
[Rosi]
I see...I didn't know they're worried about me. But I can't go back now. I'm a journalist.
scripts.translation:
[罗西]
原来如此...我不知道他们这么担心我。
但我现在不能回去，我是记者。

scripts.text:
[Rosi]
I write news articles for adventurers for a magazaine called Monthly Brigan.
scripts.translation:
[罗西]
我为冒险者撰写新闻文章，
发表在名为《布里刊》的杂志上。

scripts.text:
[Rosi]
I had a hard time coming here, and I feel like I'll get an exclusive scoop here any minute! But it's just not happening yet...
scripts.translation:
[罗西]
我费了好大劲才来到这里，
感觉随时都能挖到独家新闻！
但就是还没发生...

scripts.text:
[Rosi]
Anyway, I'm doing well. Tell him not to worry about me.
scripts.translation:
[罗西]
总之，我过得很好。
告诉他别担心我。

scripts.text:
[Euncheong]
Don't take me lightly just because I'm young. I've already been to every part of Midgard continent. I'm a real adventurer, you know.
scripts.translation:
[恩清]
别因为我年轻就轻视我。
我已经去过米德加尔特大陆的每一个角落了。
我可是真正的冒险者，知道吗。

scripts.text:
[Euncheong]
You really shouldn't worry about me. I'll go out when I'm done exploring...Tell him I'm doing okay.
scripts.translation:
[恩清]
你真的不用为我担心。
等我探索完就会出去...告诉他我过得很好。

scripts.text:
[Euncheong]
Are you an adventurer, too? Don't you dare cut in here. I was here first.
scripts.translation:
[恩清]
你也是冒险者吗？
别插队，我先来的。

scripts.text:
[Euncheong]
I'm exploring every inch of the tower. I'll write about it in my memoirs later.
scripts.translation:
[恩清]
我正在探索这座塔的每一个角落。
之后我会把它写进我的回忆录里。

scripts.text:
[Euncheong]
You want my autograph? If not, please don't interrupt.
scripts.translation:
[恩清]
你想要我的签名吗？
如果没有，请不要打扰我。

scripts.text:
[Euncheong]
Don't worry about me. I'll be a great adventurer!
scripts.translation:
[恩清]
别担心我。
我会成为伟大的冒险者！

scripts.text:
[Euncheong]
This tower is mysterious. It's an interesting place.
scripts.translation:
[恩清]
这座塔很神秘。
是个有趣的地方。

scripts.text:
[Euncheong]
I shall leave to explore different parts now.
scripts.translation:
[恩清]
我要去探索其他区域了。

scripts.text: What do you mean? I didn't cut in!
scripts.translation: 你说什么？我没有插队！

scripts.text:
[Euncheong]
Well, I was exploring here first. So you should come back later. I'll be a great adventurer!
scripts.translation:
[恩清]
哼，明明是我先在这里探索的。你还是稍后再来吧。
我会成为伟大的冒险者！

scripts.text: Explain the situation
scripts.translation: 解释情况

scripts.text:
[Euncheong]
Hah, that Laphine must be very idle, worrying about an adventurer. He shouldn't worry about a guy who's going to be the king of adventurers!
scripts.translation:
[恩清]
哈哈，拉芬一定很闲，居然担心一个冒险者。
他不用担心我，我可是要成为冒险者之王的！

scripts.text: King of adventurers?
scripts.translation: 冒险者之王？

scripts.text:
[Euncheong]
I'll leave my footprints in every part of the world, find all kinds of treasures and hide them somewhere. Every adventurer will try to follow my path then!
scripts.translation:
[恩清]
我要把足迹遍布世界的每一个角落，
找到各种各样的宝物并藏起来。
到时候，所有冒险者都会追随我的脚步！

scripts.text:
[Euncheong]
If you get an autograph from me now, you might be able to feed three generations of your family in the future. How does it sound, you want one?
scripts.translation:
[恩清]
如果你现在拿到我的签名，
将来可能够养活你家三代人了。
听起来不错吧，想要一个吗？

scripts.text: Never mind, young boy.
scripts.translation: 算了，小鬼头。

scripts.text:
[Euncheong]
You certainly are a poor judge of character! Anyway, tell him not to worry about me. I'll be the king of adventurers! I shall go explore more then.
scripts.translation:
[恩清]
你真是看人真准啊！
总之，告诉他别担心我。
我会成为冒险者之王的！
那我去继续探索了。

scripts.text:
[New Oz]
Ah...What a relief...I'm so glad you're here. I was about to leave this tower alone! But I think I'm lost.
scripts.translation:
[新奥兹]
啊...真是松了口气...
很高兴你在这里。我差点就要独自离开这座塔了！
不过我觉得我迷路了。

scripts.text:
[New Oz]
Good to see you again, my friend!
scripts.translation:
[新奥兹]
很高兴再次见到你，我的朋友！

scripts.text:
[New Oz]
You're done collecting the bookmarks!? Full of reminiscences as expected. Everyone would love it!
scripts.translation:
[新奥兹]
你收集完书签了！？
果然充满回忆。大家一定会喜欢的！

scripts.text:
[New Oz]
Don't worry. I'm pretty much done writing a song. I'm almost done with the lyrics as well as the melody.
scripts.translation:
[新奥兹]
别担心。我写歌写得差不多了。
歌词和旋律都快完成了。

scripts.text:
[New Oz]
I've been thinking about it...and I think they would love ^FF0000bookmarks made of fallen leaves!^000000 It's full of reminiscences of the past! I'm sure!
scripts.translation:
[新奥兹]
我想了想...
我觉得大家会喜欢^FF0000用落叶做的书签！^000000
它充满了过去的回忆！我确信！

scripts.text:
[New Oz]
Good job! Now, let's enjoy the rest of...No! I mean, let's find a way out!
scripts.translation:
[新奥兹]
干得好！
现在，让我们享受剩下的...不！
我是说，让我们找条出路吧！

scripts.text:
[New Oz]
Of course I'm lost because I have a poor sense of direction...but there's another reason to it, too!
scripts.translation:
[新奥兹]
我迷路当然是因为方向感很差...
但还有另一个原因！

scripts.text:
[New Oz]
Yey it's meat! I loooove meat!
scripts.translation:
[新奥兹]
耶，是肉！
我超...超爱肉的！

scripts.text:
[New Oz]
I guess this is it for me...I had such a good life...
scripts.translation:
[新奥兹]
看来我命不久矣...
我这一生过得很充实...

scripts.text:
[New Oz]
Are you a...human? Cough cough.
scripts.translation:
[新奥兹]
你是...人类吗？
咳咳。

scripts.text:
[New Oz]
No need to worry about me! ^FF0000I'll definitely go home this time!^000000 Thanks for everything! I'll take you out for a nice meal next time!
scripts.translation:
[新奥兹]
不用为我担心！
^FF0000这次我一定会回家的！^000000
谢谢你的帮助！
下次我请你吃大餐！

scripts.text:
[New Oz]
Are you done yet? Well, I'm still working on the lyrics, too...but you have to hurry up. It's time to get out of here.
scripts.translation:
[新奥兹]
你忙完了吗？
我还在写歌词...
但你得快点，我们该出发了。

scripts.text:
[New Oz]
Ah...I guess this is the fear of death...memories of the past are going through my mind like a flash...like happy moments we had at the south gate of Prontera...
scripts.translation:
[新奥兹]
啊...我想这就是对死亡的恐惧吧...
过去的记忆如走马灯般掠过脑海...
就像我们在普隆德拉南门度过的那些快乐时光...

scripts.text:
[New Oz]
It doesn't have to be delicious...just give me any food...I feel so weak that I can't even walk.
scripts.translation:
[新奥兹]
不用太好...
给我点吃的就行...
我虚弱得连路都走不动了。

scripts.text:
[New Oz]
Ah, I felt so dizzy that my head was spinning before, and now I can't see anything at all! Is it night or day? I'm so hungry...
scripts.translation:
[新奥兹]
啊，刚才我头晕得眼前发黑...
现在什么都看不见了！
现在是白天还是黑夜？
我好饿...

scripts.text:
[New Oz]
A glass of red potion for breakfast~another glass of red potion for lunch~you're already addicted~ Ah, I'm too hungry to sing...
scripts.translation:
[新奥兹]
早餐一杯红色药水~
午餐一杯红色药水~
你已经上瘾啦~
啊，我饿得连歌都唱不动了...

scripts.text:
[New Oz]
I'm hungry again from walking around so much...I'm so hungry that I can't walk anymore.
scripts.translation:
[新奥兹]
走了这么多路，我又饿了...
饿得走不动路了。

scripts.text:
[New Oz]
Did I walk too much? I'm covered with dust again. It keeps covering my eyes.
scripts.translation:
[新奥兹]
我是不是走得太多了？
身上又沾满灰尘了。
灰尘一直迷我的眼睛。

scripts.text:
[New Oz]
Whew, I guess I was walking around really hard...somehow, I lost all the souvenirs they collected for me...
scripts.translation:
[新奥兹]
呼，看来我刚才走得太急了...
不知怎么的，
大家为我准备的纪念品全丢了...

scripts.text: I'm here to see if you're still alive.
scripts.translation: 来看看你还活着吗

scripts.text: Give him food
scripts.translation: 给他食物

scripts.text: Brush off the dust
scripts.translation: 拍掉灰尘

scripts.text: Gifts for friend
scripts.translation: 送给朋友的礼物

scripts.text:
[New Oz]
It's from that muscular Laphine, right? He's a good guy. Tell him not to worry about me.
scripts.translation:
[新奥兹]
这是那个肌肉发达的拉芬寄来的吧？
他是个好人。
请告诉他不用为我担心。

scripts.text:
[New Oz]
Ah, how long has it been since the last time I saw food! Yummm! Thank goodness it's meat! I think it's a little tough...and not warm enough...but still, it's meat!!
scripts.translation:
[新奥兹]
啊，距离上次吃东西已经过了多久了！
好吃！
谢天谢地是肉！
虽然有点硬...而且不够热...
但它是肉啊！！

scripts.text:
[New Oz]
Food...I need food...It seems as if the sky is falling...
scripts.translation:
[新奥兹]
食物...
我需要食物...
感觉天都要塌了...

scripts.text:
[New Oz]
Ah...I'm so glad that I met a good friend like you.
scripts.translation:
[新奥兹]
啊...能遇到像你这样的好朋友，真是太好了。

scripts.text:
[New Oz]
Hey, you really are a good adventurer! I'm actually starting to like you even more.
scripts.translation:
[新奥兹]
嘿，你真是个优秀的冒险者！
我越来越喜欢你了。

scripts.text:
[New Oz]
Eek! I was going to get out on my own while you were gone. But then I found something interesting...so I guess I was wandering around a little...
scripts.translation:
[新奥兹]
哎呀！
趁你不在的时候，我本来想自己出去的。
但我发现了一些有趣的东西...
所以我就到处逛了逛...

scripts.text:
[New Oz]
Thanks! Man, you're awesome! What a desirable and talented individual you are!
scripts.translation:
[新奥兹]
谢谢！
哇，你太棒了！
你真是既迷人又有才华的人！

scripts.text:
[New Oz]
Oh, come to think of it, I lost the bookmarks you collected for me...I mean the ones made of fallen leaves...I should collect them again...
scripts.translation:
[新奥兹]
哦，说起来，
我弄丢了你们为我收集的书签...
我是说那些用落叶做的书签...
我得再去收集一些...

scripts.text:
[New Oz]
When I came to myself, I realized that everything you brought me was gone! I thought I put it right here!
scripts.translation:
[新奥兹]
等我回过神来，发现你带给我的一切都不见了！
我明明放在这里的！

scripts.text: [New Oz]
scripts.translation: [新奥兹]

scripts.text:
[New Oz]
I really liked the meat you brought. Except that it wasn't really well seasoned and the texture was a little crumbly...but...it was still eatable, haha...
scripts.translation:
[新奥兹]
我真的很喜欢你带来的肉。
虽然调味不太够，口感也有点碎...
但...还是能吃的，哈哈...

scripts.text:
[New Oz]
As you can see...I couldn't find a way out of this tower again. And I'm so hungry that I feel like I might pass out...
scripts.translation:
[新奥兹]
你看...我又找不到离开这座塔的路了。
而且我饿得快要晕倒了...

scripts.text:
[New Oz]
Ahaha, no need to worry about me! I can do this by myself!
scripts.translation:
[新奥兹]
哈哈，别担心我！
我自己可以的！

scripts.text:
[New Oz]
These guys are not really visible and they're so annoying. Ah...I asked you to clean up, but it's not because I'm lazy or anything. Hahaha...
scripts.translation:
[新奥兹]
这些小东西不太显眼，但真的很烦人。
啊...我让你来清理，
并不是因为我懒什么的。哈哈...

scripts.text:
[New Oz]
I think I have enough souvenirs! They'll be surprised to see these souvenirs with lots of memories!
scripts.translation:
[新奥兹]
我觉得纪念品够多了！
看到这些充满回忆的纪念品，他们一定会很惊讶的！

scripts.text:
[New Oz]
I don't need that many. Maybe one for each of them?
scripts.translation:
[新奥兹]
我不需要那么多。
也许每人一份就够了？

scripts.text:
[New Oz]
I guess I'll have no problem finding my way out of this tower now. I'm full...and I just need to get a few more souvenirs...
scripts.translation:
[新奥兹]
我想现在离开这座塔应该没问题了。
我吃饱了...只需要再找几个纪念品...

scripts.text:
[New Oz]
I'll be fine if only I could get rid of those in my way, haha...We're almost out, right?
scripts.translation:
[新奥兹]
只要把挡路的东西弄走我就没事了，哈哈...
我们快出去了吧？

scripts.text:
[New Oz]
I'm starving to death though... Could you please help me, my friend?
scripts.translation:
[新奥兹]
但我饿得快要死了...
朋友，你能帮帮我吗？

scripts.text:
[New Oz]
Thank you so much!! Yum yum. You're such a good friend! Munch munch.
scripts.translation:
[新奥兹]
非常感谢！！
好吃好吃。
你真是好朋友！
嚼嚼嚼。

scripts.text:
[New Oz]
I should get a hustle on and find a way out now! I feel like I can get out of here this time!
scripts.translation:
[新奥兹]
我得赶紧找个出口！
感觉这次能出去了！

scripts.text:
[New Oz]
Cough! Cough! Meat...Cough! Meat...meat...
Seeing his eyes and hearing him coughing constantly, I can tell he needs something to eat, like meat.
scripts.translation:
看着他空洞的眼神和不断的咳嗽声，
我知道他需要吃点东西，比如肉。

scripts.text:
[New Oz]
I thought I was so close to getting out of this tower. But when I looked around, I was at the same place again.
scripts.translation:
[新奥兹]
我以为我快要走出这座塔了。
但环顾四周，我又回到了原地。

scripts.text:
[New Oz]
Maybe this tower is under a curse.
scripts.translation:
[新奥兹]
也许这座塔被诅咒了。

scripts.text: Or maybe it's just that you have a poor sense of direction?
scripts.translation: 或者只是你的方向感很差？

scripts.text:
[New Oz]
...I wouldn't really deny that. But anyway, could you get me something to eat? I'm starving...
scripts.translation:
[新奥兹]
...我确实不否认这一点。
但无论如何，你能给我弄点吃的吗？
我快饿死了...

scripts.text: Alright! I'll be back in a second!
scripts.translation: 好的！我马上回来！

scripts.text: Do it yourself!
scripts.translation: 你自己去！

scripts.text:
[New Oz]
Thanks. I prefer meat, if possible...I really liked what you gave me last time, and I think acorns go well with meat. Hahaha.
scripts.translation:
[新奥兹]
谢谢。如果可以的话，我更喜欢肉...上次你给我的东西我真的很喜欢，我觉得橡果和肉很搭。哈哈哈。

scripts.text: [New Oz]
scripts.translation: [新奥兹]

scripts.text:
[New Oz]
Okay...I see. I'll try to find another way then. If you meet that muscular Laphine on your way out, tell him I won't be able to see him again...
scripts.translation:
[新奥兹]
好吧...我明白了。那我试试找别的方法。如果你出去时遇到那个肌肉发达的拉芬，请告诉他，我再也见不到他了...

scripts.text: Why don't you just eat whatever I get you!
scripts.translation: 你就吃我拿给你的东西吧！

scripts.text:
[New Oz]
As long as I'm getting something to eat, I was just hoping for a good one. I'm sorry, but do me a favor please. I couldn't forget the taste of the meat.
scripts.translation:
[新奥兹]
只要是有吃的就行，我只是希望能吃点好的。抱歉，请帮个忙。我忘不了肉的味道。

scripts.text:
[New Oz]
I'll take care of the rest. I can't just keep bothering you, right? Hahaha.
scripts.translation:
[新奥兹]
剩下的我自己搞定。我不能一直麻烦你，对吧？哈哈哈。

scripts.text:
[New Oz]
And then these guys piled up again!
scripts.translation:
[新奥兹]
然后这些家伙又堆上来了！

scripts.text:
[New Oz]
Of course I can do it on my own~ But if I do it alone, then I'll end up using too much of my energy, and then I'll get hungry again...
scripts.translation:
[新奥兹]
我当然可以自己搞定~ 但如果我一个人做，就会消耗太多<死亡骑士>能量，然后又会饿...

scripts.text: So you want me to help you brushing off the dust?
scripts.translation: 所以你想让我帮你清理灰尘？

scripts.text: Do it yourself then!
scripts.translation: 那就你自己做吧！

scripts.text:
[New Oz]
How did you know? I think we're really clicking! If I have a chance, I'll let you join my guild later.
scripts.translation:
[新奥兹]
你怎么知道的？我觉得我们真的很合拍！如果有机会，以后我会让你加入我的公会。

scripts.text: [New Oz]
scripts.translation: [新奥兹]

scripts.text:
[New Oz]
I see. Just don't feel too guilty if you find me dead next time you're here. It's not your fault.
scripts.translation:
[新奥兹]
我明白了。如果你下次来这里发现我死了，请不要太自责。这不是你的错。

scripts.text:
[New Oz]
Fight off some Cherenes then. You don't have to eliminate that many because I'll start fighting soon, too! Haha.
scripts.translation:
[新奥兹]
去打败一些切雷涅斯吧。你不需要消灭那么多，因为我很快也会开始战斗！哈哈。

scripts.text:
[New Oz]
I hope to see you again in Midgard! We should team up and begin a great adventure together!
scripts.translation:
[新奥兹]
希望能在米德加尔特再次见到你！我们应该组队，一起开始伟大的冒险！

scripts.text:
[New Oz]
I'll make sure to give my friends all the souvenirs you collected for me, and I'll tell them about you, too!
scripts.translation:
[新奥兹]
我会把你为我收集的所有纪念品都给我的朋友们，我也会告诉他们关于你的事！

scripts.text:
[New Oz]
Would you mind helping me with that? What are friends for! Hahaha! Thanks!!
scripts.translation:
[新奥兹]
你介意帮我一下吗？朋友不就是用来互相帮忙的吗！哈哈哈！谢谢！！

scripts.text:
[New Oz]
I'm really really sorry, but could you help me again? Just the thought of seeing my friends makes me cry like this. Please~?
scripts.translation:
[新奥兹]
真的非常非常抱歉，你能再帮我一次吗？一想到要见我的朋友们，我就忍不住哭成这样。拜托了~？

scripts.text: What a poor guy! I'll help him.
scripts.translation: 真可怜！我帮他。

scripts.text: I can't take it anymore!
scripts.translation: 我受不了了！

scripts.text: [New Oz]
scripts.translation: [新奥兹]

scripts.text:
[New Oz]
Bookmarks made of fallen leaves...Ah, they bring so many memories back and make my eyes teary. I'm sure my friends will love it!
scripts.translation:
[新奥兹]
用落叶做的书签...啊，它们唤起了许多回忆，让我眼眶湿润。我相信我的朋友们会喜欢的！

scripts.text:
[New Oz]
I see...It's my fault. I'll probably end my life here, collecting souvenirs...but it's none of your business...
scripts.translation:
[新奥兹]
我明白了...是我的错。我可能会在这里结束生命，收集纪念品...但这与你无关...

scripts.text:
[New Oz]
I just finished writing a song. Do you want to listen?
scripts.translation:
[新奥兹]
我刚写完一首歌。你想听听吗？

scripts.text:
[New Oz]
^D96E26On that path again~I was wandering for a while~^000000
scripts.translation:
[新奥兹]
^D96E26又在那条路上徘徊~我游荡了好久~^000000

scripts.text:
[New Oz]
^D96E26Familiar dungeon~full of monsters~and hunger in a maze~^000000
scripts.translation:
[新奥兹]
^D96E26熟悉的迷宫~满是魔物~还有饥饿的纠缠~^000000

scripts.text:
[New Oz]
^D96E26when I was trying to run away~thankfully no monster was there~^000000
scripts.translation:
[新奥兹]
^D96E26当我试图逃跑~幸好那里没有魔物~^000000

scripts.text:
[New Oz]
^D96E26but I couldn't make it~that far~I was faint with hunger.^000000
scripts.translation:
[新奥兹]
^D96E26但我没能走远~我饿得快要晕倒了。^000000

scripts.text:
[New Oz]
So far so good, right? If you think it's similar to another song, it's just your imagination!
scripts.translation:
[新奥兹]
到目前为止还不错吧？如果你觉得它像另一首歌，那只是你的错觉！

scripts.text: I think it's excellent.
scripts.translation: 我觉得很棒

scripts.text: I think I've heard this before.
scripts.translation: 我觉得我听过

scripts.text: [New Oz]
scripts.translation: [新奥兹]

scripts.text:
[New Oz]
Thanks! If I have a chance, I'll make a song about how you helped me, too!
scripts.translation:
[新奥兹]
谢谢！如果有机会，我也会写一首关于你帮助我的歌！

scripts.text:
[New Oz]
Ahaha...really? You might be right...? Oh well, I'll make another one, don't worry...
scripts.translation:
[新奥兹]
啊哈哈...真的吗？也许你是对的...？算了，我会再写一首的，别担心...

scripts.text:
[New Oz]
I should really get going now. I've been to most parts of the tower and I'm pretty full, too.
scripts.translation:
[新奥兹]
我真的该走了。我已经去过中央塔的大部分地方，而且我也吃饱了。

scripts.text:
[New Oz]
Thanks again, my friend! I hope to see you again somewhere. I can find a way out on my own.
scripts.translation:
[新奥兹]
再次谢谢你，我的朋友！希望能在某处再见到你。我自己能找到出路。

scripts.text:
[New Oz]
^FF0000By the time you're done collecting souvenirs,^000000 I'll probably be done. Thanks again, my friend.
scripts.translation:
[新奥兹]
^FF0000等你收集完纪念品，^000000我大概也完成了。再次谢谢你，我的朋友。

scripts.text:
[New Oz]
If you look at the books scattered all over the tower, there are bookmarks inside. I think it'll be a great gift for my friends even though it has someone else's memories.
scripts.translation:
[新奥兹]
如果你看看散落在中央塔各处的书，里面都有书签。虽然那是别人的回忆，但我认为这对我的朋友来说会是份很棒的礼物。

scripts.text:
[New Oz]
^FF0000A good melody^000000 just came across my mind, and I think I should start writing a song now. You should collect souvenirs for me in the meantime.
scripts.translation:
[新奥兹]
^FF0000一个美妙的旋律^000000突然浮现在脑海中，我觉得现在应该开始写歌了。在此期间，你应该为我收集一些纪念品。

scripts.text:
[New Oz]
...but then, I feel like something's missing. I should bring some souvenirs since I'll probably never come here again, right?
scripts.translation:
[新奥兹]
...但是，我觉得少了点什么。既然我可能永远不会再来这里，我应该带些纪念品回去，对吧？

scripts.text:
[New Oz]
Actually...I feel like my friends would just get mad at me if I go back empty-handed.
scripts.translation:
[新奥兹]
其实...我觉得如果我空手回去，朋友们会生气的。

scripts.text:
[New Oz]
I should bring some souvenirs to make them feel better. Is there anything I could use?
scripts.translation:
[新奥兹]
我应该带些纪念品让他们开心一点。有什么我能用的吗？

scripts.text: Jellopy
scripts.translation: 杰勒比结晶

scripts.text: Lucky Egg
scripts.translation: 幸运蛋

scripts.text: Loots from local monsters
scripts.translation: 当地魔物的掉落物

scripts.text:
[New Oz]
Jellopies are good collectables...but I think it's a little too common. Is there anything else?
scripts.translation:
[新奥兹]
杰勒比结晶是很好的收藏品...但我觉得它太常见了。还有别的吗？

scripts.text: Baphomet Card
scripts.translation: 巴风特卡片

scripts.text: Loots from local monsters
scripts.translation: 当地魔物的掉落物

scripts.text:
[New Oz]
Hey... but it's not something we can get around here.
scripts.translation:
[新奥兹]
嘿...但这可不是我们这里能找到的东西。

scripts.text: Loots from local monsters
scripts.translation: 当地魔物的掉落物

scripts.text:
[New Oz]
Hmm? What's that for? I guess new items came out while I was travelling.
scripts.translation:
[新奥兹]
嗯？那是用来做什么的？看来我旅行的时候出了新道具。

scripts.text:
[New Oz]
I can't get them unless I know what they are. Is there anything else?
scripts.translation:
[新奥兹]
如果不知道它们是什么，我就没法弄到。还有别的吗？

scripts.text: Old Card Album
scripts.translation: 老旧 收集册

scripts.text: Loots from local monsters
scripts.translation: 当地魔物的掉落物

scripts.text:
[New Oz]
Card Album... I can't give my friends something that might be come up with nothing! Anything else?
scripts.translation:
[新奥兹]
卡片相册...我不能送给朋友一个可能一无所获的东西！还有别的吗？

scripts.text: Loots from local monsters
scripts.translation: 当地魔物的掉落物

scripts.text:
[New Oz]
Loots from local monsters...hmm, that sounds interesting!
scripts.translation:
[新奥兹]
当地魔物的掉落物...嗯，听起来很有趣！

scripts.text:
[New Oz]
I'm sure they haven't made it here yet. So it's something new for them, too! Right?
scripts.translation:
[新奥兹]
我相信它们还没被带到这里。所以这对他们来说也是新东西！对吧？

scripts.text:
[New Oz]
And it tells them where I've been to so far.
scripts.translation:
[新奥兹]
而且这能告诉他们我到目前为止去过哪些地方。

scripts.text:
[New Oz]
That's a good idea. Let's think about what to collect then.
scripts.translation:
[新奥兹]
这是个好主意。那我们想想收集什么吧。

scripts.text:
[New Oz]
You see those guys over there? I think they're stopping me from finding a way out for some reason.
scripts.translation:
[新奥兹]
你看到那边那些人了吗？我觉得他们似乎在阻止我找到出路。

scripts.text: I don't see anything.
scripts.translation: 我什么都没看到。

scripts.text:
[New Oz]
No, you have to see them carefully. Those Dustballs over there are covering my eyes, and when I can't see clearly, I get sleepy and hungry...
scripts.translation:
[新奥兹]
不，你得仔细看。那边的尘埃挡住了我的视线，当我看不清楚时，我就会犯困和饥饿...

scripts.text: I think it's just your imagination!
scripts.translation: 我觉得那是你的错觉！

scripts.text:
[New Oz]
No, no. I'm sure they're stopping me. Get rid of them, please. Maybe just a couple of them? I have some lyrics coming into my mind just now...so I should write them down...
scripts.translation:
[新奥兹]
不，不。我确定他们在阻止我。请把它们赶走。也许只要几个？我刚才脑海里浮现了一些歌词...所以我应该把它们写下来...

scripts.text:
[New Oz]
Yum yum. Munch munch. Yum yum!
scripts.translation:
[新奥兹]
好吃好吃。嚼嚼嚼。好吃好吃！

scripts.text:
[New Oz]
Munch munch. Yum yum yum. Munch munch
scripts.translation:
[新奥兹]
嚼嚼嚼。好吃好吃好吃。嚼嚼嚼

scripts.text:
[New Oz]
Man, it's so good! This is it! Yum yum.
scripts.translation:
[新奥兹]
天哪，真好吃！就是这个味道！好吃好吃。

scripts.text:
[New Oz]
If I find a way out, I should make a song for that muscular Laphine. Yum yum.
scripts.translation:
[新奥兹]
如果我找到了出路，我应该为那个肌肉发达的拉芬写首歌。好吃好吃。

scripts.text:
[New Oz]
I'm not...sure when that would be though...munch munch.
scripts.translation:
[新奥兹]
不过...我也不确定那会是什么时候...嚼嚼嚼。

scripts.text: Is there a problem?
scripts.translation: 出什么问题了吗？

scripts.text:
[New Oz]
Oh, it's nothing. Don't worry. I came into this tower by accident and I got lost. Yum yum.
scripts.translation:
[新奥兹]
哦，没什么。别担心。我是误打误撞进这座塔的，然后迷路了。好吃好吃。

scripts.text:
[New Oz]
To tell you the truth, I got lost somewhere about 2 years ago and I traveled around to wherever. Yum yum.
scripts.translation:
[新奥兹]
说实话，我大概两年前就迷路了，到处流浪。好吃好吃。

scripts.text:
[New Oz]
and then I found this tower and came inside because I thought it'd be fun. But I haven't found a way out since then.
scripts.translation:
[新奥兹]
然后我发现了这座塔，因为觉得有趣就进来了。但从那以后，我就没找到出去的路。

scripts.text:
[New Oz]
I feel so much better now. Thanks, my friend! This must be a destiny! Would you help me?
scripts.translation:
[新奥兹]
我现在感觉好多了。谢谢你，我的朋友！这一定是命运！你能帮帮我吗？

scripts.text:
[New Oz]
It's kind of sad that I'm actually starving to death...but I had a good time, my beloved guild members...
scripts.translation:
[新奥兹]
其实我快要饿死了，这有点悲伤...但我过得很开心，我亲爱的公会成员们...

scripts.text: I brought some meat from Fili!
scripts.translation: 我从菲利那里带了一些肉来！

scripts.text:
[New Oz]
Oh, I loooove meat! But...is there any vegetable?
scripts.translation:
[新奥兹]
哦，我超...超爱吃肉！但是...有蔬菜吗？

scripts.text:
[New Oz]
Like...garnishes for meat, you know. I could get tired of eating just meat...Could you get me some?
scripts.translation:
[新奥兹]
比如...肉的配菜，你知道的。一直吃肉我会腻的...你能帮我弄点吗？

scripts.text:
[New Oz]
I mean something like acorns! I saw a pile of acorns just outside the tower.
scripts.translation:
[新奥兹]
我是说像橡实那样的东西！我在塔外看到了一堆橡实。

scripts.text: I'm here to see if you're doing okay.
scripts.translation: 我来看看你还好吗。

scripts.text:
[New Oz]
I don't know if I should say I'm okay...or not...
scripts.translation:
[新奥兹]
我不知道该说我还好...还是不好...

scripts.text:
[New Oz]
I haven't eaten anything for days...I feel like I'm going to pass out any minute.
scripts.translation:
[新奥兹]
我已经好几天没吃东西了...我感觉随时都会晕过去。

scripts.text:

But for now, I'm ^FF0000still^000000 alive...but no one knows until when...ah, I'm getting sleepy again...
scripts.translation:

但现在，我还^FF0000活着^000000...但谁知道能撑多久呢...啊，我又困了...

scripts.text:

You know that Laphine outside...yes, that muscular Laphine...tell him to bring me some food before I die.
scripts.translation:

你知道外面那个拉芬吗...对，那个肌肉发达的拉芬...让他在我死前给我带点食物来。

scripts.text:
[Professor Worm]
How did you get up here?
You couldn't seem more frail!
Are you a monster that I created?
scripts.translation:
[沃姆教授]
你是怎么上来的？
你看起来虚弱极了！
难道是我创造的魔物吗？

scripts.text:
[Professor Worm]
Busy, busy, busy! Monsters, I have to create more monsters!
Danger! I don't know when attack will come!
It's coming! It's all coming!
Like a tsunami!!
scripts.translation:
[沃姆教授]
忙，忙，忙！魔物，我必须创造更多魔物！
危险！我不知道攻击何时到来！
它来了！一切都来了！
就像海啸一样！！

scripts.text:
[Professor Worm]
This is my portrait?
scripts.translation:
[沃姆教授]
这是我的画像吗？

scripts.text:
[Professor Worm]
There's not enough ^FF0000Star Shape Mushrooms^000000 !
I was trying to do something at the time with 20 mushrooms. If you don't bring me enough,
I may not be able to remember enough either!
scripts.translation:
[沃姆教授]
^FF0000星星香菇^000000不够！
我当时正试图用20个蘑菇做点什么。如果你不带足够的来，
我可能无法回忆起足够的事情！

scripts.text:
[Professor Worm]
You brought me 20 ^FF0000Star Shape Mushrooms^000000.
Yes, yes, it feels like my memory is about to burst back!
scripts.translation:
[沃姆教授]
你带给我20个^FF0000星星香菇^000000。
是的，是的，感觉我的记忆快要回来了！

scripts.text:
[Professor Worm]
You studied all of the doodles?
scripts.translation:
[沃姆教授]
你研究了所有的涂鸦吗？

scripts.text:
[Professor Worm]
Hey monster, thanks to you I think my memory is returning bit by bit.
But why did I get stuck in this tower?
And for what reason did I put Bifrost to sleep?
scripts.translation:
[沃姆教授]
嘿，魔物，多亏了你，我觉得我的记忆正在一点点恢复。
但我为什么被困在这座塔里？
我又为什么让双层牛肉堡睡着了？

scripts.text:
[Professor Worm]
Did you find all Diary Frogs?
You only found three?
Did all the rest just get destroyed?
I should have thrown them a little more gently... 
Thanks a lot. Thanks to you, I found my portrait and got back some of my memories.
scripts.translation:
[沃姆教授]
你找到了所有的日记蛙吗？
你只找到了三只？
其余的都毁了吗？
我应该把它们扔得轻一点...
非常感谢。多亏了你，我找到了我的画像，并恢复了一些记忆。

scripts.text:
[Professor Worm]
Thanks a lot for helping me remember.
But nothing is still all that clear.
I'm so curious, that it angers me, but I don't have any more Diary Frogs to throw...
scripts.translation:
[沃姆教授]
非常感谢你帮我回忆。
但事情仍然不太清楚。
我很好奇，这让我很生气，但我没有更多的日记蛙可以扔了...

scripts.text:
[Professor Worm]
Among the many books on the shelves in this room my portrait is bookmarked inside somewhere. Please find it!
scripts.translation:
[沃姆教授]
在这个房间书架上的许多书中，我的画像被夹在某处作为书签。请找到它！

scripts.text:
[Professor Worm]
Every wall has so much doodling.
It looks like my writing. I must have done it.
Please take a look at five different walls, analyze what I doodled, and let me know what you find.
I'm so curious, so curious that all my memories might float away.
scripts.translation:
[沃姆教授]
每面墙上都画满了涂鸦。
看起来像是我的字迹，一定是我画的。
请查看五面不同的墙，解析我涂鸦的内容，并告诉我你发现了什么。
我很好奇，好奇得感觉我的记忆都要飘走了。

scripts.text:
[Professor Worm]
I threw one Diary Frog to the floor right below.
While you go look for that one I'll try to remember where I threw the others.
scripts.translation:
[沃姆教授]
我扔了一只日记蛙到正下方的地板上。
你去寻找它的时候，我会试着回忆我把其他的扔到了哪里。

scripts.text:
[Professor Worm]
I just remembered! I threw one Diary Frog to the first floor of the tower.
It sure rolled around and about.
scripts.translation:
[沃姆教授]
我想起来了！我把一只日记蛙扔到了中央塔的一楼。
它在那里滚来滚去。

scripts.text:
[Professor Worm]
I just remembered! I threw one Diary Frog so recklessly, and it just kept on rolling and disappeared out of the tower.
It must still be around the tower somewhere.
scripts.translation:
[沃姆教授]
我想起来了！我随手扔了一只日记蛙，它一直滚啊滚，最后滚出了中央塔。
它应该还在中央塔附近的某个地方。

scripts.text: [Professor Worm]
scripts.translation: [沃姆教授]

scripts.text:
[Professor Worm]
I have a job for you, so strengthen yourself to the level of an incubus and then return to me!
scripts.translation:
[沃姆教授]
我有件事要交给你，请强化自己到恶魔侍者的等级，然后再回来找我！

scripts.text: What's coming?
scripts.translation: 接下来会发生什么？

scripts.text: What are you doing here?
scripts.translation: 你来这里做什么？

scripts.text: Please tell me about Bifrost.
scripts.translation: 请告诉我关于双层牛肉堡的事。

scripts.text:
[Professor Worm]
EEEK!
How did you get up here? I kept many monsters around the tower!
There's no way anyone could have invaded it! That means, you... you are!
scripts.translation:
[沃姆教授]
哎呀！
你是怎么上来的？我在中央塔周围放了很多魔物！
不可能有人能入侵这里！也就是说，你...你是！

scripts.text:
[Professor Worm]
That's a difficult question.
I definitely knew it even until a few hundred years back but I forgot it clearly now.
I can't do anything but what I do best now.
Creating monsters and letting them loose.
scripts.translation:
[沃姆教授]
这是个很难回答的问题。
直到几百年前我还记得，但现在我完全想不起来了。
我现在只能做我最擅长的事。
制造魔物，然后放它们出去。

scripts.text:
[Professor Worm]
Bifrost? It's sleeping.
It's in a deep sleep.
I might also be sleeping a lot later..
It's going to be my turn next!
No, no! I can't just be the one to take it.
Monsters, I have to let more monsters loose!
scripts.translation:
[沃姆教授]
双层牛肉堡？它在睡觉。
它在沉睡。
我可能接下来也会睡很多觉...
下一个该轮到我了！
不，不！我不能就这样被带走。
魔物，我必须放出更多的魔物！

scripts.text: [Professor Worm]
scripts.translation: [沃姆教授]

scripts.text:
[Professor Worm]
Are you a monster that I created?
You have to be!
scripts.translation:
[沃姆教授]
你是我制造的魔物吗？
你一定是！

scripts.text: I want to know about the tower.
scripts.translation: 我想知道关于中央塔的事。

scripts.text: It's a talking worm!
scripts.translation: 这是一只会说话的虫子！

scripts.text:
[Professor Worm]
A tower? What tower?
This was a tower?
Why am I in a tower?
It's been so long that I forgot everything!
scripts.translation:
[沃姆教授]
中央塔？什么中央塔？
这里是一座塔吗？
我为什么在塔里？
时间太久了，我什么都忘了！

scripts.text:
[Professor Worm]
Why am I a bug?
You monster!
Just because I made you without much effort are your eyes just that much deficient?!
scripts.translation:
[沃姆教授]
我为什么是一只虫子？
你这魔物！
就因为我毫不费力地制造了你，你的眼睛就如此残缺不全吗？！

scripts.text:
[Professor Worm]
That's a difficult question.
I definitely knew it even until a few hundred years back but I forgot it clearly now.
I can't do anything but what I do best now.
Creating monsters and letting them loose.
scripts.translation:
[沃姆教授]
这是个很难回答的问题。
直到几百年前我还记得，但现在我完全想不起来了。
我现在只能做我最擅长的事。
制造魔物，然后放它们出去。

scripts.text: Professor Worm probes his own face and becomes shocked. He sees his own face through the silver plate and is really shocked.
scripts.translation: 沃姆教授摸了摸自己的脸，感到震惊。他透过银盘看到了自己的脸，真的非常震惊。

scripts.text:
[Professor Worm]
When did my handsome face become like this? My name is...
scripts.translation:
[沃姆教授]
我英俊的脸是什么时候变成这样的？我的名字是...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Professor Worm!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
沃姆教授！

scripts.text:
[Professor Worm]
That's right!
Wait, no that's not it..
My goodness, I even forgot the name!
Don't just stand there please go and find my portrait!
scripts.translation:
[沃姆教授]
没错！
等等，不对...
天哪，我连名字都忘了！
别站在那里了，请去把我的画像找回来！

scripts.text: I'm busy!
scripts.translation: 我很忙！

scripts.text: Why should I!
scripts.translation: 我为什么要帮你！

scripts.text:
[Professor Worm]
You came all the way up here in your free time and you are telling me you're busy?!
scripts.translation:
[沃姆教授]
你利用空闲时间特意跑到这里来，却告诉我你很忙？！

scripts.text:
[Professor Worm]
Well, you have to be curious.
While my memory got worse my intuition improved so much!
If you want to hear what you want to hear help me get my memory back!
scripts.translation:
[沃姆教授]
嗯，你肯定很好奇。
虽然我的记忆力变差了，但我的直觉却变得敏锐多了！
如果你想听到你想听的答案，就帮我找回记忆吧！

scripts.text:
[Professor Worm]
That's a difficult question.
I definitely knew it even until a few hundred years back but I forgot it clearly now.
I can't do anything but what I do best now.
Creating monsters and letting them loose.
scripts.translation:
[沃姆教授]
这是个很难回答的问题。
直到几百年前我还记得，但现在我完全想不起来了。
我现在只能做我最擅长的事。
制造魔物，然后放它们出去。

scripts.text:
[Professor Worm]
Among the many books on the shelves in this room my portrait is bookmarked inside somewhere. Please find it!
scripts.translation:
[沃姆教授]
在这个房间书架上的许多书中，我的画像被夹在某处作为书签。请找到它！

scripts.text:
[Professor Worm]
This is how I used to look?
...
Oh yeah, it is me!
But how did I become like this?
Wait a minute...
scripts.translation:
[沃姆教授]
我以前是这个样子吗？
...
啊，没错，是我！
但我怎么会变成这样的？
等等...

scripts.text:
[Professor Worm]
I am remembering something vaguely...
The weather, the landscape at the time...
scripts.translation:
[沃姆教授]
我隐约记得一些事情...
当时的天气，那里的风景...

scripts.text:
[Professor Worm]
I... yeah, it was a land with many blooming flowers where I was collecting something... That's right!
I was collecting some ^FF0000Star Shape Mushrooms^000000!
scripts.translation:
[沃姆教授]
我...是的，那是一片开满鲜花的地方，我当时正在采集什么东西...没错！
我在采集^FF0000星星香菇^000000！

scripts.text:
[Professor Worm]
Why was I doing that....
Hey monster, if you go to the land of many blooming flowers and bring me some ^FF0000Star Shape Mushrooms^000000,
I might remember everything you see!
scripts.translation:
[沃姆教授]
我当时为什么要那样做....
嘿，魔物，如果你去那片开满鲜花的地方给我带一些^FF0000星星香菇^000000回来，
我可能会想起你看到的一切！

scripts.text: Please just try to remember things now.
scripts.translation: 请现在试着回忆一下。

scripts.text: I'll bring them back for you.
scripts.translation: 我会帮你带回来的。

scripts.text:
[Professor Worm]
Well, I even forgot my name and I can't remember anything right now!
scripts.translation:
[沃姆教授]
我连自己的名字都忘了，现在什么也想不起来！

scripts.text:
[Professor Worm]
From the land of blooming flowers bring me 20 ^FF0000Star Shape Mushrooms^000000.
I think monster 'Petal' would usually roam with them in their mouths.
You couldn't expect me to remember things with just a few mushrooms!
scripts.translation:
[沃姆教授]
从开满鲜花的地方给我带20个^FF0000星星香菇^000000回来。
我想魔物“花瓣怪虫”通常嘴里会叼着它们。
就靠几个香菇，你难道指望我想起事情吗！

scripts.text: [Professor Worm]
scripts.translation: [沃姆教授]

scripts.text:
[Professor Worm]
^FF0000Star Shape Mushrooms^000000 should be easily found through finding Petals roaming the land of blooming flowers.
scripts.translation:
[沃姆教授]
在开满鲜花的地方寻找徘徊的花瓣怪虫，应该很容易找到^FF0000星星香菇^000000。

scripts.text:
[Professor Worm]
I was using these as ingredients for... some potions!
It wasn't for anything good though...
I had other ingredients too...
scripts.translation:
[沃姆教授]
我把这些当作制作...某些药剂的原料！
不过并不是为了什么好事...
我还有其他原料...

scripts.text:
[Professor Worm]
Before I forget, I should make note of these things on the wall. Wait...
Who doodled so much on this wall?!
The writing is just like mine!
... I must have done it!
scripts.translation:
[沃姆教授]
在我忘记之前，我应该把这些事情记在墙上。等等...
谁在这面墙上画了这么多涂鸦？！
字迹跟我的一模一样！
...一定是我画的！

scripts.text:
Every wall is filled with Professor Worm's notes.
If I study the walls carefully I might be able to gain some information on the tower or Bifrost.
scripts.translation:
每面墙上都写满了沃姆教授的笔记。
如果我仔细研究这些墙壁，也许能获取一些关于中央塔或双层牛肉堡的资讯。

scripts.text: The contents of the doodles were analyzed and reported to the professor.
scripts.translation: 涂鸦的内容被分析并报告给了教授。

scripts.text:
[Professor Worm]
I see. I was producing medicines to put Bifrost to sleep. For that, I was punished and transformed into a worm and my memories deteriorated so rapidly.
Let me think about this for a bit.
scripts.translation:
[沃姆教授]
我明白了。我当时正在制造让双层牛肉堡入睡的药物。为此，我受到了惩罚，变成了一条虫子，记忆也迅速衰退。
让我想想这件事。

scripts.text: Don't ask me that!
scripts.translation: 别问我那个！

scripts.text: Think harder!
scripts.translation: 再想想！

scripts.text:
[Professor Worm]
How dare a monster irritate its creator!
scripts.translation:
[沃姆教授]
一只魔物竟敢惹怒它的创造者！

scripts.text:
[Professor Worm]
Ahhhh, my head feels like it's about to explode.
I should make more notes on the wall.
Wait, there are no more spaces on the wall!
Who doodled so much on the walls?
Is it you, monster?
scripts.translation:
[沃姆教授]
啊...我的头快要炸开了。
我应该在墙上多写点笔记。
等等，墙上已经没有空间了！
是谁在墙上画了这么多涂鸦？
是你吗，魔物？

scripts.text:
[Professor Worm]
I guess I would have to write a diary then...
Oh that's right, I used to keep a diary!
scripts.translation:
[沃姆教授]
看来我不得不写日记了...
对了，我以前写过日记！

scripts.text: What did you do with a diary again?
scripts.translation: 你以前用日记做什么来着？

scripts.text: Show it to me.
scripts.translation: 给我看看。

scripts.text:
[Professor Worm]
I must have written things that I should have never forgotten!
Why are you so sarcastic, anyways?
scripts.translation:
[沃姆教授]
我肯定写了一些不该忘记的事情！
你说话怎么这么讽刺？

scripts.text:
[Professor Worm]
Well.. It's not an ordinary notebook... I used a ^0000FFDiary Frog^000000 which is a frog that can record things.
Everytime I was really mad, I threw it all over the place, so they all scattered.
scripts.translation:
[沃姆教授]
嗯...那可不是普通的笔记本...我用的是^0000FF日记蛙^000000，一种能记录事情的青蛙。
每次我特别生气的时候，都会把它们到处乱扔，所以它们都散开了。

scripts.text: What a temper you have!
scripts.translation: 你的脾气真大！

scripts.text: Should I find the Diary Frog?
scripts.translation: 我要去找日记蛙吗？

scripts.text:
[Professor Worm]
Why don't you try living imprisoned yourself?
If you were in my place you wouldn't just throw some frogs, but the entire household!
scripts.translation:
[沃姆教授]
你不妨自己试着被囚禁一下。
如果你在我的处境，你不会只扔几只青蛙，而是会把整个家都砸了！

scripts.text:
[Professor Worm]
I threw them all over the place.
If they didn't scatter too much I'm sure they're still around somewhere.
Let me see, maybe I can remember a few...
scripts.translation:
[沃姆教授]
我把它们到处乱扔了。
如果它们没有散得太远，我相信它们肯定还在附近某处。
让我想想，也许我能想起几个地方...

scripts.text:
[Professor Worm]
That's right, I threw one Diary Frog to the floor right below.
While you go look for that one,
I'll try to remember where I threw the others.
scripts.translation:
[沃姆教授]
对了，我把一只日记蛙扔到了正下方的地板上。
你去找找那只，
我试着回忆一下我把其他的扔到了哪里。

scripts.text:
[Professor Worm]
But nothing is still all that clear.
I'm so curious, that it angers me, but I don't have any more Diary Frogs to throw...
scripts.translation:
[沃姆教授]
但事情依然不太清楚。
我很好奇，这让我很生气，但我没有更多的日记蛙可以扔了...

scripts.text:
[Professor Worm]
I'll try to figure out other ways to get back my memory. And when I do please help me again.
scripts.translation:
[沃姆教授]
我会尝试其他方法来恢复记忆。到时候，请再帮帮我。

scripts.text:
[Professor Worm]

scripts.translation:

scripts.text:
It seems like it's somewhere here.
Let's look closer.
scripts.translation:
看起来它就在这附近。
让我们仔细找找。

scripts.text: Every book is bookmarked with some memos and pictures. It might just be somewhere around here.
scripts.translation: 每本书里都夹着一些备忘和图画。也许就在这附近。

scripts.text:
Found it!
...or not. It's just a doodle.
Let's look around here a little more.
scripts.translation:
找到了！
...或者没有。这只是个涂鸦。
让我们在这附近再找找。

scripts.text:
Just a ton of random things.
Let's look through anything and everything.
