只是一堆乱七八糟的东西。
让我们把这里里外外都翻一遍。

scripts.text: Found the portrait!
scripts.translation: 找到画像了！

scripts.text:
He looked totally different.
With so much flamboyance he seems he used to be a magician full of vanity.
Unfortunately, the paper is too worn out that the name has been erased.
scripts.translation:
他的样子完全不同。
如此华丽张扬，看来他生前是个充满虚荣心的魔法师。
不幸的是，纸张磨损严重，名字已经被擦掉了。

scripts.text: Let's show this to Professor Worm.
scripts.translation: 让我们把这个给沃姆教授看看。

scripts.text: Professor Worm's portrait has been found.
scripts.translation: 找到了沃姆教授的画像。

scripts.text: Since Professor Worm's portrait is found there is no need to search through the books anymore.
scripts.translation: 既然找到了沃姆教授的画像，就不需要再翻书了。

scripts.text: Let's go show it to Professor Worm.
scripts.translation: 让我们去给沃姆教授看看。

scripts.text: Don't read it!
scripts.translation: 别读它！

scripts.text: Read it.
scripts.translation: 阅读

scripts.text: It doesn't seem very interesting at all!
scripts.translation: 看起来一点都不有趣！

scripts.text: Read through the notes.
scripts.translation: 通读这些笔记。

scripts.text: Stop reading.
scripts.translation: 停止阅读

scripts.text: Read it again.
scripts.translation: 再读一遍。

scripts.text: It's not like it needs to be memorized so I'll just stop reading.
scripts.translation: 反正不需要背下来，我就停止阅读了。

scripts.text:
[Wall Note {0}]
I succeeded in putting Bifrost to sleep.
I am just so amazing!
But why do I have to remain in a place like this, too?
scripts.translation:
[墙上的留言 {0}]
我成功让双层牛肉堡睡着了。
我真是太厉害了！
但我为什么也要被困在这种地方呢？

scripts.text:
[Wall Note {0}]
It hasn't been too long since I was imprisoned in the tower, but my memories are leaving me so rapidly.
It may be Bifrost's strong will to stay awake that is affecting me this way.
scripts.translation:
[墙上的留言 {0}]
我被囚禁在塔里没多久，但我的记忆正在迅速消失。
也许是双层牛肉堡强烈的清醒意志在影响我。

scripts.text:
[Wall Note {0}]
My appearance is changing!
My hands, my skin...
This is without a doubt the form of a worm!
I can't believe I'm changing into a worm..
How could this be!
scripts.translation:
[墙上的留言 {0}]
我的外表正在改变！
我的手，我的皮肤...
这毫无疑问是蠕虫的形态！
我无法相信我正在变成蠕虫...
怎么会这样！

scripts.text:
[Wall Note {0}]
Bifrost's head is still growing continuously. I can't believe this... She's keep stretching beyond the tower!
Could it be her strong will, is still awake and is trying to send a message?
scripts.translation:
[墙上的留言 {0}]
双层牛肉堡的头还在不断生长。我无法相信...
她正在超越塔的高度不断延伸！
难道是她强烈的意志仍然清醒，并试图传递信息吗？

scripts.text:
[Wall Note {0}]
The person who will be under attack after Bifrost is none other than me!
I feel an eerie gaze directed at me!
I can't just sit here and take it.
scripts.translation:
[墙上的留言 {0}]
在双层牛肉堡之后，下一个被攻击的人就是我！
我感到一股诡异的目光正盯着我！
我不能坐在这里坐以待毙。

scripts.text: [Wall Note {0}]
scripts.translation: [墙上的留言 {0}]

scripts.text:
[Wall Note 2]
I wonder if I'll forget even my name... How it worries me...
scripts.translation:
[墙上的留言 2]
我甚至担心会忘记自己的名字...这让我很不安...

scripts.text:
[Wall Note 3]
Is this also because of Bifrost?
Is it Bifrost's curse against me for putting her to sleep?
Is it doing this to me while it's asleep?
I can't believe it... My goodness!
scripts.translation:
[墙上的留言 3]
这也是因为双层牛肉堡吗？
是双层牛肉堡对我施加的诅咒，因为我让她睡着了？
它是在睡觉时对我做这些的吗？
我无法相信...天哪！

scripts.text:
[Wall Note 5]
Monsters, I have to create more monsters to protect me. As many as I could possibly create!
scripts.translation:
[墙上的留言 5]
魔物，我必须创造更多的魔物来保护我。尽可能多地创造！

This damned frog!
I'm so mad, I ought'a throw this out!
scripts.translation:
[30号的日记记录]
该死的青蛙！
我气死了，我要把它扔出去！

scripts.text: It seems that a continued search for diary recordings would be meaningless. I should go back to Professor Worm.
scripts.translation: 看来继续寻找日记记录是没有意义的。我应该回到沃姆教授那里。

scripts.text:
[Diary Frog No. 30]
As you can see, I am a broken Diary Frog.
Professor Worm threw me out really hard all the way out here.
I didn't even do anything wrong!
scripts.translation:
[日记青蛙 30号]
如您所见，我是一只损坏的日记青蛙。
沃姆教授把我用力扔到了这里。
我明明什么都没做错！

scripts.text:
[Diary Frog No. 30]
I need 10 ^FF0000Star Shape Mushrooms^000000.
They can be obtained from Petals that roam the land of blooming flowers.
Please hurry.
Before I lose all of the diary recordings!
scripts.translation:
[日记青蛙 30号]
我需要10个^FF0000星星香菇^000000。
它们可以从在花海之地游荡的花瓣怪虫身上获得。
请快点。
在我丢失所有日记记录之前！

scripts.text:
[Diary Frog No. 30]
You brought all 10 ^FF0000Star Shape Mushrooms^000000 for me.
I have to first treat my wounds, so please wait.
scripts.translation:
[日记青蛙 30号]
你为我带来了全部10个^FF0000星星香菇^000000。
我得先处理一下伤口，请稍等。

scripts.text: [Diary Frog No. 30]
scripts.translation: [日记青蛙 30号]

scripts.text: You look fine.
scripts.translation: 你看起来没事。

scripts.text: Please calm down and let me hear the diary.
scripts.translation: 请冷静下来，让我听听日记。

scripts.text:
[Diary Frog No. 30]
Come over here please. Let me break one of your legs.
scripts.translation:
[日记青蛙 30号]
请过来。让我打断你的一条腿。

scripts.text:
[Diary Frog No. 30]
I got hurt when I was thrown out that I don't have the energy to playback the diary recording.
To help me repair myself, please bring me 10 ^FF0000Star Shape Mushrooms^000000 from the land of blooming flowers.
scripts.translation:
[日记青蛙 30号]
我被扔出去时受伤了，没有能量播放日记记录。
为了帮助我修复自己，请从花海之地带给我10个^FF0000星星香菇^000000。

scripts.text: Just walk it off.
scripts.translation: 自己走回去

scripts.text: I'll bring them for you.
scripts.translation: 我会为你带来

scripts.text:
[Diary Frog No. 30]
Then, all I can let you hear are my moans and groans.
ARGGGGGG!!!
scripts.translation:
[日记青蛙 30号]
那么，我只能让你听到我的呻吟声了。
啊啊啊啊啊！！！

scripts.text:
[Diary Frog No. 30]
^FF0000Star Shape Mushrooms^000000 can be obtained from Petals that roam the land of blooming flowers.
scripts.translation:
[日记青蛙 30号]
^FF0000星星香菇^000000可以从在花海之地游荡的花瓣怪虫身上获得。

scripts.text:
[Diary Frog No. 30]
Do you know this?
My recordings give me the fuel I need to live.
If you come back to late, all you'll hear are my moans and groans.
scripts.translation:
[日记青蛙 30号]
你知道吗？
我的录音是我生存所需的燃料。
如果你回来得太晚，你只能听到我的呻吟声了。

scripts.text:
[Diary Frog No. 30]
Nibble nibble
Glug glug
scripts.translation:
[日记青蛙 30号]
咔嚓咔嚓
咕噜咕噜

scripts.text:
[Diary Frog No. 30]
I feel all better.
I'll let you listen to Professor Worm's diary with a well composed voice.
Let me first shape my throat here...
Erhem.... Prrhaaha!
scripts.translation:
[日记青蛙 30号]
我感觉好多了。
我会用沉稳的声音让你听沃姆教授的日记。
让我先调整一下喉咙...
咳咳...噗哈哈！

scripts.text:
[Diary recording by No. 30]
This tower possesses amazing secrets!
How incredible, oh so incredible!
After hundreds of years, I finally figured it all out! How could this be!
It is so shocking that I forgot everything that I ever knew!
scripts.translation:
[30号的日记记录]
这座塔隐藏着惊人的秘密！
太不可思议了，简直太不可思议了！
经过数百年的研究，我终于弄明白了！怎么会这样！
这太令人震惊了，以至于我忘记了自己曾经知道的一切！

scripts.text:
[Diary recording by No. 30]
This damned frog!
I'm so mad, I ought'a throw this out!
scripts.translation:
[30号的日记记录]
该死的青蛙！
我气死了，我要把它扔出去！

scripts.text: It seems that a continued search for diary recordings would be meaningless. I should go back to Professor Worm.
scripts.translation: 看来继续寻找日记记录是没有意义的。我应该回到沃姆教授那里。

scripts.text:
[Expedition Member]
I've gone through Hazy Forest Maze and come all the way here just to see Eclage and I really don't want to go through that maze ever again.
scripts.translation:
[远征队成员]
我穿过了迷雾森林迷宫，一路来到这里只为看看埃克拉珠，我真的不想再穿过那个迷宫了。

scripts.text:
[Expedition Member]
It horrifies me just thinking about returning to the camp after visiting Eclage.
scripts.translation:
[远征队成员]
一想到要去埃克拉珠之后还要返回营地，我就感到恐惧。

scripts.text: Eclage?
scripts.translation: 埃克拉珠？

scripts.text: Easy way to return to the camp
scripts.translation: 返回营地的捷径

scripts.text: pat pat...
scripts.translation: 拍拍...

scripts.text:
[Expedition Member]
Huh? You didn't know it yet?
Eclage is the capital of the Laphine.
scripts.translation:
[远征队成员]
咦？你居然还不知道吗？
埃克拉珠是拉菲涅王国的首都。

scripts.text:
[Expedition Member]
Hmm? I mean, you could fly there using the mysterious seeds that you collected in the maze.
You mean, I have to jump off the huge flower?
scripts.translation:
[远征队成员]
嗯？我的意思是，你可以使用在迷宫里收集到的神奇种子飞过去。
你是说，我必须从那朵巨大的花上跳下去吗？

scripts.text:
[Expedition Member]
Are you consoling me?
It's so nice of you...
scripts.translation:
[远征队成员]
你是在安慰我吗？
你真好...

scripts.text: [Expedition Member]
scripts.translation: [远征队成员]

scripts.text:
[Expedition Member]
Many Laphine and travellers come to Mora Village from Eclage for various reasons such as transporting goods and so on...
scripts.translation:
[远征队成员]
许多拉菲涅人和旅行者都会因为运送货物等各种原因，从埃克拉珠来到穆拉村...

scripts.text:
[Expedition Member]
Since you're here, you should go there, too.
I mean, like...for sightseeing!!
Head north from Bifrost and you'll see it.
scripts.translation:
[远征队成员]
既然你都来了，不妨也去那里看看。
我是说，就像...去观光一样！！
从双层牛肉堡往北走就能看到它了。

scripts.text:
[Expedition Member]
So, it's hard to get in, but not as hard to get out.
I didn't know there would be such a way.
Haha. Thanks.
scripts.translation:
[远征队成员]
原来如此，进去很难，但出来倒没那么难。
我都不知道还有这种办法。
哈哈，谢谢你。

scripts.text:
[Eclage Guard]
Excuse me for a moment.
Is there anyone from Splendide here?
scripts.translation:
[埃克拉珠卫兵]
请留步。
请问这里有来自辉煌领域的人吗？

scripts.text: I am, but why?
scripts.translation: 我就是，怎么了？

scripts.text:
[Eclage Guard]
Ah, you are?
There's someone who wants to see you. Do you have time right now?
scripts.translation:
[埃克拉珠卫兵]
啊，原来是你。
有人想见你。你现在有时间吗？

scripts.text:
[Eclage Guard]
You don't have to worry. It's nothing suspicious or bad.
We just wanted to ask you about Splendide, so please spare your time for us.
scripts.translation:
[埃克拉珠卫兵]
别担心，没什么可疑或不好的事。
我们只是想向你打听一下关于辉煌领域的事，请抽出一点时间给我们吧。

scripts.text:
[Eclage Guard]
I'll guide you if it's okay.
scripts.translation:
[埃克拉珠卫兵]
如果没问题的话，我来带你去。

scripts.text: Sure. Let's go.
scripts.translation: 好的，走吧。

scripts.text: I don't have time for it right now...
scripts.translation: 我现在没时间...

scripts.text:
[Eclage Guard]
Please follow me then.
scripts.translation:
[埃克拉珠卫兵]
那就请跟我来。

scripts.text:
[Eclage Guard]
Oh, is that right?
That's too bad. 
But if you have some time later, please pay us a visit.
scripts.translation:
[埃克拉珠卫兵]
哦，是这样吗？
真遗憾。
不过如果你之后有空，请一定要来拜访我们。

scripts.text: [Eclage Guard]
scripts.translation: [埃克拉珠卫兵]

scripts.text:
[Eclage Guard]
I'll be at the east side of the place near the gate.
Please, find me there.
I'll be looking forward to seeing you.
scripts.translation:
[埃克拉珠卫兵]
我会在靠近大门的地方东侧等你。
请在那里找到我。
我很期待见到你。

scripts.text:
[Fome]
Mm? You're a traveler, too?
You mean, you're going to travel through Eclage with that little skill you have?
The fact that you made it here actually seems just short of a miracle...
scripts.translation:
[弗梅]
嗯？你也是旅行者吗？
你是说，就凭你那点微薄的实力，也要穿越埃克拉珠吗？
你能来到这里，简直就像是个奇迹...

scripts.text:
[Fome]
Oh my, did I talk too much?
But you're really lucky.
If you tell them that you're here to congratulate on the birth of new Mayor Jun, you'll surely meet the great Kardui.
scripts.translation:
[弗梅]
哎呀，我是不是说太多了？
不过你真的很幸运。
如果你告诉他们你是来祝贺新市长君诞生的，你一定能见到伟大的卡尔杜伊。

scripts.text:
[Fome]
Ah...how beautiful.
I heard some bad rumors but I don't believe in them at all~
scripts.translation:
[弗梅]
啊……真美。
虽然听到了一些不好的传闻，但我完全不信~

scripts.text:
[Fome]
Ha, I almost went too far again.
Did you talk to Litrip and York?
scripts.translation:
[弗梅]
哈哈，我又差点说漏嘴了。
你和利特里普还有约克谈过了吗？

scripts.text:
[Fome]
When it comes to Bifrost Tower, which is the most popular tourist attraction, Litrip knows the best!
scripts.translation:
[弗梅]
说到最热门的旅游景点——双层牛肉堡，利特里普可是最了解的！

scripts.text:
[Fome]
Come here and have a talk with us.
My name is Fome and I'm from the central region of Alpheim.
You are...
scripts.translation:
[弗梅]
过来和我们聊聊吧。
我叫弗梅，来自阿尔海姆的中部地区。
你是……

scripts.text:
[Fome]
An Eclage Guard was looking for you just a minute ago, right?
I think he said he'll be waiting for you at the east gate. Don't you have to go?
scripts.translation:
[弗梅]
刚才有一位埃克拉珠卫兵在找你，对吧？
我记得他说会在东门等你。你不是该去那边吗？

scripts.text:
[Fome]
You've been working for the king of Laphines all along?!
How could you not say a word about it to me?
I want to be able to meet the king often, too.
scripts.translation:
[弗梅]
你一直在为拉菲尼斯的国王效力吗？！
你怎么能对我只字不提呢？
我也想经常能见到国王。

scripts.text:
[Fome]
You seem very busy.
I heard so much about you from here and there.
I see that you're friends with Laphines already.
scripts.translation:
[弗梅]
你看起来很忙。
我在各处都听到了关于你的传闻。
看来你已经和拉菲尼斯成为朋友了。

scripts.text:
[Fome]
I'm sure there is something.
It seemed from my observation that they were anxious while celebrating the birth of the king.
scripts.translation:
[弗梅]
肯定……有什么……
据我观察，他们在庆祝国王诞生时显得非常焦虑。

scripts.text:
[Fome]
I should start planning on moving to the next region. 
I'm debating whether I should just go back or go to Mora Village...
scripts.translation:
[弗梅]
我该开始计划前往下一个地区了。
我在犹豫是回去还是去穆拉村庄……

scripts.text:
[Fome]
Wait, let me guess!
You're a member of the famous Midgard expedition, right?!
scripts.translation:
[弗梅]
等等，让我猜猜！
你是著名的米德加尔特探险队的成员，对吧？！

scripts.text: Yes.
scripts.translation: 是的

scripts.text: How did he know?
scripts.translation: 他怎么知道的？

scripts.text:
[Fome]
Well, it's simple.
There's no one who looks like you or dresses like you around Eclage.
scripts.translation:
[弗梅]
嗯，很简单。
在埃克拉珠，没有人的长相或穿着像你这样。

scripts.text:
[Fome]
I heard the ways to Bifrost are blocked by a strange rift and soon, travelers who came here through the Hazy Forest started to appear.
scripts.translation:
[弗梅]
我听说通往双层牛肉堡的道路被一道奇怪的裂缝阻断了，随后，那些通过迷雾森林来到这里的旅行者开始现身。

scripts.text:
[Fome]
They are humans who came from Midgard passing through Jotunheim!
Seriously...I'm glad I came to Eclage.
I didn't expect to meet a person from Midgard!
scripts.translation:
[弗梅]
他们是来自米德加尔特、途经约顿海姆的人类！
真是的……我很庆幸自己来到了埃克拉珠。
没想到能遇到来自米德加尔特的人！

scripts.text:
[Fome]
Eclage is crowded with travelers, and until recently, most of them were from Alpheim.
It's nice to see you. I was about to talk to you just now.
scripts.translation:
[弗梅]
埃克拉珠挤满了旅行者，直到最近，他们大多来自阿尔海姆。
见到你真好。我刚才正想和你聊聊呢。

scripts.text: Why is Eclage popular among travelers?
scripts.translation: 为什么埃克拉珠在旅行者中很受欢迎？

scripts.text: What is the main attraction of Eclage?
scripts.translation: 埃克拉珠的主要景点是什么？

scripts.text:
[Fome]
Why does this place have so many travelers...?
First of all, I think it's due to the fact that you're able to communicate freely here since Eclage is with Bifrost.
scripts.translation:
[弗梅]
为什么这个地方有这么多旅行者……？
首先，我认为这是因为埃克拉珠与双层牛肉堡相连，所以在这里可以自由交流。

scripts.text:
[Fome]
The main attraction of Eclage?
It's Bifrost Tower, of course!
Although It's not inside Eclage, technically! Ahhahahahaha
scripts.translation:
[弗梅]
埃克拉珠的主要景点？
当然是双层牛肉堡！
虽然严格来说它不在埃克拉珠境内！啊哈哈哈哈

scripts.text: [Fome]
scripts.translation: [弗梅]

scripts.text:
[Fome]
Thanks to Bifrost's will, everyone is able to communicate with no problem here just like you and I right now.
scripts.translation:
[弗梅]
多亏了双层牛肉堡的意志，大家都能像你我这样毫无障碍地交流。

scripts.text:
[Fome]
Second, it's because Eclage is the end and the gateway of Alpheim.
It's the only way to get to Jotunheim.
scripts.translation:
[弗梅]
其次，是因为埃克拉珠是阿尔海姆的尽头，也是通往约顿海姆的门户。
这是前往约顿海姆的唯一途径。

scripts.text:
[Fome]
A great number of travelers who admire the unknown world come to Eclage.
Also, they want to see Bifrost, which connects Jotunheim and Alpheim, with their own eyes.
scripts.translation:
[弗梅]
许多向往未知世界的旅行者都会来到埃克拉珠。
他们都想亲眼看看连接约顿海姆和阿尔海姆的双层牛肉堡。

scripts.text:
[Fome]
Moreover, the biggest reason why Eclage is so crowded recently is...!!!
scripts.translation:
[弗梅]
而且，最近埃克拉珠如此拥挤的最大原因是...!!!

scripts.text: It is...?!

[Fome]
A new Mayor Jun was born!
scripts.translation:
[弗梅]
新的大君君诞生了！

scripts.text: Whosa whatsits?
scripts.translation: 谁家的什么？

scripts.text:
[Fome]
No, no, Mayor Jun. It's a Laphine name.
It's a...right, it means a 'king.'
The King is born!
scripts.translation:
[弗梅]
不不，是大君君。这是拉芬族的名字。
意思是...对，就是“国王”。
国王诞生了！

scripts.text:
[Fome]
Although he is pretty old, he became a king.
As the king of Laphines, he is so beautiful.
scripts.translation:
[弗梅]
虽然他年纪挺大了，但他成为了国王。
作为拉芬族的国王，他真是美极了。

scripts.text: When was that?
scripts.translation: 那是什么时候的事？

scripts.text:
[Fome]
Mm? Maybe 10 years ago?
5 years ago? Or 15? Anyway, it's less than 100 years.
scripts.translation:
[弗梅]
嗯？大概是10年前吧？
5年前？还是15年前？总之，不到100年。

scripts.text:
This traveler named Fome is going on forever about the king of Laphines.
It seems as if she doesn't care about others and is sinking into her own world, so it's hard to understand what she's talking about.
Let's talk to other travelers.
scripts.translation:
这位名叫弗梅的旅行者一直在喋喋不休地谈论拉芬族的国王。
她似乎沉浸在自己的世界里，不太在意别人，让人很难听懂她在说什么。
还是去和其他旅行者聊聊吧。

scripts.text:
[Fome]
I've come here just recently, so I didn't have a chance to go outside Eclage.
Whew, it's kind of scary.
scripts.translation:
[弗梅]
我刚来这里不久，还没机会去埃克拉珠外面看看。
呼，有点吓人呢。

scripts.text:
[Fome]
Bifrost Tower is...oh, right.
Litrip has been there, right? Ask Litrip about it!
scripts.translation:
[弗梅]
双层牛肉堡塔...啊，对了。
利特里普去过那里，对吧？去问问利特里普吧！

scripts.text:
A traveler named Litrip seems to know about Bifrost Tower.
Let's go talk to him.
scripts.translation:
名叫利特里普的旅行者似乎知道双层牛肉堡塔的事。
让我们去和他谈谈。

scripts.text:
[Fome]
Since he was very polite and all, I'm sure it's something good.
Sure. The Laphines in Eclage are very generous to travelers.
scripts.translation:
[弗梅]
因为他非常礼貌，我相信他是个好人。
没错。埃克拉珠的拉芬族对旅行者非常慷慨。

scripts.text:
[Fome]
I've seen him only once when I was congratulating him, and I only said few words...
Seriously~ I remember how beautiful he was.
scripts.translation:
[弗梅]
我只在祝贺他时见过他一次，只说了几句话...
天哪~ 我记得他长得真好看。

scripts.text:
[Fome]
But it seems like Laphines aren't all that delighted to see their king.
Why is that? Do you know anything about it?
scripts.translation:
[弗梅]
但看起来拉芬族们并不太高兴见到他们的国王。
这是为什么？你知道些什么吗？

scripts.text:
[Fome]
I couldn't ask them straightforward questions related to that since I was afraid that it might hurt their pride.
scripts.translation:
[弗梅]
我害怕冒犯他们的自尊心，所以不敢直接问他们相关的问题。

scripts.text:
As far as you know, the perception of Kardui among Laphines is somewhat favorable on the outside.
But in reality, the majority of Laphines feel uneasy, distrustful, and doubtful about him.
Let's stop worrying and ask Kardui instead!
scripts.translation:
据你所知，拉芬族对外界对卡尔杜伊的评价还算不错。
但实际上，大多数拉芬族对他感到不安、不信任且心存疑虑。
别担心了，直接去问问卡尔杜伊吧！

scripts.text:
What Fome said is interesting.
A distrusted king...should I listen to what other Laphines say about it?
scripts.translation:
弗梅说的话很有意思。
一个不受信任的国王...我应该听听其他拉芬族怎么说吗？

scripts.text: A group of travelers of Alpheim are having a conversation.
scripts.translation: 一群来自阿尔海姆的旅行者正在交谈。

scripts.text: Avoid them.
scripts.translation: 避开他们

scripts.text: Join the group.
scripts.translation: 加入他们

scripts.text: They don't seem to care that much.
scripts.translation: 他们似乎不太在意。

scripts.text:
When you approach, they stop talking for a second and make a seat for you.
Start a conversation.
scripts.translation:
当你走近时，他们停顿了片刻，为你让出了一个位置。
开始对话。

scripts.text:
[Litrip]
Hey, young man.
It's very impressive that you're able to come this far...
scripts.translation:
[利特里普]
嘿，年轻男子。
你能来到这么远的地方，真令人印象深刻...

scripts.text:
[Litrip]
It's not fun listening to my story only.
You should go talk to Fome and Chiba, too.
scripts.translation:
[利特里普]
只听我一个人的故事可没意思。
你也应该去听听弗梅和千叶怎么说。

scripts.text:
[Litrip]
And Let me know if you ever solve the mystery of Bifrost Tower.
I'll be looking forward to hearing from you, hahaha.
scripts.translation:
[利特里普]
如果你解开了双层牛肉堡塔的秘密，记得告诉我。
我很期待听到你的消息，哈哈。

scripts.text:
[Litrip]
Oh, look at this strange traveler. 
Come here. My name is Litrip.
scripts.translation:
[利特里普]
哦，看看这位奇怪的旅行者。
过来吧。我叫利特里普。

scripts.text:
[Litrip]
The celebratory atmostphere for the new king is almost gone now.
But something feels weird here.
scripts.translation:
[利特里普]
为新国王庆祝的气氛几乎已经消散了。
但这里感觉有些不对劲。

scripts.text:
[Litrip]
It seems like Laphines have some official affairs to do with you. 
Didn't they tell you to come to the east gate?
You should go.
scripts.translation:
[利特里普]
看起来拉芬族有一些公务要和你谈。
他们没让你去东门吗？
你应该去那里。

scripts.text:
[Litrip]
Weren't you supposed to meet someone at the east gate?
scripts.translation:
[利特里普]
你不是应该在东门见某人吗？

scripts.text:
[Litrip]
Since the last time I saw you talking to the guard, I hear your name here and there. 
Is it something important? You've become pretty famous here.
scripts.translation:
[利特里普]
自从我上次看到你与卫兵交谈后，我就到处听到你的名字。
有什么重要的事吗？你在这里变得相当有名了。

scripts.text:
[Litrip]
I'm thinking about going to the tower again with Chiba.
I heard it's got a nice view.
If I'm lucky enough, I'll go to Mora, too.
scripts.translation:
[利特里普]
我正打算再和千叶一起去一次塔。
听说那里的风景不错。
如果运气好，我还会去穆拉。

scripts.text:
[Litrip]
You're from Mora?
You must have seen Bifrost Tower on the way then?
scripts.translation:
[利特里普]
你来自穆拉？
那你一定在途中见过双层牛肉堡塔吧？

scripts.text: I saw it from the outside.
scripts.translation: 我从外面看过了

scripts.text: I've gone inside the tower.
scripts.translation: 我进过塔里面

scripts.text:
[Litrip]
I see. Wasn't it pretty crazy?
Once upon a time, It used to be a very nice observatory.
scripts.translation:
[利特里普]
是吗。是不是很疯狂？
很久以前，它曾是一座非常漂亮的观测台。

scripts.text: [Litrip]
scripts.translation: [利特里普]

scripts.text:
[Litrip]
Really? That's too bad.
Well, but it's good to play it safe since there are frightful monsters inside the tower.
It's certainly better than losing your life by being rash.
scripts.translation:
[利特里普]
是吗？真遗憾。
不过，塔里有很多可怕的魔物，谨慎一点总是好的。
总比鲁莽行事丢了性命强。

scripts.text:
[Litrip]
Although it's occupied by horrible monsters now.
Seeing that you went into the tower and came out unharmed, I can tell you're pretty skilled.
scripts.translation:
[利特里普]
虽然那里现在被可怕的魔物占据了。
既然你能进塔并安然无恙地出来，看来你的身手相当不错。

scripts.text:
[Litrip]
There's a rumor that a suspicious alchemist resides on top of the tower.
No one knows why, but I heard he's been there for a good while.
scripts.translation:
[利特里普]
有个传闻说，塔顶住着一位可疑的炼金术士。
没人知道为什么，但我听说他在那里已经很久了。

scripts.text:
[Litrip]
If that alchemist is still alive, he could be a living history himself since the tower, the alchemist, and Bifrost have existed even before Eclage was founded.
scripts.translation:
[利特里普]
如果那位炼金术士还活着，他本身就是一段活的历史了，因为塔、炼金术士和双层牛肉堡，在埃克拉珠建立之前就已经存在了。

scripts.text:
[Litrip]
A good number of people still challenge themselves to find the mysterious legend of Bifrost Tower but so far, none of them succeeded.
scripts.translation:
[利特里普]
很多人试图解开双层牛肉堡塔的神秘传说，但至今无人成功。

scripts.text: What about Laphines?
scripts.translation: 那拉菲尼斯呢？

scripts.text:
[Litrip]
Hmm, Laphines?
For some reason, they're not interested in Bifrost Tower at all. 
I think they perceive it just as a natural object.
scripts.translation:
[利特里普]
嗯，拉菲尼斯？
不知为何，他们对双层牛肉堡塔完全不感兴趣。
我想在他们眼里，那只是一个自然存在的物体。

scripts.text:
[Litrip]
They're actually more than capable of solving the mystery if they wanted to but I feel like they're just respecting the existence of Bifrost Tower.
scripts.translation:
[利特里普]
其实他们完全有能力解开这个谜团，但我感觉他们只是在尊重双层牛肉堡塔的存在。

scripts.text:
[Litrip]
However, they don't necessarily stop people from going into the tower, either. So I'm thinking maybe they're just not aware of it.
If you're curious, go challenge yourself and solve the mystery of the tower.
scripts.translation:
[利特里普]
不过，他们也不会阻止别人进塔。所以我觉得他们可能只是没意识到这件事。
如果你好奇的话，不妨去挑战一下，解开塔的谜团。

scripts.text:
[Litrip]
My story ends here.
Go ask Fome and Chiba. They should have useful information, too.
scripts.translation:
[利特里普]
我的故事就到这里了。
去问问弗梅和千叶吧，他们应该也有有用的信息。

scripts.text:
[Litrip]
Just like a feeling of emptiness that comes after an exciting festival...
scripts.translation:
[利特里普]
就像热闹的庆典过后，那种空落落的感觉...

scripts.text:
[Chiba]
Although I prefer traveling alone,
I don't mind having some company in dangerous areas.
But you...Hmm...I don't think you're skilled enough to travel around this area.
scripts.translation:
[千叶]
虽然我更喜欢独自旅行，
但在危险区域有个伴也无妨。
不过你...嗯...我觉得你的身手还不够好，不适合在这个地区旅行。

scripts.text:
[Chiba]
I know Laphines perform a huge ceremony for the succession of kingship but I don't know exactly what the ceremony is about.
scripts.translation:
[千叶]
我知道拉菲尼斯会举行盛大的王位继承仪式，但我不清楚仪式的具体内容。

scripts.text:
[Chiba]
It's a rare opportunity to see the ceremony with your own eyes since Mayor Jun lives pretty long.
scripts.translation:
[千叶]
因为市长朱恩活得很长寿，能亲眼目睹这场仪式的机会非常难得。

scripts.text:
[Chiba]
You're a human from Midgard.
I'm Chiba.
As you can see, I'm a traveler just like you.
scripts.translation:
[千叶]
你是来自米德加尔特的米德加尔特人。
我是千叶。
如你所见，我和你一样，也是个旅行者。

scripts.text:
[Chiba]
Wasn't there an Eclage Guard looking for you just now?
You'd better respect Laphines as much as possible in order to avoid any discord.
It's the basis of traveling.
scripts.translation:
[千叶]
刚才是不是有个埃克拉珠卫兵在找你？
为了避免冲突，你最好尽可能尊重拉菲尼斯。
这是旅行的基本原则。

scripts.text:
[Chiba]
Didn't you go somewhere with an Eclage Guard?
If you're lost on the way, ask the guard at the east gate. 
He will guide you.
scripts.translation:
[千叶]
你是不是和埃克拉珠卫兵一起去了什么地方？
如果迷路了，去问问东门口的卫兵。
他会指引你的。

scripts.text:
[Chiba]
So, you weren't a mere traveler after all.
scripts.translation:
[千叶]
原来，你并不是个普通的旅行者。

scripts.text:
[Chiba]
Mm...should I try to go through Hazy Forest?
Maybe it's too much...isn't it?
I'll just go to the tower with Litrip again.
scripts.translation:
[千叶]
嗯...我该试试穿过迷雾森林吗？
也许有点冒险...不是吗？
我还是再和利特里普一起去一次塔吧。

scripts.text:
[Chiba]
I think local area information is the most important when traveling. 
You think so, too?
scripts.translation:
[千叶]
我觉得旅行时，当地的信息是最重要的。
你也这么认为吗？

scripts.text:
[Chiba]
I heard there's a way to avoid a rift that is blocking Jotunheim...
Do people really travel through Hazy Forest?
scripts.translation:
[千叶]
我听说有一条路可以避开阻挡尤特海姆的裂缝...
真的有人穿过迷雾森林旅行吗？

scripts.text: Yes.
scripts.translation: 是的

scripts.text: By magic!
scripts.translation: 靠魔法！

scripts.text: [Chiba]
scripts.translation: [千叶]

scripts.text:
[Chiba]
So it is.
That's how strong humans are, I guess.
When I was Mora, I heard there are many missing men in Hazy Forest...
scripts.translation:
[千叶]
原来如此。
看来人类真的很强大啊。
我在穆拉的时候，听说迷雾森林里有很多失踪的人...

scripts.text:
[Chiba]
Indeed...people who get to Mora first use magic to help others travel?
That's brilliant.
scripts.translation:
[千叶]
确实...先到达穆拉的人会用魔法帮助他人旅行？
这真高明。

scripts.text:
[Chiba]
Anyway it's true that there are active interactions thanks to you people.
I should be grateful for that.
scripts.translation:
[千叶]
总之，多亏了你们，这里才有了活跃的互动。
我应该为此感到感激。

scripts.text:
[Chiba]
Do you want to know something more interesting?
Everyone in Alpheim knows about it, but I'm sure you people have never heard about it.
scripts.translation:
[千叶]
你想听点更有趣的事吗？
阿尔海姆的人都知道，但我确信你们肯定没听说过。

scripts.text:
[Chiba]
Among Laphines, have you seen the taller ones with especially bright skin and gorgeous wings?
scripts.translation:
[千叶]
在拉菲尼斯中，你见过那些个子特别高、皮肤特别白皙、翅膀特别华丽的吗？

scripts.text:
[Chiba]
They're the 'Donas.' By the way, normal-looking Laphines are called 'Papang' in their language. 
It sounds like some kind of a snack, but well, we should respect them.
scripts.translation:
[千叶]
他们被称为“多娜”。顺便说一下，普通的拉菲尼斯在他们语言里叫“帕帕昂”。
听起来像某种零食，不过嘛，我们还是应该尊重他们。

scripts.text:
[Chiba]
The reason Donas are taller and gorgeous is because they're all candidates for Mayor.
That is, they all have a chance of becoming the king.
scripts.translation:
[千叶]
多娜之所以更高大、更华丽，是因为她们都是市长的候选人。
也就是说，她们都有机会成为国王。

scripts.text:
[Chiba]
We're not talking about upper class or lower class here. They are classified according to their job.
It might not be important, but it's good to know about it as a foreigner.
scripts.translation:
[千叶]
这里说的不是上流社会或下流社会，而是根据职位划分的。
这可能不重要，但作为外国人知道一下也好。

scripts.text:
[Chiba]
Anyway, Donas have strong magical powers and they live longer. But since there are not many of them most of them are assigned to important positions. 
Who knows? It might be good to win their favor. Hahaha.
scripts.translation:
[千叶]
总之，多娜拥有强大的魔力，而且寿命更长。但由于数量不多，她们大多被安排在重要职位上。
谁知道呢？也许讨好她们会有好处。哈哈哈。

scripts.text:
[Chiba]
The throne of the king of Laphines seems to be inherited by blood, but it isn't in reality.
Mayor Jun is known to emerge among the Donas but it's just exactly that.
scripts.translation:
[千叶]
拉菲尼斯国王的王位看似由血统继承，但实际上并非如此。
市长朱恩据说会从多娜中产生，但事实也确实如此。

scripts.text:
[Chiba]
He literally just emerges without any kind of a formal inheritance process.
Isn't it pretty interesting?
scripts.translation:
[千叶]
她确实是在没有任何正式继承程序的情况下产生的。
这不是很有趣吗？

scripts.text:
You received information related to Laphines from Chiba. 
Let's go talk to other travelers.
scripts.translation:
你从千叶那里获得了关于拉菲尼斯的信息。
让我们去和其他旅行者谈谈吧。

scripts.text:
[Chiba]
If I came earlier, I could have become a part of a historic moment...
but I missed it. Kekeke.
scripts.translation:
[千叶]
如果我早点来，也许就能成为历史时刻的一部分了...
但我错过了。呵呵呵。

scripts.text:
[Eclage Guard]
Oh, I should hurry and go back to where I was. 
Excuse me.
scripts.translation:
[埃克拉珠卫兵]
哦，我得赶紧回到我该在的地方了。
失礼了。

scripts.text: - You have too many items to proceed with the quest. -
scripts.translation: - 你的物品栏已满，无法继续任务。 -

scripts.text:
[Eclage Guard]
Eh, good to see you again.
We should have introduced ourselves earlier if we knew we would run into each other so often like this.
scripts.translation:
[埃克拉珠卫兵]
啊，很高兴再次见到你。
早知道我们会这么频繁地相遇，早该自我介绍的。

scripts.text:
[Minuel]
I'm Minuel.
It's such a common name. I don't even know what it means.
I think my parents just gave me a name that is easy on the ear.
scripts.translation:
[米努埃尔]
我是米努埃尔。
这名字很普通，我甚至不知道它有什么含义。
我想我父母只是随便取了一个听起来顺耳的名字。

scripts.text:
[Minuel]
Come to think of it, I heard the news.
You've decided to work in Eclage...
scripts.translation:
[米努埃尔]
说起来，我听到了消息。
你决定在埃克拉珠工作...

scripts.text: It's just a rumor.
scripts.translation: 那只是谣言。

scripts.text: Do they have a job for me?
scripts.translation: 他们有适合我的工作吗？

scripts.text:
[Minuel]
Actually I don't have any time for myself since I have to be here all the time.
Not only I, but most Laphines who are in this business are faced with that position, too.
scripts.translation:
[米努埃尔]
实际上，因为我必须一直待在这里，所以我没有自己的时间。
不仅是我，大多数从事这份工作的拉菲尼斯都面临同样的处境。

scripts.text:
[Minuel]
[Minuel]
Come to think of it, you've done a lot of work for other Laphines as well. 
This is enough. Now, you should go see him.
scripts.translation:
[米努埃尔]
[米努埃尔]
说起来，你为其他拉菲尼斯也做了很多工作。
这就够了。现在，你应该去见他了。

scripts.text:
[Minuel]
Eh? Really?
That's too bad. There was a suitable job for you.
Well, I understand.
[Minuel]
Come to think of it, you've done a lot of work for other Laphines as well. 
This is enough. Now, you should go see him.
scripts.translation:
[米努埃尔]
诶？真的吗？
真遗憾。本来有一份适合你的工作。
好吧，我理解。
[米努埃尔]
说起来，你为其他拉菲尼斯也做了很多工作。
这就够了。现在，你应该去见他了。

scripts.text:
[Minuel]
Other Laphines around me have gone crazy about my Yai, decorated with by products of monsters. 
This could be a new trend.
scripts.translation:
[米努埃尔]
我身边的其他拉菲尼斯都对我用魔物副产品装饰的Yai着迷。
这可能是一种新潮流。

scripts.text:
[Minuel]
Eh? Really?
That's too bad. There was a suitable job for you.
Well, I understand.
Other Laphines around me have gone crazy about my Yai, decorated with by products of monsters. 
This could be a new trend.
scripts.translation:
[米努埃尔]
诶？真的吗？
真遗憾。本来有一份适合你的工作。
好吧，我理解。
我身边的其他拉菲尼斯都对我用魔物副产品装饰的Yai着迷。
这可能是一种新潮流。

scripts.text:
[Minuel]
So, we don't have any time to decorate our Yai. 
Of course we could buy the materials. But just like any other consumers, we would like to gather them on our own.
scripts.translation:
[米努埃尔]
所以，我们没有时间去装饰Yai。
当然我们可以购买材料。但就像其他消费者一样，我们更希望亲手收集它们。

scripts.text:
[Minuel]
Since you're free to go anywhere,
could you gather some decorations for Yai?
scripts.translation:
[米努埃尔]
既然你可以自由去任何地方，
你能收集一些装饰Yai的材料吗？

scripts.text: Sure.
scripts.translation: 当然。

scripts.text: No.
scripts.translation: 不。

scripts.text:
[Minuel]
Thank you.
You need to find
5 Horns of Hillslion, 5 Magical Powers, and 5 Horse's Hooves each.
scripts.translation:
[米努埃尔]
谢谢。
你需要找到
5个希斯利安的角，5个魔力之角，以及5个马蹄。

scripts.text:
[Minuel]
I would like to decorate it with unpolished beauty.
You can get the materials by hunting the monsters near Splendide, where I'm not supoosed to go.
scripts.translation:
[米努埃尔]
我想用一种未经雕琢的美来装饰它。
你可以通过狩猎辉煌领域附近的魔物来获取材料，那里是我不能去的地方。

scripts.text:
[Minuel]
I've heard some rumors about Hillslions, and they seem to appear in Sapha's areas.
Their horns, Mystic Horns of Cornuses that live in the grasslands and something called Horse's Hooves.
scripts.translation:
[米努埃尔]
我听说了一些关于希斯利安的传闻，它们似乎出现在萨法的区域。
它们的角，以及生活在草原上的科努斯的魔力之角，还有所谓的马蹄。

scripts.text:
[Minuel]
I'm sure you would know more about those hooves than I do.
I'll be counting on you!
scripts.translation:
[米努埃尔]
我相信你对那些马蹄的了解比我多。
就拜托你了！

scripts.text:
[Minuel]
Ha, do you really think so?
You will be coming here again.
Soon, in the near future. Hehehe
scripts.translation:
[米努埃尔]
哈，你真这么认为吗？
你还会再来的。
很快，就在不久的将来。呵呵呵

scripts.text:
[Minuel]
You are here already!
Let me check the items.
Mm...
scripts.translation:
[米努埃尔]
你来了！
让我检查一下物品。
嗯...

scripts.text:
[Minuel]
I asked you for 5 Horns of Hillslion, 5 Mystic Horns, and 5 Horse's Hooves.
You'll be able to get Mystic Horns by catching Cornuses near Splendide.
scripts.translation:
[米努埃尔]
我让你找5个希斯利安的角，5个魔力之角，和5个马蹄。
你可以通过捕捉辉煌领域附近的科努斯来获得魔力之角。

scripts.text:
[Minuel]
If they are scratched fittingly, they will look even wilder. 
These are great. Thank you so much.
scripts.translation:
[米努埃尔]
如果刮得恰到好处，它们看起来会更狂野。
这些很棒。非常感谢。

scripts.text:
[Minuel]
Come to think of it, you've done a lot of work for other Laphines as well. 
This is enough. Now, you should go see him.
scripts.translation:
[米努埃尔]
说起来，你为其他拉菲尼斯也做了很多工作。
这就够了。现在，你应该去见他了。

scripts.text:
[Minuel]
Soon, you'll be able to hear good news.
You should look forward to it.
scripts.translation:
[米努埃尔]
很快，你就能听到好消息了。
请期待一下吧。

scripts.text:
[Minuel]
My job is to deliver his will at the right time.
And I think now is the time.
scripts.translation:
[米努埃尔]
我的职责是在合适的时候传达他的旨意。
我想，现在就是时候了。

scripts.text:
[Minuel]
I think I've grown attached to you since I was seeing you very often.
Well, I'm just saying how I feel.
scripts.translation:
[米努埃尔]
因为经常见到你，我觉得自己有点依赖你了。
嗯，我只是说说心里话。

scripts.text:
[Minuel]
Come to think of it, you've done a lot of work for other Laphines as well. 
This is enough. Now, you should go see him.
scripts.translation:
[米努埃尔]
说起来，你为其他拉菲尼斯也做了很多工作。
这就够了。现在，你应该去见他了。

scripts.text:
[Minuel]
My job is to deliver his will at the right time.
And I think now is the time.
scripts.translation:
[米努埃尔]
我的职责是在合适的时候传达他的旨意。
我想，现在就是时候了。

scripts.text:
[Minuel]
I think I've grown attached to you since I was seeing you very often.
Well, I'm just saying how I feel.
scripts.translation:
[米努埃尔]
因为经常见到你，我觉得自己有点依赖你了。
嗯，我只是说说心里话。

scripts.text:
Other Laphines around me have gone crazy about my Yai, decorated with by products of monsters. 
This could be a new trend.
scripts.translation:
我身边的其他拉菲尼斯都对我用魔物副产品装饰的雅伊（Yai）着了迷。
这可能会成为一种新的潮流。

scripts.text:
[Eclage Guard]
Welcome to Eclage.
Enjoy your trip.
scripts.translation:
[埃克拉珠卫兵]
欢迎来到埃克拉珠。
祝您旅途愉快。

scripts.text:
[Eclage Guard]
Oh, you are here!
May I escort take you to the one who wants to meet you?
scripts.translation:
[埃克拉珠卫兵]
哦，您来了！
我可以带您去见那位想见您的人吗？

scripts.text:
[Eclage Guard]
I thought you sill had something to do.
May I guide you?
scripts.translation:
[埃克拉珠卫兵]
我以为您还有事要忙。
需要我为您引路吗？

scripts.text:
[Eclage Guard]
I see you pretty often.
I was notified in advance that the Chief of Staff requested for an audience.
scripts.translation:
[埃克拉珠卫兵]
我挺常见到您的。
我提前收到了通知，参谋长要求与您会面。

scripts.text:
[Eclage Guard]
May I escort you to the audience chamber?
scripts.translation:
[埃克拉珠卫兵]
我可以带您去会客室吗？

scripts.text: [Eclage Guard]
scripts.translation: [埃克拉珠卫兵]

scripts.text: Sure. Let's go.
scripts.translation: 好的，走吧。

scripts.text: I don't have time for it right now...
scripts.translation: 我现在没时间...

scripts.text:
[Eclage Guard]
Please follow me then.
scripts.translation:
[埃克拉珠卫兵]
那就请跟我来。

scripts.text:
Ah...is that right?
I'll wait then.
scripts.translation:
啊...是吗？
那我先在这里等着。

scripts.text:
[Eclage Guard]
Don't worry about me.
I'll just wait here as long as it takes.
Well, it's my job. Don't worry.
scripts.translation:
[埃克拉珠卫兵]
别担心我。
我会一直在这里等，直到需要为止。
嗯，这是我的工作。别担心。

scripts.text: Yes, please.
scripts.translation: 是的，请。

scripts.text: No, it's okay.
scripts.translation: 没关系。

scripts.text:
[Eclage Guard]
Please follow me then.
scripts.translation:
[埃克拉珠卫兵]
那就请跟我来。

scripts.text:
[Eclage Guard]
Is that right?
I see. Come find me whenever you need it.
scripts.translation:
[埃克拉珠卫兵]
是吗？
明白了。有需要的时候随时来找我。

scripts.text:
[Eclage Guard]
But I'm afraid it's too early.
I think you have to wait for a while.
scripts.translation:
[埃克拉珠卫兵]
不过恐怕现在还为时过早。
我想您需要再等一会儿。

scripts.text:
[Eclage Guard]
Since it's about time, should I lead you in now?
scripts.translation:
[埃克拉珠卫兵]
既然时间差不多了，我现在带您进去吗？

scripts.text: Yes, please.
scripts.translation: 是的，请。

scripts.text: I'll come back later.
scripts.translation: 我稍后再来。

scripts.text:
[Eclage Guard]
Follow me, please.
scripts.translation:
[埃克拉珠卫兵]
请跟我来。

scripts.text:
[Eclage Guard]
Do as you wish although Mayor Jun might be upset if you keep him waiting for too long.
scripts.translation:
[埃克拉珠卫兵]
请随意，不过如果您让市长Jun等太久，他可能会不高兴。

scripts.text: Yes, please.
scripts.translation: 是的，请。

scripts.text: No, it's okay.
scripts.translation: 没关系。

scripts.text:
[Eclage Guard]
Follow me, please.
scripts.translation:
[埃克拉珠卫兵]
请跟我来。

scripts.text:
[Eclage Guard]
Thank you.
I thought you were using me for teleportation since you're here so often.
scripts.translation:
[埃克拉珠卫兵]
谢谢。
因为您经常来这里，我还以为您只是利用我进行瞬间移动呢。

scripts.text:
[Minuel]
Mayor Jun wants to see you.
I don't have time to guide you right now, so I'll just tell you how to get there.
scripts.translation:
[米努埃尔]
市长Jun想见您。
我现在没时间带您过去，就告诉您怎么走吧。

scripts.text:
[Minuel]
Are you on your way from the palace again?
scripts.translation:
[米努埃尔]
您又是从宫殿那边过来的吗？

scripts.text:
[Minuel]
Hey, what a strong and pleasant morning it is!
Wait, is it morning?
Anyway, you seem so healthy just like a fresh-caught fish.
scripts.translation:
[米努埃尔]
嘿，多么强壮而愉快的早晨啊！
等等，现在是早晨吗？
总之，您看起来气色真好，就像刚钓上来的鱼一样。

scripts.text:
[Minuel]
You need to find 10 Horns of Hillslion, 10 Mystic Horns, and 10 Horse's Hooves.
scripts.translation:
[米努埃尔]
你需要找到10个希斯利安的角、10个魔力之角和10个马的蹄子。

scripts.text:
[Minuel]
You are here already!
Let me check the items.
Mm...
scripts.translation:
[米努埃尔]
你来了！
让我检查一下物品。
嗯...

scripts.text:
[Minuel]
Do you have a minute?
My friends love the by products of monsters that you brought me the other day and I was going to ask you if you could get some more. Is that okay?
scripts.translation:
[米努埃尔]
您有空吗？
我的朋友们很喜欢您前几天带给我的魔物副产品，我想问问您能不能再弄一些。可以吗？

scripts.text:
[Minuel]
Good to see you again.
The Chief of Staff? You have to go upstairs through the spiral road to see him.
He's inside the conference hall, which is on the right side of the palace.
scripts.translation:
[米努埃尔]
很高兴再次见到您。
参谋长？您得沿着螺旋楼梯上去才能见到他。
他在宫殿右侧的会议室里。

scripts.text: [Minuel]
scripts.translation: [米努埃尔]

scripts.text:
[Minuel]
I have to decorate Yai with the materials you brought me the other day, but I don't know when I could leave...
I hope time passes as quickly as possible.
scripts.translation:
[米努埃尔]
我得用您前几天带给我的材料来装饰我的Yai，但我不知道什么时候能抽身...
希望时间过得快一点。

scripts.text:
[Minuel]
Go through the exit here, go up twice following the spiral road, and you'll find the entrance to the audience chamber.
This way please.
scripts.translation:
[米努埃尔]
从这里出去，沿着螺旋楼梯上两层，就能找到接见厅的入口了。
请这边走。

scripts.text: A scholar of magics sponsored by Shenime
scripts.translation: 由谢尼梅资助的魔法学者

scripts.text:
[Minuel]
Is the Chief of Staff sponsoring a scholar of magics?
I had no idea...Now that I think about it...ah...that's why...
scripts.translation:
[米努埃尔]
参谋长在资助一位魔法学者？
我完全不知道...仔细想想...啊...难怪...

scripts.text: What do you mean?
scripts.translation: 你这是什么意思？

scripts.text:
[Minuel]
When he gets off work,
I saw him going to the east side pretty often.
His Yai is on the opposite side, but often I saw him heading east.
scripts.translation:
[米努埃尔]
他下班后，
我经常看到他往东边走。
他的Yai在另一边，但我经常看到他往东走。

scripts.text:
[Minuel]
So I thought maybe he has someone to meet there.
Now that I think about it, wouldn't that someone be the scholar that he is sponsoring?
scripts.translation:
[米努埃尔]
所以我猜他可能在那里见什么人。
仔细想想，那个人会不会就是他资助的那位学者？

scripts.text:
[Minuel]
Of course it's just my guess...
But I'm glad if this could help you by any chance.
scripts.translation:
[米努埃尔]
当然这只是我的猜测...
但如果这能帮到您，我会很高兴的。

scripts.text:
[Minuel]
Mm? What's that look for?
A traveler from Mora told me that it's a popular way of saying hello...Did I say something wrong?
scripts.translation:
[米努埃尔]
嗯？您这是什么表情？
一位来自穆拉的旅行者告诉我，这是一种流行的打招呼方式...我是不是说错什么了？

scripts.text:
[Minuel]
Oh, by the way, the decorations you brought are very popular among other Laphines. 
I might have to ask you another favor later.
scripts.translation:
[米努埃尔]
哦，对了，您带来的装饰品在其他拉菲涅人中很受欢迎。
我可能之后还得麻烦您一次。

scripts.text:
[Minuel]
If they are scratched fittingly, they will look even wilder. 
These are great. My friends will love it!
scripts.translation:
[米努埃尔]
如果刮得恰到好处，它们看起来会更狂野。
这些很棒。我的朋友们会喜欢的！

scripts.text: Sorry, I'm busy.
scripts.translation: 抱歉，我很忙。

scripts.text: Fine. I'll do it.
scripts.translation: 好的。我会做的。

scripts.text:
[Minuel]
That's too bad.
Maybe next time!
scripts.translation:
[米努埃尔]
太遗憾了。
下次吧！

scripts.text:
[Minuel]
Thank you so much.
The Horns of Hillslion, Mystic Horns, and Horse's Hooves that you brought were just so popular among my friends.
I would like you to bring me 10 of each, please.
scripts.translation:
[米努埃尔]
非常感谢。
您带来的希斯利安的角、魔力之角和马的蹄子在我的朋友们中非常受欢迎。
请再帮我带10个每种，好吗？

scripts.text:
[Minuel]
Decorating Yai wildly and with unpolished beauty became a new trend among my friends.
Haha...I'll be waiting here, then.
scripts.translation:
[米努埃尔]
用狂野且未经修饰的美来装饰Yai成了我朋友们中的新潮流。
哈哈...那我就在这里等着了。

scripts.text: - You have too many items to proceed with the quest. -
scripts.translation: - 你的物品栏已满，无法继续任务。 -

scripts.text:
[Chief of Staff]
Sorry, but no unauthorized entry is allowed here.
scripts.translation:
[参谋长]
抱歉，这里不允许未经授权的人员进入。

scripts.text:
[Chief of Staff]
Welcome to Eclage.
I order them to lead you here.
scripts.translation:
[参谋长]
欢迎来到埃克拉珠。
我命令他们带您来这里。

scripts.text:
[Shenime]
I'm in charge of the military supplies that are sent to the outpost of Splendide.
My name is Shenime.
scripts.translation:
[谢尼梅]
我负责管理送往辉煌领域前哨站的军用物资。
我的名字是谢尼梅。

scripts.text:
[Shenime]
Our supplies sent to Mora Village...
oww...I'm sorry. I've been having this headache recently...
scripts.translation:
[谢尼梅]
我们送往穆拉村的物资...
啊...抱歉。我最近一直头痛...

scripts.text:
[Shenime]
Anyway, I've heard that there are people
who deliver our supplies to Splendide through Hazy Forest.
scripts.translation:
[谢尼梅]
总之，我听说有人通过迷雾森林将我们的物资运往辉煌领域。

scripts.text:
[Shenime]
It's so good to see you in person. 
People who are clever enough are already trying hard to build relationships with Eclage.
scripts.translation:
[谢尼梅]
很高兴能当面见到你。
那些聪明的人已经在努力与埃克拉珠建立关系了。

scripts.text: So, I'm not the first one?
scripts.translation: 所以，我不是第一个？

scripts.text:
[Shenime]
Yes, you're not...oww...
But it doesn't matter.
You humans are already doing so much for Splendide and us.
scripts.translation:
[谢尼梅]
是的，你不是...啊...
但这并不重要。
你们人类已经为辉煌领域和我们做了很多。

scripts.text:
[Shenime]
Oh, the reason I'm frowning is because of this headache.
Don't get me wrong.
Um..anyway, to go on with my story...
scripts.translation:
[谢尼梅]
哦，我皱眉是因为头痛。
别误会。
嗯...总之，让我继续刚才的话题...

scripts.text:
[Shenime]
We are supposed to welcome you.
Should I get to the point now? I mean, the reason why I wanted to meet you.
scripts.translation:
[谢尼梅]
我们本该好好欢迎你的。
我该说正事了吗？我是说，我想见你的原因。

scripts.text:
[Shenime]
As you know already, we're disconnected from Splendide due to the accident in Bifrost.
And for us Laphines, it's hard to go against the will of the forest and Bifrost.
scripts.translation:
[谢尼梅]
如你所知，由于双层牛肉堡的事故，我们与辉煌领域断绝了联系。
对我们拉菲涅斯来说，违背森林和双层牛肉堡的意志是很困难的。

scripts.text:
[Shenime]
I'm sure every fairy in Alpheim feels the same, too.
Anyway, I want to know what's going on in Splendide and Jotunheim nowadays.
scripts.translation:
[谢尼梅]
我相信阿尔海姆的每个妖精都有同感。
总之，我想知道如今辉煌领域和约顿海姆的情况。

scripts.text:
[Shenime]
I heard the battle against Manuk has recently calmed down to the point of a truce...
and it could have been that they didn't get supplies in time.
scripts.translation:
[谢尼梅]
我听说与马努克的战斗最近已经平息到停战的地步...
也许是因为他们没能及时获得补给。

scripts.text: You've answered Shenime's serious questions and describe the situation as far as you could remember.
scripts.translation: 你回答了谢尼梅的严肃问题，并尽可能详细地描述了情况。

scripts.text: Now that I think about it...
scripts.translation: 这么一想......

scripts.text:
[Shenime]
What is it?
What you've told me is going to be very helpful.
Is there anything else you would like to talk about?
scripts.translation:
[谢尼梅]
怎么了？
你告诉我的这些会非常有帮助。
还有什么你想谈的吗？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I was told that Sapha made Yggdrasil Tree sick,
and your side started a war in order to protect the tree
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我听说萨法让世界树生病了，
你们为了守护世界树而发动了战争

scripts.text:
[{0}]
but what I know is a little bit different from that.
Apparently, the cause of the war seems to be the damage given to Yggdrasil Tree caused by Sapha's excessive mining, but...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
但我知道的情况略有不同。
看来战争的起因似乎是萨法过度采矿对世界树造成的伤害，但是...

scripts.text:
[Shenime]
Wait, stop there.
scripts.translation:
[谢尼梅]
等等，停一下。

scripts.text: What's the matter?
scripts.translation: 怎么了？

scripts.text:
[Shenime]
This war is like a holy war for us.
It's a war that we carry on upon our honor and dignity.
scripts.translation:
[谢尼梅]
这场战争对我们来说就像圣战一样。
这是一场为了荣誉和尊严而进行的战争。

scripts.text:
[Shenime]
So whatever the truth you know is,
if you're not going to hold responsibility for the backlash it might bring,
don't say anything at all.
scripts.translation:
[谢尼梅]
所以无论你知道的真相是什么，
如果你不想承担可能引发的后果，
那就什么都别说。

scripts.text: Why are you trying to hide the truth...
scripts.translation: 你为什么想隐瞒真相...

scripts.text:
[Shenime]
This is a matter between Yggdrasil the world-ash and its protector.
Mayor Jun should be the one listening to your story, not me.
scripts.translation:
[谢尼梅]
这是世界树尤克特拉希尔与其守护者之间的事。
应该由市长琼来听你的故事，而不是我。

scripts.text: What?
scripts.translation: 什么？

scripts.text:
[Shenime]
My work is done here.
What I'm saying is that I'm not the one to clear up your question.
I'll arrange a meeting with Mayor Jun for you.
scripts.translation:
[谢尼梅]
我的工作在这里已经结束了。
我的意思是，我不是那个能解答你疑惑的人。
我会为你安排与市长琼的会面。

scripts.text:
In the middle of the conversation, Shenime stopped talking and frowned as if he was having a headache again.
After massaging his head for a while, he looked much better and continued to go on.
scripts.translation:
谈话进行到一半时，谢尼梅停了下来，皱着眉头，似乎又头痛了。
他揉了揉头，过了一会儿看起来好多了，然后继续说道。

scripts.text:
[Shenime]
Promise me that you will not tell anyone 
about the truth that you believe.
scripts.translation:
[谢尼梅]
答应我，不要把你认为的真相告诉任何人。

scripts.text: No!
scripts.translation: 不！

scripts.text: Yes, I promise.
scripts.translation: 是的，我保证。

scripts.text:
[Shenime]
You put me on the spot.
I don't want you to be the cause of friction.
scripts.translation:
[谢尼梅]
你让我很为难。
我不希望成为引发摩擦的原因。

scripts.text:
[Shenime]
Can't you just keep it to yourself before discussing the matter with Mayor Jun?
scripts.translation:
[谢尼梅]
在跟市长琼讨论这件事之前，你能不能先自己保守秘密？

scripts.text: No, I can't!
scripts.translation: 不，我不能！

scripts.text: Fine, I won't tell anyone.
scripts.translation: 好吧，我不会告诉任何人。

scripts.text:
[Shenime]
I see that you've made up your mind.
scripts.translation:
[谢尼梅]
看来你已经下定决心了。

scripts.text:
[Shenime]
Oh well...
It's your loss..
scripts.translation:
[谢尼梅]
唉...
那是你的损失。

scripts.text:
[Shenime]
I'll arrange a meeting to let Mayor Jun get to know you.
You need to wait a little bit. Please bear with us.
scripts.translation:
[谢尼梅]
我会安排一次会面，让市长琼认识你。
你需要稍等一会儿。请多包涵。

scripts.text:
[Shenime]
I'll notify the guard that brought you here.
Go find the guard after some time. 
He will guide you.
scripts.translation:
[谢尼梅]
我会通知带你来的卫兵。
过一会儿去找那个卫兵。
他会指引你。

scripts.text:
[Shenime]
Until then, I hope you have a good time.
I'll send you to the plaza.
By the way, the guard who is going to lead you will be at the east gate. Don't forget the time.
scripts.translation:
[谢尼梅]
在那之前，希望你玩得愉快。
我会把你送到广场。
顺便说一下，负责引导你的卫兵会在东门。别忘了时间。

scripts.text: Shenime is pressing his head with a hand and seems to be having a headache.
scripts.translation: 谢尼梅用手按着头，看起来头痛得很厉害。

scripts.text:
[Shenime]
This headache has gotten worse recently.
....What brings you here?
Didn't Mayor call you?
You should go talk to him.
scripts.translation:
[谢尼梅]
最近这头痛越来越严重了。
....你来这里做什么？
不是市长叫你来吗？
你应该去跟他谈谈。

scripts.text: Shenime held his hand out with a suspicious smile.
scripts.translation: 谢尼梅带着怀疑的微笑伸出了手。

scripts.text: No, not yet.
scripts.translation: 不，还没准备好。

scripts.text: Hold his hand.
scripts.translation: 握住他的手。

scripts.text:
[Shenime]
This is one of the places you should watch carefully.
Shouldn't you, a foreigner, consider it as an honor and receive the offer?
You're hesitating too much.
scripts.translation:
[谢尼梅]
这是你应该仔细留意的地方之一。
作为一个外国人，你不应该把这看作一种荣幸并接受吗？
你犹豫得太多了。

scripts.text:
When you held Shenime's hand, you felt a sharp pain in your hand.
You took your hand off quickly and examined it, but nothing was there.
scripts.translation:
当你握住谢尼梅的手时，你感到手上一阵刺痛。
你迅速把手抽回来检查，但什么也没发现。

scripts.text: Is it just imagination...?
scripts.translation: 只是错觉...？

scripts.text:
[Shenime]
What's wrong?
May I guide you?
Now, this is the place you should watch carefully.
scripts.translation:
[谢尼梅]
怎么了？
需要我为您引路吗？
这里正是您应该仔细留意的地方。

scripts.text:
[Stranger Laphine]
What is it you want?
If you're looking for Shenime, that's too bad. I'm newly appointed to his position since he disappeared out of the blue.
I have to work. So, if it's not anything important, I would like you to not bother me.
scripts.translation:
[陌生的拉菲尼]
您有什么事？
如果您是在找谢尼梅，那就太不巧了。他不知为何突然失踪了，所以我被临时指派接替他的职位。
我现在必须工作。如果没有什么重要的事，请不要打扰我。

scripts.text:
[Shenime]
You need to wait a little longer to see Mayor Jun.
He is pretty busy, so please bear with us.
scripts.translation:
[谢尼梅]
您还需要再等一会儿才能见到朱恩市长。
他最近非常忙碌，请您稍作等待。

scripts.text:
[Shenime]
There's another guard who was supposed to be guiding you...
I can't go anywhere right now.
scripts.translation:
[谢尼梅]
原本应该有一位卫兵来为您引路的...
但我现在走不开。

scripts.text:
[Shenime]
Did you tell Mayor Jun about what you think?
He should be the one to decide.
scripts.translation:
[谢尼梅]
您把您的想法告诉朱恩市长了吗？
应该由他来做出决定。

scripts.text:
[Shenime]
I've heard about you.
You've decided to work for Eclage?
scripts.translation:
[谢尼梅]
我听说过您。
您决定为埃克拉珠效力了吗？

scripts.text:
[Shenime]
Welcome.
You are a foreigner yet you gained Mayor's recognition, which is rare.
scripts.translation:
[谢尼梅]
欢迎您。
您虽然是外国人，却获得了市长的认可，这非常罕见。

scripts.text:
[Shenime]
Ah, you've come at just the right time.
I heard you've been going to Bifrost Tower recently?
I wanted to ask you a favor since you're going there anyway...
scripts.translation:
[谢尼梅]
啊，您来得正是时候。
我听说您最近经常去双层牛肉堡塔？
既然您反正要去那里，我想请您帮个忙...

scripts.text:
[Shenime]
I need 10 dustaballs and 10 bookmarks made of fallen leaves.
You can find them inside the tower.
scripts.translation:
[谢尼梅]
我需要10个灰尘球和10个由落叶制成的书签。
您可以在塔内找到它们。

scripts.text:
[Shenime]
You found them!
Thank you.
This should last for a while.
scripts.translation:
[谢尼梅]
您找到了！
谢谢您。
这些应该够我们用一阵子了。

scripts.text:
[Shenime]
Avant that you just asked isn't he a genius who disappeared decades ago after doing some inappropriate experiments?
scripts.translation:
[谢尼梅]
您刚才问到的阿旺，难道不是那位几十年前因进行不当实验而失踪的天才吗？

scripts.text:
[Shenime]
Are you still interested in the scholar that I was sponsoring?
Unfortunately, he disappeared all of a sudden.
scripts.translation:
[谢尼梅]
您还对那位我资助的学者感兴趣吗？
不幸的是，他突然失踪了。

scripts.text:
[Shenime]
Mayor ordered us to heighten security around the Orb.
I don't know why, but you should pay attention, too.
Since you're still working for the king and all...right?
scripts.translation:
[谢尼梅]
市长命令我们加强围绕宝珠的安保。
我不知道原因，但您也应该多加留意。
毕竟您还在为国王效力...对吧？

scripts.text:
[Shenime]
Ah...I'm starting to have a headache.
Mayor is ordering me to reinforce the guards for the Orb without even telling me why...
scripts.translation:
[谢尼梅]
啊...我开始头疼了。
市长命令我加强宝珠的守卫，却连原因都不告诉我...

scripts.text:
[Shenime]
I hope you intervene actively in this matter.
Although we can't let any other races to be in charge of the Orb since it is very meaningful to us Laphines,
scripts.translation:
[谢尼梅]
希望您能积极介入此事。
虽然我们不能让其他种族负责宝珠，因为它对我们拉菲尼人意义非凡，

scripts.text:
[Shenime]
How much do you know about the Orb?
A crystal filled with concentrated magical powers, pride of all Laphines?
scripts.translation:
[谢尼梅]
您对宝珠了解多少？
那是蕴含浓缩魔力的水晶，是所有拉菲尼人的骄傲？

scripts.text:
[Shenime]
The place where the lighting for the Orb is installed in other words, the place where the guards stay is the ceiling.
It's a place that you pass by before going up to the palace.
scripts.translation:
[谢尼梅]
安装宝珠照明装置的地方，也就是卫兵驻守的地方，是在天花板上。
那是您前往宫殿前会经过的地方。

scripts.text:
[Shenime]
I heard you are helping out here and there nowadays.
You must be busy.
scripts.translation:
[谢尼梅]
我听说您最近到处帮忙。
您一定很忙吧。

scripts.text:
[Shenime]
There's a guard at the east side of the plaza near the gate.
I notified him already, so just ask him to guide you.
scripts.translation:
[谢尼梅]
在靠近大门的广场东侧有一位卫兵。
我已经通知他了，您直接请他为您引路即可。

scripts.text:
[Shenime]
It seems like you haven't even met him yet. Ask the guard to guide you.
scripts.translation:
[谢尼梅]
看来您还没见过他。请让卫兵为您引路。

scripts.text:
[Shenime]
At the starting point of Bifrost, there should be a messenger stamping his feet.
scripts.translation:
[谢尼梅]
在双层牛肉堡的起点，应该有一位信使正在跺脚。

scripts.text:
[Shenime]
It's a messenger that we sent in an effort to contact Splendide regularly,
but I think it's still difficult to do so.
scripts.translation:
[谢尼梅]
那是我们为了定期联络辉煌领域而派去的信使，
但我觉得目前联络起来还是很困难。

scripts.text:
[Shenime]
If you could help us with that, wouldn't other Laphines think better of you?
scripts.translation:
[谢尼梅]
如果您能帮我们解决这个问题，其他拉菲尼人会不会更看好您呢？

scripts.text: I'm supposed to give you something..
scripts.translation: 我本该给您一样东西...

scripts.text:
[Shenime]
Oh, yes. Mayor has bestowed a wing on you.
Here it is.
scripts.translation:
[谢尼梅]
啊，是的。市长大人赐予您一对翅膀。
给您。

scripts.text:
[Shenime]
It's nothing huge, but it's not common, either.
Just shake it gently and you'll find yourself in Eclage anytime.
scripts.translation:
[谢尼梅]
虽然不是什么了不起的东西，但也不常见。
只要轻轻摇晃它，您随时都能到达埃克拉珠。

scripts.text:
[Shenime]
It's an item that fits you perfectly. I mean you, who work for the king. Hehe.
scripts.translation:
[谢尼梅]
这是一件非常适合您的物品。我是说您，身为国王的人。呵呵。

scripts.text:
[Shenime]
Actually, I'm sponsoring a scholar of magics.
He needs some materials for experiments, and I was told you can find the materials in Bifrost Tower.
scripts.translation:
[谢尼梅]
其实，我正在资助一位魔法学者。
他需要一些实验材料，听说您可以在中央塔找到这些材料。

scripts.text:
[Shenime]
If it's okay, can you do me a favor?
Of course I'll give you a big reward.
scripts.translation:
[谢尼梅]
如果不介意的话，能帮我个忙吗？
当然，我会给您丰厚的奖励。

scripts.text: Sure.
scripts.translation: 当然。

scripts.text: Sorry, I can't.
scripts.translation: 抱歉，我不行。

scripts.text:
[Shenime]
I was worried since it's something unexpected for you. I'm so glad.
Collect the following items for me, please.
scripts.translation:
[谢尼梅]
因为这对您来说有些意外，我原本很担心。很高兴您答应了。
请帮我收集以下物品。

scripts.text:
[Shenime]
Ah, that's too bad.
I'll ask someone else then.
scripts.translation:
[谢尼梅]
啊，真遗憾。
那我再去问问别人吧。

scripts.text: [Shenime]
scripts.translation: [谢尼梅]

scripts.text:
[Shenime]
I need Dustballs and bookmarks made of fallen leaves.
You can find them inside the tower.
Bring me 10 of each for now, please.
scripts.translation:
[谢尼梅]
我需要尘埃和用落叶制成的书签。
您可以在塔内找到它们。
请先给我各10个。

scripts.text: Who is the scholar of magics?
scripts.translation: 那位魔法学者是谁？

scripts.text:
[Shenime]
I'm just sponsoring him personally. 
Scholars and alchemists who belong to the door of truth fall short in many areas aside from research. 
Some of them can't make a living and things like that...
The one I'm sponsoring is one of them.
scripts.translation:
[谢尼梅]
我只是在个人资助他。
属于真理之门的学者和炼金术士，除了研究之外在很多方面都很匮乏。
有些人甚至无法维持生计之类的...
我资助的就是其中一位。

scripts.text: I would like to meet him.
scripts.translation: 我想见见他。

scripts.text:
[Shenime]
That's not going to be possible.
He is in the middle of a very important experiment, and since he's so sensitive, he doesn't like meeting strangers.
scripts.translation:
[谢尼梅]
这恐怕不太可能。
他正在进行一项非常重要的实验，而且他性格敏感，不喜欢见陌生人。

scripts.text:
[Shenime]
It's difficult for me to tell you about him and besides, I'm not obligated to tell you about his personal information. 
Don't bother to ask about him anymore.
scripts.translation:
[谢尼梅]
我很难向您透露关于他的事情，而且我也没有义务告诉您他的个人信息。
请不要再多问了。

scripts.text: About Avant.
scripts.translation: 关于阿旺。

scripts.text:
[Shenime]
Avant?
I don't know him.
A scholar of magics? There's no one with that name among the scholars I know. 
I don't know.
scripts.translation:
[谢尼梅]
阿旺？
我不认识他。
魔法学者？在我认识的学者中没有叫这个名字的人。
我不知道。

scripts.text:
[Shenime]
I don't know where you heard about him but you should give up. You won't be able to find him.
scripts.translation:
[谢尼梅]
我不知道你在哪里听说的，但你还是放弃吧。你找不到他的。

scripts.text:
[Shenime]
Since he was interested in humans like you, I was going to arrange a meeting for you two,
but I don't know where he is...
scripts.translation:
[谢尼梅]
既然他对你们人类感兴趣，我本来打算安排你们见面的，
但我不知道他在哪里...

scripts.text:
[Shenime]
Anyway, are you still interested in the scholar of magics that I was sponsoring?
That's what you wanted to ask in the first place, right?
scripts.translation:
[谢尼梅]
总之，你对我资助的那位魔法学者还感兴趣吗？
你一开始想问的就是这个，对吧？

scripts.text: Do you know anything about his research?
scripts.translation: 你知道他的研究内容吗？

scripts.text:
[Shenime]
I don't.
He told me he would do me a favor if I sponsored him.
scripts.translation:
[谢尼梅]
我不知道。
他告诉我，如果我资助他，他会帮我一个忙。

scripts.text:
[Shenime]
There's nothing more to say.
I resent his sudden disappearance.
scripts.translation:
[谢尼梅]
没什么好说的了。
我讨厌他这种突然消失的行为。

scripts.text:
[Shenime]
and the scholar that I was sponsoring is gone...
Oh my...is this cheat-and-run?!
scripts.translation:
[谢尼梅]
而且我资助的那位学者也失踪了...
天哪...这是卷款潜逃吗？！

scripts.text: Are you upset?
scripts.translation: 你生气了吗？

scripts.text:
[Shenime]
Am I upset?
Ha...I think I might have been cheated.
He promised to do a research on the topic that I'm interested in, only if I sponsored him for a certain period of time.
scripts.translation:
[谢尼梅]
我生气吗？
哈...我觉得我可能被骗了。
他承诺只要我资助他一段时间，他就会研究我感兴趣的课题。

scripts.text: Did you know what he was researching?
scripts.translation: 你知道他在研究什么吗？

scripts.text: What did you want him to research about?
scripts.translation: 你想让他研究什么？

scripts.text:
[Shenime]
What he asked for was pretty simple. 
I provided a place for living and researching and the cost of materials used when doing a research upon my request.
scripts.translation:
[谢尼梅]
他要求的条件很简单。
我提供居住和研究的地方，以及应我要求进行研究时所需的材料费用。

scripts.text:
[Shenime]
I didn't want to provide him with food and a place to live for free,
so I asked him to do a research on Bifrost Tower.
scripts.translation:
[谢尼梅]
我不想免费给他提供食宿，
所以我让他研究中央塔。

scripts.text: [Shenime]
scripts.translation: [谢尼梅]

scripts.text:
[Shenime]
I thought he was doing a research on the topic that I was interested in.
Didn't you give me the materials the other day?
The ones related to the monsters inside the tower.
scripts.translation:
[谢尼梅]
我以为他在研究我感兴趣的课题。
前几天你不是给了我一些材料吗？
那些是关于塔内魔物的。

scripts.text:
[Shenime]
He just ran away when I had fed him, housed him, and provided him with the materials for experiments!!
I'm very shocked.
scripts.translation:
[谢尼梅]
我给他提供了食物、住所和实验材料，他却跑了！！
我非常震惊。

scripts.text: Why do you complain after so long a time?
scripts.translation: 为什么过了这么久才抱怨？

scripts.text:
[Shenime]
...I thought about it and I didn't have anyone else to talk to.
I wasn't sponsoring him in secret, but still...
When I asked about his whereabouts to the scholars in the gate of the truth, they didn't know either...
scripts.translation:
[谢尼梅]
...我想了想，也没别人可以倾诉。
我并没有秘密资助他，但是...
当我去真理之门询问他的下落时，那里的学者们也不知道...

scripts.text:
[Shenime]
...and I was going to ask him to do a research on Hazy Forest. 
I have to look for another scholar now.
scripts.translation:
[谢尼梅]
...而且我本来打算让他研究迷雾森林。
我现在得再找一位学者了。

scripts.text:
[Shenime]
That's all I did, and I don't know anything other than that.
When he finishes the research, I was going to ask him to do another research on Hazy Forest.
scripts.translation:
[谢尼梅]
我只做了这些，除此之外我什么都不知道。
等他完成研究后，我打算让他再研究一下迷雾森林。

scripts.text:
[Shenime]
But I didn't know he would be irresponsible like this.
I've been fooled!
scripts.translation:
[谢尼梅]
但我没想到他会这么不负责任。
我被骗了！

scripts.text:
[Shenime]
I'm going to have to find another scholar who is more eligible for the job.
scripts.translation:
[谢尼梅]
看来我得找一位更胜任这项工作的学者了。

scripts.text:
[Shenime]
Anyway, this is what happened to me.
By the way, you who work for the king do you know what is on Mayor's mind nowadays?
scripts.translation:
[谢尼梅]
总之，这就是我遇到的情况。
顺便问一下，身为国王手下的你，知道市长最近在想什么吗？

scripts.text:
[Shenime]
Mayor has to be a representative of Laphines as a whole.
If he's planning something on his own, it's unacceptable.
scripts.translation:
[谢尼梅]
市长必须代表整个拉菲涅斯。
如果他擅自行动，那是不可接受的。

scripts.text: There is no such thing.
scripts.translation: 没有这回事。

scripts.text: What do you want to know?
scripts.translation: 您想知道什么？

scripts.text:
[Shenime]
It's about the Orb.
He ordered to reinforce the guard around the Orb.
Do you know why?
scripts.translation:
[谢尼梅]
是关于宝珠的事。
他下令加强宝珠周围的守卫。
你知道为什么吗？

scripts.text: Tell him why.
scripts.translation: 告诉他原因。

scripts.text: I don't know, either.
scripts.translation: 我也不知道。

scripts.text: To what extent should you tell him?
scripts.translation: 你应该告诉他到什么程度？

scripts.text: Tell him all about it.
scripts.translation: 全部告诉他。

scripts.text: Make up something.
scripts.translation: 编个理由。

scripts.text:
[Shenime]
What?
So, you're saying that the scholar I was sponsoring is 'the Avant?'
scripts.translation:
[谢尼梅]
什么？
你是说，我资助的那位学者是“阿旺”？

scripts.text: You didn't even know the name of the person you were sponsoring?
scripts.translation: 你连资助的人叫什么名字都不知道？

scripts.text:
[Shenime]
No...no way...!
It's just that he went by a different name.
scripts.translation:
[谢尼梅]
不...不可能...！
只是他用了别的名字而已。

scripts.text:
[Shenime]
Anyway, if what you're saying is true, then it is a big problem.
But from my observation, I've never seen him talking to other people.
scripts.translation:
[谢尼梅]
总之，如果你说的是真的，那就是个大问题。
但据我观察，我从未见他与人交谈。

scripts.text:
[Shenime]
Considering his personality, he might have done it out of interest, not with a specific purpose.
Actually I'm hoping that he did it out of interest.
scripts.translation:
[谢尼梅]
考虑到他的性格，他可能只是出于兴趣，并没有特定的目的。
实际上，我希望他只是出于兴趣。

scripts.text:
[Shenime]
The incident in Splendide alone gives me a headache...but things are getting even worse.
scripts.translation:
[谢尼梅]
仅辉煌领域的事件就让我头疼...但情况似乎变得更糟了。

scripts.text:
[Shenime]
Although you're a foreigner, you're under obligation to protect the Orb since you know everything.
scripts.translation:
[谢尼梅]
虽然你是外国人，但既然你了解一切，就有义务保护宝珠。

scripts.text:
[Shenime]
I hope not, but if something bad happens I would like you to help me.
scripts.translation:
[谢尼梅]
我希望不会发生坏事，但如果真出了事，我希望你能帮我。

scripts.text:
[Shenime]
Now I should focus more on deploying the guards.
.. ..
scripts.translation:
[谢尼梅]
现在，我应该更专注于部署卫兵。
... ...

scripts.text:
[Shenime]
You don't know, either?
Mayor Jun didn't feel safe for some reason and because of that, he ordered us to tighten guard?
scripts.translation:
[谢尼梅]
你也不知道吗？
不知为何，市长朱恩感到不安，因此下令加强警戒。

scripts.text:
[Shenime]
Well, I understand.
I should do it if he says so.
I should believe that Mayor gave us the order after considering it normally and logically.
scripts.translation:
[谢尼梅]
嗯，我理解。
既然他这么说了，我就照做吧。
我应该相信市长是在经过正常且合乎逻辑的考量后才下达的命令。

scripts.text:
[Shenime]
It's unexpected.
I thought you were the one who Mayor Jun trusts the most in Eclage.
scripts.translation:
[谢尼梅]
这出乎意料。
我以为你是市长朱恩在埃克拉珠最信任的人。

scripts.text:
[Shenime]
Whatever the reason is, I should believe that Mayor gave us the order after considering it normally and logically.
scripts.translation:
[谢尼梅]
无论原因是什么，我都应该相信市长是在经过正常且合乎逻辑的考量后才下达的命令。

scripts.text: You don't want to follow his order?
scripts.translation: 你不想听从他的命令？

scripts.text:
[Shenime]
Of course I do!
I'm just worried that the corrupt blood might have clouded Mayor's judgement.
scripts.translation:
[谢尼梅]
我当然想听从！
我只是担心腐败的血脉可能影响了市长的判断。

scripts.text:
[Shenime]
Fine. Let's put it this way.
You seem to trust and follow Mayor Jun not caring about the sense of uneasiness among us.
scripts.translation:
[谢尼梅]
好吧。这么说吧。
你似乎不顾我们内心的不安，依然信任并追随市长朱恩。

scripts.text:
[Shenime]
We pray that the modern Mayor will be like the wind that just passes by.
Once is enough of that kind of a strong wind.
scripts.translation:
[谢尼梅]
我们祈祷现代市长能像风一样，只是匆匆路过。
那种强烈的风，一次就足够了。

scripts.text:
[Shenime]
I don't know why Mayor is so obsessed with the Orb but since he made that decision after talking to you, I'm sure you had great influence on him as well.
scripts.translation:
[谢尼梅]
我不知道市长为何如此执着于宝珠，但既然他是在与你交谈后做出决定的，我相信你对他也产生了很大的影响。

scripts.text:
[Shenime]
Let's wait and see
what happens to the Orb, the pride and origin of us Laphines. 
Of course you should be there, too.
scripts.translation:
[谢尼梅]
让我们拭目以待，
看看作为拉菲尼人骄傲与起源的宝珠会发生什么。
当然，你也应该在场。

scripts.text:
[Shenime]
shouldn't you wait and see whether Mayor, the one you trust so much, has made the right decision or not?
scripts.translation:
[谢尼梅]
你不应该等待并观察，看看你如此信任的市长是否做出了正确的决定吗？

scripts.text: He is right.
scripts.translation: 他是正确的。

scripts.text:
[Shenime]
If he's not right, it's a problem for me as well!
I'm just keeping my eyes on him since you never know when he will reveal his personal ambitions just like Seneth did.
Who can be sure about his integrity? This could be a manipulative trick that looks fine only on the surface.
scripts.translation:
[谢尼梅]
如果他错了，那也是我面临的问题！
我只是在监视他，因为你永远不知道他何时会像塞内斯那样暴露个人野心。
谁能保证他的正直？这可能只是一个表面看起来很好的操纵手段。

scripts.text:
[Shenime]
However, the presence of Mayor itself is perfect and worthy of reverence.
Therefore, we have to stay vigilant while hoping that he would make the right decisions.
scripts.translation:
[谢尼梅]
然而，市长本身的存在是完美且值得敬畏的。
因此，我们必须保持警惕，同时希望他能做出正确的决定。

scripts.text:
[Shenime]
So this is only for caution's sake.
There is only one thing I want.
scripts.translation:
[谢尼梅]
所以这只是为了谨慎起见。
我只想要一件事。

scripts.text:
[Shenime]
I want you to be a witness and judge whether a series of actions taken around the Orb were truly for the sake of the Orb and Laphines or not.
scripts.translation:
[谢尼梅]
我希望你作为见证人，判断围绕宝珠采取的一系列行动是否真正为了宝珠和拉菲尼人的利益。

scripts.text:
[Shenime]
I'm talking about something structural, noot those abstract concepts.
Have you ever looked up to see the ceiling of the plaza, which is decorated with the Orb?
scripts.translation:
[谢尼梅]
我指的是结构性的东西，而不是那些抽象的概念。
你有没有抬头看过广场的天花板，上面装饰着宝珠？

scripts.text:
[Shenime]
Maybe not.
Even if you have, you would have been blinded by the bright light.
scripts.translation:
[谢尼梅]
也许没有。
即使看过，你也会被明亮火光刺得睁不开眼。

scripts.text: Why are you saying all this?
scripts.translation: 你为什么说这些？

scripts.text:
[Shenime]
Didn't Mayor tell you?
In the ceiling, there are light fixtures installed to bring out the brightness of the Orb even more.
scripts.translation:
[谢尼梅]
市长没告诉你吗？
天花板上安装了照明设备，以进一步凸显宝珠的亮度。

scripts.text:
[Shenime]
The Orb is always exposed in the plaza and since all Laphines have their eyes on it the guards who protect the Orb look down from the ceiling where the light fixtures are installed.
scripts.translation:
[谢尼梅]
宝珠一直暴露在广场上，所有拉菲尼人都注视着它，而守护宝珠的卫兵则从安装了照明设备的天花板上方俯视着这里。

scripts.text:
[Shenime]
In other words, it is easy to harm the Orb once the ceiling is attacked and disabled.
scripts.translation:
[谢尼梅]
换句话说，一旦天花板遭到攻击并失效，宝珠就很容易受到伤害。

scripts.text:
[Shenime]
Do you want to go and take a look?
It should be fine if it's you.
Moreover, you are under obligation to judge whether the king has made the right decision or not.
scripts.translation:
[谢尼梅]
你想去看看吗？
如果是你的话，应该没问题。
而且，你有义务判断国王的决定是否正确。

scripts.text:
[Shenime]
Let me guide you.
Hold my hand.
scripts.translation:
[谢尼梅]
让我来带你去。
握住我的手。

scripts.text: What should I do?
scripts.translation: 我该做什么？

scripts.text: Ask Kardui first.
scripts.translation: 先问问卡尔杜伊

scripts.text: Hold his hand.
scripts.translation: 握住他的手。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I don't understand why you're telling me this important information.
Give me some time to think about it.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我不明白你为什么要告诉我这些重要信息。
请给我一点时间考虑一下。

scripts.text:
[Shenime]
You need some time to think about it?
I'm not usually this hospitable to a foreigner, but I see.
Come back later then.
scripts.translation:
[谢尼梅]
你需要时间考虑？
我通常对外国人不会这么客气，但既然你这么说，那就这样吧。
稍后再来。

scripts.text:
When you held Shenime's hand, you felt a sharp pain in your hand.
You took your hand off quickly and examined it, but nothing was there.
scripts.translation:
当你握住谢尼梅的手时，你感到手上一阵刺痛。
你迅速把手抽回来检查，但什么也没发现。

scripts.text: Is it just imagination...?
scripts.translation: 只是错觉...？

scripts.text:
[Shenime]
What's wrong?
May I guide you?
Now, this is the place you should watch carefully.
scripts.translation:
[谢尼梅]
怎么了？
需要我为您引路吗？
这里正是您应该仔细留意的地方。

scripts.text: - You have too many items to proceed with the quest. -
scripts.translation: - 你的物品栏已满，无法继续任务。 -

scripts.text:
[Kardui]
Is this how people feel when they lose blood?
The feeling of magical powers oozing out of my body...
Sorry. I'm a little bit tired.
scripts.translation:
[卡尔杜伊]
这就是失血的感觉吗？
魔力从身体里流出的感觉...
抱歉，我有点累了。

scripts.text:
[Hisie]
Wait...leave him alone.
He just fell asleep.
He must be very tired from replacing the magical powers of the Orb.
scripts.translation:
[希西]
等等...别管他了。
他只是睡着了。
他一定因为替换宝珠的魔力而非常疲惫。

scripts.text:
[Hisie]
I'm not so happy about it, but Avant is in the process of making something that will replace the Orb's inner core.
If he suceeds, things will be the way they used to be, right?
scripts.translation:
[希西]
虽然我不太高兴，但阿旺正在制作一个能替代宝珠内核的东西。
如果他成功了，一切就会恢复原样，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Hisie]
Seriously...I can't believe I have to ask him a favor.
....
scripts.translation:
[希西]
真是的...我竟然要向他开口求助。
...

scripts.text:
[Kardui]
My head is cluttered with too many things.
The brains of Mayor is supposed to be filled with hundreds of thousands of drawers...
But this is way beyond that.
scripts.translation:
[卡尔杜伊]
我的脑子里装满了太多东西。
市长的头脑本该装满成千上万个抽屉...
但这已经远远超出了那个范围。

scripts.text:
[Kardui]
Ah, I just want to whine. Where did my brother go...?
If other Laphines see me like this, they'll probably be frightened.
scripts.translation:
[卡尔杜伊]
啊，我只想抱怨一下。我的兄弟去哪了...？
如果其他拉菲尼人看到我这样，他们可能会害怕。

scripts.text:
[Kardui]
Ahahahahahaha-
You see. I feel like either knowledges of a thousand years or memories of a ten thousand years is so useless.
scripts.translation:
[卡尔杜伊]
啊哈哈哈哈哈-
你看。我觉得无论是千年的知识，还是万年的记忆，都是如此无用。

scripts.text:
[Kardui]
I'm racking my brains searching through all the memories, informations, and history of every Mayor,
but there's no such thing as ways of fighting against the king of demons.
scripts.translation:
[卡尔杜伊]
我绞尽脑汁，搜索着所有市长的记忆、信息和历史，
但并没有对抗恶魔国王的方法。

scripts.text:
[Kardui]
I should probably leave this to an expert?
scripts.translation:
[卡尔杜伊]
我应该把这个交给专家吗？

scripts.text:
[Kardui]
Welcome to Eclage, stranger.
... this was a popular way of greeting each other, but I guess it's not fun anymore.
scripts.translation:
[卡尔杜伊]
欢迎来到埃克拉珠，陌生人。
...这曾经是一种流行的问候方式，但我想现在听起来不再有趣了。

scripts.text:
[Kardui]
Now, you who work for the king!
Work your fingers to the bone for me!
scripts.translation:
[卡尔杜伊]
现在，你为国王工作！
为我拼命工作吧！

scripts.text:
[Kardui]
It looks like you've been doing well.
scripts.translation:
[卡尔杜伊]
看起来你过得不错。

scripts.text:
[Kardui]
Long time no see.
Is there anything you want from me?
scripts.translation:
[卡尔杜伊]
好久不见。
你有什么需要我帮忙的吗？

scripts.text:
[Kardui]
How do you like staying in Eclage?
Since you people don't have wings, we've made roads for your convenience...
scripts.translation:
[卡尔杜伊]
你觉得住在埃克拉珠怎么样？
既然你们没有翅膀，为了方便起见，我们修了路...

scripts.text:
[Kardui]
I was going to tell you when we first met,
but isn't it difficult for you to travel around Eclage?
scripts.translation:
[卡尔杜伊]
我本来想在我们第一次见面时就告诉你的，
但在埃克拉珠四处走动对你来说是不是很困难？

scripts.text:
[Kardui]
Have you been to Bifrost Tower?
scripts.translation:
[卡尔杜伊]
你去过中央塔吗？

scripts.text:
[Kardui]
Isn't my brother so cool?
He is the only one who understands how I feel. 
He is the one who comforted me and made my hatred go away.
scripts.translation:
[卡尔杜伊]
我哥哥是不是很酷？
他是唯一理解我感受的人。
是他安慰了我，让我心中的仇恨消散了。

scripts.text:
[Kardui]
So, is there any progress...?
...
Huh? Brother?
scripts.translation:
[卡尔杜伊]
那么，有什么进展吗...？
...
啊？哥哥？

scripts.text:
[Kardui]
Go to Avant's laboratory and see what kind of research he is doing.
If it's something useless, it's even better to mess up his research materials.
scripts.translation:
[卡尔杜伊]
去阿旺的实验室看看他在做什么研究。
如果是没用的东西，最好把他的研究材料搞乱。

scripts.text:
[Kardui]
I heard your story from my brother already.
You took care of Avant with your bare hands, right?
puhehehe...
scripts.translation:
[卡尔杜伊]
我已经从我哥哥那里听到你的故事了。
你是徒手制服了阿旺，对吧？
噗呵呵呵...

scripts.text:
[Kardui]
Anyway, I had no idea he would be doing a research on things like this.
Brother, you know what it means, right?
scripts.translation:
[卡尔杜伊]
总之，我没想到他会在研究这种东西。
哥哥，你知道这意味着什么，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Kardui]
So, do you guys have any good news?
What was Avant researching about?
scripts.translation:
[卡尔杜伊]
那么，你们有什么好消息吗？
阿旺在研究什么？

scripts.text:
[Kardui]
I commanded the guards to strengthen security patrols around the Orb.
They seemed quite confused since it's all so sudden but...
scripts.translation:
[卡尔杜伊]
我命令卫兵加强水晶球周围的安保巡逻。
他们似乎很困惑，因为这一切发生得太突然了，但是...

scripts.text:
[Kardui]
So, you and my brother talked about such things.
Now that I think about it, he was sponsoring Avant.
scripts.translation:
[卡尔杜伊]
原来你和哥哥谈了这些事情。
现在想想，他一直在资助阿旺。

scripts.text:
[Kardui]
I've been waiting for you. My brother told me about you.
Since I was so focused on finding Avant, I totally forgot about the Chief of Staff.
scripts.translation:
[卡尔杜伊]
我一直在等你。哥哥跟我提起过你。
因为我太专注于寻找阿旺，完全忘了参谋长的事。

scripts.text:
[Kardui]
I want to know what this anxiety is about.
Could this be a warning sign coming from Yggdrasil?
scripts.translation:
[卡尔杜伊]
我想知道这种不安感从何而来。
这会不会是来自世界树的警告？

scripts.text:
[Kardui]
Gosh, it's getting even more interesting!
Why on earth is he doing that?
Every Laphine knows about the lightings in the ceiling.
scripts.translation:
[卡尔杜伊]
天哪，事情越来越有趣了！
他到底为什么要那样做？
每个拉菲涅人都知道天花板上的灯光。

scripts.text:
[Kardui]
We have to find out why the Chief of Staff want to take you to the lighting room.
Do we just have to wait and see for now.
scripts.translation:
[卡尔杜伊]
我们必须弄清楚参谋长为什么要带你去灯光室。
我们现在只能先观望吗。

scripts.text:
[Kardui]
It's all my fault...for making you...go through this.
I'm sorry...
scripts.translation:
[卡尔杜伊]
都是我的错...让你...经历了这些。
对不起...

scripts.text:
[Kardui]
The incident in the lighting room is proven to be an act of self-defense.
You're free to go anywhere for now.
scripts.translation:
[卡尔杜伊]
灯光室的事件被证实是正当防卫。
你现在可以自由行动了。

scripts.text:
[Kardui]
A dead body with a hole...
The Chief of Staff was manipulated, too.
His name was Shenime, right?
Then what might have been the original name of the Chief of Staff...
scripts.translation:
[卡尔杜伊]
一具身上有洞的尸体...
参谋长也是被操纵的。
他的名字叫谢尼梅，对吧？
那么参谋长原本的名字可能是什么...

scripts.text:
[Kardui]
Mmm...
I don't know who you are, but could you wait until I call you?
I'll have to meet you some day, but now is not the right time.
scripts.translation:
[卡尔杜伊]
嗯...
我不知道你是谁，但你能等我联系你吗？
总有一天我会见你，但现在不是时候。

scripts.text:
[Kardui]
I have a gift for you. Go and ask the Chief of Staff.
You will find it useful.
scripts.translation:
[卡尔杜伊]
我有一份礼物给你。去找参谋长领取吧。
你会用得上的。

scripts.text:
[Kardui]
Isn't that brooch really really cute?
You can use it to come to Eclage anytime. 
This is all I can do for your convenience right now.
scripts.translation:
[卡尔杜伊]
这枚胸针真的很可爱吧？
你可以用它随时来到埃克拉珠。
目前我能为你提供的便利仅此而已。

scripts.text:
[Kardui]
Go to the top floor of Bifrost Tower and give this letter to my brother.
You'll know when you get there.
scripts.translation:
[卡尔杜伊]
去中央塔的顶层，把这封信交给我的兄弟。
你到了那里就会明白的。

scripts.text: [Kardui]
scripts.translation: [卡尔杜伊]

scripts.text:
[Kardui]
Anyway, you who came from a long way away
and reconized by the guardian.
There is a truth that you would like to tell me?
scripts.translation:
[卡尔杜伊]
总之，你从远方而来，
并被守护者认可。
你有什么想告诉我的真相吗？

scripts.text:
[Kardui]
If that's the case, you will be very busy from now on.
scripts.translation:
[卡尔杜伊]
如果是这样，那你今后会很忙。

scripts.text: What do you mean?
scripts.translation: 你这是什么意思？

scripts.text:
[Kardui]
You have to do a lot of work in order to convince me, the elders, and many other Laphines.
scripts.translation:
[卡尔杜伊]
为了让我、长老们以及许多其他拉菲人信服，
你需要做很多工作。

scripts.text:
[Kardui]
Of couse I could trust everything you say,
but will other Laphines accept a Mayor Jun who is swayed by a word of a foreigner?
scripts.translation:
[卡尔杜伊]
我当然可以完全相信你说的，
但其他拉菲人会接受一个被外乡人言语左右的大市长朱恩吗？

scripts.text:
[Kardui]
Especially when that Mayor Jun is me. Ah...
scripts.translation:
[卡尔杜伊]
尤其是当这位大市长朱恩就是我时。啊...

scripts.text:
[Kardui]
Don't you understand?
Here, in Eclage, You have to get more recognition from Laphines.
scripts.translation:
[卡尔杜伊]
你不明白吗？
在这里，在埃克拉珠，你需要获得拉菲人更多的认可。

scripts.text: Do I have to make a contribution?
scripts.translation: 我需要做出贡献吗？

scripts.text: It's about Yggdrasil!
scripts.translation: 这是关于世界树的事！

scripts.text:
[Kardui]
See, you understood it right.
scripts.translation:
[卡尔杜伊]
看吧，你理解得很对。

scripts.text: It's about Yggdrasil!
scripts.translation: 这是关于世界树的事！

scripts.text:
[Kardui]
Um.
I know.
scripts.translation:
[卡尔杜伊]
嗯。
我知道了。

scripts.text:
[Kardui]
You don't have to make a face.
No matter what I look like to you, I am the history and the spirit of Laphines, and also the protector of Yggdrasil.
scripts.translation:
[卡尔杜伊]
别露出那种表情。
无论我在你眼中是什么样，我是拉菲人的历史与精神，也是世界树的守护者。

scripts.text:
[Kardui]
Do you think I, who inherited the will of Yggdrasil, don't know anything?
I don't blame you since it is ignorance.
scripts.translation:
[卡尔杜伊]
你觉得继承了世界树意志的我，会一无所知吗？
我不怪你，那是无知。

scripts.text:
[Kardui]
The war of Jotunheim will soon be over.
And it will happen not by constraint, but as a result of mutual agreement.
scripts.translation:
[卡尔杜伊]
约顿海姆的战争很快就会结束。
而且它不会因强制而结束，而是双方协议的结果。

scripts.text:
[Kardui]
So, stranger,
don't worry about it and do you want to work with me for Eclage?
scripts.translation:
[卡尔杜伊]
所以，陌生人，
别担心，你愿意为埃克拉珠与我合作吗？

scripts.text: Then why do you make war and disregard the truth?
scripts.translation: 那你为何发动战争并无视真相？

scripts.text:
[Kardui]
Hmm...
I'll tell you when we get closer to each other.
I'm not obligated to talk about this important subject with a person I just met.
scripts.translation:
[卡尔杜伊]
嗯...
等我们更亲近时再告诉你吧。
我没有义务与刚见面的人谈论这个重要话题。

scripts.text:
[Kardui]
For now, I will tell the administrative ruler, the elders, and all the guards
about you,
and you will enjoy all the rights in Eclage as a person who works for the king.
scripts.translation:
[卡尔杜伊]
目前，我会告诉行政统治者、长老们和所有卫兵
关于你的事，
你将作为为国王工作的人，在埃克拉珠享有所有权利。

scripts.text: Just hire a worker then!
scripts.translation: 那就直接雇个工人吧！

scripts.text:
[Kardui]
It's a part of building relationships with me, the king of a race. You don't like it?
If that's the case, I guess there's no friendship between the two of us.
scripts.translation:
[卡尔杜伊]
这是建立与我——一个种族的国王——之间关系的一部分。你不喜欢吗？
如果是这样，我想我们之间不会有友谊了。

scripts.text: What do you mean 'the two of us?'
scripts.translation: 你说“我们”是什么意思？

scripts.text:
[Kardui]
Us? 
Umm...
Friends who share their secrets from now on?
scripts.translation:
[卡尔杜伊]
我们？
嗯...
从今以后分享彼此秘密的朋友？

scripts.text:
[Kardui]
..Haha...wasn't it funny?
What's up with that face.
Anyway, I allow you to visit anytime.
scripts.translation:
[卡尔杜伊]
...哈哈...好笑吗？
你那是什么表情。
总之，我允许你随时来访。

scripts.text:
[Kardui]
However, if you don't meet my expectation, you won't get anything.
I'll be looking forward to seeing you, stranger who will be my friend.
scripts.translation:
[卡尔杜伊]
不过，如果你达不到我的期望，你将一无所获。
我期待见到你，将成为我朋友的陌生人。

scripts.text:
[Kardui]
...It's a joke.
I truly want you to become an important figure in Eclage.
Even if you don't, I want you to be recognized as a harmless person who gives benefit to Eclage.
scripts.translation:
[卡尔杜伊]
...开个玩笑。
我真心希望你能成为埃克拉珠的重要人物。
即使不能，我也希望你被认可为对埃克拉珠有益且无害的人。

scripts.text:
[Kardui]
It's going to be tough, but think of it as having insurance.
Some day, a person who remembers your name will be a great help to you.
scripts.translation:
[卡尔杜伊]
这会很艰难，但把它当作一种保险吧。
总有一天，记得你名字的人会成为你的巨大助力。

scripts.text: Yes, thanks to you.
scripts.translation: 是的，谢谢你。

scripts.text:
[Kardui]
All I wanted was for you to gain recognition in Eclage, and I didn't intend anything bad by what I did.
Seriously, I called you again right away, didn't I?
scripts.translation:
[卡尔杜伊]
我只是希望你在埃克拉珠获得认可，我并没有任何恶意。
说真的，我马上又把你叫来了，不是吗？

scripts.text:
[Kardui]
.....
You think I did it on purpose to trick you.
I had no intention to do that.
scripts.translation:
[卡尔杜伊]
.....
你认为我是故意骗你的。
我没有那个意图。

scripts.text:
[Kardui]
The reason I requested your presence today is
