to tell you the unfinished story from the other day. So, I hope you feel better.
scripts.translation:
[卡尔杜伊]
我今天请你来，
是为了告诉你那天没讲完的故事。希望你现在感觉好些了。

scripts.text: I'm not mad.
scripts.translation: 我没生气。

scripts.text: Unfinished story?
scripts.translation: 没讲完的故事？

scripts.text:
[Kardui]
Really? What a relief.
Should I continue then?
scripts.translation:
[卡尔杜伊]
真的吗？太好了。
那我继续讲？

scripts.text:
[Kardui]
You were trying to tell me about the confrontation around Yggdrasil the other day.
Now, it's my turn to tell you how I got to know about that.
scripts.translation:
[卡尔杜伊]
前几天你试图告诉我关于世界树周围对峙的事。
现在，轮到我来告诉你我是如何得知这件事的。

scripts.text:
[Kardui]
Listen and just forget what I'm about to tell you.
scripts.translation:
[卡尔杜伊]
听着，然后忘掉我接下来要告诉你的事。

scripts.text:
[Kardui]
Yggdrasil and its protector are connected to each other and are able to communicate to a certain extent.
scripts.translation:
[卡尔杜伊]
世界树和它的守护者彼此相连，能够在一定程度上交流。

scripts.text:
[Kardui]
I even knew through Yggdrasil that the strange incident that happened inside the tree was not because of the excessive mining.
scripts.translation:
[卡尔杜伊]
我甚至通过世界树得知，树内发生的奇怪事件并非因为过度开采。

scripts.text: Then why?
scripts.translation: 那是为什么？

scripts.text:
[Kardui]
It's only natural for you to wonder why.
But when they detected something strange inside Yggdrasil, I couldn't communicate with Yggdrasil for some reason.
scripts.translation:
[卡尔杜伊]
你自然会想知道为什么。
但当它们检测到世界树内有异常时，我不知为何无法与世界树交流。

scripts.text:
[Kardui]
So I dispatched a research group in an effort to find out what happened.
But even the research group couldn't come up with better ideas.
scripts.translation:
[卡尔杜伊]
所以我派遣了一支研究小组，试图查明发生了什么。
但即使研究小组也没能想出更好的办法。

scripts.text:
[Kardui]
According to their report, it was due to the excessive mining.
You already know what happened next.
scripts.translation:
[卡尔杜伊]
根据他们的报告，原因是过度开采。
接下来发生了什么，你已经知道了。

scripts.text: So it all started just because...
scripts.translation: 所以这一切只是因为...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
...Mayor Jun could not communicate with Yggdrasil?
What about now?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
...朱恩市长无法与世界树交流？
现在呢？

scripts.text:
[Kardui]
Everything's fine, of course.
I'm sitting here, yet I have an insight into every truth.
scripts.translation:
[卡尔杜伊]
当然，一切都很好。
我坐在这里，却对每一个真相都了如指掌。

scripts.text:
[Kardui]
At that time, it might have been the best way to go.
Communicating with Yggdrasil was possible only after the war began and everything became irremediable.
scripts.translation:
[卡尔杜伊]
当时，那可能已经是最好的选择了。
直到战争爆发，一切变得不可挽回，我才得以与世界树交流。

scripts.text:
[Kardui]
When Mayor Jun was disconnected from Yggdrasil,
there appeared an evil spirit that we've never seen before.
scripts.translation:
[卡尔杜伊]
当朱恩市长与世界树断开连接时，
出现了一个我们从未见过的邪恶精灵。

scripts.text:
[Kardui]
To make things even worse, other protector betrayed and failed in his duty.
No one knew what was going on at that time.
scripts.translation:
[卡尔杜伊]
更糟糕的是，另一位守护者背叛并未能履行职责。
当时没人知道发生了什么。

scripts.text:
[Kardui]
The Mayor Jun, who was disconnected from Yggdrasil for a moment, could not go on
and became obsolete.
scripts.translation:
[卡尔杜伊]
与世界树短暂断开连接的朱恩市长，
无法继续下去，最终被淘汰了。

scripts.text:
[Kardui]
So, there came another Mayor Jun, which is me.
scripts.translation:
[卡尔杜伊]
于是，另一位朱恩市长出现了，那就是我。

scripts.text:
[Kardui]
After realizing it, I pondered about ways to untangle this twisted truth
for a long long time.
Since I have some problems to resolve myself, too...
scripts.translation:
[卡尔杜伊]
意识到这一点后，我花了很长时间思考如何解开这个扭曲的真相。
毕竟，我自己也有一些问题需要解决...

scripts.text:
[Kardui]
Have you met the ones who participated in sealing and purification in regard to the nest of the guardians?
They are the ones among the very few who know the truth.
scripts.translation:
[卡尔杜伊]
你见过参与封印和净化守护者巢穴的人吗？
他们是极少数知道真相的人之一。

scripts.text:
[Kardui]
But they say the same thing.
That it is too late to stop the war.
That this war has been going on for a good while and both sides are too proud to give in.
scripts.translation:
[卡尔杜伊]
但他们说的都一样。
阻止战争已经太迟了。
这场战争已经持续了很久，双方都太骄傲，不肯让步。

scripts.text:
[Kardui]
However, a third party came into the scene unexpectedly.
That is, you, humans.
scripts.translation:
[卡尔杜伊]
然而，一个第三方意外地介入了。
那就是你们，人类。

scripts.text:
[Kardui]
By the entrance of you people, both Saphas and Laphines are distracted. 
I'm trying to use this as an opportunity to change Laphines' thinking.
scripts.translation:
[卡尔杜伊]
由于你们的介入，萨法和拉菲娜都分心了。
我正试图利用这个机会改变拉菲娜的想法。

scripts.text:
[Kardui]
Saphas, the giants of Jotunheim, know already
that we are not each other's enemy.
scripts.translation:
[卡尔杜伊]
约顿海姆的巨人萨法，
已经知道我们彼此并非敌人。

scripts.text:
[Kardui]
So, you don't need to worry too much.
That's why I'm telling you this long story needlessly.
This is the problem that I, Mayor Jun, should solve.
scripts.translation:
[卡尔杜伊]
所以，你不必太担心。
这也是我为什么要告诉你这些冗长故事的原因。
这是朱恩市长，也就是我，应该解决的问题。

scripts.text:
[Kardui]
Are you relieved now?
Or are you still worried?
No matter how you feel, I'm sure most of your questions are answered.
scripts.translation:
[卡尔杜伊]
你现在放心了吗？
还是仍然担心？
无论你的感受如何，我相信你的大部分问题都已得到解答。

scripts.text:
[Kardui]
Although all your questions are answered, come to see me from time to time.
I might look pretty busy, but actually, I get bored, too. 
Oh, by the way, I told the Chief of Staff to give you something.
scripts.translation:
[卡尔杜伊]
虽然你的问题都得到解答了，但请偶尔来看看我。
我看起来可能很忙，但实际上，我也会感到无聊。
哦，对了，我让参谋长给你带点东西。

scripts.text: What is that?
scripts.translation: 那是什么？

scripts.text: You said I'm a tyrant!
scripts.translation: 你说我是暴君！

scripts.text: The cause of misery!
scripts.translation: 痛苦的根源！

scripts.text: [Kardui]
scripts.translation: [卡尔杜伊]

scripts.text:
[Kardui]
That? What is 'that?'
If you ask in a third-person determiner without any context, I wouldn't understand...
scripts.translation:
[卡尔杜伊]
那个？什么是“那个”？
如果你用第三人称代词，又不提供上下文，我是无法理解的...

scripts.text:
[Kardui]
I'm a tyrant? Ahahahahaha
That's the best joke I've ever heard.
I've never done any act of tyranny or forced to execute anything at all...
scripts.translation:
[卡尔杜伊]
我是暴君？啊哈哈哈哈哈
这是我听过的最好笑的笑话。
我从未做过任何暴虐之事，也从未强迫任何人执行任何命令...

scripts.text:
[Kardui]
Misery? The cause of misery...
Is that an expression about me?
scripts.translation:
[卡尔杜伊]
痛苦？痛苦的根源...
这是在说我吗？

scripts.text:
[Kardui]
Where have you been and what have you been doing? Why are you saying these random things?
scripts.translation:
[卡尔杜伊]
你去了哪里，又做了什么？为什么要说这些莫名其妙的话？

scripts.text: Tell him about the rumor.
scripts.translation: 告诉他关于谣言的事

scripts.text:
[Kardui]
What you're saying is that Laphines are looking at me with distrust and that they are worried, right?
Haha...I know already, but thanks for caring and telling me this in person.
scripts.translation:
[卡尔杜伊]
你的意思是，拉菲尼斯对我充满不信任，并且感到担忧，对吗？
哈哈...我早就知道了，但谢谢你的关心，还特意亲口告诉我。

scripts.text:
[Kardui]
However, you should be more careful or think again before saying something like that.
Others might think you're telling me this to make mischief between me and Laphines.
scripts.translation:
[卡尔杜伊]
不过，你在说这种话之前，应该更谨慎一些，或者再想想。
别人可能会认为你是在挑拨我和拉菲尼斯之间的关系。

scripts.text:
[Kardui]
Anyway, I'm already like your friend in your heart?
Only a friend would be worried about those rumors.
scripts.translation:
[卡尔杜伊]
总之，在我心里，你已经像我的朋友了？
只有朋友才会担心那些谣言。

scripts.text:
[Kardui]
Well, even if you weren't, let's just say that you were worried about me. I want to make a close friend of you.
scripts.translation:
[卡尔杜伊]
好吧，即使你不是，我们就当你是担心我好了。我想和你成为亲密的朋友。

scripts.text:
[Kardui]
Do you remember what I told you before?
We're going to be friends who share secrets.
To celebrate our friendship, I'll tell you my secrets.
scripts.translation:
[卡尔杜伊]
你还记得我之前告诉你的话吗？
我们要成为分享秘密的朋友。
为了庆祝我们的友谊，我要告诉你我的秘密。

scripts.text:
[Kardui]
Mayor Jun is the one who inherited all the memories of the kings of many generations.
That is, the memories of every king, from the first Mayor Jun to the late Mayor Jun.
scripts.translation:
[卡尔杜伊]
朱恩市长继承了历代国王的所有记忆。
也就是说，从第一代朱恩市长到已故的朱恩市长，每一位国王的记忆。

scripts.text:
[Kardui]
It is a vast collection of information and a whirlpool of emotions at the same time.
Also, it is the reason for Donas' existence. Donas are ready to be used anytime.
scripts.translation:
[卡尔杜伊]
这是一座庞大的信息宝库，同时也是情感的漩涡。
这也是多纳斯存在的原因。多纳斯随时准备被使用。

scripts.text:
[Kardui]
If something ever happens and I die from it, 
then all the memories are transferred to one of the Donas and he becomes a new king, a Mayor Jun.
scripts.translation:
[卡尔杜伊]
如果发生什么意外，我因此死去，
那么所有记忆都会转移给其中一位多纳斯，他将成为新的国王，也就是朱恩市长。

scripts.text: It's interesting, but why is that important?
scripts.translation: 很有趣，但这为什么重要？

scripts.text:
[Kardui]
It's because I'm half Dona and half Papang.
Having mixed blood in the lineage of Dona, a prospective Mayor Jun...
It would be the most frightful thing to Laphines.
scripts.translation:
[卡尔杜伊]
因为我是半多纳斯，半帕潘格。
在多纳斯的血统中混入了杂血，作为未来的朱恩市长...
这对拉菲尼斯来说是最可怕的事情。

scripts.text:
[Kardui]
Actually I'm not the first king with mixed blood.
However, the first mixed-blood king was a complete tyrant, unfortunately.
scripts.translation:
[卡尔杜伊]
实际上，我不是第一位混血国王。
然而，不幸的是，第一位混血国王是个彻头彻尾的暴君。

scripts.text:
[Kardui]
Having a mixed-blood king itself is frightful for Laphines. But thinking about the possibility of inheriting the violent nature of the previous mixed-blood king...
I understand their uneasiness.
scripts.translation:
[卡尔杜伊]
拥有混血国王本身就让拉菲尼斯感到恐惧。但想到可能会继承前一位混血国王的暴虐本性...
我理解他们的不安。

scripts.text:
[Kardui]
I tried not to show it, but I was sad and distressed for a while after inheriting that memory.
Upon becoming Mayor, I can no longer forget things. So I can't even forget about it.
scripts.translation:
[卡尔杜伊]
我尽量不表现出来，但在继承那段记忆后，我曾一度感到悲伤和痛苦。
成为市长后，我再也不能忘记事情。所以我甚至无法忘记那段痛苦。

scripts.text:
[Kardui]
Seneth, the first king with mixed blood, hated and cursed the fact that he has mixed blood, which led him toward total destruction.
What Laphines are worried about right now is the same. They're worried that Mayor Jun would fail in his duty and lose his mind...
scripts.translation:
[卡尔杜伊]
塞内斯，第一位混血国王，憎恨并诅咒自己拥有混血血统，这导致他走向了彻底的毁灭。
拉菲尼斯现在担心的也是同样的事。他们担心朱恩市长会失职，甚至失去理智...

scripts.text:
[Kardui]
Haha...the more they're worried, the harder I should try.
Even though I'm half breed, which is discriminated against, I will fulfill my duties
and I will never avoid my fate like Seneth.
scripts.translation:
[卡尔杜伊]
哈哈...他们越担心，我就越要努力。
虽然我是被歧视的混血儿，但我会履行我的职责，
绝不会像塞内斯那样逃避命运。

scripts.text:
[Kardui]
It was boring and long story.
It's good to have someone to whom I can open up myself and talk.
That's how I've been enduring all this time.
scripts.translation:
[卡尔杜伊]
这故事又长又无聊。
能有人倾诉心声，感觉真好。
这段时间，我就是靠着这些撑过来的。

scripts.text:
[Kardui]
I sometimes think to myself. If only Seneth had someone he could talk to,
things would have been different...
scripts.translation:
[卡尔杜伊]
我有时会想，如果塞内斯也有个能倾诉的人，
结局会不会就不一样了...

scripts.text:
[Kardui]
Now that I think about it, I answered two of your questions already!
I'll give you a chance to pay back next time. Just wait for it!
scripts.translation:
[卡尔杜伊]
这么一想，我已经回答了你两个问题了！
下次我会给你机会还礼的。等着瞧吧！

scripts.text:
[Kardui]
By the way, I'm going to stop talking in a serious manner when talking to you.
Even though I'm Mayor, I sometimes want to act my age.
scripts.translation:
[卡尔杜伊]
顺便说一句，和你说话时，我不想再那么严肃了。
虽然我是市长，但有时也想像个同龄人一样。

scripts.text:
[Kardui]
Mayor is like an endless cycle of previous lives,
and being Mayor is like living hundreds of lives..
...When I'm overwhelmed with all the memories, I act like an old man who is thousands of years old before I know it.
scripts.translation:
[卡尔杜伊]
市长一职就像前世今生的无尽轮回，
当市长就像活了几百辈子...
...每当被无数记忆淹没时，不知不觉间，我就像个几千岁的老人。

scripts.text:
[Kardui]
Sometimes I feel like it would be nice to live as Kardui, not as Kardui the Mayor Jun.
Of course I've never tried to do so.
scripts.translation:
[卡尔杜伊]
有时候我觉得，如果能只作为卡尔杜伊，而不是朱恩市长卡尔杜伊，该多好。
当然，我从来没试过那样做。

scripts.text:
[Kardui]
So, the two of us should build good relationships.
scripts.translation:
[卡尔杜伊]
所以，我们俩应该建立更好的关系。

scripts.text:
[Kardui]
It will be better for you to improve your skills.
You'll be able to see more then.
You should work on it since I can't protect you outside of Eclage.
scripts.translation:
[卡尔杜伊]
对你来说，提升技能会更好。
那样你就能看得更远了。
毕竟在埃克拉珠之外，我可保护不了你，所以你要好好努力。

scripts.text: Yes, I have.
scripts.translation: 是的，我听过。

scripts.text: No, but I'm thinking about it.
scripts.translation: 没有，但我正在考虑。

scripts.text: No, I've never thought about it.
scripts.translation: 没有，我从来没想过。

scripts.text:
[Kardui]
Ah, that's tood bad.
It's one of the main attractions of Eclage.
scripts.translation:
[卡尔杜伊]
啊，那太遗憾了。
那可是埃克拉珠的主要看点之一。

scripts.text:
[Kardui]
Then I can trust you and give some works.
My brother is in Bifrost Tower,
and I would like you to deliver a letter to him.
scripts.translation:
[卡尔杜伊]
那我就可以信任你，交给你一些工作了。
我哥哥在双层牛肉堡，
我想请你给他送封信。

scripts.text:
[Kardui]
Since this is something personal, I'm aksing you, my friend. Will you do it for me?
Think of this as a way of paying me back.
scripts.translation:
[卡尔杜伊]
既然是私事，我就以朋友的身份拜托你了。你愿意帮我吗？
就当是还我刚才的人情吧。

scripts.text:
[Kardui]
You will find him on the top floor of Bifrost Tower.
He lives there.
Give him this, please.
scripts.translation:
[卡尔杜伊]
你可以在双层牛肉堡的顶层找到他。
他就住在那里。
请把这个交给他。

scripts.text: Kardui gave a letter to you.
scripts.translation: 卡尔杜伊给了你一封信。

scripts.text:
[Kardui]
If it wasn't for him, I would have become like Seneth, who knows?
....
The other one is pretty important, too. I'll be counting on you!
scripts.translation:
[卡尔杜伊]
如果不是因为他，谁知道我会不会变成像塞内斯那样的人呢？
....
另一件事也很重要。拜托你了！

scripts.text:
[Hisie]
It's been a while
since the last time we talked to each other like this.
scripts.translation:
[希西]
我们像这样聊天，
已经很久没有过了。

scripts.text: How did you get in here?
scripts.translation: 你是怎么进来的？

scripts.text:
[Hisie]
I just did.
I think the security is not as tight as before.
I had no trouble getting in.
scripts.translation:
[希西]
我直接进来的。
我觉得安保措施没以前那么严了。
我进来得很轻松。

scripts.text:
[Kardui]
I feel like I'm dreaming.
So, if the security is like this, will I be able to see you everyday?
They should keep it this way.
scripts.translation:
[卡尔杜伊]
我简直像在做梦一样。
既然安保措施这么松，那我是不是可以天天来看你了？
他们最好一直这样。

scripts.text:
[Kardui]
No, brother. Just stay here.
Don't go back to the tower...
scripts.translation:
[卡尔杜伊]
不，兄弟。你就待在这里吧。
别回中央塔去了...

scripts.text:
[Hisie]
You'll get in trouble then.
I'll come more often instead. That should be enough.
scripts.translation:
[希西]
那样你会惹上麻烦的。
我会更常来这里的。这样就够了。

scripts.text: Eh...
Get to the point!
scripts.translation: 说重点！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I understand that you're so happy to see your brother, but this is enough.
Aren't you embarrassed? I almost felt sick...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我知道你见到哥哥很高兴，但适可而止吧。
你不觉得尴尬吗？我都快吐了...

scripts.text:
[Kardui]
If you felt sick, then it's a big problem.
If you ever get sick, I'll guarantee your living from now on.
Poor thing...
scripts.translation:
[卡尔杜伊]
如果你真的觉得恶心，那就是大问题。
如果你生病了，我以后保证你的生活费。
真是可怜...

scripts.text: You know it doesn't mean that!!
scripts.translation: 你误会了！！

scripts.text:
[Kardui]
Ah, you're right.
So, there must have been some progress since both of you are here together?
scripts.translation:
[卡尔杜伊]
啊，你说得对。
那么，既然你们两个一起来了，事情一定有了进展吧？

scripts.text:
[Hisie]
It feels so new now that I see you with my own eyes.
I don't know how this sounds to you, but I think it's a good thing that you became Mayor.
scripts.translation:
[希西]
亲眼看到你，感觉一切都焕然一新。
不知道这话听起来怎么样，但我觉得你当上市长是件好事。

scripts.text:
[Kardui]
Eh? Brother, what do you mean?
You're joking...
scripts.translation:
[卡尔杜伊]
呃？兄弟，你什么意思？
你在开玩笑吧...

scripts.text:
[Hisie]
I mean it's good to see you bright and cheerful.
If I go on, your companion will really get sick, so I'll get to the point.
scripts.translation:
[希西]
我是说看到你精神焕发很好。
再说下去，你的同伴真的要吐了，所以我直说了。

scripts.text:
[Hisie]
I found out where Avant is.
He's living in Eclage.
Moreover, I think he's into some kind of experiments.
scripts.translation:
[希西]
我找到阿旺在哪里了。
他住在埃克拉珠。
而且，我觉得他在进行某种实验。

scripts.text:
[Kardui]
No way, is he doing something weird again?
Even if he isn't, I want to interrupt him so badly.
Hehehe...
scripts.translation:
[卡尔杜伊]
不会吧，他又在搞什么奇怪的东西？
就算不是，我也想打断他。
嘿嘿嘿...

scripts.text:
[Hisie]
Me, too.
I don't know what it is, but I would like to see his work.
scripts.translation:
[希西]
我也是。
我不知道那是什么，但我想看看他的研究成果。

scripts.text:
[Kardui]
Avant hates something exceptional that happens out of his routine, right?
Let's make it happen. Let's make tons of exceptional situations.
scripts.translation:
[卡尔杜伊]
阿旺讨厌打破他日常规律的事情，对吧？
那就让他打破吧。让我们制造大量的意外情况。

scripts.text:
[Hisie]
Should we go now?
Get ready. Let's go.
scripts.translation:
[希西]
我们现在就出发吗？
做好准备。我们走。

scripts.text:
[Kardui]
Just thinking about it makes me so excited!
Take care of my brother, please.
scripts.translation:
[卡尔杜伊]
光是想想我就好兴奋！
请照顾好我的兄弟。

scripts.text:
[Kardui]
Anyway, I had no idea he would be doing a research on things like this.
Brother, you know what it means, right?
scripts.translation:
[卡尔杜伊]
总之，我没想到他会在研究这种东西。
哥哥，你知道这意味着什么，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Hisie]
This is a research on extracting the magical powers of the Orb.
He must have gone crazy.
He has been doing everything that is prohibited since forever...
scripts.translation:
[希西]
这是关于提取宝珠魔力的研究。
他肯定疯了。
他一直在做那些被禁止的事情...

scripts.text:
[Kardui]
Well...but thanks to that, we're here.
It's soooo irritating though.
scripts.translation:
[卡尔杜伊]
嗯...不过多亏了他，我们才能走到这一步。
真是让人火大。

scripts.text:
[Hisie]
Oh...right.
Anyway, this time, he has gone too far.
Did you expect this when you told me to find Avant all of a sudden?
scripts.translation:
[希西]
啊...对。
总之，这次他做得太过分了。
你突然让我去找阿旺的时候，你有预料到这种情况吗？

scripts.text:
[Kardui]
Well, I don't know. I just felt something uneasy from Yggdrasil.
I didn't know what exactly it was, but while I was pondering on it, Avant just came across my mind.
scripts.translation:
[卡尔杜伊]
嗯，我不知道。我只是从世界树那里感到了一丝不安。
我不知道具体是什么，但当我正在思考这件事时，阿旺的名字突然浮现在脑海中。

scripts.text: How are Yggdrasil and the Orb related?
scripts.translation: 世界树和宝珠有什么关系？

scripts.text:
[Kardui]
You might think they're not related at all, but the Orb is the essence of all magical powers of us Laphines.
You could say that it is filled with a tremendous amount of magical powers.
scripts.translation:
[卡尔杜伊]
你可能觉得它们毫无关系，但宝珠是我们拉菲涅斯人所有魔力的精华。
可以说，它蕴含着巨大的魔力。

scripts.text:
[Kardui]
If one could extract magical powers from the Orb, just like Avant's research, 
he gets to possess great power with no effort.
scripts.translation:
[卡尔杜伊]
如果有人能像阿旺的研究那样从宝珠中提取魔力，
他就能毫不费力地拥有强大的力量。

scripts.text:
[Kardui]
If somebody steals magical powers from the Orb with ulterior motives and starts using it...
scripts.translation:
[卡尔杜伊]
如果有人怀着不可告人的目的从宝珠中窃取魔力并开始使用它...

scripts.text:
[Hisie]
It's a disaster.
When looking at the results, he was close to completing the research. 
It's a relief if we're the only ones that know about the results of this research...
scripts.translation:
[希西]
那就是一场灾难。
从结果来看，他几乎完成了研究。
如果只有我们知道这个研究的结果，那就谢天谢地了...

scripts.text:
[Kardui]
The Orb is in danger if there is anyone else who knows about it.
I will heighten security around it.
scripts.translation:
[卡尔杜伊]
如果还有其他人知道这件事，宝珠就处于危险之中。
我会加强宝珠周围的安全措施。

scripts.text:
[Hisie]
I will question Avant persistently.
What are you going to do?
scripts.translation:
[希西]
我会持续审问阿旺。
你打算怎么做？

scripts.text: Should I help protecting the Orb?
scripts.translation: 我要帮忙保护宝珠吗？

scripts.text: Come on, I'm a busy person.
scripts.translation: 算了，我很忙的。

scripts.text: [Kardui]
scripts.translation: [卡尔杜伊]

scripts.text:
[Kardui]
I'm glad to hear that.
The Orb is going to be alright if you help us.
scripts.translation:
[卡尔杜伊]
很高兴听到你这么说。
如果你帮助我们，宝珠就会没事的。

scripts.text:
[Kardui]
Whatever.
You have to keep what you've seen and heard to yourself.
You understand?
scripts.translation:
[卡尔杜伊]
随便你。
但你必须对你看到和听到的事情守口如瓶。
你明白吗？

scripts.text:
[Kardui]
Thank you brother.
Both of you should leave the Orb to me and take some rest.
And promise me to keep it secret.
scripts.translation:
[卡尔杜伊]
谢谢你，哥哥。
你们两个应该把宝珠交给我，然后去休息一下。
并且答应我保守这个秘密。

scripts.text:
[Kardui]
{0}.
This is a present for you.
I hope my magical powers help you improve.
scripts.translation:
[卡尔杜伊]
{0}。
这是给你的礼物。
希望我的魔力能帮助你提升。

scripts.text:
[Kardui]
What's that look for?
You didn't bring anything?
Did you forget and leave it somewhere? Go bring it.
scripts.translation:
[卡尔杜伊]
这是什么表情？
你没带任何东西吗？
是不是忘了落在哪里了？去把它拿回来。

scripts.text:
[Kardui]
I'm sure everyone will come forward in honor since it's for the sake of the Orb.
No one would argue when it comes to protecting the Orb.
scripts.translation:
[卡尔杜伊]
我相信大家都会为了宝珠的利益而挺身而出。
当涉及到保护宝珠时，没有人会提出异议。

scripts.text:
[Kardui]
No, more precisely, he didn't know that the scholar he was sponsoring was actually Avant.
Anyway, I don't have a say in his personal sponsorship matters.
scripts.translation:
[卡尔杜伊]
不，更准确地说，他不知道他资助的学者其实是阿旺。
总之，我对他的个人资助事务没有发言权。

scripts.text:
[Kardui]
Just like my brother said, we'd be so glad if you help us.
We need your help.
scripts.translation:
[卡尔杜伊]
就像我哥哥说的，如果你能帮助我们，我们会非常感激。
我们需要你的帮助。

scripts.text:
[Hisie]
Did you find out anything?
On the surface, there is no room for doubt. 
He sponsored a scholar by chance, whom he happened to meet by another chance.
scripts.translation:
[希西]
你查出什么了吗？
表面上看，没有疑点。
他偶然资助了一位学者，而这位学者又是他偶然遇到的。

scripts.text: When I told him everything...
scripts.translation: 当我告诉他一切时...

scripts.text:
[Kardui]
Did you tell him that the scholar is Avant?
Did you tell him about the research, too?
scripts.translation:
[卡尔杜伊]
你告诉他那位学者是阿旺了吗？
你也告诉他关于研究的事情了吗？

scripts.text:
[Hisie]
But in the end, Shenime didn't know anything about the scholar he was sponsoring and he had no idea about the scholar's personal research?
scripts.translation:
[希西]
但最后，谢尼梅对他资助的学者一无所知，也完全不了解学者的个人研究？

scripts.text:
[Hisie]
But he could be pretending not to know anything when he actually knows everything.
We can't find out anything this way...
scripts.translation:
[希西]
但他可能只是在假装什么都不知道，实际上他什么都知道。
这样我们什么也查不出来...

scripts.text: He was more interested in the Orb than the scholar of magics.
scripts.translation: 他对宝珠的兴趣比对魔法学者更大。

scripts.text:
[Kardui]
It's too bad...
So, it's more likely that Avant did a research on his own?
By the way, every Laphine has a great interest in the Orb.
scripts.translation:
[卡尔杜伊]
真是可惜...
那么，阿旺更可能是独自进行研究的？
顺便说一下，每个拉芬人都对宝珠很感兴趣。

scripts.text: He is trying to get me involved.
scripts.translation: 他正试图让我卷入其中。

scripts.text:
[Hisie]
Get you involved? What does that mean?
scripts.translation:
[希西]
让你卷入其中？那是什么意思？

scripts.text: Tell him about the conversation you had with Shenime.
scripts.translation: 告诉他你和谢尼梅的对话内容。

scripts.text:
[Kardui]
...Wow..if he doesn't trust me that much, why does he still let me be in this place?
Is it because the authority of Mayor is not transferable unless I die?
scripts.translation:
[卡尔杜伊]
...哇...如果他不那么信任我，为什么还让我留在这个职位上？
是因为市长的权力除非我死否则无法转移吗？

scripts.text:
[Kardui]
No matter how hard I've tried, I guess it wasn't enough to cure mistrusts among them.
Although I was aware of it, hearing it again makes me feel lonely.
scripts.translation:
[卡尔杜伊]
无论我多么努力，似乎都不足以消除他们之间的不信任。
虽然我已经意识到了，但再次听到这些让我感到孤独。

scripts.text:
[Hisie]
Don't take it seriously.
Let them think whatever they want to and leave them alone.
Kar, you just have to remain steadfast in your beliefs.
scripts.translation:
[希西]
别太往心里去。
让他们想什么就什么，随他们去吧。
卡尔，你只需要坚持自己的信念。

scripts.text:
[Hisie]
All that aside, I'm sure Shenime is hiding something.
Otherwise, he wouldn't let a foreigner like you be in charge of the Orb.
scripts.translation:
[希西]
不管怎样，我确信谢尼梅在隐瞒什么。
否则，他不会让像你这样的外国人负责宝珠。

scripts.text:
[Kardui]
You're right, my brother.
He told you to wait and see? A witness hoping that I'm normal?
I thought he was different from other officials and treated me without prejudice, but it was all a lie...
scripts.translation:
[卡尔杜伊]
你说得对，哥哥。
他让你等着看？一个希望我表现正常的见证人？
我以为他和其他官员不同，对我没有偏见，但原来都是谎言...

scripts.text:
[Hisie]
Kar, he is just one of many Laphines out there.
You know it already. It's nothing new.
scripts.translation:
[希西]
卡尔，他只不过是众多拉芬人中的一个。
你早就知道了。这没什么新鲜的。

scripts.text:
[Hisie]
It's okay. Some day, everyone will recognize
that you're not a doll that needs to be protected, but a ture Mayor.
scripts.translation:
[希西]
没关系。总有一天，大家都会认识到，你不是一个需要被保护的玩偶，而是一位真正的市长。

scripts.text:
[Kardui]
Right. If I'm just carried away by my feelings, I'm not different from Seneth.
Let's think about the problems we're facing right now.
scripts.translation:
[卡尔杜伊]
没错。如果我任由情绪左右，我和塞内斯就没有区别了。
让我们想想目前面临的问题吧。

scripts.text:
[Kardui]
{0}
It seems like I always ask you a favor.
Please help me again this time.
scripts.translation:
[卡尔杜伊]
{0}
看来我总是向你求助。
这次也请帮帮我。

scripts.text: I'm at your service.
scripts.translation: 我随时为您效劳。

scripts.text:
[Kardui]
Why is Shenime trying to get you involved in this. Of course he has his reasons like witness or evidence or whatever...
I'm sure there's something more.
scripts.translation:
[卡尔杜伊]
谢尼梅为什么要让你卷入其中。当然他有他的理由，比如见证人或证据之类的...
我确信还有更深层的原因。

scripts.text:
[Kardui]
I can't get rid of this anxiety..
And it's about you, the Orb, and Shenime.
scripts.translation:
[卡尔杜伊]
我无法摆脱这种不安...
这与你、宝珠，还有谢尼梅有关。

scripts.text:
[Kardui]
But I feel so reassured knowing that you, who could be the key to the case, are on my side. 
I don't know why Shenime is trying to get you involved, but you should approach him actively.
scripts.translation:
[卡尔杜伊]
但想到你——这个案件的关键——站在我这边，我感到很安心。
我不知道谢尼梅为什么要拉你入局，但你应该主动去接触他。

scripts.text:
[Kardui]
I'll be counting on you.
scripts.translation:
[卡尔杜伊]
就拜托你了。

scripts.text:
[Hisie]
I'll be staying here for a while, so come straight here anytime if you ever find anything.
Thanks.
scripts.translation:
[希西]
我会在这里待一段时间，如果你发现什么线索，随时直接来这里。
谢谢。

scripts.text:
[Kardui]
I hope my fears about Shenime are unfounded. 
I can't be sure of anything right now.
scripts.translation:
[卡尔杜伊]
我希望我对谢尼梅的担忧是多余的。
现在我对任何事都无法确定。

scripts.text:
[Kardui]
So, I'll leave Shenime into your hands.
There's nothing I can do to help you since I'm not the one who reigns here.
Sorry for asking you too many favors.
scripts.translation:
[卡尔杜伊]
所以，谢尼梅的事就交给你了。
既然这里不是由我统治，我也帮不上什么忙。
抱歉让你帮了这么多忙。

scripts.text:
[Kardui]
But there is a huge difference between knowing it and letting someone else know it on purpose.
I would like to question him myself, but since you're involved, it will eventually look like I'm the one who caused all this.
scripts.translation:
[卡尔杜伊]
但“知道”和“故意让别人知道”之间有着巨大的差别。
我想亲自审问他，但既然你卷入了其中，最后看起来会像是我惹出了这一切。

scripts.text:
[Hisie]
Don't be impatient. 
Nothing has happened yet.
Instead, shouldn't we be thinking about how to deal with Shenime in the future?
scripts.translation:
[希西]
别急躁。
现在还没发生什么。
相反，我们是不是应该想想未来该如何应对谢尼梅？

scripts.text: Hisie is right.
scripts.translation: 希西说得对。

scripts.text:
[Kardui]
....What we can do...right now...
{0} is you doing whatever Shenime tells you to do and finding out the truth...?
scripts.translation:
[卡尔杜伊]
...我们现在能做的...
{0} 就是照谢尼梅说的去做，查明真相...吗？

scripts.text:
[Kardui]
I guess there's no other way.
Just in case, I'll send additional troops there.
Do whatever Shenime wants you to do.
scripts.translation:
[卡尔杜伊]
我想没有别的办法了。
以防万一，我会派增援部队过去。
照谢尼梅的要求去做吧。

scripts.text:
[Kardui]
For now, we just have to believe...that Shenime did all this unintentionally.
scripts.translation:
[卡尔杜伊]
眼下，我们只能相信...谢尼梅做这一切是无心的。

scripts.text: What about the Orb?
scripts.translation: 宝珠怎么样了？

scripts.text:
[Kardui]
Laphines don't know yet.
Although the Orb's inner core is gone, my brother and I are collecting our magical powers and supplying the Orb constantly.
scripts.translation:
[卡尔杜伊]
拉菲尼斯还不知道。
虽然宝珠的内核消失了，但我哥哥和我正在聚集魔力，持续为宝珠供能。

scripts.text:
[Kardui]
It's a trick of the eye though...but no one noticed it.
Surprisingly, our magical powers were pretty strong.
Haha...do we have to thank Avant for this?
scripts.translation:
[卡尔杜伊]
这其实是一种视觉错觉...但没人发现。
令人惊讶的是，我们的魔力相当强大。
哈哈...我们要感谢阿旺吗？

scripts.text:
[Kardui]
I'm just two to three times more tired than usual.
If you're asking me about how I feel, magical powers are oozing of my body and it doesn't feel that great.
Would I be able to collect these abundant magical powers and fill the Orb's inner core?
scripts.translation:
[卡尔杜伊]
我只是比平时累了两三倍。
如果你问我的感受，魔力正从我的身体里渗出，感觉不太好。
我能收集这些充沛的魔力，填补宝珠的内核吗？

scripts.text:
[Hisie]
......Don't work too hard.
No matter how much I help, our magical powers will reach the limit some day.
scripts.translation:
[希西]
......别太勉强自己。
无论我帮多少，我们的魔力总有一天会达到极限。

scripts.text:
[Kardui]
Let's think about that later. 
Anyway...I heard from Nydhog.
The Chief of Staff seemed to be manipulated by a subordinate of Morocc.
scripts.translation:
[卡尔杜伊]
这个以后再说吧。
总之...我从尼德霍格那里听到了消息。
参谋长似乎被莫罗克的一个下属操纵了。

scripts.text:
[Kardui]
How could I have not known.
...Was I really a king in name only...
scripts.translation:
[卡尔杜伊]
我怎么会不知道。
...难道我真的只是一个名义上的国王...

scripts.text:
[Kardui]
We have to take care of the Orb and Shenime, but the biggest problem right now is {0} taking care -.
Everyone should keep that in mind.
scripts.translation:
[卡尔杜伊]
我们必须处理宝珠和谢尼梅的事，但眼下最大的问题是{0}的处理。
大家都应该记住这一点。

scripts.text:
[Hisie]
I see. The situation is not good since the elders is blaming you for the incident that took place in the lighting room.
scripts.translation:
[希西]
我明白了。情况不太妙，因为长老们正在责怪你，认为是你导致了照明室发生的那起事故。

scripts.text:
[Kardui]
I just told the elders that the Orb is fine.
What they care about the most is the death of our soldiers and Shenime's whereabouts.
scripts.translation:
[卡尔杜伊]
我刚才已经告诉长老们，宝珠没有问题。
他们最关心的是我们士兵的死亡，以及谢尼梅的下落。

scripts.text: Tell him about Avant.
scripts.translation: 告诉他关于阿旺的事

scripts.text:
[Kardui]
Right. Avant is in the prison, where you were imprisoned for a moment.
I almost forgot that he is the main culprit of this.
scripts.translation:
[卡尔杜伊]
没错。阿旺就在监狱里，也就是你之前被短暂关押的地方。
我差点忘了，他才是这起事件的主要罪魁祸首。

scripts.text: You told him about the conversation you had with Avant.
scripts.translation: 你告诉他了你和阿旺的对话内容。

scripts.text:
[Hisie]
...........
So, in the end, we're all manipulated by Shenime, no I mean, by the king of demons.
scripts.translation:
[希西]
...........
原来如此，到头来，我们都被谢尼梅操控了，不，应该说，是被恶魔之王操控了。

scripts.text:
[Hisie]
Then we return to the problem of {0}- ....
Fortunately, Laphines that you've helped are taking your side.
scripts.translation:
[希西]
那么，我们回到{0}的问题上...-
幸好，你帮助过的拉菲尼斯站在我们这边。

scripts.text:
[Kardui]
That's a relief.
However, even if they admit that it was self-defense on the outside,
they wouldn't believe it in their hearts.
scripts.translation:
[卡尔杜伊]
那就好。
不过，即使对外宣称这是正当防卫，
他们心里也不会相信。

scripts.text: I'll go after Shenime!
scripts.translation: 我要去追谢尼梅！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Although I was acting in self-defense, it's true that I...hurt the soldiers.
Give me a chance to pay back.
I'll find Shenime, the main instigator of everything. I'll find the Orb, too!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
虽然我是出于正当防卫，但确实...我伤害了士兵。
请给我一个弥补的机会。
我会找到谢尼梅，这个一切事件的始作俑者。我也会找到宝珠！

scripts.text:
[Kardui]
...If you think so,
I'll hold you responsible for this incident and give you an order to find Shinime.
scripts.translation:
[卡尔杜伊]
...如果你这么想的话，
我将追究你在这起事故中的责任，并命令你去寻找谢尼梅。

scripts.text:
[Kardui]
It's perfect if you could find the Orb
but we'll have to get ready for the worst.
I'm going to talk to Avant.
scripts.translation:
[卡尔杜伊]
如果你能找到宝珠那就完美了，
但我们必须做好最坏的打算。
我要去和阿旺谈谈。

scripts.text:
[Kardui]
......It was a perfect chance to kill him.
Too bad.
Now I have to ask him a favor.
scripts.translation:
[卡尔杜伊]
......这本来是个除掉他的绝佳机会。
真可惜。
现在我还得求他帮忙。

scripts.text:
[Hisie]
Kar, everything is going to be fine.
Don't be impatient.
We have protectors here. It will all work out.
scripts.translation:
[希西]
卡尔，一切都会好起来的。
别急躁。
这里有守护者。一切都会顺利的。

scripts.text:
[Hisie]
Are we pretty much decided then?
Let Kar proceed with the official works and {0} let - be in charge of finding Shenime.
As for me, I'll stay with Kar since I have to add my magical powers to the Orb as well.
scripts.translation:
[希西]
那么，我们基本决定了吗？
让卡尔继续处理官方事务，由{0}负责寻找谢尼梅。
至于我，我会留在卡尔身边，因为我必须为宝珠注入魔力。

scripts.text:
[Kardui]
That's good to hear, brother.
scripts.translation:
[卡尔杜伊]
听到你这么说，我很欣慰，兄弟。

scripts.text:
[Kardui]
I'll manage to guarantee your freedom of action,
so find Shenime, please.
According to my brother, ^4d4dffyou will be able to find clues somewhere in Bifrost.^000000
scripts.translation:
[卡尔杜伊]
我会保证你的行动自由，
所以请找到谢尼梅。
根据我兄弟的说法，^4d4dff你应该能在双层牛肉堡的某个地方找到线索。^000000

scripts.text:
[Kardui]
Find Shenime, please.
According to my brother, ^4d4dffyou will be able to find clues somewhere in Bifrost.^000000
scripts.translation:
[卡尔杜伊]
请找到谢尼梅。
根据我兄弟的说法，^4d4dff你应该能在双层牛肉堡的某个地方找到线索。^000000

scripts.text:
[Kardui]
How is it possible that no one knows it?
Is this because of our mental laziness and carelessness...?
scripts.translation:
[卡尔杜伊]
怎么可能没有人知道这件事？
难道是因为我们思想上的懒惰和疏忽...？

scripts.text:
[Kardui]
I have to stay alert myself.
The corpse of the Chief of Staff will help in imposing my will on others.
scripts.translation:
[卡尔杜伊]
我自己也必须保持警惕。
参谋长的尸体将有助于我向他人施加我的意志。

scripts.text:
[Kardui]
It may be tough, but from now on, I'll prepare to fight against the king of demons.
That's the best I can do right now.
scripts.translation:
[卡尔杜伊]
虽然会很艰难，但从今往后，我将准备与恶魔之王战斗。
这是我目前能做的最好的事了。

scripts.text:
[Kardui]
You've been a great help all this time.
Will you stay as my friend now and forever?
May the blessing of Yggdrasil be upon you...
scripts.translation:
[卡尔杜伊]
这段时间你帮了大忙。
现在和将来，你愿意一直做我的朋友吗？
愿世界树的祝福与你同在...

scripts.text: - You have too many items to proceed with the quest. -
scripts.translation: - 你的物品栏已满，无法继续任务。 -

scripts.text:
[Leo]
Welcome to Eclage, the capital of Laphines and a gateway to Alpheim.
I hope you enjoy your trip.
scripts.translation:
[里奥]
欢迎来到埃克拉珠，这里是拉菲尼斯的首都，也是通往阿尔海姆的门户。
祝您旅途愉快。

scripts.text:
[Leo]
Hi, how are you?
scripts.translation:
[里奥]
嗨，你好吗？

scripts.text:
[Leo]
How are you, really!
scripts.translation:
[里奥]
你还好吗，真的！

scripts.text: Does he want something?
scripts.translation: 他想要什么？

scripts.text: It's a strange fairy!
scripts.translation: 是个奇怪的妖精！

scripts.text:
[Leo]
Mayor Jun told us
that you would do anything for Laphines and Eclage.
scripts.translation:
[里奥]
卡尔杜伊市长告诉我们，
你会为了拉菲尼斯和埃克拉珠做任何事。

scripts.text:
[Leo]
In order to take care of the urgent matter...
scripts.translation:
[里奥]
为了处理这件紧急的事情...

scripts.text: No, I refuse!
scripts.translation: 不，我拒绝！

scripts.text: What do you want me to do?
scripts.translation: 你想让我做什么？

scripts.text:
[Leo]
Although you have all the rights to say no, this is what I get...
I understand.
scripts.translation:
[里奥]
虽然你完全有权利说不，但这就是我得到的结果...
我理解。

scripts.text:
[Leo]
It's nothing more than a request for Pinguicula's pickled fruits and Luciola's honey jam,
which are specialties of Splendide...
scripts.translation:
[里奥]
这不过是请求一些捕虫堇的腌渍水果和毒黄蜂的蜜桶，
它们是辉煌领域的特产...

scripts.text:
[Leo]
I know it's something personal...but Hazy Forest is such a huge obstacle...
so I couldn't help but...
scripts.translation:
[里奥]
我知道这是私事...但迷雾森林是个巨大的障碍...
所以我忍不住...

scripts.text: You said it's something urgent!!!
scripts.translation: 你说是紧急的事情！！！

scripts.text:
[Leo]
I feel like I might die if I don't eat them!!!
What's more urgent than this?!!?!?
scripts.translation:
[里奥]
如果我不吃它们，我觉得我会死掉！！！
还有什么比这更紧急的吗？!!?!

scripts.text:
[Leo]
You visit Splendide pretty often anyway!
On your way back, just carry one under your arm, another in your hand, please~
I won't ask you anything like this ever again!
scripts.translation:
[里奥]
反正你经常去辉煌领域！
回来的时候，请一只手臂夹一个，另一只手拿一个，拜托~
我以后绝不会再向你提这种要求了！

scripts.text:
[Leo]
So...is that yes?
I need 3 jars of Pinguicula's pickled fruits and another 3 jars of Luciola's honey jam~
They are sold inside the base of Splendide.
scripts.translation:
[里奥]
那么...算是答应了？
我需要3罐捕虫堇的腌渍水果和另外3罐毒黄蜂的蜜桶~
它们在辉煌领域基地内部有售。

scripts.text:
[Leo]
You might need Splendide Coins to buy pickled fruits and honey jam.
You could earn those coins if you work in Splendide, so...hehe..........
scripts.translation:
[里奥]
你可能需要辉煌领域金币来购买腌渍水果和蜜桶。
如果你在辉煌领域工作，就能赚取这些金币，所以...嘿嘿..........

scripts.text:
[Leo]
Helping out in Splendide is eventually helping Eclage, too.
Now, go for it!
scripts.translation:
[里奥]
在辉煌领域帮忙，最终也是在帮助埃克拉珠。
好了，去吧！

scripts.text:
[Leo]
Oh...no. I'm not a weird Laphine.
You got me wrong. It's a misunderstanding...
scripts.translation:
[里奥]
啊...不。我不是那种奇怪的拉芬。
你误会了。这是个误会...

scripts.text:
[Leo]
I need 3 jars of Pinguicula's pickled fruits and another 3 jars of Luciola's honey jam~
They are specialties of the base of Splendide.
I'll be counting on you!
scripts.translation:
[里奥]
我需要3罐捕虫堇的腌渍水果和另外3罐毒黄蜂的蜜桶~
它们是辉煌领域基地的特产。
拜托你了！

scripts.text:
[Leo]
Ohhhhh look at that!!!
Sweet pickled fruits and honey jam that is even sweeter!!!
You saved my life.
I don't know how I managed to live without these sweets!
scripts.translation:
[里奥]
哇啊啊啊看看那个！！！
甜甜的腌渍水果，还有更甜的蜜桶！！！
你救了我的命。
我不知道没有这些甜点我是怎么活下来的！

scripts.text:
[Leo]
I should judge you again.
It seems like Mayor Jun has an eye for character.
So he is Mayor after all...
scripts.translation:
[里奥]
我应该重新审视一下你。
看来朱恩市长很有眼光。
所以他确实是市长没错...

scripts.text:
[Eclage Guard]
Here you are.
Mayor Jun told me to find you since you've done enough.
Have you done Leo's work, too?
scripts.translation:
[埃克拉珠卫兵]
给你。
朱恩市长让我来找你，因为你已经做得够多了。
你也帮里奥办完事了吗？

scripts.text:
[Eclage Guard]
I see.
I'll tell you what he said then.
scripts.translation:
[埃克拉珠卫兵]
我明白了。
那我告诉你他说了什么。

scripts.text:
[Eclage Guard]
Although you might want to work even more for Eclage,
I think you've done enough.
As a matter of fact, it's not that important, but I just wanted to make you do it.
scripts.translation:
[埃克拉珠卫兵]
虽然你可能想为埃克拉珠做更多，
但我觉得你已经做得够多了。
其实这并不重要，我只是想让你做这件事。

scripts.text:
[Eclage Guard]
That's it.
He said you would know the meaning upon hearing this. Now if you'll excuse me..
scripts.translation:
[埃克拉珠卫兵]
就是这样。
他说你会听到后明白其中的含义。那么，失陪了..

scripts.text:
[Leo]
Well, that's what he said.
It might be inappropriate for me to say this since I'm the one asking the favor,
but I don't understand why Mayor does this.
scripts.translation:
[里奥]
嗯，他就是这么说的。
虽然是我在请求帮忙，由我来说这话可能不太合适，
但我不明白市长为什么要这么做。

scripts.text:
[Leo]
Anyway, I'll make sure to report your story to the superior office, and you will hear from them sooner or later.
scripts.translation:
[里奥]
总之，我会把你的事迹上报给上级部门，你迟早会收到他们的回信。

scripts.text:
[Eclage Guard]
Here you are.
Mayor Jun told me to find you since you've done enough.
Have you done Leo's work, too?
scripts.translation:
[埃克拉珠卫兵]
给你。
朱恩市长让我来找你，因为你已经做得够多了。
你也帮里奥办完事了吗？

scripts.text:
[Eclage Guard]
I see.
I'll tell you what he said then.
scripts.translation:
[埃克拉珠卫兵]
我明白了。
那我告诉你他说了什么。

scripts.text:
[Eclage Guard]
Although you might want to work even more for Eclage,
I think you've done enough.
As a matter of fact, it's not that important, but I just wanted to make you do it.
scripts.translation:
[埃克拉珠卫兵]
虽然你可能想为埃克拉珠做更多，
但我觉得你已经做得够多了。
其实这并不重要，我只是想让你做这件事。

scripts.text:
[Eclage Guard]
That's it.
He said you would know the meaning upon hearing this. Now if you'll excuse me..
scripts.translation:
[埃克拉珠卫兵]
就是这样。
他说你会听到后明白其中的含义。那么，失陪了..

scripts.text:
[Leo]
I don't want to know about what he told you.
I'm just guessing that there is some kind of conspiracy between you and Mayor Jun.
What on earth is he thinking...
scripts.translation:
[里奥]
我不想知道他对你说了什么。
我只是猜测你和朱恩市长之间有什么阴谋。
他到底在想什么...

scripts.text:
[Leo]
Let's stop talking about Mayor Jun.
Just think about what you have to do right now.
scripts.translation:
[里奥]
别谈朱恩市长了。
想想你现在该做什么吧。

scripts.text:
[Leo]
Hmm...Are you and Mayor Jun involved in some kind of conspiracy?
The more I think about it, I feel like there is something going on.
What on earth is he thinking...
scripts.translation:
[里奥]
嗯...你和朱恩市长是不是有什么阴谋？
越想越觉得有什么不对劲。
他到底在想什么...

scripts.text:
[Leo]
The honey jam and pickled fruits were so delicious.
Those guys in the base must be feasting on these everyday.
scripts.translation:
[里奥]
蜜桶和腌渍水果真好吃。
基地里那些人肯定天天都在吃这些。

scripts.text:
[Leo]
I've already reported about your cooperation to the superior office.
Don't worry.
I think I might have to see you again sooner or later.
scripts.translation:
[里奥]
我已经把你的合作情况上报给上级部门了。
别担心。
我想我迟早还会再见到你。

scripts.text:
[Leo]
Hmm...Are you and Mayor Jun involved in some kind of conspiracy?
The more I think about it, I feel like there is something going on.
What on earth is he thinking...
scripts.translation:
[里奥]
嗯...你和朱恩市长是不是有什么阴谋？
越想越觉得有什么不对劲。
他到底在想什么...

scripts.text:
[Leo]
Let's stop talking about Mayor Jun.
Just think about what you have to do right now.
scripts.translation:
[里奥]
别谈朱恩市长了。
想想你现在该做什么吧。

scripts.text:
[Leo]
As far as you know, the perception of Kardui among Laphines is somewhat favourable on the outside.
But in reality, the majority of Laphines feel uneasy, distrustful, and doubtful about him.
Let's stop worrying and ask Kardui instead!
scripts.translation:
[里奥]
据你所知，拉芬人对卡尔杜伊的看法在表面上还算友好。
但实际上，大多数拉芬人对他都感到不安、不信任和怀疑。
别担心了，直接去问卡尔杜伊吧！

scripts.text:
As far as you know, the perception of Kardui among Laphines is somewhat favourable on the outside.
But in reality, the majority of Laphines feel uneasy, distrustful, and doubtful about him.
Let's stop worrying and ask Kardui instead!
scripts.translation:
据你所知，拉芬人对卡尔杜伊的看法在表面上还算友好。
但实际上，大多数拉芬人对他都感到不安、不信任和怀疑。
别担心了，直接去问卡尔杜伊吧！

scripts.text:
Leo doesn't seem to trust Kardui, who is their king.
If you have a chance, you'll be able to listen to other Laphines as well.
scripts.translation:
里奥似乎不信任他们的国王卡尔杜伊。
如果有机会，你也能听听其他拉芬人的看法。

scripts.text:
[Leo]
Let's stop talking about Mayor Jun.
Just think about what you have to do right now.
scripts.translation:
[里奥]
别谈朱恩市长了。
想想你现在该做什么吧。

scripts.text:
[Leo]
By the way, Bifrost Tower must be a generator of monsters.
When you eliminate one, there appears another one, and this goes on and on...
It like you're sprinting only to find yourself standing at the starting line again.
scripts.translation:
[里奥]
顺便说一句，中央塔肯定是魔物的生成器。
消灭一个，另一个就会出现，如此反复...
就像你拼命冲刺，结果发现自己又回到了起跑线。

scripts.text:
[Leo]
Welcome to Eclage.
- ,{0}who recently became famous.
scripts.translation:
[里奥]
欢迎来到埃克拉珠。
- ，最近名声大噪的{0}。

scripts.text:
[Leo]
They never get exhasted.
There has been a stream of complaints regarding safety from travellers. 
Seriously...they're so annoying.
scripts.translation:
[里奥]
它们永远不知疲倦。
最近有很多旅行者投诉安全问题。
真是...烦死了。

scripts.text:
[Leo]
Since we bear down on them while we're on patrol,
thankfully there's less complaints from travellers.
scripts.translation:
[里奥]
既然我们在巡逻时会压制它们，
还好，旅行者的投诉变少了。

scripts.text:
[Leo]
You've done a great job again.
Here, it's a reward.
scripts.translation:
[里奥]
你又干得漂亮。
拿着，这是给你的奖励。

scripts.text:
[Leo]
5 bodies of Menblatt and Fetal, each.
You know?
scripts.translation:
[里奥]
花妖精和花瓣怪虫各5只。
你懂吧？

scripts.text:
[Leo]
How's everything today?
I have a work that is somewhat good and beneficial for you.
It's to eliminate Menblatta and Petals that appear in the blooming field.
scripts.translation:
[里奥]
今天一切都好吗？
我有个对你来说不错且有益的工作。
就是去消灭出现在花田里的花妖精和花瓣怪虫。

scripts.text: [Leo]
scripts.translation: [里奥]

scripts.text:
[Leo]
Only if your level was higher, I could have guided you to a nice route for a walk...
That's too bad.
scripts.translation:
[里奥]
要是你的等级再高一点，我就能带你去一条不错的散步路线了...
真可惜。

scripts.text:
[Leo]
I ask you to eliminate them when you patrol the area next time.
Whew...
scripts.translation:
[里奥]
下次你巡逻这片区域时，麻烦把它们清理掉。
呼...

scripts.text:
[Leo]
If you don't mind, let's go patrol the area again.
scripts.translation:
[里奥]
如果不介意的话，我们再去巡逻这片区域吧。

scripts.text:
[Leo]
If you want, please return this time tomorrow.
I'll make your position secure. Of course, your job is to patrol in the blooming field.
Hahaha!
scripts.translation:
[里奥]
如果你愿意，明天这个时候再来吧。
我会确保你的位置安全。当然，你的任务是在花田里巡逻。
哈哈！

scripts.text:
[Leo]
Honestly, isn't Menblatt pretty?
I wonder how it became that....pretty.
Laphines? No, they're not Laphines.
scripts.translation:
[里奥]
说实话，花妖精挺漂亮的吧？
真不知道它们怎么会变得这么...漂亮。
拉芬人？不，它们不是拉芬人。

scripts.text:
[Leo]
Petal? Petals are so cute, too.
I would like to have one in my Yai.
But...you saw it.
scripts.translation:
[里奥]
花瓣怪虫？花瓣怪虫也很可爱。
我想在我的Yai里养一只。
但是...你也看到了。

scripts.text:
[Leo]
They trample flower beds!
That's why they're unacceptable...
scripts.translation:
[里奥]
它们会践踏花坛！
所以它们是不可接受的...

scripts.text:
[Leo]
There have been many complaints from travellers saying that those guys bother travellers for no reason.
Do you want to do it?
scripts.translation:
[里奥]
有很多旅行者投诉说那些家伙无缘无故地骚扰他们。
你想去做吗？

scripts.text: I'll go! I'll do it! I'll get rid of them!
scripts.translation: 我去！我来做！我把它们清理掉！

scripts.text: I don't feel like it today.
scripts.translation: 我今天不想去。

scripts.text: Don't you want pickled fruits?
scripts.translation: 你不想要腌水果吗？

scripts.text:
[Leo]
Look at your fighting spirit!
Alright, let's go! But of couse! Only you will go!
Let's go punish Menblatts and Petals that bother travellers and trample flower beds!
scripts.translation:
[里奥]
看看你的斗志！
好，走吧！不过当然！只有你去！
让我们去惩罚那些骚扰旅行者、践踏花坛的花妖精和花瓣怪虫吧！

scripts.text:
[Leo]
Ah...you don't want to?
I'll have to do it alone.
All by myself...
scripts.translation:
[里奥]
啊...你不想去？
那我只好自己去了。
就我一个人...

scripts.text:
[Leo]
Ah..pickled fruits.
I decided not to eat it for some time.
I ate so much that I took to my bed with a bad toothache.
.........isn't it depressing.
scripts.translation:
[里奥]
啊...腌水果。
我决定暂时不吃了。
我吃得太多了，结果牙疼得卧床不起。
.........真让人沮丧。

scripts.text: [Leo]
scripts.translation: [里奥]

scripts.text:
[Leo]
You have to punish 5 Menblatts and 5 Petals.
They will be playing all over the blooming field, in which stands Bifrost Tower in front of Eclage.
You know already, right?
scripts.translation:
[里奥]
你需要惩罚5只花妖精和5只花瓣怪虫。
它们会在埃克拉珠前方的双层牛肉堡周围的花田里玩耍。
你应该已经知道了，对吧？

scripts.text: You don't like the king?
scripts.translation: 你不喜欢国王吗？

scripts.text:
[Leo]
No, it's not that I don't like him. I'm rather concerned...or having trouble trusting him...something like that.
Since he didn't do anything wrong, I don't have any reason to hate him, but..
scripts.translation:
[里奥]
不，不是我不喜欢他。我更多的是担心...或者说对他有些难以信任...大概是这样吧。
既然他没有做错什么，我并没有理由恨他，但是...

scripts.text:
[Leo]
there was a precedent
and it's a pretty rare case...so I'm just concerned in many ways.
It should not bother a foreigner like you.
scripts.translation:
[里奥]
之前有过先例，
而且这种情况相当罕见...所以我在很多方面都很担忧。
这不应该困扰像你这样的外国人。

scripts.text: - You have too many items to proceed with the quest. -
scripts.translation: - 你的物品栏已满，无法继续任务。 -

scripts.text:
[Roy]
It's hard.
It really is hard.
The more I think about it, I feel like Shenime has a nasty temper.
scripts.translation:
[罗伊]
真难。
真的很难。
我越想越觉得谢尼梅脾气很坏。

scripts.text:
[Roy]
You, who appeared in this time of crisis.
You, who went through Hazy Forest Maze..Are you the guidance of god? Or a blessing from god?
scripts.translation:
[罗伊]
你，在这个危机时刻出现。
你，穿越了迷雾森林迷宫...你是神的指引？还是神的赐福？

scripts.text:
[Roy]
I guess I have no other choice.
They say Laphines are nothing without their pride, but since I value my life over pride,
can I ask you a favor?
scripts.translation:
[罗伊]
我想我别无选择。
据说拉菲人如果没有尊严就什么都不是，但既然我把生命看得比尊严更重要，
我可以请你帮个忙吗？

scripts.text: What is it?
scripts.translation: 什么事？

scripts.text: No.
scripts.translation: 不。

scripts.text:
[Roy]
It's something difficult for Laphines, but for humans, it's very easy.
That is, brining the news from Splendide!
scripts.translation:
[罗伊]
这对拉菲人来说很难，但对人类来说非常简单。
那就是，从辉煌领域带回消息！

scripts.text:
[Roy]
Ah...
It took you less than a second to say no, how clear is that.
Now, I'll erase the memory of this very moment!
scripts.translation:
[罗伊]
啊...
你连一秒都没用就拒绝了，这态度多鲜明啊。
现在，我要抹去这一刻的记忆！

scripts.text:
[Roy]
[Eclage Guard]
Here you are.
Mayor Jun told me to find you since you've done enough.
Have you done Leo's work, too?
scripts.translation:
[罗伊]
[埃克拉珠卫兵]
你来了。
市长朱恩让我来找你，因为你的任务已经完成了。
里奥的任务你也完成了吗？

scripts.text:
[Roy]
[Roy]
...Only if we could get that...canned food, too...we wouldn't have to suffer so much like this...
scripts.translation:
[罗伊]
[罗伊]
...如果我们也能弄到那些...罐头食品...我们就不用像这样受苦了...

scripts.text:
[Roy]
I should take care of it but...
my magical powers are not all that great.
scripts.translation:
[罗伊]
我应该去处理的，但是...
我的魔力并不怎么强大。

scripts.text:
[Roy]
...well, you don't need to know the details!
You just need to collect mails from the contact officer in Splendide.
scripts.translation:
[罗伊]
...好吧，你不需要知道细节！
你只需要去辉煌领域找联络官收集信件。

scripts.text:
[Roy]
There's nothing confidential, so you can do it, too.
Bringing one mail. I'm sure it's easy for you.
scripts.translation:
[罗伊]
没有什么机密内容，所以你也可以做。
带一封回来。我相信对你来说很容易。

scripts.text: Leave it to me!
scripts.translation: 交给我吧！

scripts.text: I don't want to.
scripts.translation: 我不想。

scripts.text:
[Roy]
Good!
Go to Splendide and meet the contact officer!
Collect mails that are not confidential and could be a love letter to someone!
and bring them to me, please.
scripts.translation:
[罗伊]
很好！
去辉煌领域找联络官！
收集那些非机密且可能是情书的信件！
然后带给我，拜托了。

scripts.text:
[Roy]
What? You're saying no after making me talk all this time?
....Well, things happen.
But you'll come back. So I'm not worried.
scripts.translation:
[罗伊]
什么？让我说了这么多之后你才说不？
....好吧，世事无常。
但你一定会回来的。所以我并不担心。

scripts.text:
[Roy]
Ah...
It took you less than a second to say no, how clear is that.
Now, I'll erase the memory of this very moment!
scripts.translation:
[罗伊]
啊...
你连一秒都没用就拒绝了，这态度多鲜明啊。
现在，我要抹去这一刻的记忆！

scripts.text:
[Roy]
Isn't that easy?
I'll be standing here and waiting for you to bring me that mail.
scripts.translation:
[罗伊]
这不是很简单吗？
我会站在这里，等你把那封信带给我。

scripts.text:
[Roy]
Hehe. I knew it.
From the moment they picked me for this job,
everything is in 'the big invisible hand!!'
scripts.translation:
[罗伊]
呵呵。我就知道。
从他们选中我担任这个工作的那一刻起，
一切都在“无形的大手”掌控之中！！

scripts.text:
[Roy]
So that I could ask you again with a renewed mind.
Ahahahah...ha...hahha..hahaa..
scripts.translation:
[罗伊]
这样我才能用全新的态度再次请求你。
啊哈哈...哈...哈哈哈..哈哈...

scripts.text:
[Roy]
Let me explain again.
Go to Splendide and meet the contact officer!
Collect mails that are not confidential and could be a love letter to someone!
and bring them to me, please.
scripts.translation:
[罗伊]
让我再解释一遍。
去辉煌领域找联络官！
收集那些非机密且可能是情书的信件！
然后带给我，拜托了。

scripts.text:
[Roy]
This is right. This is the right box.
You've done it right.
See, there's nothing important here.
Most of them are just personal letters asking about each other's health.
scripts.translation:
[罗伊]
没错，就是这个箱子。
你做得很好。
看，这里没有什么重要的东西。
大部分都只是询问彼此近况的私人信件。

scripts.text:
[Roy]
Now, I have to go and make a report on these mails. 
Thank you.
scripts.translation:
[罗伊]
现在，我得去汇报这些信件的情况了。
谢谢。

scripts.text:
[Eclage Guard]
Here you are.
Mayor Jun told me to find you since you've done enough.
Have you done Leo's work, too?
scripts.translation:
[埃克拉珠卫兵]
给你。
朱恩市长让我来找你，因为你已经做得够多了。
你也帮里奥办完事了吗？

scripts.text:
[Eclage Guard]
I see.
I'll tell you what he said then.
scripts.translation:
[埃克拉珠卫兵]
我明白了。
那我告诉你他说了什么。

scripts.text:
[Eclage Guard]
Although you might want to work even more for Eclage,
I think you've done enough.
As a matter of fact, it's not that important, but I just wanted to make you do it.
scripts.translation:
[埃克拉珠卫兵]
虽然你可能想为埃克拉珠做更多，
但我觉得你已经做得够多了。
其实这并不重要，我只是想让你做这件事。

scripts.text:
[Eclage Guard]
That's it.
He said you would know the meaning upon hearing this. Now if you'll excuse me..
scripts.translation:
[埃克拉珠卫兵]
就是这样。
他说你会听到后明白其中的含义。那么，失陪了..

scripts.text:
[Roy]
Did you hear that?
scripts.translation:
[罗伊]
你听到了吗？

scripts.text:
[Roy]
...Only if we could get that...canned food, too...we wouldn't have to suffer so much like this...
scripts.translation:
[罗伊]
...要是能弄到那些...罐头食品就好了...这样我们就不用像现在这样受苦了...

scripts.text:
[Roy]
There are just too many useless letters.
What's even worse is that long-distance couples send love letters and...
Why a messenger like me has to listen to other people's love stories?
scripts.translation:
[罗伊]
无用的信件实在太多了。
更糟糕的是，异地恋的人还会寄来情书...
像我这样的信使，为什么要听别人的爱情故事？

scripts.text:
[Roy]
Collect the mailbox from the contact officer
in the advanced base of Splendide.
Isn't that easy?
scripts.translation:
[罗伊]
去辉煌领域的前进基地找联络官，
把邮箱取回来。
这不是很简单吗？

scripts.text:
[Roy]
Hmm...once again, it's filled with useless letters saying hello
and bragging about animal horns.
Thank you.
scripts.translation:
[罗伊]
嗯...又是那些打招呼、
炫耀锹形虫角的无用信件。
谢谢。

scripts.text:
[Roy]
Um, I'm sorry,
but could you go again?
to Splendide, to collect the mails...
scripts.translation:
[罗伊]
那个，不好意思，
能麻烦你再跑一趟吗？
去辉煌领域收集信件...

scripts.text:
[Roy]
I can make it to Mora Village.
But how can I go through Hazy Forest? All alone?
...Ah.. I'm just feeling sorry for myself, so just continue on your way.
scripts.translation:
[罗伊]
我能走到穆拉村庄。
但我怎么独自穿过迷雾森林呢？
...啊...我只是在自怜，请继续赶路吧。

scripts.text:
[Roy]
To recall what the guard that just dropped by said,
Mayor wants to meet you, right?
Don't you have to go?
scripts.translation:
[罗伊]
回想一下刚才路过的卫兵说的话，
市长想见你，对吧？
你不该去吗？

scripts.text:
[Roy]
In the end, I'm not a messenger, but a mailman.
...That's right. Actually, I'm not even a mailman. Ah....
scripts.translation:
[罗伊]
到头来，我不是信使，只是个邮差。
...没错。其实我连邮差都算不上。啊....

scripts.text:
[Roy]
It's about time that the mailbox was filled up.
...I get more anxious as time goes by.
scripts.translation:
[罗伊]
邮箱应该快满了吧。
...时间越久，我就越焦虑。

scripts.text:
[Roy]
...I thought it'd be so nice to become a soldier...
So I applied to the advanced base, but I became a messenger and eventually......
scripts.translation:
[罗伊]
...我曾以为当士兵会很好...
所以我申请了前进基地，结果却成了信使，最后......

scripts.text:
[Roy]
...There will be those useless love letters again after some time, right?
You bring them, and I deliver them. You could say we're a couple, too. A delivery couple.
scripts.translation:
[罗伊]
...过段时间，那些无用的情书又会来吧？
你送来，我送达。可以说我们也是一对情侣。一对投递情侣。

scripts.text: - From the back, Roy seems lonely. -
scripts.translation: - 从背后看，罗伊显得很孤独。 -

scripts.text:
[Roy]
Since you've done such a good job,
I'll be in charge of delivering mails in Eclage and
...let's work together on a regular basis, please?
scripts.translation:
[罗伊]
既然你做得这么好，
就由我负责埃克拉珠的信件投递吧，
...请让我们长期合作，好吗？

scripts.text:
[Roy]
Promise me that you will work with me again, please.
This is a little something for you.
I'll be looking forward to seeing you!
scripts.translation:
[罗伊]
请答应我，以后还要和我合作。
这是给你的小礼物。
期待再次见到你！

scripts.text: Sure.
scripts.translation: 当然。

scripts.text: I don't feel like it today.
scripts.translation: 我今天不想去。

scripts.text:
[Roy]
Thank you so much.
Go to Splendide, meet the contact officer, and collect the mailbox.
scripts.translation:
[罗伊]
非常感谢。
去辉煌领域，找联络官，把邮箱取回来。

scripts.text:
[Roy]
Ek!
I didn't know you would say no like that...
scripts.translation:
[罗伊]
哎呀！
没想到你会这么干脆地拒绝...

scripts.text: [Roy]
scripts.translation: [罗伊]

scripts.text:
[Roy]
Mails from Eclage are sent along with the supplies for the base,
but they can't send us mails.
scripts.translation:
[罗伊]
来自埃克拉珠的信件是随基地补给一起送来的，
但他们无法给我们寄信。

scripts.text:
[Roy]
It has to be done on a regular basis, so you've been a great help.
I'll be waiting for you here.
scripts.translation:
[罗伊]
这需要定期处理，所以你的帮助非常宝贵。
我会在这里等你。

scripts.text: - You have too many items to proceed with the quest. -
scripts.translation: - 你的物品栏已满，无法继续任务。 -

scripts.text:
[Contact Officer]
Mm...give that box to Roy, please.
Roy will take care of it.
scripts.translation:
[联络官]
嗯...请把那个箱子交给罗伊。
罗伊会处理好的。

scripts.text:
[Contact Officer]
What is it?
Someone from the camp?
scripts.translation:
[联络官]
怎么了？
是营地的人吗？

scripts.text:
[Contact Officer]
Thank you for helping us again. 
Bring it to Roy and he will know what to do.
scripts.translation:
[联络官]
再次感谢你的帮助。
把它交给罗伊，他会知道该怎么做。

scripts.text:
[Contact Officer]
You're here to collect the mails again?
I have one mailbox that is filled up...
scripts.translation:
[联络官]
你又是来取信件的？
我有一个邮箱已经满了...

scripts.text:
[Contact Officer]
You from the camp?
Have you been to Eclage?
If you went as far as Mora, you should visit Eclage as well. 
It's so beautiful there.
scripts.translation:
[联络官]
你是营地的人？
你去过埃克拉珠吗？
既然都走到穆拉了，应该也去看看埃克拉珠吧。
那里非常美丽。

scripts.text:
[Contact Officer]
Um, it's too hard for us to go through Hazy Forest, and the roads are blocke because of a rift...
It's a big problem. I'm getting old because of the stress!
scripts.translation:
[联络官]
嗯，对我们来说穿越迷雾森林太难了，而且因为裂缝，道路也被封锁了...
这是个很大的问题。压力让我都变老了！

scripts.text:
[Contact Officer]
Mails from Eclage are sent along with the supplies for the base.
Before, it was hard to send mails from this side to that side. But thanks to you, we no longer have a problem sending mails and we're so happy.
scripts.translation:
[联络官]
来自埃克拉珠的信件是随基地补给一起送来的。
以前，从这边寄信到那边很困难。但多亏了你，我们现在寄信不再有问题了，真让人高兴。

scripts.text:
[Contact Officer]
You're from Eclage?
Hmm? Roy? I see. I've been waiting for so long.
scripts.translation:
[联络官]
你是从埃克拉珠来的？
嗯？罗伊？我明白了。我已经等了很久了。

scripts.text:
[Contact Officer]
I knew it'd be almost impossible to get here...but I was waiting just to be sure.
What a relief that you came on Roy's behalf!
Give this box to Roy, please.
scripts.translation:
[联络官]
我知道这几乎不可能...但我还是等着以防万一。
你代表罗伊来了，真是松了一口气！
请把那个箱子交给罗伊。

scripts.text:
[Contact Officer]
Well, most of them are personal letters, so it's more of a mail delivery.
Please, help us out.
scripts.translation:
[联络官]
嗯，大部分是私人信件，所以这更像是送信。
请帮帮我们。

scripts.text: Yes, that's what I'm for.
scripts.translation: 是的，这是我的职责。

scripts.text: No, that's not why I'm here.
scripts.translation: 不，我不是为此而来的。

scripts.text:
[Contact Officer]
Here, take this.
Everyone in the base is so excited
that they can send anything they want.
scripts.translation:
[联络官]
给你，拿着这个。
基地里的每个人都很兴奋，
因为他们现在可以寄任何想要的东西了。

scripts.text:
[Contact Officer]
Huh...really.
That's sad.
Well.. What can I say.
scripts.translation:
[联络官]
啊...是吗。
真可惜。
唉...我也没什么好说的。

scripts.text: [Contact Officer]
scripts.translation: [联络官]

scripts.text:
[Contact Officer]
Don't dump anything on the way or throw anything,
but deliver them safely, please.
scripts.translation:
[联络官]
路上不要丢弃或扔任何东西，
请安全送达。

scripts.text:
A female Laphine and a male Laphine are talking about something.
But they stopped talking as soon as they saw me. 
I think I've interrupted the conversation.
scripts.translation:
一只女性拉菲尼和一只男性拉菲尼正在交谈。
但看到我后，他们立刻停止了说话。
我想我打扰到他们的谈话了。

scripts.text:
[Female Laphine]
Ahhhh I didn't say anything. I didn't...
It's true that I'm one of the most talkative Laphines in town, but I don't tell everything down to the last detail.
scripts.translation:
[女性拉菲尼]
啊...我什么都没说。我没有...
虽然我是镇上最健谈的拉菲尼之一，但我不会把每个细节都告诉别人。

scripts.text:
[Female Laphine]
So, you'd better not try to find out something from me, outsider!
scripts.translation:
[女性拉菲尼]
外乡人，你最好别试图从我这里套出什么话来！

scripts.text:
[Male Laphine]
You shouldn't get involved in the matters of other races.
Especially when it's something like family affairs.
scripts.translation:
[男性拉菲尼]
你不该插手其他种族的内政。
尤其是像家事这种私事。

scripts.text:
[Male Laphine]
You're visiting Eclage?
I hope you have a good time here.
scripts.translation:
[男性拉菲尼]
你是来埃克拉珠游玩的吗？
希望你在这里度过愉快的时光。

scripts.text:
[Female Laphine]
Honestly, aren't you concerned?
It's been a good while, but
you can't say it will never happen again.
scripts.translation:
[女性拉菲尼]
说实话，你不担心吗？
虽然已经过了很久，
但也不能说这种事永远不会再发生。

scripts.text:
[Male Laphine]
...Hmm.
It's true that it goes against common sense.
But isn't it okay as long as he doesn't tyrannize like Seneth did?
scripts.translation:
[男性拉菲尼]
……嗯。
确实，这违背常理。
但只要他不像塞内斯那样暴政，不就没问题了吗？

scripts.text:
[Female Laphine]
That's what I'm concerned about.
No one can be sure that he won't do the same.
To be honest, I never experienced it myself. But just listening about the times when Seneth was Mayor is more than enough.
scripts.translation:
[女性拉菲尼]
这正是我担心的地方。
没人能保证他不会重蹈覆辙。
老实说，我自己并没有经历过那段时期。但光是听听塞内斯当市长时的事情，就足以让人不寒而栗了。

scripts.text:
[Female Laphine]
I'm glad I wasn't there during that time.
Don't you think Mayor...has to be perfect?
scripts.translation:
[女性拉菲尼]
我很庆幸自己没在那段时间待在这里。
你不觉得……市长必须是完美的吗？

scripts.text:
[Male Laphine]
Well, but there's no guarantee that the new Mayor will do the same?
You think having a new Mayor is a good thing, too.
scripts.translation:
[男性拉菲尼]
嗯，但也没法保证新市长不会那样做吧？
你也觉得换一位新市长是件好事。

scripts.text:
[Female Laphine]
That's true. But why does it have to be 'him'....
If it wasn't for that, I wouldn't be concerned like this...
scripts.translation:
[女性拉菲尼]
没错。但为什么偏偏是“他”……
如果不是因为那个人，我也不会这么担心……

scripts.text:
[Male Laphine]
That's enough.
That foreigner can hear you.
scripts.translation:
[男性拉菲尼]
够了。
那个外乡人听得见。

scripts.text: Actually, I've already heard you. Could you tell me more about it?
scripts.translation: 其实，我已经听到了。能多告诉我一些吗？

scripts.text: What was it about?
scripts.translation: 那是关于什么的？

scripts.text:
[Male Laphine]
No, I don't think we should.
Hahaha...
It's about us Laphines, so...
scripts.translation:
[男性拉菲尼]
不，我觉得不该说。
哈哈……
毕竟这是我们拉菲尼自己的事……

scripts.text:
[Female Laphine]
A foreigner like you doesn't need to know.
Stop eavesdropping and mind your own business.
scripts.translation:
[女性拉菲尼]
像你这样的外乡人不需要知道。
别偷听了，管好你自己的事吧。

scripts.text:
Mayor and tyrant? And what's Seneth?
Anyway, they seem to be worried about Kardui, the current Mayor.
Let's stop worrying and ask Kardui instead!
scripts.translation:
市长和暴君？还有塞内斯是谁？
总之，他们似乎很担心现任市长卡尔杜伊。
别担心了，直接去问卡尔杜伊吧！

scripts.text:
What Laphines said is interesting.
A story about a tyrant..should I listen to what other Laphines have to say?
scripts.translation:
拉菲尼们说的话很有趣。
关于暴君的故事……我该听听其他拉菲尼怎么说吗？

scripts.text:
Two Laphines from the upper class are talking about something.
One of them seems to be working and very annoyed. 
As if they were aware of my stare, they waved me away with a show of irritation.
scripts.translation:
两只上流阶层的拉菲尼正在谈论着什么。
其中一只看起来正在工作，而且非常烦躁。
仿佛察觉到了我的目光，它们带着恼怒的神情挥了挥手，示意我离开。

scripts.text:
[Visitor Laphine]
It's not appropriate for a foreigner to pay too much attention to our domestic affairs.
scripts.translation:
[来访的拉菲尼]
外乡人过分关注我们的内政，是不合适的。

scripts.text:
[Visitor Laphine]
I don't understand why there is a series of bad events in town...
Mayor was disconnected from Yggdrasil,
he became obsolete because of that,
and there's the rift, too.
scripts.translation:
[来访的拉菲尼]
我不明白为什么镇上接二连三地发生坏事……
市长与伊格德拉希尔断开了连接，
因此变得过时了，
而且还有裂缝的问题。

scripts.text:
[Visitor Laphine]
I heard the rift is created by the king of demons, and Saphas are in trouble because of that.
What's more, the new Mayor is...kind of...
scripts.translation:
[来访的拉菲尼]
我听说裂缝是由恶魔之王造成的，萨法也因此陷入了困境。
更糟糕的是，新市长……有点……

scripts.text:
[Visitor Laphine]
Could this be the sign of the end of the world?
Didn't we have something like this before?
What do you think?
scripts.translation:
[来访的拉菲尼]
这难道是世界末日的征兆吗？
我们以前好像也发生过类似的事情？
你觉得呢？

scripts.text:
[Working Laphine]
...I'm working. Don't bother me.
My head aches when I think about the rift. There is a big snag in sending supplies to Splendide because of that.
scripts.translation:
[工作中的拉菲尼]
……我在工作。别打扰我。
一想到裂缝我就头疼。正因为如此，向辉煌领域运送物资遇到了很大的麻烦。

scripts.text:
[Visitor Laphine]
Ah, come to think of it, you know humans that came through Hazy Forest.
I don't know what is on Mayor's mind, but he invites them and gives them works.
scripts.translation:
[来访的拉菲尼]
啊，对了，你知道那些穿过迷雾森林的人类吗。
我不知道市长在想什么，但他邀请他们，并给他们安排工作。

scripts.text:
[Visitor Laphine]
The current Mayor is exceptionally young,
and 'that'...
and he tries to meet foreigners...
Why is he like that?
scripts.translation:
[来访的拉菲尼]
现任市长异常年轻，
而且“那个”……
他还试图会见外乡人……
他为什么这样？

scripts.text:
[Working Laphine]
You mean a foreigner like the guy over there who's been listening to us?
Mayor meets him pretty often nowadays.
scripts.translation:
[工作中的拉菲尼]
你是指像那边一直在偷听我们的那个家伙一样的外乡人吗？
市长最近经常见他。

scripts.text:
[Visitor Laphine]
Ekk?!
Since when were you here?!
Don't sneak up like that. You're not supposed to be here.
scripts.translation:
[来访的拉菲尼]
咦？！
你什么时候在这里的？！
别偷偷摸摸的。你不应该在这里。

scripts.text: What is 'that?'
scripts.translation: “那个”是什么？

scripts.text:
[Working Laphine]
It's none of your business.
It's just a small talk between just two of us, so don't think about it.
Now, all visitors should leave the room.
scripts.translation:
[工作中的拉菲尼]
这不关你的事。
这只是我们两个之间的闲聊，别多想。
现在，所有访客都请离开房间。

scripts.text:
What is 'that' Laphines are talking about? It seems to be related to Kardui.
Let's stop worrying and ask Kardui instead!
scripts.translation:
拉菲尼们谈论的“那个”是什么？似乎与卡尔杜伊有关。
别担心了，还是去问问卡尔杜伊吧！

scripts.text:
What Laphines said is interesting.
I would like to listen more, but I have to go. Should I listen to what other Laphines have to say?
scripts.translation:
拉菲尼们说的话很有趣。
我想再听一会儿，但我必须走了。我该听听其他拉菲尼怎么说吗？

scripts.text:
[Working Laphine]
Do you have questions about our king?
However, the king of humans and our Mayor are incomparably different.
Don't apply the same concept when thinking about our Mayor.
scripts.translation:
[工作中的拉菲尼]
你对我们的国王有疑问吗？
然而，人类的国王和我们的市长是完全不同的。
思考我们的市长时，不要套用同样的概念。

scripts.text:
[Working Laphine]
I hope you don't show curiosity anymore.
Do you understand?
scripts.translation:
[工作中的拉菲尼]
我希望你不要再表现出好奇心了。
你明白了吗？

scripts.text:
[Working Laphine]
This is the office area designated for official business.
You're not supposed to be here.
scripts.translation:
[工作中的拉菲尼]
这是指定用于公务的办公区域。
你不应该在这里。

scripts.text:
[Hisie]
What are you staring at, traveller?
scripts.translation:
[希西]
旅行者，你在盯着什么看？

scripts.text:
[Hisie]
I'm sorry for making you wait.
I read the letter.
He said he wanted to introduce his friend, and I guess it's you.
scripts.translation:
[希西]
抱歉让你久等了。
我读了那封信。
他说他想介绍他的朋友，我想那就是你。

scripts.text:
[Hisie]
Did you find anything?
A scholar of magics sponsored by the Chief of Staff?
We'd better ask who he is and where he came from.
scripts.translation:
[希西]
你发现什么了吗？
由参谋长赞助的魔法学者？
我们最好问问他是谁，从哪里来的。

scripts.text:
[Hisie]
Was there any progress?
scripts.translation:
[希西]
有进展吗？

scripts.text:
[Hisie]
Did the Chief of Staff say that?
Unless he wants to surprise everyone with a great research,
I'm sure that scholar of magics is not a normal Laphine.
scripts.translation:
[希西]
是参谋长说的吗？
除非他想用一项伟大的研究来震惊所有人，
我确信那位魔法学者不是普通的拉菲尼。

scripts.text:
[Hisie]
Good, this is enough.
I'm thinking about going into Eclage without anyone noticing me.
scripts.translation:
[希西]
很好，这就够了。
我在考虑在不被任何人注意的情况下潜入埃克拉珠。

scripts.text:
[Hisie]
We need to find the materials for his experiment in order to approach him casually.
Let's bring him the materials and pretend Shenime sent you.
scripts.translation:
[希西]
我们需要找到他实验所需的材料，以便自然地接近他。
让我们带上材料，假装是谢尼梅派你来的。

scripts.text:
[Hisie]
Although he changed his hair color, it was Avant for sure. 
Just like they say 'the beacon does not shine on its own base.' keke...
scripts.translation:
[希西]
虽然换了发色，但肯定是阿旺。
俗话说“灯下黑”嘛，呵呵...

scripts.text:
[Hisie]
I see they are tightening the guard around the Orb...
and I feel like I forgot about something..
scripts.translation:
[希西]
看来他们加强了水晶周围的守卫...
总觉得我忘了什么事...

scripts.text:
[Hisie]
Since you had interactions with the Chief of Staff constantly, it'll be easier for you to approach him.
Although Kar is Mayor, he might be the one with the least power throughout history.
scripts.translation:
[希西]
既然你一直和参谋长打交道，接近他应该比较容易。
虽然卡尔是市长，但他可能是历史上权力最小的市长。

scripts.text:
[Hisie]
I've been spending more time at the palace thant here.
Since I have to send my magical powers to replace the Orb's inner core...
scripts.translation:
[希西]
我最近花在宫殿里的时间比在这里多。
因为我必须输送魔力来替换水晶的核心...

scripts.text:
[Hisie]
If you climbed all the way here out of curiosity, you'd better start going down now.
Professor has been under the weather nowadays.
scripts.translation:
[希西]
如果你只是好奇才爬到这里，最好现在就开始下山。
智者最近身体不太舒服。

scripts.text:
[Hisie]
Not yet, I'm still reading.
Just a minute.
scripts.translation:
[希西]
还没好，我还在看。
请稍等。

scripts.text:
[Hisie]
I ask you to be in charge of searching inside Eclage.
There will hardly be any clues, so it's going to be pretty tough.
scripts.translation:
[希西]
拜托你负责在埃克拉珠内部搜索。
线索会很少，所以会很艰难。

scripts.text:
[Hisie]
I need to see what Avant is researching about.
Let's hurry.
scripts.translation:
[希西]
我得去看看阿旺在研究什么。
快走吧。

scripts.text:
[Hisie]
You were supposed to bring Avant's research materials to Kar.
Why are you here?
scripts.translation:
[希西]
你本该把阿旺的研究资料带给卡尔。
你怎么在这里？

scripts.text:
[Hisie]
Let's go to Eclage.
I'm going to talk to Kar.
scripts.translation:
[希西]
我们去埃克拉珠。
我要去见卡尔。

scripts.text:
The Laphine standing in front of you is tall and dark-skinned, and he has small wings.
He seems to be a mix of Dona, the upper class Laphines, and Papang, the lower class Laphine.
Moreover...
scripts.translation:
站在你面前的拉菲尼身材高大，皮肤黝黑，长着小小的翅膀。
他似乎是上层拉菲尼多娜和下层拉菲尼帕潘格的混血。
而且...

scripts.text: He looks the same!!
scripts.translation: 他长得一模一样！！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
You, Laphine?
Why do you look exactly the same as Kardui?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你，拉菲尼？
为什么你和卡尔杜伊长得一模一样？

scripts.text:
[Hisie]
Is your job saying random things?
or is it commenting on my looks?
Who on earth are you?
scripts.translation:
[希西]
你的职业是胡说八道吗？
还是在评论我的长相？
你到底是什么人？

scripts.text:
[Hisie]
Did Kar send you?
scripts.translation:
[希西]
是卡尔派你来的吗？

scripts.text: I need to meet Kardui's brother.
scripts.translation: 我要见卡尔杜伊的哥哥。

scripts.text:
[Hisie]
......I guess Kar didn't tell you about me.
You didn't even ask the name of his brother and just came?
scripts.translation:
[希西]
......看来卡尔没告诉你关于我的事。
你连他哥哥的名字都没问就来了？

scripts.text:
[Hisie]
I'm Hisie, Kar's older brother.
The reason why we look alike is because we're twins.
You're here to bring me that letter in your hand, right?
scripts.translation:
[希西]
我是希西，卡尔的哥哥。
我们长得像是因为我们是双胞胎。
你是来把手里那封信给我的，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Hisie]
Maybe this is what he meant when he told me that I might have a guest over soon.
I'll read the letter. Just wait over there.
scripts.translation:
[希西]
也许这就是他告诉我可能很快会有客人来访的意思。
我要读信了。请在那边稍等。

scripts.text:
[Hisie]
It will only take a few minutes.
scripts.translation:
[希西]
只需要几分钟。

scripts.text:
[Hisie]
He probably wanted to surprise me.
He hasn't changed a bit.
I look pretty unique because, as you already know, I'm half Dona and half Papang.
scripts.translation:
[希西]
他大概是想给我个惊喜。
他一点都没变。
我看起来挺特别的，因为如你所知，我是半多娜半帕潘。

scripts.text:
[Hisie]
It's a long story, but I think you should know.
There was one more thing Kar mentioned in the letter besides introducing you.
scripts.translation:
[希西]
说来话长，但我觉得你应该知道。
除了介绍你之外，卡尔在信里还提到了另一件事。

scripts.text:
[Hisie]
But then...
Why is he looking for Avant now?
scripts.translation:
[希西]
但是...
他为什么现在要找阿旺？

scripts.text: Avant?
scripts.translation: 阿旺？

scripts.text: One more thing?
scripts.translation: 另一件事？

scripts.text:
[Hisie]
He wants me to find Avant.
And he says you'll be a great help?
scripts.translation:
[希西]
他想让我去找阿旺。
他说你会帮上大忙？

scripts.text:
[Hisie]
Avant is a scholar of magical powers...
...and the father of me and Kar.
But why did he choose you?
If it's something that he didn't want to tell anyone, he could have just told me.
scripts.translation:
[希西]
阿旺是一位魔法学者...
...也是我和卡尔的父亲。
但他为什么选了你？
如果是他不想告诉任何人的事，他完全可以只告诉我。

scripts.text:
[Hisie]
Anyway, I don't know Avant's whereabouts.
I don't want to know, and I want to stop Kar looking for him. But there must be a reason.
scripts.translation:
[希西]
总之，我不知道阿旺的下落。
我也不想知道，我想阻止卡尔去找他。但一定是有原因的。

scripts.text: But he's your father?
scripts.translation: 但他是你父亲？

scripts.text:
[Hisie]
He's just our biological father.
In reality, we're nothing more than materials for his experiments.
We are just objects that were made in an effort to prove his hypothesis.
scripts.translation:
[希西]
他只是我们的生物学父亲。
实际上，我们不过是他的实验材料。
我们只是为了验证他的假设而被制造出来的物品。

scripts.text:
[Hisie]
So, there can't be any relationship or love between us.
Kar could be looking for Avant in order to eliminate him.
scripts.translation:
[希西]
所以，我们之间不可能存在任何关系或爱意。
卡尔可能在找阿旺是为了除掉他。

scripts.text: Experiments? Hypothesis?
scripts.translation: 实验？假设？

scripts.text: Objects that were made?
scripts.translation: 被制造出来的物品？

scripts.text:
[Hisie]
Do you know about Seneth, who became Mayor even though he was half breed?
Avant must have been interested about the fact that half-blood became Mayor.
scripts.translation:
[希西]
你知道塞内斯吗？他虽然是混血，却当上了市长。
阿旺一定对混血儿能当市长这件事很感兴趣。

scripts.text:
[Hisie]
So, he developed a couple of hypotheses and did experiments in order to prove them.
Kar is a piece of work that Avant created with thorough preparations,
scripts.translation:
[希西]
于是，他提出了几个假设，并进行了实验来证明它们。
卡尔是阿旺精心准备后创造出来的作品，

scripts.text:
[Hisie]
while I am an accident that always happens in experiments. 
Anyway, Kar became the king but lost his whole life.
However, his hatred for Avant hasn't changed a bit.
scripts.translation:
[希西]
而我则是实验中总是会出现的意外。
总之，卡尔成为了国王，却失去了整个人生。
然而，他对阿旺的仇恨一点都没变。

scripts.text:
[Hisie]
But now, Kar is looking for Avant...?
Maybe he changed his mind or he has a plan. 
After becoming Mayor, that crybaby has grown so much.
scripts.translation:
[希西]
但现在，卡尔在找阿旺...？
也许他改变主意了，或者他有计划。
自从当上市长后，那个爱哭鬼成长了很多。

scripts.text: A crybaby?
scripts.translation: 爱哭鬼？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
You must be kidding that he's a crybaby.
The Kardui I know is very confident and skillful...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你肯定在开玩笑，说他是个爱哭鬼。
我认识的卡尔杜伊非常自信且技艺高超...

scripts.text:
[Hisie]
You're right. I know.
His personality has changed a lot ever since he became Mayor. 
I've wanted to see that with my own eyes.
scripts.translation:
[希西]
你说得对。我知道。
自从他当上市长后，性格变了很多。
我一直想亲眼看看。

scripts.text: What if you go and see him in person?
scripts.translation: 如果你亲自去看看他呢？

scripts.text:
[Hisie]
If I do, younger Laphines are going to be scared.
I'm not Dona nor Papang. I don't belong anywhere.
What Florence wanted to do once upon a time, creating a lineage of mixed blood.
Wouldn't he have wanted to create something like me?
scripts.translation:
[希西]
如果我去的话，年轻的拉菲尼斯们会害怕的。
我不是多娜，也不是帕潘格。我不属于任何地方。
弗洛伦斯曾经想做的事，就是创造混血的谱系。
他难道不正是想创造像我这样的存在吗？

scripts.text:
[Hisie]
Anyway, we should look for Avant?
It's been decades since his stupid experiment was caught by the elders and he disappeared.
I'm sure he's somewhere celebrating the success of his experiments.
He is like that.
scripts.translation:
[希西]
总之，我们应该去找阿旺？
自从他那愚蠢的实验被长老们发现并消失后，已经几十年了。
我确信他正在某个地方庆祝实验的成功。
他就是那样的人。

scripts.text:
[Hisie]
I'll let you search the inside of Eclage.
He was an excellent scholar of magics, so scholars who belong to the gate of the truth might know something.
scripts.translation:
[希西]
我会让你去埃克拉珠内部搜索。
他曾是优秀的魔法学者，所以属于真理之门的学者们可能知道些什么。

scripts.text:
[Hisie]
I'll be searching outside Eclage on my own.
I'm lucky if I could find the slightest trace.
Now, let's move!
scripts.translation:
[希西]
我会独自去埃克拉珠外部搜索。
如果我能找到哪怕一点线索，那也算幸运了。
现在，出发吧！

scripts.text:
[Hisie]
You can easily find Dustballs and bookmarks made of fallen leaves anywhere in this tower.
Just do what he asked you to do for now, and try to gather some information.
scripts.translation:
[希西]
在这座中央塔里，你很容易就能找到尘埃和由落叶制成的书签。
先做他让你做的事，试着收集一些信息。

scripts.text: Tell him about the information you received from Minuel.
scripts.translation: 告诉他你从米努埃尔那里得到的信息。

scripts.text:
[Hisie]
We should go check who the scholar of magics that Shenime sponsors is.
I accidentally found a laboratory Yai in the east.
scripts.translation:
[希西]
我们应该去查一下谢尼梅资助的那位魔法学者是谁。
我在东边偶然发现了一个亚伊实验室。

scripts.text:
[Hisie]
But since it's a Yai that is opened just like any other Yais for residence or a simple research...
it might not be a place for secret experiments or where Avant would hide in.
scripts.translation:
[希西]
但既然这是一个像其他用于居住或简单研究的亚伊一样开放的实验室...
它可能不是进行秘密实验的地方，也不是阿旺会藏身的地方。

scripts.text:
[Hisie]
Let's go check who he is since we don't have any clues other than that.
This is my plan.
scripts.translation:
[希西]
既然除了这个之外我们没有任何线索，那就去查一下他是谁吧。
这是我的计划。

scripts.text:
[Hisie]
I want you to pretend that Shenime sent you and bring him a Dustball and 10 bookmarks.
I'll hide and check from afar whether it's Avant or not.
scripts.translation:
[希西]
我要你假装是谢尼梅派你来的，给他带一个尘埃和10个书签。
我会躲起来，从远处确认他是不是阿旺。

scripts.text:
[Hisie]
I'm thinking about going into Eclage without anyone noticing me.
Meet me at the forked road before entering the plaza of Eclage.
Don't forget to bring the materials for experiments.
scripts.translation:
[希西]
我在考虑在不被任何人发现的情况下进入埃克拉珠。
在埃克拉珠广场前的岔路口与我汇合。
别忘了带上实验材料。

scripts.text:
[Hisie]
Usually, those geeks of the gate of the truth take pride in their works and don't like hiding it. 
There is definitely something about that scholar of magics. I'm concerned.
scripts.translation:
[希西]
通常，真理之门的那些书呆子们会以他们的作品为荣，不喜欢隐藏它。
那位魔法学者肯定有什么特别之处。我很担心。

scripts.text:
[Hisie]
We'd better do some research about him.
If we can't get any information about the scholar, we could track down Shenime.
scripts.translation:
[希西]
我们最好对他做一些调查。
如果我们无法获得关于那位学者的信息，我们可以追踪谢尼梅。

scripts.text:
[Hisie]
I'll leave that part to you.
I'm concerned about something, so I'm going to go and check it myself.
I'll be looking forward to hearing some good news!
scripts.translation:
[希西]
那部分交给你了。
我有些担心，所以我要亲自去查看一下。
期待听到好消息！

scripts.text:
[Hisie]
Meet me at the forked road before entering the plaza of Eclage.
Now, let's move!
scripts.translation:
[希西]
在埃克拉珠广场前的岔路口与我汇合。
现在，出发吧！

scripts.text:
[Hisie]
Fortunately, I've found those materials for them the other day. I just have to find the same things again.
There were 10 Dustballs and 10 bookmarks, right?
scripts.translation:
[希西]
幸运的是，前几天我已经找到了那些材料。我只需要再找到同样的东西。
是10个尘埃和10个书签，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Hisie]
I have to tell Kar about this.
Hurry up
scripts.translation:
[希西]
我必须把这件事告诉卡尔。
快一点

scripts.text: About Avant
scripts.translation: 关于阿旺

scripts.text: About the Chief of Staff
scripts.translation: 关于参谋长

scripts.text:
[Hisie]
That wicked man is just laughing and not saying anything.
He's just repeating the same answers like, 'because it's interesting,' or 'because it's fun.'
scripts.translation:
[希西]
那个卑鄙的家伙只是在那笑，什么也不说。
他只会重复同样的回答，比如“因为很有趣”或者“因为好玩”。

scripts.text:
[Hisie]
....!
Oh, right! The Chief of Staff!
How could I have forgotten about him?
I was too focused on Avant that I totally forgot about him.
scripts.translation:
[希西]
...！
对了！参谋长！
我怎么会把他忘了？
我光顾着担心阿旺，完全把他给忘了。

scripts.text: [Hisie]
scripts.translation: [希西]

scripts.text:
[Hisie]
Although I was expecting this...
dealing with his personality makes me just so annoyed.
scripts.translation:
[希西]
虽然早有心理准备...
但和他这种性格的人打交道，真的让我很烦躁。

scripts.text:
[Hisie]
Moreover, he's the one who rejected me as soon as he saw me. But he seems so interested in my body now,
and everytime I see him, I feel like I'm being examined and it horrifies me.
scripts.translation:
[希西]
而且，他一开始见到我就拒绝了我。但现在他似乎对我的身体很感兴趣，
每次见到他，我都觉得自己像是在被检查，这让我感到恐惧。

scripts.text:
[Hisie]
He's just amazed to see how I grew up to so clearly represent my mixed heritage.
I'll probably never admit that a person like him is my father!
scripts.translation:
[希西]
他对我长成现在这样，完美地体现了混血特征感到惊讶。
我大概永远不会承认像他这样的人是我的父亲！

scripts.text:
[Hisie]
The Chief of Staff doesn't know that Avant is imprisoned.
If he's the one who was pulling wires from behind, he'll be worried by now...
scripts.translation:
[希西]
参谋长不知道阿旺被囚禁了。
如果他是幕后操纵这一切的人，他现在应该很担心...

scripts.text: Should I go and check on him?
scripts.translation: 我要去确认一下他的情况吗？

scripts.text:
[Hisie]
Thanks for suggesting.
Please, help us out.
It doesn't look good if Kar or I go and handle it ourselves.
scripts.translation:
[希西]
谢谢你的建议。
请帮帮我们。
如果卡尔或我自己去处理，情况会很不妙。

scripts.text:
[Hisie]
Especially, if Kar does so, other Laphines might misunderstand him.
Prejudice can be very hurtful.
scripts.translation:
[希西]
特别是如果卡尔去的话，其他拉菲涅人可能会误解他。
偏见可能会造成很大的伤害。

scripts.text:
[Hisie]
Most Laphines want Kar to just keep the informations inherited from all the previous Mayors
and pass them on to the next Mayor quietly.
When he tries to do something, there is always a lot of resistance.
scripts.translation:
[希西]
大多数拉菲涅人希望卡尔只是安静地继承前任市长们的信息，
并传递给下一任市长。
当他试图做点什么时，总是会遇到很大的阻力。

scripts.text:
[Hisie]
Kar doesn't have many people on his side. 
So, I want you to be a help to him
I'll leave the Chief of Staff to you.
scripts.translation:
[希西]
卡尔身边没有多少人支持他。
所以，我希望你能成为他的帮手。
参谋长就交给你了。

scripts.text:
[Hisie]
If you find out something, return to where Kar is.
scripts.translation:
[希西]
如果你发现了什么，回到卡尔所在的地方。

scripts.text:
[Hisie]
I'm so thankful to you for your help.
Once everything goes back to normal, I would like to talk to you some more.
scripts.translation:
[希西]
非常感谢你的帮助。
等一切恢复正常后，我想和你多聊聊。

scripts.text:
[Hisie]
We're here.
I'll tell you where the laboratory Yai is.
If you follow this road and head east...
it's where I marked.
scripts.translation:
[希西]
我们到了。
我会告诉你雅伊实验室在哪里。
如果你沿着这条路往东走...
就是我标记的地方。

scripts.text:
[Hisie]
You have the materials for experiment, right?
You have to approach him casually as if Shenime sent you.
Now, let's go.
scripts.translation:
[希西]
你有实验用的材料，对吧？
你必须表现得随意一点，好像谢尼梅派你来的。
现在，走吧。

scripts.text:
[Hisie]
This is the right Yai.
Remember to be casual.
Don't go inside, but make him come outside.
scripts.translation:
[希西]
这就是正确的雅伊。
记得要表现得随意。
不要进去，让他出来。

scripts.text:
[Hisie]
Since it's Avant's Yai, there might be equipped with some devices.
Anyway, let's wait and see if there's any chance.
scripts.translation:
[希西]
既然是阿旺的雅伊，可能配备了一些装置。
不管怎样，让我们先看看有没有机会。

scripts.text:
[Hisie]
Did you pack Dustballs and bookmarks made of fallen leaves?
You have to hurry.
